# Standard Operating Procedure: Final Automated Test Equipment JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing

High-volume packaged component socket testing, timing parameter characterization (tCK, tRCD, tRP, tAC), high-temperature operating life (HTOL) stress, and speed bin grading.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In high-speed DDR qualification at 180nm, signal integrity across the Device Under Test (DUT) loadboard interface is the primary throughput bottleneck. Direct pin-electronics loopback and trace impedance mismatches (> +/- 5 Ohms from standard 50-Ohm single-ended / 100-Ohm differential targets) induce excessive ringing, jitter, and ground bounce during double-data-rate strobing (DQS/DQ). High-temperature operating life (HTOL) burn-in boards must incorporate matched-impedance transmission lines and local decoupling capacitors rated for continuous operation at 125°C to avoid false functional failures during in-situ pattern verification.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DDR1/DDR2 memory architecture implemented in an open-source 180nm process is severely bounded by cell leakage in the planar 1T1C storage capacitor node (trench or stacked Ta2O5/SiO2/Si3N4 dielectric). Under JEDEC JESD22-A108 HTOL conditions (125°C junction temperature, VDD_stress = 1.25x nominal VDD), the retention time tREF degrades exponentially via Fowler-Nordheim and trap-assisted tunneling. Guardbanding must account for refresh margin degradation from nominal 64ms down to <= 8ms at elevated temperatures, requiring precise march test algorithms (March C- and March SS) executed across both nominal and stressed corner voltage domains.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom high-density burn-in boards (BIB) with polyimide/BT substrates and gold-plated Kelvin burn-in sockets (e.g., clamshell or CSP/FBGA sockets rated to 150°C) represent long-lead procurement risks (12 to 16 weeks). Dual-sourcing of compatible burn-in sockets and standardization onto commercial ATE platforms (such as Advantest T5588/T5386 or Teradyne UltraFLEX) with universal DIB (Device Interface Board) layouts is critical to prevent testing backlogs across Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) qualification timelines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test cell utilization costs scale sharply during extended 1000-hour HTOL qualification cycles. The test flow must be bifurcated into rapid, high-coverage ATE room-temperature/cold/hot speed-bin screening (tAC, tRCD, tRP, tRAS parametric test vectors in < 2.5 seconds per packaged die) followed by mass-parallel socketed HTOL chamber stressing with intermittent periodic readouts (at 48h, 168h, 500h, and 1000h) to safeguard program schedule and budget.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic cell retention loss and bit-flip failures caused by temperature-accelerated subthreshold junction leakage and trap-assisted tunneling in the 1T1C access transistor at 125°C.
1. Interconnect open circuits or resistance surges caused by electromigration in BEOL TiN/Al-Cu/TiN metal lines under high current density during continuous write/read cycling at HTOL stress voltages.
1. Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown (TDDB) of the thin gate oxide in access transistors and high-voltage sense-amplifier pull-up PMOS drivers under sustained 1.25x VDD electrical overstress.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-01` | **JEDEC AC Timing and Double Data Rate Speed-Bin Characterization** | Automated Test Equipment (Advantest T5588 or equivalent high-speed memory tester) equipped with 50-Ohm matched impedance pin-electronics, programmable algorithmic pattern generator (APG), parametric measurement units (PMU), and thermal conditioning socket (Enplas CSP/BGA socket with active thermal head +/- 0.5°C). | 1. Clamp packaged DUT into the ATE thermal socket and ramp interface temperature to 85°C. 2. Initialize DRAM controller registers via Mode Register Set (MRS) command sequence with CAS Latency (CL) = 2.5/3.0. 3. Apply standard March C- pattern (Write 0 up, Read 0/Write 1 up, Read 1/Write 0 down, Read 0 down) using programmable APG across the full memory array at target clock frequencies from 100 MHz up to 200 MHz in 5 MHz increments. 4. Measure tRCD (RAS-to-CAS delay), tRP (Row Precharge time), tAC (Access time from CK/CK#), and setup/hold times (tIS, tIH, tDS, tDH) using fine-delay verniers (20 ps resolution). 5. Record functional shmoo plots of supply voltage (VDD from 2.0V to 2.8V) versus clock frequency (tCK). | `Device operates error-free (0 bit fails) across all address spaces up to >= 166 MHz (DDR-333 grade) or >= 200 MHz (DDR-400 grade) at 85°C with tRCD <= 15 ns, tRP <= 15 ns, and tAC <= 0.70 ns. Zero vector failures observed under March C- pattern across specified supply range.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-02` | **High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) 1000-Hour Reliability Qualification** | High-density multi-socket HTOL burn-in chamber (Despatch or Aehr Test Systems) equipped with regulated N2 purge, multi-channel regulated VDD stress power supplies, in-situ dynamic vector driver board, and calibrated Type-K monitoring thermocouples attached to pilot device package cases. | 1. Mount all 231 test units into dedicated high-temperature Kelvin sockets on the HTOL BIBs. 2. Insert boards into the chamber and ramp temperature at <= 3°C/min to an ambient soak temperature yielding Tj = 125°C +/- 2°C. 3. Apply stress voltage VDD_stress = 1.25 x VDD_nom (3.125V for 2.5V nominal core). 4. Drive continuous dynamic pseudo-random toggling patterns across address/control pins at 10 MHz to maintain internal active circuit toggling. 5. Maintain stress for 1000 hours with interim off-line ATE readouts at 48h, 168h, and 500h (cooling to room temperature under bias, measuring within specified Q-time). 6. Perform full JEDEC functional, parametric, and retention tests at room temperature (25°C) and hot (85°C) after 1000 hours. | `Zero functional failures allowed across all 231 units after 1000 hours cumulative stress (0 fails / 231 units, confirming Lot Tolerance Percent Defective LTPD <= 3% at 90% confidence level according to JEDEC JESD22-A108 and JESD47). Data retention at 85°C must remain >= 64ms with standby leakage IDD2N <= 150 uA.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal protective gloves (silicone/Nomex rated to 200°C) for handling hot burn-in boards, Anti-static ESD lab coat and conductive ESD wrist/heel straps, Safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1 certified), Nitrile gloves (cleanroom Grade 100, 6 mil) for solvent-based board contact cleaning
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For thermal burns from hot burn-in boards or oven racks: Immediately immerse affected skin in cool, clean running water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply ice directly; cover with sterile dry dressing and seek medical attention. For IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious isotonic eye wash for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. For N2 displacement/asphyxiation risk: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen or artificial respiration if breathing has stopped; notify on-site emergency medical response.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: HTOL oven exhaust ports must be hard-ducted to the facility industrial general exhaust to discharge outgassing flux volatiles and trace organic compounds. Local benchtop chemical exhaust hood (minimum face velocity 100 FPM / 0.51 m/s) required during solvent cleaning of loadboards. Dedicated ambient O2 deficiency sensors and alarms (set threshold at 19.5% O2) installed adjacent to nitrogen-purged burn-in chambers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent rags and wipes must be segregated into airtight, FM-approved, self-closing hazardous flammable waste cans and disposed of via certified chemical disposal contractors under RCRA solvent waste regulations. No liquid chemical waste generated directly in dry electrical test/burn-in chambers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA for socket contact degreasing)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen (Inert Purge Gas for Chamber / Bake Ovens)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Packaged DRAM ICs clean, dry, and moisture-free (pre-baked at 125°C for 24 hours or sealed in JEDEC J-STD-033 moisture barrier bags with indicating desiccant, relative humidity < 10%).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sockets and leads post-HTOL stress free of thermal oxidation, contact corrosion, or polymeric socket-outgassing residue, preserving solderability per J-STD-002.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption by package epoxy molding compound exceeds JEDEC MSL-3 thresholds; upon rapid insertion into 125°C HTOL test chambers, trapped interfacial moisture causes internal delamination, wire bond shearing, or popcorn package cracking.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful electrical characterization, functional speed-bin classification, and 1000-hour HTOL reliability qualification of the 180nm open-source DRAM packaged dies, demonstrating robust DDR timing margins, retention stability, and zero infant mortality/wearout failures per JEDEC JESD22-A108.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_DDR_SpeedBin_Shmoo_Characterization_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `HTOL_1000Hour_Reliability_Matrix_Data.csv`
- [ ] `Wafer_Die_Retention_and_Leakage_Degradation_Plot.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Package maximum operating clock frequency at 85°C across nominal VDD** | `166.0` | +34.0 / -0.0 MHz | Automated Test Equipment (ATE) algorithmic pattern test running March C- vectors at 85°C case temperature |
| `ASSERT-02` | **1000-hour HTOL cumulative failure count across qualification sample (Tj=125°C, VDD=3.125V)** | `0` | +0 / -0 fails | In-situ chamber monitoring coupled with offline 48h, 168h, 500h, 1000h full functional ATE readouts across n=231 units |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-HTOL 1000h data retention time across all cells at T_case = 85°C** | `64.0` | +64.0 / -0.0 ms | Variable-delay pause retention testing on ATE following row write and refresh-inhibit stress sequence |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 231 packaged DRAM dies from 3 distinct MPW fabrication runs successfully complete the 1000-hour HTOL stress schedule at Tj=125°C and VDD=3.125V with 0 failures, meet all JEDEC DDR-333/DDR-400 AC timing specifications (tCK, tRCD, tRP, tAC) on ATE across -40°C to +85°C operating range, and achieve full formal signoff from the Reliability Qualification Council and Lead Systems Architect.

# Standard Operating Procedure: ATE Loadboard Interface Design & JEDEC Timing Vector Pattern Generation

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The ATE loadboard high-speed transmission lines (50-ohm single-ended, 100-ohm differential) must match the driver impedance of the 180nm I/O pad ring across all PVT corners. Transmission line trace length mismatch between CK/CK# and DQ/DQS strobe lines must be constrained under 2.54 mm (100 mils) to prevent setup/hold skew from dominating the JEDEC timing budget, while decoupling capacitors (0201/0402 ceramic NPO/X7R) must be placed within 1.5 mm of pogo pin pads to maintain power delivery impedance below 150 mOhm up to 400 MHz.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm CMOS nodes operating at 1.8V nominal core/periphery, the input receiver hysteresis (V_IH/V_IL) and slew rates (~1.0 V/ns) require custom VTL (Vector Translation Language) pattern generation that strictly complies with JEDEC JESD79 DDR SDRAM read/write cycles. The test pattern generator must account for ATE pin electronics channel capacitance (typically 15-30 pF per pin) which distorts the DRAM driver's rise/fall profiles unless de-embedded using S-parameter calibration (TDR/TDT) models.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom multi-layer ATE loadboards (16-24 layer Rogers 4350B or high-Tg FR-4 Megtron 6) and precision pogo-pin test sockets have lead times spanning 8 to 14 weeks. Component obsolescence or socket pin wear after 100k insertions poses severe risk to pilot burn-in and speed-bin schedules; secondary socket suppliers and interchangeable footprint daughterboards must be qualified early.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Loadboard fabrication, ATE interface docking verification, and JEDEC vector translation must converge exactly with the MPW BEOL dicing and packaging delivery window. Delays in loadboard bring-up directly bottleneck HTOL burn-in qualification and speed-binning milestones, incurring high ATE hourly machine-time penalties ($350-$600/hr) on commercial testers.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Pogo-pin socket contact resistance degradation (>1.0 Ohm) inducing false VIL/VIH marginality failures during high-temperature (125°C) qualification runs.
1. High-speed signal crosstalk and return path discontinuities across split ground planes on the loadboard, causing jitter exceeding 120 ps on the differential DQS strobe.
1. Cycle-to-cycle timing skew and round-trip flight time mismatches between ATE comparator strobes and DRAM output valid windows, leading to false read access time (tAA/tAC) test rejects.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-01` | **ATE Loadboard Signal Integrity & Characteristic Impedance TDR Verification** | Keysight N1000A DCA-X Wideband Oscilloscope with N1055A 50GHz TDR Module and Semi-Rigid High-Frequency Ground-Signal-Ground (GSG) Microprobes | 1. Perform SOLT (Short-Open-Load-Thru) 2-port calibration on TDR module to probe tip reference plane. 2. Contact the GSG microprobe directly to the ATE pogo-pin landing pads for DQ0-DQ15, DQS, CK, and address/control traces. 3. Launch a 35-ps rise-time step pulse through each signal line down to the tester interface edge connector. 4. Record reflection coefficient rho and calculate differential and single-ended characteristic impedance profiles along the trace length. 5. Measure differential phase delay skew between CK and CK#, as well as intra-byte DQS to DQ trace lengths. | `Single-ended trace characteristic impedance Z0 = 50.0 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm (5%); differential impedance Zdiff = 100.0 Ohm +/- 5.0 Ohm (5%). Signal trace propagation delay mismatch between CK/CK# < 5.0 ps; intra-byte skew across DQ0-DQ7 to DQS < 10.0 ps.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-02` | **JEDEC Speed-Bin Vector Timing & Dynamic Functional Read/Write Verification** | Advantest V93000 / Teradyne UltraFLEX ATE system equipped with high-speed digital pin cards, programmed with STIL/WGL JEDEC DDR test vectors, and multi-channel digitizing oscilloscope | 1. Apply JEDEC initialization vector sequence: precharge all banks, enable DLL, execute 200 clock cycles of NOP, and perform full auto-refresh cycles. 2. Drive write-pattern burst (BL=4, BL=8) with pseudo-random bit sequence (PRBS-7) across full address range at clock frequencies 133 MHz, 166 MHz, and 200 MHz. 3. Execute read-burst vector patterns and program ATE dual-threshold comparators to sample DQ valid windows relative to DQS edges. 4. Perform shmoo timing analysis across VDD (1.62V to 1.98V) and tCK periods to quantify setup (tDS), hold (tDH), and access time (tAC). | `Zero functional vector fail across 100% address space at 166 MHz (DDR-333 timing specs). Data access time from CK/CK# tAC <= 0.70 ns; data strobe-to-data setup time tDS >= 0.45 ns; hold time tDH >= 0.45 ns at nominal 1.8V core/IO supply.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe cleanroom lab coat (anti-static dissipation fabric), ESD grounding wrist strap with integrated 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (minimum 4 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses with side shields
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Move exposed personnel to fresh air immediately; provide artificial respiration if breathing ceases. Eye Contact: Flush thoroughly with eyewash solution or isotonic saline for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids apart. Skin Contact: Wash affected area with non-abrasive soap and water, remove contaminated apparel. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical guidance; seek immediate emergency clinical assistance.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop chemical fume extraction hood with minimum face velocity of 100 linear feet per minute (LFM / 0.51 m/s) dedicated for loadboard socket contact cleaning and solvent degreasing.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent wipes and residue must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-proof hazardous solvent waste drums clearly labeled 'Flammable Solvent Waste - Isopropanol'; do not dispose via municipal drain lines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C4) | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DI H2O)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (>18 MOhm-cm at 25°C) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly fabricated ENIG (Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold) or Hard Gold plated ATE pogo pads and socket contacts, free of ionic residues, particulate contamination (Class 10,000 / ISO 7 cleanroom standard), and copper corrosion.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Cleaned, dried, and solvent-free board surface with socket pogo-pins aligned and verified for contact planarity, stored under positive nitrogen pressure purged dry box.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric sulfide/chloride corrosion and oxidation on gold/nickel interface pads forming insulating micro-films, causing contact resistance spikes >2.0 Ohms, ground bounce, and severe false bin-rejection rates during high-frequency ATE timing characterization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: The ATE loadboard high-speed transmission lines (50-ohm single-ended, 100-ohm differential) must match the driver impedance of the 180nm I/O pad ring across all PVT corners. Transmission line trace length mismatch between CK/CK# and DQ/DQS strobe lines must be constrained under 2.54 mm (100 mils) to prevent setup/hold skew from dominating the JEDEC timing budget, while decoupling capacitors (0201/0402 ceramic NPO/X7R) must be placed within 1.5 mm of pogo pin pads to maintain power delivery impedance below 150 mOhm up to 400 MHz.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm CMOS nodes operating at 1.8V nominal core/periphery, the input receiver hysteresis (V_IH/V_IL) and slew rates (~1.0 V/ns) require custom VTL (Vector Translation Language) pattern generation that strictly complies with JEDEC JESD79 DDR SDRAM read/write cycles. The test pattern generator must account for ATE pin electronics channel capacitance (typically 15-30 pF per pin) which distorts the DRAM driver's rise/fall profiles unless de-embedded using S-parameter calibration (TDR/TDT) models.
critics.supply_chain: Custom multi-layer ATE loadboards (16-24 layer Rogers 4350B or high-Tg FR-4 Megtron 6) and precision pogo-pin test sockets have lead times spanning 8 to 14 weeks. Component obsolescence or socket pin wear after 100k insertions poses severe risk to pilot burn-in and speed-bin schedules; secondary socket suppliers and interchangeable footprint daughterboards must be qualified early.
critics.laya_pm: Loadboard fabrication, ATE interface docking verification, and JEDEC vector translation must converge exactly with the MPW BEOL dicing and packaging delivery window. Delays in loadboard bring-up directly bottleneck HTOL burn-in qualification and speed-binning milestones, incurring high ATE hourly machine-time penalties ($350-$600/hr) on commercial testers.
critical_failure_modes: Pogo-pin socket contact resistance degradation (>1.0 Ohm) inducing false VIL/VIH marginality failures during high-temperature (125°C) qualification runs.
High-speed signal crosstalk and return path discontinuities across split ground planes on the loadboard, causing jitter exceeding 120 ps on the differential DQS strobe.
Cycle-to-cycle timing skew and round-trip flight time mismatches between ATE comparator strobes and DRAM output valid windows, leading to false read access time (tAA/tAC) test rejects.

testcases.title: ATE Loadboard Signal Integrity & Characteristic Impedance TDR Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight N1000A DCA-X Wideband Oscilloscope with N1055A 50GHz TDR Module and Semi-Rigid High-Frequency Ground-Signal-Ground (GSG) Microprobes
testcases.pre_conditions: ATE Loadboard unpowered, cleanroom ambient 21°C +/- 1°C, relative humidity 45% +/- 5%, bare PCB docked to calibration fixture without DUT socket installed.
testcases.procedure: 1. Perform SOLT (Short-Open-Load-Thru) 2-port calibration on TDR module to probe tip reference plane. 2. Contact the GSG microprobe directly to the ATE pogo-pin landing pads for DQ0-DQ15, DQS, CK, and address/control traces. 3. Launch a 35-ps rise-time step pulse through each signal line down to the tester interface edge connector. 4. Record reflection coefficient rho and calculate differential and single-ended characteristic impedance profiles along the trace length. 5. Measure differential phase delay skew between CK and CK#, as well as intra-byte DQS to DQ trace lengths.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Single-ended trace characteristic impedance Z0 = 50.0 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm (5%); differential impedance Zdiff = 100.0 Ohm +/- 5.0 Ohm (5%). Signal trace propagation delay mismatch between CK/CK# < 5.0 ps; intra-byte skew across DQ0-DQ7 to DQS < 10.0 ps.

testcases.title: JEDEC Speed-Bin Vector Timing & Dynamic Functional Read/Write Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Advantest V93000 / Teradyne UltraFLEX ATE system equipped with high-speed digital pin cards, programmed with STIL/WGL JEDEC DDR test vectors, and multi-channel digitizing oscilloscope
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm DRAM packaged units mounted into clamshell high-frequency ATE socket; VDD/VDDQ stabilized at 1.8V +/- 10mV; loadboard calibrated with de-embedded fixture S-parameters; ambient test chamber at 25°C.
testcases.procedure: 1. Apply JEDEC initialization vector sequence: precharge all banks, enable DLL, execute 200 clock cycles of NOP, and perform full auto-refresh cycles. 2. Drive write-pattern burst (BL=4, BL=8) with pseudo-random bit sequence (PRBS-7) across full address range at clock frequencies 133 MHz, 166 MHz, and 200 MHz. 3. Execute read-burst vector patterns and program ATE dual-threshold comparators to sample DQ valid windows relative to DQS edges. 4. Perform shmoo timing analysis across VDD (1.62V to 1.98V) and tCK periods to quantify setup (tDS), hold (tDH), and access time (tAC).

# Standard Operating Procedure: ATE DUT Loadboard PCB Schematic & High-Speed Impedance-Matched Layout

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-01` | **Thermosonic Ball Wirebond Shear & Wire Pull Mechanical Strength Test** | Dage 4000 / Nordson Microtester Bond Pull & Ball Shear Test System | 1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with uncured epoxy: Wash with copious soap and warm water (do not use solvents like acetone which increase dermal absorption). Eye contact with silica dicing slurry: Flush at eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dicing saw fully enclosed with continuous high-volume DI water mist shroud. Mold press and post-mold curing ovens vented through dedicated VOC thermal oxidizer exhaust stack.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Silicon dicing slurry centrifuged and segregated into solid cake for non-hazardous landfill. Cured thermoset epoxy scrap disposed of as regulated solid waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Epoxy Novolac Resin (Mold Compound)** | `29690-82-2` | Semiconductor Packaging Grade | `Solid pellet / transfer mold compound` |
| **Amorphous Silica Filler** | `14808-60-7` | Sub-micron spherical particle | `75-88 wt% in epoxy mold compound` |
| **Silver-Filled Conductive Die Attach Adhesive** | `7440-22-4` | Electronic Grade Silver Flake | `70-80 wt% Ag in epoxy base` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Saw-diced wafer mounted on UV dicing tape, clean and dry with zero particulate or water residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Epoxy die-attached, cured, and thermosonically wirebonded to leadframe/substrate pads prior to molding.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation of exposed aluminum/copper bond pads degrades thermosonic ball bond adhesion, inducing high electrical contact resistance or catastrophic non-stick bond pad lifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of ATE DUT Loadboard PCB Schematic & High-Speed Impedance-Matched Layout: BEOL metallization, electrical die sort (EDS), wafer backgrinding/dicing, and wirebond plastic encapsulation successfully yield JEDEC-qualified DRAM packaged units.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Electrical_Die_Sort_Wafer_Yield_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Wirebond_Ball_Shear_And_Pull_CPK_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `JEDEC_TSOP54_Final_ATE_SpeedBin_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wirebond ball shear strength** | `>= 18.0 gf` | Minimum failure load >= 15.0 gf across 30 samples | Dage 4000 micro-tester lateral ball shear per MIL-STD-883 |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) wafer array functional yield** | `>= 90.0%` | Minimum yield >= 85.0% on prime wafers | Automated wafer probe array test with March C- diagnostic patterns |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Packaged DRAM package coplanarity & lead pitch** | `<= 0.08 mm coplanarity` | JEDEC TSOP-54 mechanical envelope tolerance (+/- 0.05 mm) | Optical 3D coordinate measuring machine (CMM) metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% passing electrical continuity and JEDEC parametric DC checks; destructive wirebond shear CPK >= 1.67 with zero package voiding or delamination detected under scanning acoustic microscopy (C-SAM).

critics.systems_engineer: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
critics.domain_expert: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
critics.supply_chain: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
critics.laya_pm: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).
critical_failure_modes: Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization.

nodes.sop_content:
# SOP: ATE DUT Pogo-Pin Socket Footprint & Multi-Rail Decoupling BOM Selection

**Module Hierarchy**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > BEOL Multi-Layer Metallization, Wafer Sort & Packaging > Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing > ATE Loadboard Interface Design & JEDEC Timing Vector Pattern Generation > ATE DUT Loadboard PCB Schematic & High-Speed Impedance-Matched Layout > ATE DUT Pogo-Pin & Power Delivery Network (PDN) Multi-Rail Schematic Capture > ATE DUT Pogo-Pin Socket Footprint & Multi-Rail Decoupling BOM Selection  
**Document Tracking**: [`docs/ate_socket_footprint_decoupling.md`](./docs/ate_socket_footprint_decoupling.md)

---

### Workflow Architecture & Voltage Matrix

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **DUT Package Pinout & Socket Footprint Mapping**:
   - Extract the physical lead/pad coordinates for the bonded 180nm DRAM prototype packaged in ceramic QFN/DIP housings (bonded with $25\,\mu\text{m}$ wire to $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum bonding pads).
   - Lay out the loadboard landing pad footprint for the high-frequency elastomer or spring-loaded pogo-pin socket. Set the landing pad copper diameter to $0.40\,\text{mm} \pm 0.02\,\text{mm}$ with a non-solder mask defined (NSMD) mask opening of $0.50\,\text{mm}$.
   - Place through-hole guide pin tooling holes with $\pm 0.025\,\text{mm}$ positional tolerance to secure socket mechanical retention without exerting lateral shear on pogo pins.

2. **Multi-Rail PDN Allocation & Cavity Assignment**:
   - Separate loadboard power planes into three critical DRAM rails:
     - **$V_{DD}$ Rail ($1.8\,\text{V}$)**: Core logic, peripheral CMOS gates, and Sense Amplifier restore pull-up (SAP node).
     - **$V_{PP}$ Rail ($2.6\,\text{V} - 2.8\,\text{V}$)**: Wordline boosted gate overdrive to eliminate access transistor threshold loss ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$).
     - **$V_{BLP}$ Rail ($V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\,\text{V}$)**: Precision bitline equalization and precharge reference.
   - Design loadboard PCB cavity back-drilling and bottom-side cutout under the socket footprint to allow mounting high-frequency decoupling capacitors directly beneath the pogo-pin terminals (loop distance $< 1.5\,\text{mm}$).

3. **Multi-Rail Decoupling BOM Selection & Placement**:
   - **$V_{DD}$ ($1.8\,\text{V}$)**:
     - *High-frequency tier*: Place $0201 / 0402$ reverse-geometry MLCCs ($0.1\,\mu\text{F}$, X7R, $6.3\,\text{V}$, $\text{ESL} \le 120\,\text{pH}$, $\text{ESR} \le 30\,\text{m}\Omega$) directly on bottom-side via-in-pad arrays connected to $V_{DD}$/GND pogo pins.
     - *Mid-frequency tier*: Place $2 \times 1.0\,\mu\text{F}$ and $1 \times 10\,\mu\text{F}$ 0603 MLCCs within $5.0\,\text{mm}$ of the socket frame perimeter.
   - **$V_{PP}$ ($2.6\,\text{V} - 2.8\,\text{V}$ Wordline Boost)**:
     - Place $0402$ $0.047\,\mu\text{F} - 0.1\,\mu\text{F}$ (X7R, $10\,\text{V}$, low ESL) capacitors adjacent to the $V_{PP}$ socket pins to absorb dynamic discharge transient currents when wordlines transition to overdrive ($2.6\,\text{V}-2.8\,\text{V}$).
   - **$V_{BLP}$ ($0.9\,\text{V}$ Bitline Precharge Reference)**:
     - Place low-noise $0.1\,\mu\text{F}$ and $0.01\,\mu\text{F}$ C0G/NP0 dielectric ceramic capacitors directly at the $V_{BLP}$ pin bypass port to suppress charge-sharing switching ripple between BL and /BL.

4. **Via-in-Pad Array & Return Current Design**:
   - Apply filled and capped via-in-pad (VIPPO) for all GND and power pogo-pin landing pads using double-via pairs per pin ($0.20\,\text{mm}$ drill, $0.40\,\text{mm}$ pad) to minimize parasitic loop inductance $L_{loop} \le 0.4\,\text{nH}$.
   - Ensure an uninterrupted solid ground reference plane on layer 2 directly beneath the top landing pattern.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

1. **Wordline Boost Overdrive Voltage Stability**:
   - Transient voltage on the $V_{PP}$ rail during simultaneous wordline activation must stay within **$2.6\,\text{V} \text{ to } 2.8\,\text{V}$** with dynamic droop **$\Delta V_{PP} \le 50\,\text{mV}$**.
2. **Pogo-Pin Interface Loop Inductance & Contact Resistance**:
   - Pogo-pin pair loop inductance at $500\,\text{MHz}$ must be **$\le 0.45\,\text{nH}$**; Kelvin contact DC loop resistance must measure **$\le 35\,\text{m}\Omega$** per pin.
3. **Bitline Equalization ($V_{BLP}$) Noise Margin**:
   - Precharge reference rail voltage must remain at **$0.90\,\text{V} \pm 15\,\text{mV}$** ($V_{DD}/2$) during active sense-amp equalization phase transitions.
4. **Loadboard PDN Impedance ($Z_{target}$)**:
   - Target impedance across $V_{DD}$ ($1.8\,\text{V}$) must remain **$\le 45\,\text{m}\Omega$** from $100\,\text{kHz}$ to $250\,\text{MHz}$.

---

### Verified Literature Context Citations

- **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**: Confirms the operational phase voltages: $V_{DD}$ restore via SAP PMOS switches, $V_{BLP}$ precision reference at $V_{DD}/2$ ($0.9\,\text{V}$) for bitline shorting/equalization, and boosted wordline overdrive $V_{PP} = 2.6\,\text{V} \text{ to } 2.8\,\text{V}$ ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$) preventing threshold voltage loss.
- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**: Provides mechanical package baseline for ceramic DIP / QFN packages bonded to $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum pads with $25\,\mu\text{m}$ wire (Mil-Std-883 pull strength $\ge 4.0\,\text{gf}$, die attach thermal resistance $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Provides $180\,\text{nm}$ access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\,\text{nm}, W = 220\,\text{nm}$) and access timing constraints that establish the switching charge requirements for the PDN decoupling network.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The integration of high-bandwidth pogo-pin sockets on the ATE loadboard must balance contact resistance (R_contact < 35 mOhm) and loop inductance (L_loop < 0.8 nH) with mechanical actuation forces across a 60-ball/84-ball FBGA footprint. For 180nm DRAM running DDR-200/333/400 speeds with peak di/dt spikes during simultaneous sense-amplifier activation (restoring 28 fF cell capacitance across 512 bitlines simultaneously), inadequate PDN decoupling behind the pogo-pin field will cause severe rail bounce exceeding 5% on VDD/VDDQ, leading to false timing failures during regenerative sense amplification.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 1.8V VDD core and 1.8V/2.5V VDDQ I/O, the cross-coupled regenerative sense amplifier draws rapid transient current during charge restoration. The socket footprint must feature reverse-geometry low-inductance ceramic capacitors (0201/0306 MLCCs, X7R/X5R) placed directly on the loadboard bottom side within a 1.2 mm radius of the pogo-pin BGA breakout vias. Failing to optimize the resonance frequency of the multi-tier capacitor array (100pF RF bypass, 10nF mid-band, 1uF bulk decoupling) will induce anti-resonance impedance peaks in the 100 MHz to 400 MHz envelope, degrading bitline restoration margins.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying custom beryllium-copper (BeCu) pogo pins with hard-gold over nickel plating and proprietary elastomeric contact sockets risks procurement lead times of 14-18 weeks. We must standardize on commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) high-frequency coaxial or dual-point crown spring probes (e.g., Smiths Interconnect or Cohu/Johnstech equivalents) and standard EIA 0201/0402 AEC-Q200 qualified MLCC decoupling components with multi-vendor stocking (Murata, TDK, Taiyo Yuden) to prevent ATE hardware assembly hold-ups.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The BOM procurement and PCB fabrication/assembly milestone cannot slip past Week 6 of the MPW tapeout cycle. Socket footprint keep-out zones must be frozen concurrently with package substrate ball map signoff. A dual-track fabrication plan is required: establish primary footprint tooling for the selected pogo socket while routing modular solder-down DUT footprints as a zero-socket fallback board in case pogo delivery lags wafer delivery from the foundry.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic VDD rail collapse exceeding +/- 90 mV during sense-amp strobe causing refresh failure or false single-bit soft errors.
1. Mechanical spring fatigue or solder ball gold-tin intermetallic migration leading to pogo contact resistance elevation (>100 mOhm) after 5,000 insertions.
1. Loadboard cavity anti-resonance impedance spike (> 1.2 Ohm at 200 MHz) generating excessive jitter and eye closure on high-speed DQ/DQS strobe lines.

| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-1-1-02` | **Multi-Rail PDN Self-Impedance & Simultaneous Switching Noise (SSN) Dynamic Load Transient Test** | Picotest J2102B Common Mode Transformer, Keysight Infiniium MXR-Series 4 GHz Oscilloscope, 500 MHz Arbitrary Function Generator, Picotest PDN Cable / 2-Port Shunt-Thru VNA Setup | 1. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 388 mechanical puncture-resistant nitrile cleanroom gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-glare side-shield safety glasses, ESD-safe grounded lab coat with continuous conductive wrist strap (ANSI/ESD S20.20 compliant), Particulate respirator (3M N95 or cleanroom FFP2 mask) during compressed air or aerosol contact cleaning
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Relocate person to fresh air immediately; provide oxygen if breathing is labored. Skin Contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and warm water for 15 minutes; remove contaminated garments. Eye Contact: Flush eyes immediately with sterile isotonic saline or eye wash fountain for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmic evaluation. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; rinse mouth with copious water and contact emergency medical center immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Maintain benchtop localized snorkel fume extraction (minimum face velocity of 100 FPM / 0.5 m/s) over socket assembly and solvent ultrasonic cleaning tubs. Lab ambient must be Class 10,000 (ISO 7) or better with continuous positive-pressure HEPA filtration and minimum 15 air volume changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent isopropyl alcohol and solvent cleaning wipes in dedicated, grounded, flame-proof, self-closing hazardous solvent containers. Do not pour into municipal drains. Contract certified hazardous chemical disposal handlers for high-temperature incineration per EPA RCRA Title 40 CFR regulations.

| **Lead-Free Solder Residue Flux (Rosin mildly activated / modified carboxylate)** | `65997-06-0` | IPC J-STD-004 ROL0 / ROL1 | `10.0% to 25.0% in glycol solvent` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly reflowed immersion gold (ENIG or ENEPIG) PCB landing pads and gold-plated pogo-pin plunger tips free of flux residues, fingerprint oils, and particulate contamination (MIL-STD-883 Method 2009).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Socket assembly mechanically torqued to specification (0.22 Nm +/- 0.02 Nm per screw), contact pins micro-lubricated with monomolecular gold protector, and vacuum-sealed with desiccant indicator pack.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric exposure beyond 120 minutes in ambient humid air causes copper/nickel underlayer diffusion through thin gold plating, promoting galvanic oxidation, tarnishing, and moisture absorption that increases pogo contact resistance by > 200%.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified ATE DUT pogo-pin socket footprint layout package and completed multi-rail decoupling BOM selection for 180nm DRAM testing. Deliverables include validated Altium/Cadence schematic and PCB footprints with back-side cavity mounting, PDN frequency-domain S-parameter simulation models, and four-wire contact resistance test logs satisfying JEDEC DDR speed-bin qualification standards.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_DUT_SOCKET_FOOTPRINT_MECH_SPEC_REV1.0.pdf`
- [ ] `ATE_LOADBOARD_MULTI_RAIL_DECOUPLING_BOM_V1.csv`
- [ ] `PDN_IMPEDANCE_SIMULATION_VS_MEASURED_S2P.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **DC Contact Resistance per Pogo-Pin Channel** | `30.0 mOhm` | +/- 5.0 mOhm | Four-wire Kelvin DC resistance measurement using Keithley 2450 across all 84 active socket pins at 100 mA force current. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **PDN Peak AC Loop Impedance from DC to 400 MHz** | `95.0 mOhm` | +/- 25.0 mOhm | Two-port shunt-thru S21 impedance extraction with Keysight E5071C VNA directly across VDD/VSS BGA socket landing vias. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dynamic VDD Power Rail Ripple under 1.2A di/dt Step Load** | `55.0 mV` | +/- 15.0 mV | High-bandwidth active differential probe measurement on 4 GHz oscilloscope during simulated 180nm DRAM sense-amplifier strobe vector burst. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Unanimous sign-off by Systems Engineer, DRAM Design Lead, and ATE Test Lead upon confirming: 100% of socket pogo-pin pins exhibit R_contact < 35 mOhm, PDN maximum AC impedance remains <= 120 mOhm across 0.1-400 MHz, zero mechanical pin binding observed across 100 insertion cycles, and decoupling BOM components are confirmed available with minimum 52 weeks supply continuity.

testcases.procedure: 1. Connect 4-wire Kelvin probes across VDD, VDDQ, VSS, and DQ pogo-pin channels between loadboard bottom test pads and top shorting coupon. 2. Force 100 mA DC current and record four-terminal voltage drop to calculate R_contact for all 84 pin locations. 3. Connect VNA micro-coaxial probes to calibrated loadboard SMA breakout lines through the pogo socket terminated into a 50-ohm calibration dummy. 4. Sweep S-parameters from 10 MHz to 3.0 GHz and measure S21 insertion loss, S11 return loss, and extract lumped loop inductance (L_loop).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: DC contact resistance R_contact must be <= 35.0 mOhm across 100% of pins. S21 insertion loss must be >= -1.0 dB at 1.0 GHz. Loop inductance L_loop must be <= 0.85 nH per power/ground pin pair.

testcases.title: Multi-Rail PDN Self-Impedance & Simultaneous Switching Noise (SSN) Dynamic Load Transient Test
testcases.instrumentation: Picotest J2102B Common Mode Transformer, Keysight Infiniium MXR-Series 4 GHz Oscilloscope, 500 MHz Arbitrary Function Generator, Picotest PDN Cable / 2-Port Shunt-Thru VNA Setup
testcases.pre_conditions: Decoupling capacitor BOM fully populated onto loadboard bottom cavity. Power delivery rail connected to external low-noise ATE programmable power supply set to 1.800 V nominal. Active high-speed current transient fixture installed into socket.
testcases.procedure: 1. Calibrate 2-port shunt-thru impedance measurement on VDD and VDDQ planes at the BGA pin cavity from 100 kHz to 1.0 GHz using VNA. 2. Extract self-impedance profile Z_pdn(f) across frequency spectrum. 3. Configure transient fixture to pulse dynamic current delta_I = 1.2 A with di/dt = 1.5 A/ns (emulating 180nm DRAM column sense amplification and burst read/write). 4. Capture peak-to-peak voltage ripple (V_pp) and high-frequency ringing on VDD/VDDQ using high-impedance active differential probes (>= 2.5 GHz).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Peak PDN impedance Z_pdn must remain <= 120 mOhm from DC up to 400 MHz with no resonant impedance peak exceeding 250 mOhm. Transient voltage droop must not exceed +/- 72 mV (< 4.0% of 1.8V nominal) under 1.2 A step load.

ppe_required: EN 388 mechanical puncture-resistant nitrile cleanroom gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness)
ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-glare side-shield safety glasses
ESD-safe grounded lab coat with continuous conductive wrist strap (ANSI/ESD S20.20 compliant)
Particulate respirator (3M N95 or cleanroom FFP2 mask) during compressed air or aerosol contact cleaning

cas_chemicals.name: Synthetic Hydrocarbon / Polyalphaolefin Contact Lubricant (DeoxIT Gold G-Series)
cas_chemicals.concentration: 5.0% active synthetic fluoropolymer in mineral carrier

cas_chemicals.name: Lead-Free Solder Residue Flux (Rosin mildly activated / modified carboxylate)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Inhalation: Relocate person to fresh air immediately; provide oxygen if breathing is labored. Skin Contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and warm water for 15 minutes; remove contaminated garments. Eye Contact: Flush eyes immediately with sterile isotonic saline or eye wash fountain for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmic evaluation. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; rinse mouth with copious water and contact emergency medical center immediately.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Maintain benchtop localized snorkel fume extraction (minimum face velocity of 100 FPM / 0.5 m/s) over socket assembly and solvent ultrasonic cleaning tubs. Lab ambient must be Class 10,000 (ISO 7) or better with continuous positive-pressure HEPA filtration and minimum 15 air volume changes per hour.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Collect spent isopropyl alcohol and solvent cleaning wipes in dedicated, grounded, flame-proof, self-closing hazardous solvent containers. Do not pour into municipal drains. Contract certified hazardous chemical disposal handlers for high-temperature incineration per EPA RCRA Title 40 CFR regulations.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly reflowed immersion gold (ENIG or ENEPIG) PCB landing pads and gold-plated pogo-pin plunger tips free of flux residues, fingerprint oils, and particulate contamination (MIL-STD-883 Method 2009).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Socket assembly mechanically torqued to specification (0.22 Nm +/- 0.02 Nm per screw), contact pins micro-lubricated with monomolecular gold protector, and vacuum-sealed with desiccant indicator pack.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Atmospheric exposure beyond 120 minutes in ambient humid air causes copper/nickel underlayer diffusion through thin gold plating, promoting galvanic oxidation, tarnishing, and moisture absorption that increases pogo contact resistance by > 200%.

expected_result.summary: Verified ATE DUT pogo-pin socket footprint layout package and completed multi-rail decoupling BOM selection for 180nm DRAM testing. Deliverables include validated Altium/Cadence schematic and PCB footprints with back-side cavity mounting, PDN frequency-domain S-parameter simulation models, and four-wire contact resistance test logs satisfying JEDEC DDR speed-bin qualification standards.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: DC Contact Resistance per Pogo-Pin Channel
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Four-wire Kelvin DC resistance measurement using Keithley 2450 across all 84 active socket pins at 100 mA force current.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: PDN Peak AC Loop Impedance from DC to 400 MHz
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Two-port shunt-thru S21 impedance extraction with Keysight E5071C VNA directly across VDD/VSS BGA socket landing vias.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Dynamic VDD Power Rail Ripple under 1.2A di/dt Step Load
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-bandwidth active differential probe measurement on 4 GHz oscilloscope during simulated 180nm DRAM sense-amplifier strobe vector burst.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Unanimous sign-off by Systems Engineer, DRAM Design Lead, and ATE Test Lead upon confirming: 100% of socket pogo-pin pins exhibit R_contact < 35 mOhm, PDN maximum AC impedance remains <= 120 mOhm across 0.1-400 MHz, zero mechanical pin binding observed across 100 insertion cycles, and decoupling BOM components are confirmed available with minimum 52 weeks supply continuity.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Loadboard Multi-Rail PDN & Pogo-Pin Interface Schematic Capture
**Document ID:** `SOP-ATE-CKT-180NM-PDN-001`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design & ATE Hardware Engineering  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM MPW)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Structural Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    ATE System Power    │
│  Supplies & Channels   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Loadboard Multi-Rail  │
│   Decoupling Matrix    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      ATE Testhead      │
│     Pogo-Pin Tower     │
│       Interface        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    DUT Socket / QFN    │
│     Package Leads      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  180nm DRAM Core VDD   │
│   1.8V / VPP 2.8V /    │
│          VSS           │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Engineering Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Schematic Multi-Rail Hierarchy & Symbol Allocation
1. In the EDA schematic capture environment, instantiate power rail ports for the **180nm DRAM DUT**:
   - **$V_{DD}$ Core/Periphery Supply:** Set nominal voltage to $1.8\text{ V}$.
   - **$V_{PP}$ High-Voltage Wordline Overdrive Supply:** Configure nominal net voltage to $2.5\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$ to provide the required gate overdrive ($V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}}$), compensating for the access transistor $V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$ ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) and avoiding the $33\%$ stored charge loss ($1.2\text{ V}$ unboosted limit) into the $28\text{ fF}$ storage capacitor.
   - **$V_{SS}$ Reference Ground:** Allocate solid multi-point digital/analog return paths.
2. Place testpoint sensing networks across the Dickson charge pump clock monitor nodes ($20\text{ MHz to } 50\text{ MHz}$, flying capacitance $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\text{ pF to } 50\text{ pF}$) for on-chip vs. external $V_{PP}$ force/sense options.

#### Step 2: Pogo-Pin Testhead Interface & Pin Matrix Mapping
1. Capture the multi-pin coaxial and spring contact pogo-pin receiver block interfacing the ATE testhead tower to the loadboard bottom side:
   - Assign dedicated dual-pogo pins for every high-current power channel to maintain contact resistance $R_{\text{cont}} \le 35\text{ m}\Omega$ per contact point.
   - Interleave signal pogo pins with alternating ground return pins in a **G-S-G** / checkerboard matrix to restrict net pogo-pin pair loop inductance to $L_{\text{loop}} \le 1.5\text{ nH}$.
2. Map pogo-pin nets directly to the corresponding Ceramic QFN / DIP lead frame pins connecting through $25\ \mu\text{m}$ bonding wires (Gold Ball or Al-1% Si Wedge, pull strength $\ge 4.0\text{ gf}$) to the $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ aluminum die pads.

#### Step 3: Decoupling Network & Anti-Resonance Filtering
1. Place a multi-stage ceramic capacitor ladder array in parallel directly adjacent to the pogo-ring socket:
   - High-frequency suppression: MLCC 0402 $100\text{ pF}$ (SRF $\sim 300\text{ MHz}$) and $1\text{ nF}$.
   - Mid-frequency suppression: MLCC 0603 $100\text{ nF}$ ($X7R, 10\text{ V}$).
   - Low-frequency bulk stabilization: $10\ \mu\text{F}$ and $47\ \mu\text{F}$ low-ESR tantalum/ceramic capacitors.
2. Ensure schematic layout constraints require bypass placement within $< 3.0\text{ mm}$ of the pogo-pin target footprint pads to minimize via loop inductance.

#### Step 4: Overvoltage Clamp, Current Sense & Rule Check (ERC)
1. Add fast TVS diode clamps rated at $V_{\text{BR}} = 3.3\text{ V}$ on $V_{PP}$ and $2.4\text{ V}$ on $V_{DD}$ to protect the 180nm thin oxide gates from ATE hot-switch voltage transients.
2. Execute Electrical Rule Check (ERC): Verify no floating pins, confirm supply net class conductor current limits ($\ge 2.0\text{ A}$ continuous per rail), and export netlist for impedance-matched layout synthesis.

---

### 3. Electrical PDN Target Metrics

```text
                 Normalized Electrical PDN Targets      
                    ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░                          │
Loop Inductance (nH)┤░░░                          │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒                        │
Pogo R_cont (10mΩ)  ┤▒▒▒▒▒                        │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
VPP Overdrive (100mV)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                    │███████████████████          │
VDD Supply (100mV)  ┤███████████████████          │
                    └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                     0      7     14     21     28 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method & Verification Standard |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **$V_{DD}$ Supply Transient Ripple** | $\le 36.0$ | $\text{mV}$ (peak-to-peak) | Active probe oscilloscope measurement at loadboard DUT socket pins under full-burst write cycles ($1.8\text{ V} \pm 2\%$). |
| **$V_{PP}$ Wordline Boost Voltage** | $2.50\text{ to }2.80$ | $\text{V}$ | DMM Kelvin 4-wire DC sense at ATE loadboard testhead pogo-pin interface to ensure access transistor channel saturation. |
| **Pogo-Pin Interface Contact Resistance ($R_{\text{cont}}$)** | $\le 35.0$ | $\text{m}\Omega$ | Micro-ohmmeter 4-point Kelvin probe test across individual pogo-pin plunger and barrel contacts under compression. |
| **Pogo-Pin Power Return Loop Inductance ($L_{\text{loop}}$)** | $\le 1.50$ | $\text{nH}$ | Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) $S_{21}$ / impedance bridge measurement up to $500\text{ MHz}$ across the interleaved G-S-G pin matrix. |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, bitline contact sharing and leakage limits.
- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**: NMOS access transistor $V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$, threshold loss elimination ($1.8\text{ V} - 0.6\text{ V} = 1.2\text{ V}$ avoided), wordline overdrive requirement $V_{PP} = 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$, and 4-stage Dickson oscillator operating at $20\text{ MHz to } 50\text{ MHz}$ with $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\text{ pF to } 50\text{ pF}$.
- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**: $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ aluminum die pads, $25\ \mu\text{m}$ gold ball / Al-1% Si wedge bonding wire, Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 pull strength $\ge 4.0\text{ gf}$, and Ablebond 84-1LMIS die attach ($R_{\text{th}} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$).

*Document persisted to project knowledge base at [sop_loadboard_pdn_pogo_interface.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_loadboard_pdn_pogo_interface.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The schematic capture for the multi-rail PDN (VDD=1.8V core/array, VDDQ=1.8V I/O, VPP=3.3V wordline boost, and VBB=-0.8V substrate bias) must account for high-frequency current transients (di/dt) induced during simultaneous sensing operations across thousands of cross-coupled regenerative sense amplifiers. Pogo-pin parasitic inductances (~1.2 nH to 2.5 nH per pin) without dedicated ground return pogo-pins interspersed in a 1:1 or 2:1 signal-to-ground/power pin ratio will trigger catastrophic ground bounce (L*di/dt > 180 mV), destabilizing folded bitline sensing margins (delta-VBL ~ 120-180 mV) and causing false sensing latch-ups.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm commercial node, folded bitline sense amplifiers rely on rapid pull-down through SAN to GND and pull-up through SAP to VDD. When multiple column select lines (CSL) and wordline activations fire, the dynamic current draw on the 1.8V VDD core rail spikes up to 4.5A within 1.8 ns. The schematic must explicitly incorporate a multi-tiered decoupling network (ultra-low ESR 0201/0402 ceramic capacitors 100nF, 1uF, and 10uF placed directly beneath the DUT socket cavity) alongside parallel Kelvin-sense pogo-pin channels for real-time remote voltage regulation to suppress IR drop below 25 mV.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying non-standard custom spring-contact pogo-pins or proprietary high-frequency test sockets will induce 14-week lead times and sole-source exposure. The bill-of-materials (BOM) must standardize on industry-proven beryllium-copper (BeCu) or palladium-alloy tipped pogo-pins (e.g., ECT or Smiths Interconnect 0.8mm/1.0mm pitch standard barrel) and automotive/industrial-grade multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs) in EIA 0402/0603 footprints readily available through standard commercial distribution channels.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schematic capture delivery must strictly freeze pin mapping and net naming hierarchies to align with the automated vector pattern generation milestones. Any ambiguity between VDD_CORE, VDDQ, and analog bias rails will cascade into re-spins of both the 16-layer high-speed loadboard PCB layout and the ATE device power supply (DPS) channel assignment map, jeopardizing the 6-week window before tapeout wafer arrival at the OSAT test facility.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe dynamic VDD/GND rail bounce during sense amplifier latching exceeding 10% of nominal rail voltage (180 mV), corrupting cell charge restoration and inducing destructive read failures.
1. Excessive pogo-pin loop inductance (>3.5 nH) causing resonance with loadboard decoupling capacitor networks, leading to undamped transient ringing at ~150-250 MHz.
1. Inadequate thermal and current-carrying rating on high-current VPP/VDD pogo-pin groups during HTOL burn-in stress (125 deg C ambient, 1.4x nominal bias), causing spring tempering and contact resistance degradation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-1-2-01` | **PDN AC Impedance Profile and Loop Inductance Verification** | Keysight E5061B Vector Network Analyzer (5 Hz - 3 GHz) with E5071C 4-port TDR option, Picoprobe micro-coaxial 50-ohm ground-signal-ground (GSG) probe, and calibrated ATE DUT socket test fixture. | 1. Calibrate VNA across 100 kHz to 1.5 GHz using SOLT standards at the GSG probe tip. 2. Land GSG micro-probes directly across the DUT socket pogo-pin contact tips for VDD-to-GND and VDDQ-to-GND nets. 3. Perform 2-port S21 series-through impedance measurement to extract Z_PDN vs frequency. 4. Record peak resonant impedance and frequency. 5. Switch to TDR mode and inject a 35 ps rise-time step pulse to extract total loop inductance across the pogo-pin/socket transition interface. | `Z_PDN across 1 MHz to 500 MHz must remain <= 45 mOhms for VDD and VDDQ rails; peak impedance resonance peak must not exceed 85 mOhms; extracted total pogo-pin loop inductance must be <= 1.8 nH per power/ground pair.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-1-2-02` | **Dynamic Transient Load Step and IR Drop Kelvin-Sense Regulation Test** | High-speed programmable active electronic load (Tektronix AWG70000 with GaN FET transient load switcher, di/dt >= 2.5 A/ns), Teledyne LeCroy WavePro HD 8 GHz 12-bit High-Definition Oscilloscope, calibrated 50-ohm active differential probes. | 1. Connect differential probes directly to the pogo-pin Kelvin-sense pads at the top of the socket. 2. Program the transient load switcher to pulse a 0.2A to 4.5A current step on the 1.8V VDD rail with a rise time of 1.5 ns (simulating multi-bank sensing activation). 3. Measure maximum dynamic peak-to-peak voltage droop (V_droop) and overshoot (V_overshoot) during transition. 4. Maintain continuous 4.5A DC load for 60 seconds and record steady-state DC IR drop compensated by Kelvin sensing. | `Transient voltage droop Delta-V must be <= 54 mV (<= 3.0% of nominal 1.8V); transient ringing must dampen to within +/- 1.0% within 12 ns; steady-state DC voltage error under full 4.5A load must be <= 10 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses with side shields, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) compliant nitrile gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness), ESD-safe dissipative lab coat with grounded wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistance)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with sterile isotonic saline or emergency eyewash for a minimum of 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmic attention. Skin Contact: Wash affected area thoroughly with mild soap and water; remove contaminated dissipative clothing. Inhalation: Move individual immediately to well-ventilated fresh air; if breathing is labored, administer medical-grade oxygen by trained personnel.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized laminar exhaust hood or dedicated fume extraction arm maintaining a minimum capture velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) at the soldering and board cleaning station; cleanroom air exchange rate maintained at >= 20 air changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and liquid IPA residues must be segregated into closed, grounded, flame-proof hazardous waste containers labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'; disposed of via certified licensed semiconductor hazardous chemical waste management facilities in compliance with local environmental safety ordinances.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / cleanroom grade) | `99.8% w/w` |
| **Rosin-based Soldering Flux / Residue (Abietic Acid base)** | `514-10-3` | Electronics Assembly Grade (IPC J-STD-004 ROL0) | `< 25.0% w/w in vehicle solvents` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Bare ENIG (Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold, 3-5 uin Au over 120-200 uin Ni) or ENEPIG loadboard contact pads and pogo-pin plunger tips, pre-cleaned with semiconductor-grade IPA, free of particulate contamination (>0.3 um), finger oils, and flux halides.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Assembled socket/pogo-pin array mated to loadboard PCB with contact resistance measured <= 35 mOhms per pin, contact tips desiccated and hermetically capped with anti-static nitrogen-purged protective cover.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture and airborne sulfur/chlorine compounds induce galvanic corrosion and micro-porosity oxidation of the thin immersion gold layer, escalating pogo-pin contact resistance from <30 mOhms to >250 mOhms, causing intermittent Kelvin-sense voltage drops and false ATE binning failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete, fully DRC-clean, and simulation-validated electronic schematic capture of the ATE Loadboard Multi-Rail PDN and DUT Pogo-Pin Socket Interface. The design implements decoupled power domains (VDD_1V8, VDDQ_1V8, VPP_3V3, VBB_NEG0V8) with optimized multi-tier capacitor networks, isolated remote Kelvin-sense lines, and interleaved signal-to-ground pogo-pin assignments matched to the 180nm DRAM test die footprint.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_LOADBOARD_GEN3_PDN_SCHEMATIC_REV1_0.pdf`
- [ ] `ATE_DUT_POGO_PIN_NETLIST_AND_BOM.csv`
- [ ] `PDN_AC_IMPEDANCE_SIMULATION_REPORT_DC_TO_1GHZ.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Simulated and captured PDN Target Impedance across VDD core domain from 100 kHz to 500 MHz** | `40.0` | +/- 5.0 mOhms | Keysight ADS / Cadence Sigrity PowerSI full-wave S-parameter frequency-domain extraction |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total lumped parasitic loop inductance per VDD/VSS pogo-pin power pair through the test socket** | `1.50` | +/- 0.25 nH | Ansys Q3D Extractor 3D quasi-static electromagnetic field solver netlist extraction |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Kelvin remote-sense track DC series resistance from pogo-pin contact pad to ATE DPS feedback terminal** | `1.20` | +/- 0.15 Ohms | Four-wire micro-ohmmeter measurement and Altium DC drop netlist simulation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal engineering signoff achieved upon zero ERC/DRC warnings in Altium/Cadence schematic database, 100% netlist correlation with the 180nm DRAM pinout specification document, and simulated PDN target impedance <= 45 mOhms verified and countersigned by the Lead Systems Engineer and ATE Test Program Architect.

testcases.title: PDN AC Impedance Profile and Loop Inductance Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight E5061B Vector Network Analyzer (5 Hz - 3 GHz) with E5071C 4-port TDR option, Picoprobe micro-coaxial 50-ohm ground-signal-ground (GSG) probe, and calibrated ATE DUT socket test fixture.
testcases.pre_conditions: Loadboard DUT socket populated with shorting calibration substrate; all decoupling capacitors soldered per schematic BOM; ATE DPS power planes connected with remote Kelvin sensing enabled; ambient temperature stabilized at 25.0 +/- 1.0 deg C.
testcases.procedure: 1. Calibrate VNA across 100 kHz to 1.5 GHz using SOLT standards at the GSG probe tip. 2. Land GSG micro-probes directly across the DUT socket pogo-pin contact tips for VDD-to-GND and VDDQ-to-GND nets. 3. Perform 2-port S21 series-through impedance measurement to extract Z_PDN vs frequency. 4. Record peak resonant impedance and frequency. 5. Switch to TDR mode and inject a 35 ps rise-time step pulse to extract total loop inductance across the pogo-pin/socket transition interface.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Z_PDN across 1 MHz to 500 MHz must remain <= 45 mOhms for VDD and VDDQ rails; peak impedance resonance peak must not exceed 85 mOhms; extracted total pogo-pin loop inductance must be <= 1.8 nH per power/ground pair.

testcases.title: Dynamic Transient Load Step and IR Drop Kelvin-Sense Regulation Test
testcases.instrumentation: High-speed programmable active electronic load (Tektronix AWG70000 with GaN FET transient load switcher, di/dt >= 2.5 A/ns), Teledyne LeCroy WavePro HD 8 GHz 12-bit High-Definition Oscilloscope, calibrated 50-ohm active differential probes.
testcases.pre_conditions: ATE DPS powered on with VDD=1.800V, VDDQ=1.800V, VPP=3.300V, VBB=-0.800V; loadboard docked to ATE test head; DUT socket loaded with high-speed dynamic load emulator die.
testcases.procedure: 1. Connect differential probes directly to the pogo-pin Kelvin-sense pads at the top of the socket. 2. Program the transient load switcher to pulse a 0.2A to 4.5A current step on the 1.8V VDD rail with a rise time of 1.5 ns (simulating multi-bank sensing activation). 3. Measure maximum dynamic peak-to-peak voltage droop (V_droop) and overshoot (V_overshoot) during transition. 4. Maintain continuous 4.5A DC load for 60 seconds and record steady-state DC IR drop compensated by Kelvin sensing.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Transient voltage droop Delta-V must be <= 54 mV (<= 3.0% of nominal 1.8V); transient ringing must dampen to within +/- 1.0% within 12 ns; steady-state DC voltage error under full 4.5A load must be <= 10 mV.

ppe_required: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses with side shields
Electrostatic discharge (ESD) compliant nitrile gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness)
ESD-safe dissipative lab coat with grounded wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistance)

cas_chemicals.name: Rosin-based Soldering Flux / Residue (Abietic Acid base)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with sterile isotonic saline or emergency eyewash for a minimum of 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmic attention. Skin Contact: Wash affected area thoroughly with mild soap and water; remove contaminated dissipative clothing. Inhalation: Move individual immediately to well-ventilated fresh air; if breathing is labored, administer medical-grade oxygen by trained personnel.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Benchtop localized laminar exhaust hood or dedicated fume extraction arm maintaining a minimum capture velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) at the soldering and board cleaning station; cleanroom air exchange rate maintained at >= 20 air changes per hour.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent solvent wipes and liquid IPA residues must be segregated into closed, grounded, flame-proof hazardous waste containers labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'; disposed of via certified licensed semiconductor hazardous chemical waste management facilities in compliance with local environmental safety ordinances.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Bare ENIG (Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold, 3-5 uin Au over 120-200 uin Ni) or ENEPIG loadboard contact pads and pogo-pin plunger tips, pre-cleaned with semiconductor-grade IPA, free of particulate contamination (>0.3 um), finger oils, and flux halides.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Assembled socket/pogo-pin array mated to loadboard PCB with contact resistance measured <= 35 mOhms per pin, contact tips desiccated and hermetically capped with anti-static nitrogen-purged protective cover.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Atmospheric moisture and airborne sulfur/chlorine compounds induce galvanic corrosion and micro-porosity oxidation of the thin immersion gold layer, escalating pogo-pin contact resistance from <30 mOhms to >250 mOhms, causing intermittent Kelvin-sense voltage drops and false ATE binning failures.

expected_result.summary: Complete, fully DRC-clean, and simulation-validated electronic schematic capture of the ATE Loadboard Multi-Rail PDN and DUT Pogo-Pin Socket Interface. The design implements decoupled power domains (VDD_1V8, VDDQ_1V8, VPP_3V3, VBB_NEG0V8) with optimized multi-tier capacitor networks, isolated remote Kelvin-sense lines, and interleaved signal-to-ground pogo-pin assignments matched to the 180nm DRAM test die footprint.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Simulated and captured PDN Target Impedance across VDD core domain from 100 kHz to 500 MHz
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Keysight ADS / Cadence Sigrity PowerSI full-wave S-parameter frequency-domain extraction

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Total lumped parasitic loop inductance per VDD/VSS pogo-pin power pair through the test socket
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Ansys Q3D Extractor 3D quasi-static electromagnetic field solver netlist extraction

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Kelvin remote-sense track DC series resistance from pogo-pin contact pad to ATE DPS feedback terminal
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Four-wire micro-ohmmeter measurement and Altium DC drop netlist simulation

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Formal engineering signoff achieved upon zero ERC/DRC warnings in Altium/Cadence schematic database, 100% netlist correlation with the 180nm DRAM pinout specification document, and simulated PDN target impedance <= 45 mOhms verified and countersigned by the Lead Systems Engineer and ATE Test Program Architect.
