# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## TDR Calibration & Microstrip Reference Fixture SOLT De-embedding

**Module Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > BEOL Multi-Layer Metallization, Wafer Sort & Packaging > Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing > ATE Loadboard Interface Design & JEDEC Timing Vector Pattern Generation > ATE DUT Loadboard PCB Schematic & High-Speed Impedance-Matched Layout > TDR Transmission Line Metrology & S-Parameter Signal Integrity Verification > TDR Calibration & Microstrip Reference Fixture SOLT De-embedding  
**Document Link**: [sop_tdr_calibration_fixture_deembedding.md](./docs/sop_tdr_calibration_fixture_deembedding.md)  
**Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) / 180nm Commercial CMOS MPW  

---

### 1. SOP Workflow Diagram
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   VNA/TDR Instrument   │
│          Prep          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SOLT Coaxial 2-Port   │
│          Cal           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Fixture 2x Thru     │
│    Characterization    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  AFR/SOLT S-Parameter  │
│      De-embedding      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   TDR Step Response    │
│       Impedance        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Instrument Stabilization & Acquisition Configuration**:
   - Power on the Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) equipped with Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) transform and step source ($t_r \le 20\,\text{ps}$, $V_{\text{step}} = 200\,\text{mV}$).
   - Allow a $\ge 60\,\text{minute}$ thermal stabilization in the metrology environment ($22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$, $45\% \pm 5\%\,\text{RH}$).
   - Configure frequency sweep from $10\,\text{MHz}$ to $20.0\,\text{GHz}$ ($1\,\text{kHz}$ IF bandwidth, 4001 points) with time-domain impulse/step window span of $10.0\,\text{ns}$ ($2.5\,\text{ps}$ resolution).

2. **Coaxial Tier-1 Reference Plane Calibration (SOLT)**:
   - Connect precision $3.5\,\text{mm}$ / SMA mechanical calibration standards to Ports 1 and 2 coaxial test cables.
   - Execute 2-port Short-Open-Load-Thru (SOLT) sequence to measure reflection ($S_{11}, S_{22}$) and transmission ($S_{21}, S_{12}$) coefficients across all standards.
   - Calculate systematic 12-term error vector coefficients, establishing the calibrated reference plane at the coaxial cable tips.

3. **ATE Loadboard Microstrip 2x-Thru Fixture Characterization**:
   - Mate coaxial launches to the on-board 2x-Thru coupon on the ATE DUT loadboard panel sharing identical dielectric stackup and microstrip trace geometries.
   - For wafer sort/pad interface lines, align coupon launch pads with standard Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) geometry: rectangular pads with width $W = 100\,\mu\text{m}$, length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Acquire complete 2-port S-parameters ($S_{11}, S_{21}, S_{12}, S_{22}$) from $10\,\text{MHz}$ to $20.0\,\text{GHz}$ and verify coupon phase balance ($|S_{11} - S_{22}| \le 0.35\,\text{dB}$, phase error $\le 1.5^\circ$).

4. **Fixture Bisection & Mathematical De-embedding (AFR / T-Matrix Inversion)**:
   - Bisect the 2x-Thru structure using time-domain gating / Automatic Fixture Removal (AFR) to extract the single-ended 1x lead-in fixture scattering matrix $[S_{\text{fixture}}]$.
   - Convert to transmission cascade matrices ($[T]$) and de-embed the fixture transfer functions:
     $$[T_{\text{DUT}}] = [T_{\text{fixture\_left}}]^{-1} \cdot [T_{\text{measured}}] \cdot [T_{\text{fixture\_right}}]^{-1}$$
   - Shift the measurement reference plane directly to the ATE DUT socket microstrip launch interface pads.

5. **TDR Step Response & Characteristic Impedance Verification**:
   - Compute step response via inverse Fourier transform / chirp Z-transform of de-embedded $S_{11}$ data.
   - Measure characteristic impedance $Z(t)$ along an on-board $50.0\,\Omega$ verification coupon.
   - Verify elimination of coaxial launch capacitive dips and connector inductive peaks.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
             TDR Metrology & De-embedding Target Metrics
            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │░░                                        │
  Delay Skew┤░░                                        │
            │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒       │
 Directivity┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒       │
Fixture Loss┤▓▓                                        │
            │▓▓                                        │
  TDR Zo Tol┤██████████████████████████████████████████│
            │██████████████████████████████████████████│
            └┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
            0.0      12.5       25.0      37.5     50.0 
```

- **Mean Characteristic Impedance ($Z_0$)**: $50.0\,\Omega \pm 1.0\,\Omega$ across the uniform microstrip routing length.
- **Max Launch Discontinuity Delta ($\Delta Z_{\text{discontinuity}}$)**: $\le 2.0\,\Omega$ deviation from nominal $50.0\,\Omega$ at the de-embedded interface plane.
- **Fixture Lead-in Insertion Loss ($S_{21}$)**: $\le 1.2\,\text{dB}$ at $10.0\,\text{GHz}$ for single 1x fixture trace segment.
- **Coaxial Calibration Directivity**: $\ge 42.0\,\text{dB}$ across the calibrated bandwidth ($10\,\text{MHz} - 20\,\text{GHz}$).
- **De-embedded Inter-channel Delay Skew**: $\le 1.8\,\text{ps}$ between matched differential / bitline test channels.

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Technical Context Citations

1. **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**:
   - Rectangular contact pad dimensions $W = 100\,\mu\text{m}$, length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\,\mu\text{m}$, progressive pad gaps $d = 5\,\mu\text{m}, 10\,\mu\text{m}, 20\,\mu\text{m}, 40\,\mu\text{m}, 80\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Linear relationship $R_T = 2 \cdot R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$, yielding diffusion sheet resistance $R_s$, contact resistance $R_c$, and specific contact resistivity $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\,[\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor geometry $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$ in $8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline layout with capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric layer with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, minimum storage node capacitance budget of $28\,\text{fF}$ per cell, and sub-1 fA leakage requirement at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh retention intervals.
3. **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**:
   - Test transistor geometries: long-channel reference $W/L = 20\,\mu\text{m}/5\,\mu\text{m}$, intermediate $W/L = 10\,\mu\text{m}/1.0\,\mu\text{m}$, and target sub-micron $W/L = 2.0\,\mu\text{m}/0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ ($180\,\text{nm}$).
   - Parameter extraction baseline: $V_{\text{thn}} = +0.55\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$ (NMOS), $V_{\text{thp}} = -0.60\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$ (PMOS), $I_{\text{on}} \ge 500\,\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ at $V_{\text{GS}} = 1.8\,\text{V}$, $I_{\text{off}} \le 10\,\text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$ at $V_{\text{GS}} = 0\,\text{V}$, and $I_{\text{on}}/I_{\text{off}} > 10^7$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: TDR calibration on an ATE loadboard microstrip environment requires a pristine definition of reference planes. Launch parasitics from SMA/2.92mm edge-mount connectors into PCB microstrips introduce significant capacitive discontinuities (~0.2 pF) and modal dispersion. An automated SOLT (Short-Open-Load-Thru) or TRL de-embedding algorithm must isolate the connector launch from the internal traces up to the DRAM socket pads, otherwise return loss and characteristic impedance (Z0 = 50 Ohm +/- 5%) will be skewed by fixture artifacts during high-speed JEDEC DDR timing vector runs.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct SOLT calibration on planar microstrip fixtures is sensitive to open-circuit fringing capacitance (C_fringing) and short-circuit via loop inductance (L_via). For DDR bus characterization up to 1.6 Gbps (800 MHz Nyquist, 5th harmonic at 4 GHz), non-ideal 0402 calibration load resistors introduce parasitic reactance above 2 GHz. The calibration kit standards must be fabricated on the identical Rogers/FR4 hybrid coupon with matched dielectric constant (Dk) tolerance and surface roughness copper foil profile.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring precision-calibrated commercial coaxial-to-microstrip SOLT calibration substrate fixtures (e.g., Rosenberger or Keysight Cal Kits) presents lead time constraints (8-12 weeks) and high NRE costs. The project must acquire precision 0.1% thin-film microwave calibration resistors (50.0 Ohm, 0402 footprint, Vishay/Murata RF grade) and gold-plated microstrip calibration standards fabricated concurrently on the loadboard panel coupon to preserve project timelines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: De-embedding verification must gate loadboard sign-off before socketing the 180nm DRAM test silicon. Fixture characterization deliverables, including S-parameter de-embedding Touchstone files (.s2p) and TDR impedance profile logs, must be reviewed and signed off prior to running automated JEDEC DDR HTOL burn-in vectors.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inductive ground-loop peaking at the SMA transition misidentified as transmission line impedance mismatch
1. Frequency-dependent phase rotation error during SOLT 12-term error correction due to improper calibration standard delay entry
1. Oxidation or wear on microstrip cal substrate gold plating leading to non-repeatable contact resistance (>0.2 Ohm variation)

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-3-1-01` | **TDR Characteristic Impedance and Discontinuity Verification Across Calibrated Fixture Plane** | Keysight DCA-X 86100D Wideband Mainframe with 54754A Differential TDR Module (20 GHz bandwidth, 18 ps incident rise time), 50-Ohm matched torque wrench (8 in-lb), micro-probing station with G-S-G 500um pitch probes. | 1. Connect high-bandwidth precision coaxial cables to Channel 1 and Channel 2 of the TDR module. 2. Apply TDR incident step into the 2.92mm launch connector of the microstrip Thru calibration trace. 3. Position the G-S-G probe at the fixture reference plane. 4. Execute impedance trace acquisition over a 10 ns window with 4096 points. 5. Apply software SOLT de-embedding matrix to mathematically remove launch connector discontinuity. 6. Measure characteristic impedance Z0 along the flat microstrip region and extract peak reflection coefficient (rho). | `De-embedded characteristic impedance Z0 must be within 50.0 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm (47.5 to 52.5 Ohm) across the entire trace length; peak parasitic launch discontinuity after de-embedding must not exceed |Delta Z| < 1.5 Ohm.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-3-1-02` | **Vector Network Analyzer 2-Port SOLT Calibration and S-Parameter De-embedding Error Verification** | Rohde & Schwarz ZNA26 4-Port VNA (100 kHz to 26.5 GHz), Rosenberger SOLT calibration verification coupon, 3.5mm precision calibration kit. | 1. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) of the Microstrip Short, Open, Load, and Thru reference standards on the PCB coupon. 2. Generate 2x1-port / 2-port de-embedding S-parameter files (.s2p) using the 12-term error model. 3. Measure the Verification 50-Ohm microstrip transmission line with de-embedding algorithms activated. 4. Measure residual return loss (S11) and insertion loss flatness (S21) up to 8 GHz. 5. Verify phase linearity and group delay variation across the JEDEC DDR signaling frequency band (100 MHz to 4 GHz). | `Residual Return Loss |S11| > 22 dB from 100 MHz to 4.0 GHz; Insertion Loss |S21| magnitude deviation < 0.2 dB relative to theoretical copper/dielectric loss model; Group delay variation < +/- 12 ps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) dissipative wrist strap and grounded lab coat, Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (powder-free, 4 mil)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact: Wash thoroughly with soap and water. In case of eye splash: Irrigate eyes immediately with eyewash fountain for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek medical attention if irritation persists. In case of inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard electronics RF metrology lab HVAC maintaining 20-22 deg C, 40-50% RH, with local downdraft or bench-top fume extractor for solvent cleaning wipes.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and swabs must be segregated into closed-top, designated yellow flammable/solvent waste receptacles for certified hazardous chemical disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, RF Contact Cleaner)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / Electronic Grade) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly plated Immersion Gold / ENIG microstrip contact coupon, clean and free of organic residues, finger oils, or dust.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: SOLT probe-contacted gold pads cleaned with electronic-grade IPA wipe, free of probe tip scrub gouging exceeding 5 um depth.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient atmospheric exposure causes surface tarnish, copper intermetallic migration, and humidity absorption into FR4/Rogers prepreg, altering dielectric loss tangent (tan delta) and degrading high-frequency calibration repeatability (>0.5 dB shift at 4 GHz).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete SOLT calibration and de-embedding verification of the ATE DUT loadboard microstrip test fixtures, establishing reference planes at the DRAM socket pin boundary and confirming 50-Ohm controlled impedance integrity across all DDR signal vector paths.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_DUT_Microstrip_SOLT_Deembedding_Model.s2p`
- [ ] `TDR_Z0_Trace_Verification_Report_Gen3.pdf`
- [ ] `SOLT_Calibration_Coupon_SParam_Matrix.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **De-embedded Microstrip Line Characteristic Impedance (Z0)** | `50.0 Ohm` | +/- 2.5 Ohm | Keysight DCA-X 86100D TDR step-response analysis at 20 ps rise time |
| `ASSERT-02` | **De-embedded Residual Return Loss (|S11|) up to 4 GHz** | `24.0 dB` | >= 22.0 dB minimum | R&S ZNA26 VNA 2-port calibrated S-parameter frequency sweep |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Differential Insertion Loss Phase Deviation Across Cal Plane** | `0.0 deg` | +/- 3.0 deg | VNA S21 phase linear unwrap against theoretical transmission line model |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All ATE high-speed DRAM DDR channel microstrips pass TDR impedance bounds (47.5 - 52.5 Ohm) and return loss assertions, with Touchstone .s2p de-embedding models validated against reference verification standards and formally approved by the RF Metrology and ATE Lead Engineers.

critics.systems_engineer: TDR calibration on an ATE loadboard microstrip environment requires a pristine definition of reference planes. Launch parasitics from SMA/2.92mm edge-mount connectors into PCB microstrips introduce significant capacitive discontinuities (~0.2 pF) and modal dispersion. An automated SOLT (Short-Open-Load-Thru) or TRL de-embedding algorithm must isolate the connector launch from the internal traces up to the DRAM socket pads, otherwise return loss and characteristic impedance (Z0 = 50 Ohm +/- 5%) will be skewed by fixture artifacts during high-speed JEDEC DDR timing vector runs.
critics.domain_expert: Direct SOLT calibration on planar microstrip fixtures is sensitive to open-circuit fringing capacitance (C_fringing) and short-circuit via loop inductance (L_via). For DDR bus characterization up to 1.6 Gbps (800 MHz Nyquist, 5th harmonic at 4 GHz), non-ideal 0402 calibration load resistors introduce parasitic reactance above 2 GHz. The calibration kit standards must be fabricated on the identical Rogers/FR4 hybrid coupon with matched dielectric constant (Dk) tolerance and surface roughness copper foil profile.
critics.supply_chain: Procuring precision-calibrated commercial coaxial-to-microstrip SOLT calibration substrate fixtures (e.g., Rosenberger or Keysight Cal Kits) presents lead time constraints (8-12 weeks) and high NRE costs. The project must acquire precision 0.1% thin-film microwave calibration resistors (50.0 Ohm, 0402 footprint, Vishay/Murata RF grade) and gold-plated microstrip calibration standards fabricated concurrently on the loadboard panel coupon to preserve project timelines.
critics.laya_pm: De-embedding verification must gate loadboard sign-off before socketing the 180nm DRAM test silicon. Fixture characterization deliverables, including S-parameter de-embedding Touchstone files (.s2p) and TDR impedance profile logs, must be reviewed and signed off prior to running automated JEDEC DDR HTOL burn-in vectors.
critical_failure_modes: Inductive ground-loop peaking at the SMA transition misidentified as transmission line impedance mismatch
Frequency-dependent phase rotation error during SOLT 12-term error correction due to improper calibration standard delay entry
Oxidation or wear on microstrip cal substrate gold plating leading to non-repeatable contact resistance (>0.2 Ohm variation)

testcases.title: TDR Characteristic Impedance and Discontinuity Verification Across Calibrated Fixture Plane
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight DCA-X 86100D Wideband Mainframe with 54754A Differential TDR Module (20 GHz bandwidth, 18 ps incident rise time), 50-Ohm matched torque wrench (8 in-lb), micro-probing station with G-S-G 500um pitch probes.
testcases.pre_conditions: Loadboard microstrip test coupon placed in an ESD-safe controlled metrology environment (22 deg C +/- 1 deg C, 45% RH). 1-hour instrument warm-up completed; electronic TDR step generator deskew and 50-Ohm coaxial reference normalization performed.
testcases.procedure:
1. Connect high-bandwidth precision coaxial cables to Channel 1 and Channel 2 of the TDR module.
2. Apply TDR incident step into the 2.92mm launch connector of the microstrip Thru calibration trace.
3. Position the G-S-G probe at the fixture reference plane.
4. Execute impedance trace acquisition over a 10 ns window with 4096 points.
5. Apply software SOLT de-embedding matrix to mathematically remove launch connector discontinuity.
6. Measure characteristic impedance Z0 along the flat microstrip region and extract peak reflection coefficient (rho).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: De-embedded characteristic impedance Z0 must be within 50.0 Ohm +/- 2.5 Ohm (47.5 to 52.5 Ohm) across the entire trace length; peak parasitic launch discontinuity after de-embedding must not exceed |Delta Z| < 1.5 Ohm.

testcases.title: Vector Network Analyzer 2-Port SOLT Calibration and S-Parameter De-embedding Error Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Rohde & Schwarz ZNA26 4-Port VNA (100 kHz to 26.5 GHz), Rosenberger SOLT calibration verification coupon, 3.5mm precision calibration kit.
testcases.pre_conditions: VNA calibrated at coaxial test cable tips using standard SOLT. S-parameter intermediate frequency bandwidth (IFBW) set to 1 kHz with -10 dBm source power.
testcases.procedure:
1. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) of the Microstrip Short, Open, Load, and Thru reference standards on the PCB coupon.
2. Generate 2x1-port / 2-port de-embedding S-parameter files (.s2p) using the 12-term error model.
3. Measure the Verification 50-Ohm microstrip transmission line with de-embedding algorithms activated.
4. Measure residual return loss (S11) and insertion loss flatness (S21) up to 8 GHz.
5. Verify phase linearity and group delay variation across the JEDEC DDR signaling frequency band (100 MHz to 4 GHz).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Residual Return Loss |S11| > 22 dB from 100 MHz to 4.0 GHz; Insertion Loss |S21| magnitude deviation < 0.2 dB relative to theoretical copper/dielectric loss model; Group delay variation < +/- 12 ps.

ppe_required: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses
Electrostatic discharge (ESD) dissipative wrist strap and grounded lab coat
Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (powder-free, 4 mil)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Vector Network Analyzer S-Parameter Acquisition & Differential Trace Impedance Profiling

**Node Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > BEOL Multi-Layer Metallization, Wafer Sort & Packaging > Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing > ATE Loadboard Interface Design & JEDEC Timing Vector Pattern Generation > ATE DUT Loadboard PCB Schematic & High-Speed Impedance-Matched Layout > TDR Transmission Line Metrology & S-Parameter Signal Integrity Verification > Vector Network Analyzer S-Parameter Acquisition & Differential Trace Impedance Profiling  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   4-Port VNA SOLT or   │
│    TRL Calibration     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Port Fixture 2x-Thru  │
│      De-embedding      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Differential      │
│    Mixed-Mode Sweep    │
│    Sdd11 and Sdd21     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    IFFT Time-Domain    │
│    Transform / TDR     │
│       Profiling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Impedance Window    │
│   Verification: 100    │
│      Ohm +/- 10%       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **VNA Warm-up & Setup Configuration**:
   - Power on the 4-Port Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) and allow a 60-minute thermal stabilization period at $23^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ cleanroom/lab ambient.
   - Configure instrument stimulus frequency range from $10\text{ MHz}$ to $6.0\text{ GHz}$, intermediate frequency bandwidth ($\text{IFBW}$) set to $1\text{ kHz}$, and 1601 measurement points with source power at $-10\text{ dBm}$.

2. **Full 4-Port Calibration (Coaxial Reference Plane)**:
   - Perform full 4-port Short-Open-Load-Through (SOLT) or electronic calibration (ECal) over Ports 1–4 using a precision $3.5\text{ mm}$ cal kit up to the coaxial test cable ends.
   - Verify uncalibrated residual directivity $> 40\text{ dB}$ and raw source match $> 35\text{ dB}$.

3. **Fixture De-Embedding (2x-Thru / AFR)**:
   - Measure the 2x-Thru calibration artifact located on the coupon area of the ATE DUT loadboard PCB.
   - Execute Automatic Fixture Removal (AFR) or TRL algorithmic de-embedding on the VNA to mathematically subtract SMA launch receptacles, via transitions, and pogo pin interface parasitics.

4. **Mixed-Mode S-Parameter Acquisition**:
   - Connect Port 1 & Port 3 to the differential input pair ($D+, D-$) and Port 2 & Port 4 to the differential receiver/DUT termination ($R+, R-$).
   - Switch VNA mathematical display format to Mixed-Mode:
     - Differential Return Loss: $S_{dd11}$
     - Differential Insertion Loss: $S_{dd21}$
     - Common-Mode Rejection / Mode Conversion: $S_{cd21}, S_{dc11}$
   - Save multi-port Touchstone `.s4p` data files to the metrology repository.

5. **Time-Domain Transform & TDR Profiling**:
   - Enable the VNA Time-Domain / IFFT Transform Option in Low-Pass Step mode.
   - Set virtual step rise time $t_r = 50\text{ ps}$ (equivalent to the fast edges of 180nm CMOS high-speed output buffers).
   - Display impedance profile $Z(t)$ versus physical path length $x = \frac{c \cdot t}{2 \sqrt{\varepsilon_{\text{eff}}}}$ along the differential microstrip/stripline trace.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
High-Speed Trace S-Parameter & Impedance Targets
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│░                                        │ Sdd21 Insertion Loss Target (dB)
│▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                                  │ Sdd11 Return Loss Target (dB)
│▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │ Single-Ended Z0 (Ohm)
│█████████████████████████████████████████│ Differential Z0 (Ohm)
└┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
 0        25        50        75       100 
```

| Metric Identifier | Parameter Target | Tolerance / Boundary | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`Z0_DIFF_ATE`** | **100.0** | $\pm 10.0$ ($90.0$ to $110.0$) | $\Omega$ | VNA Time-Domain TDR step response ($t_r = 50\text{ ps}$) |
| **`Z0_SE_ATE`** | **50.0** | $\pm 5.0$ ($45.0$ to $55.0$) | $\Omega$ | Single-ended reflection profile ($S_{11}$ TDR) |
| **`SDD11_RET_LOSS`** | **$\le -15.0$** | Upper limit $-15.0$ | $\text{dB}$ | 4-Port Mixed-mode sweep ($10\text{ MHz} - 1.6\text{ GHz}$) |
| **`SDD21_INS_LOSS`** | **$\ge -1.2$** | Minimum $-1.2$ (attenuation $\le 1.2$) | $\text{dB}$ | 4-Port Mixed-mode through measurement at $1.6\text{ GHz}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
- **Source: Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**  
  *Context applied:* Fast-switching buffer transistor edge rates ($L = 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$, $V_{DS} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $I_{\text{on}} \ge 500\ \mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$) establish the required $t_r = 50\text{ ps}$ step pulse rise-time in the time-domain IFFT impedance profiling.
- **Source: Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**  
  *Context applied:* Governs transmission line metrology de-embedding principles ($R_T = 2 R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$) applied analogously across calibration coupon traces to isolate fixture contact interface parasitics from PCB trace propagation parameters.

---
> [!NOTE]
> Micro-knowledge for this procedure has been persisted to [docs/knowledge/vna_s_parameter_differential_profiling.md](./docs/knowledge/vna_s_parameter_differential_profiling.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Loadboard PCB differential traces for high-speed DDR command, address, and data strobe (DQS) lines require end-to-end impedance matching to prevent reflection-induced eye closure at the ATE pogo-pin interface. Fixture de-embedding via 2x Thru or TRL calibration coupons must be strictly executed up to the 5th harmonic of the clock frequency (minimum 4 GHz bandwidth for 180nm DDR-200/333/400 operation) to isolate loadboard trace transmission characteristics from test fixture parasitics and SMA launch transitions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Mixed-mode S-parameter acquisition (specifically differential return loss SDD11 and differential insertion loss SDD21) must maintain differential trace impedance at Zdiff = 100 Ω ± 7% across all routing layers (Megtron 6 or Nelco N4000-13 substrate). Any localized impedance discontinuities caused by reference plane splits, microstrip-to-stripline via stubs, or solder mask dielectric tolerance will degrade common-mode rejection (SCD21) and induce excessive skew between differential DQS/DQS# pairs exceeding the JEDEC tDQSQ limit of 0.40 ns.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precision 3.5mm/2.92mm calibration kits (SOLT/TRL) and high-bandwidth RF semi-rigid coaxial test leads are single-source capital items with 8-12 week procurement lead times; spare matched probe pairs and torque wrenches (5/16-inch, 8 in-lbs) must be inventoried locally to prevent metrology stalls during loadboard bring-up for foundry MPW delivery.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: VNA metrology validation must be signed off within a strict 72-hour window following PCB delivery to unblock ATE socket mechanical assembly and JEDEC pattern qualification. Delays in fixture de-embedding calculations directly push wafer sort schedule milestones and consume reserved burn-in socket availability.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Uncompensated high-frequency test fixture launch via stubs causing resonance dips in SDD21 below -3 dB at 2.5 GHz.
1. Improper VNA electronic calibration (E-Cal) or over-torqued SMA connectors introducing phase drift and false differential impedance readings (> ±10% off-target).
1. Asymmetric coupled microstrip etch undercut leading to differential-to-common mode conversion (SCD21 > -20 dB), violating DDR differential signaling noise margins.

Configure frequency sweep from 10 MHz to 10 GHz with 1601 points, IF bandwidth 1 kHz, source power -5 dBm. 3. Enable Time Domain Transform (IFFT with Kaiser-Bessel window, beta=6) with a step rise time set to 50 ps (10-90%). 4. Measure instantaneous differential characteristic impedance Zdiff(t) along the trace length (from launch SMA to socket pad). 5. Record minimum, maximum, and mean Zdiff values across the active trace region. 6. Repeat across all critical DDR data strobe and clock differential trace pairs on the loadboard. | `Differential impedance Zdiff across active trace length must remain within 100.0 Ω ± 7.0 Ω (93.0 Ω to 107.0 Ω). Localized discontinuities at via transitions must not deviate outside 90.0 Ω to 112.0 Ω for a duration exceeding 35 ps.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-3-2-02` | **Mixed-Mode S-Parameter Insertion Loss (SDD21) and Common-Mode Conversion (SCD21) Verification** | Keysight E5080B 4-Port 20 GHz VNA, N4691D ECal module, precision matched SMA semi-rigid RF cable assemblies, calibrated loadboard test coupon fixtures. | 1. Measure baseline 4-port single-ended S-parameters across 10 MHz to 6 GHz. 2. Compute mathematical conversion to mixed-mode S-parameters: SDD11, SDD21, and SCD21. 3. De-embed fixture launch parasitics using loaded 1x Thru/2x Thru S-parameter touchstone files. 4. Record differential insertion loss SDD21 at Nyquist frequency (f = 200 MHz for DDR-400 and f = 1 GHz for harmonic analysis). 5. Measure differential return loss SDD11 across 10 MHz to 3 GHz. 6. Extract common-mode conversion SCD21 across the operational band up to 3 GHz to evaluate trace asymmetry. | `Differential insertion loss SDD21 must be > -1.8 dB at 1.0 GHz. Differential return loss SDD11 must remain < -15.0 dB up to 2.0 GHz. Mode conversion SCD21 must be < -25.0 dB across 10 MHz to 3.0 GHz, guaranteeing common-mode noise suppression.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety spectacles with side shields, Class 0 ESD static-dissipative wrist strap with 1 MΩ current-limiting resistor, Powder-free cleanroom-grade nitrile gloves (4 mil thickness)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Wash affected area with soap and clean water. Eye contact: Irrigate eyes immediately with sterile isotonic saline or emergency eyewash water for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Move individual to fresh air. If irritation or dizziness persists, seek immediate medical consultation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized laminar fume extractor or ESD-safe point-of-use snorkel exhaust operating at minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) during chemical solvent wipe procedures.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used solvent-wetted lint-free poly-cellulose wipes must be collected in an airtight, self-closing FM-approved flammables waste container and disposed of through licensed hazardous waste incineration protocols.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly fabricated ATE loadboard with immersion silver (IAg) or electroless nickel immersion gold (ENIG) surface finish, unoxidized, free of flux residue or ionic contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: De-fluxed, solvent-cleaned, dry contact pads with zero mechanical burnishing or connector thread deformation, inspected under 20x optical inspection.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric tarnish of immersion silver finish or copper oxidation on exposed calibration coupon pads, causing high contact resistance (> 0.2 Ω) and erratic micro-probe calibration drift during VNA acquisition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete mixed-mode S-parameter acquisition and differential trace impedance profiling of all DDR high-speed interconnects on the ATE DUT loadboard, fully verified with de-embedded fixture models and compliant with JEDEC DDR impedance and signal integrity specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_Loadboard_DDR_Differential_SParameters_DeEmbedded.s4p`
- [ ] `TDR_Differential_Trace_Impedance_Profile_Report.csv`
- [ ] `VNA_ATE_Fixture_DeEmbedding_Signoff_Certificate.pdf`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Differential insertion loss (SDD21) at 1.0 GHz fundamental test frequency** | `-1.2` | +0.4 / -0.6 dB | Mixed-mode S-parameter 4-port measurement post 2x Thru launch de-embedding |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Differential-to-common mode conversion (SCD21) up to 3.0 GHz** | `-28.0` | < -25.0 dB maximum threshold | Mixed-mode S-parameter extraction using Keysight E5080B VNA S-parameter calculation engine |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All high-speed differential signal pairs on the ATE loadboard show 100 Ω ± 7% impedance profile with zero discontinuities exceeding tolerance limits, differential return loss SDD11 < -15 dB up to 2 GHz, and de-embedded .s4p Touchstone files archived and validated against golden JEDEC timing vectors.

An actionable, industrial leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been authored and documented in [`docs/sop_tdr_discontinuity_extraction_eye_diagram_signal_integrity.md`](./docs/sop_tdr_discontinuity_extraction_eye_diagram_signal_integrity.md).

### Summary of the Implemented SOP

- **Domain Module**: Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing > ATE Loadboard Interface Design & JEDEC Timing Vector Pattern Generation > ATE DUT Loadboard PCB Schematic & High-Speed Impedance-Matched Layout > TDR Transmission Line Metrology & S-Parameter Signal Integrity Verification > **TDR Discontinuity Extraction & Eye-Diagram Signal Integrity Verification**.
- **Execution Architecture**:
  1. **Calibration & De-embedding**: SOLT coaxial calibration and AFR / 2x-Thru de-embedding to shift the measurement reference plane directly to the ATE loadboard launch interface.
  2. **TDR Step Response & Impedance Profiling**: Step injection ($t_r = 30\text{ ps} \pm 2\text{ ps}$, $V_{\text{step}} = 200\text{ to } 400\text{ mV}$) to construct spatial $Z(t)$ across launch, trace, pogo-pin/socket, and DRAM package bond wire zones.
  3. **Reactive Discontinuity Extraction**: Direct numerical integration of $\Gamma(t)$ to isolate excess shunt capacitance ($C_{\text{pad}} = -\frac{1}{2 Z_0} \int \Gamma(t) dt$) and excess series loop inductance ($L_{\text{via}} = \frac{Z_0}{2} \int \Gamma(t) dt$).
  4. **JEDEC DDR PRBS Testing & Eye Acquisition**: Excitation with PRBS-7/15 patterns at nominal $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ swing across high-bandwidth differential active probing.
  5. **Eye & Jitter Decomposition**: Dual-Dirac decomposition of $TJ$ at $\text{BER} = 10^{-12}$ ($TJ = DJ_{\delta-\delta} + 14.069 \cdot RJ_{\text{rms}}$) and JEDEC keep-out diamond mask compliance.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Microstrip Line Impedance ($Z_0$)** | $50.0$ | $\pm 2.5$ ($47.5 \text{ to } 52.5$) | $\Omega$ |
| **Excess Pad Shunt Capacitance ($C_{\text{pad}}$)** | $\le 0.45$ | $\text{Max } 0.50$ | $\text{pF}$ |
| **Excess Via/Pin Loop Inductance ($L_{\text{via}}$)** | $\le 0.85$ | $\text{Max } 1.10$ | $\text{nH}$ |
| **Eye Height Opening ($V_{\text{eye}}$)** | $\ge 1.35$ | $\text{Min } 1.25$ | $\text{V}$ |
| **Eye Width Opening ($t_{\text{eye}}$)** | $\ge 0.70$ | $\text{Min } 0.65$ | $\text{UI}$ |
| **Total Jitter ($TJ @ \text{BER} = 10^{-12}$)** | $\le 0.25$ | $\text{Max } 0.30$ | $\text{UI}$ |

### Verified Local Literature Sources Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor channel geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and cell capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$).
- **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**: Sub-micron transistor parameters ($W/L = 2.0\,\mu\text{m} / 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$, $V_{\text{thn}} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$, $V_{\text{thp}} = -0.60\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$) and $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ baseline.
- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**: $V_{DD} - V_{\text{th}} = 1.2\text{ V}$ margin retention loss mechanisms and overdrive edge fidelity.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Loadboard microstrip-to-DUT socket transitions introduce parasitic inductances (L_socket ~ 1.2 nH) and capacitive pads (C_pad ~ 0.8 pF) that distort JEDEC DDR timing vectors. The spatial discontinuity profile extracted via Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) must be rigorously de-embedded using 2X Thru or multiline TRL calibrations up to 20 GHz; otherwise, the eye-diagram jitter metrics measured at the ATE pin-electronics will reflect board-level impedance mismatch rather than the 180nm DRAM output driver (Ron ~ 34 ohm) performance.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm CMOS with VDD = 1.8V, the output buffer drive capability (I_on >= 500 uA/um) and sense-amplifier restoration timing impose strict limits on allowable transmission line reflection. Any differential pair skew exceeding 5 ps or local characteristic impedance dip below 45 ohms (nominal 50 ohm single-ended / 100 ohm differential) will collapse the DDR data eye height below JEDEC minimum input thresholds (V_IH(AC) - V_IL(AC) = 310 mV), inducing false bit-error failures during wafer-sort and HTOL speed binning.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Controlled-impedance multi-layer Megtron 6 or Rogers 4350B laminates for ATE loadboards have long lead times (>8 weeks) and strict stackup tolerances (+/-5%). Failing to identify layer-to-layer copper surface roughness and dielectric constant (Dk) variations will cause high-frequency attenuation, requiring re-spins of expensive custom pogo-pin test sockets and delay of the 180nm MPW tapeout silicon validation schedule.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: TDR fixture characterization and eye-diagram validation must execute synchronously within the Stage 3 reality gate before committing physical engineering samples to continuous HTOL burn-in chambers. Any delay in establishing de-embedded S-parameter touchstone models will block automated test pattern generation and stall commercial packaging qualification milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. SMA-to-PCB launch pad capacitive discontinuity exceeding 1.5 pF causing >15% reflection coefficient (rho > 0.15) and degrading DDR clock rise times.
1. Excessive differential trace length mismatch (>0.15 mm) introducing intra-pair skew > 8 ps, inducing duty cycle distortion and complete closure of the DQ/DQS receiver eye mask.
1. Inadequate power distribution network (PDN) decoupling near the socket pins resulting in dynamic VDD droop (>100 mV) during simultaneous switching output (SSO), confounding TDR transmission measurements.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-3-3-01` | **Picosecond Differential TDR Impedance Discontinuity & Propagation Skew Extraction** | Keysight N1000A DCA-X Wideband Sampling Oscilloscope with N1055A 50 GHz TDR/TDT Module, Semi-rigid 2.4mm phase-matched coax cables (matched within 1 ps), G-S-G micro-probing station. | 1. Launch a 15 ps incident differential step pulse (200 mV amplitude) into the DQ0/DQS0 differential pairs via calibrated RF micro-probes. 2. Record the differential reflection waveform Z_diff(t) across a 10 ns window with 500 fs sampling resolution. 3. Perform spatial peeling algorithm to extract local characteristic impedance Z_0 along the PCB microstrip, via transitions, and socket pads. 4. Measure propagation delay t_pd on both true and complement lines to compute differential intra-pair skew Delta_t. | `Differential line impedance must remain strictly within 100 ohms +/- 5 ohms (95 ohm to 105 ohm) along uniform runs, socket pad discontinuity must not drop below 88 ohms (capacitive dip < 0.6 pF equivalent), and intra-pair skew must be <= 3.0 ps.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-1-3-3-02` | **PRBS-7 High-Speed Data Eye-Diagram & Deterministic Jitter Verification** | Anritsu MP1900A Signal Quality Analyzer (BERT) generating PRBS-7 differential patterns at JEDEC DDR data rates (400 Mbps nominal for 180nm), Keysight Infiniium UXR 33 GHz Real-Time Oscilloscope with DDR Eye-Diagram Compliance Software Suite. | 1. Drive continuous PRBS-7 data stream across the DQ/DQS channel at 400 Mbps for 10^7 unit intervals. 2. Trigger real-time oscilloscope using recovered DQS clock and capture eye-diagram with continuous color-grade persistence. 3. Extract eye height at 0.5 UI, eye width at VREF = 0.900 V, Total Jitter (TJ at BER = 10^-12), Random Jitter (RJ), and Deterministic Jitter (DJ). 4. Overlay JEDEC DDR input receiver voltage/timing keep-out mask. | `Eye height must be >= 450 mV at 0.5 UI; Eye width must exceed >= 0.70 UI (1.75 ns at 400 Mbps); Total Jitter TJ (BER = 10^-12) must not exceed <= 120 ps; Zero mask violations across 10^7 recorded bit cycles.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe grounded wrist strap and conductive heel grounders, Class 00 electrical safety insulating gloves rated for 500V working voltage, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, Lint-free nitrile cleanroom gloves (Class 100 compatible, 4 mil thickness)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush immediately with sterile eyewash solution or copious water for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash exposed areas with mild soap and water. Inhalation of solvent fumes: Move personnel immediately to fresh air; provide artificial respiration or supplemental oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation within dedicated ESD RF test bench equipped with localized arm hood extraction system maintaining minimum capture face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); continuous facility HVAC air circulation maintaining Class 10,000 cleanroom cleanliness.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes and solvent swabs must be deposited into closed, spring-loaded FM-approved flammable waste containers; hazardous waste collected by certified EHS disposal contractors pursuant to EPA RCRA and local environmental standards.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Grade 1) | `99.9%` |
| **Lead-Free Solder Residue (Tin/Silver/Copper alloy oxide)** | `7440-31-5` | Technical Grade | `<0.1%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly flux-cleaned, dry, gold-plated (ENIG/ENEPIG) SMA launch pads and pogo-pin socket contact arrays free of organic contaminants and oxide films.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Post-TDR probe-inspected contact pads with micro-scrub mark diameter < 25 um, zero copper exposure, wiped clean with anhydrous electronic grade IPA.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric copper and nickel-gold intermetallic oxidation causing contact resistance (R_contact) to escalate above 50 mOhms, inducing spurious low-impedance steps and phase jitter artifacts in broadband TDR measurements.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical layer de-embedding, spatial TDR discontinuity profiling, and DDR signal integrity eye-diagram signoff across all critical DQ, DQS, and Command/Address transmission lines on the 180nm DRAM ATE loadboard fixture.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_LOADBOARD_GEN3_TDR_DISCONTINUITY_EXTRACTION_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `ATE_DQ_DQS_S_PARAMETER_DEEMBEDDED_TOUCHSTONE_DATA.s4p`
- [ ] `ATE_JEDEC_400MBPS_EYE_DIAGRAM_COMPLIANCE_MATRIX.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Single-ended and differential transmission line characteristic impedance across the active PCB routing zone** | `50.0 ohm (SE) / 100.0 ohm (Diff)` | +/- 5.0% | High-bandwidth differential TDR step reflectometry (15 ps rise time) evaluated via DCA-X sampling scope. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Intra-pair propagation skew between complementary clock/strobe traces (CK/CK_B and DQS/DQS_B)** | `0.0 ps` | <= 3.0 ps | Time-Domain Transmission (TDT) 50% voltage threshold differential arrival time measurement. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **PRBS-7 differential data eye opening height at 400 Mbps JEDEC operational rate** | `550 mV` | >= 450 mV minimum | Real-time DSO eye-diagram compliance software mask test across 10^7 UI at nominal VDD (1.8V). |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal approval granted only when all differential channels exhibit characteristic impedance within 100 +/- 5 ohms, socket pad capacitive dips do not exceed 0.6 pF, and all DQ/DQS channels achieve 100% compliance against the JEDEC 400 Mbps eye mask with zero bit errors over 10^7 cycles.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Commercial High-Density Pogo Tower & DUT Test Socket Procurement

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > BEOL Multi-Layer Metallization, Wafer Sort & Packaging [BEOL & Packaging] > Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing [Reliability & Qualification] > ATE Loadboard Interface Design & JEDEC Timing Vector Pattern Generation [Circuit Design] > Commercial High-Density Pogo Tower & DUT Test Socket Procurement [Packaging]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-2-01` | **Thermosonic Ball Wirebond Shear & Wire Pull Mechanical Strength Test** | Dage 4000 / Nordson Microtester Bond Pull & Ball Shear Test System | 1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-2-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup

# Standard Operating Procedure: JEDEC DDR Functional Pattern Synthesis & VCD Vector Simulation

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pattern synthesis from RTL/gate-level netlist down to Value Change Dump (VCD) vectors requires strict cycle-accurate alignment with JEDEC DDR (JESD79 series) specifications at 180nm core (1.8V) and SSTL_2/1.8V I/O domains. Simulating asynchronous strobes (DQS) against bi-directional data buses (DQ) under event-driven VCD causes severe file bloat (exceeding hundreds of gigabytes) and edge ambiguities unless timing vectors are sliced and cycle-coalesced at explicit test vector boundaries prior to ATE translation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm CMOS with nominal VDD=1.8V, DDR read/write preamble and postamble sequences exhibit significant RC delays through pad ESD networks (R_series ~ 20-50 Ohms, C_pad ~ 3-5 pF). VCD simulations must utilize post-layout back-annotated Standard Delay Format (SDF) files with full parasitics across PVT corners (Slow-Slow 1.62V 125C, Fast-Fast 1.98V -40C, Typical-Typical 1.80V 25C). Omitting write-recovery (tWR) and activate-to-precharge (tRAS) min/max checks in the VCD monitor creates false test-vector signoffs that fail on physical ATE loadboards.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Translating VCD vectors into tester-specific formats (STIL IEEE 1450 / WGL) directly impacts ATE vector memory depth allocation on platforms like Advantest T5588 or Teradyne UltraFLEX. Uncompressed functional patterns that fail to leverage hardware loop counters and algorithmic pattern generator (APG) structures consume massive tester pattern memory, increasing test execution time from sub-seconds to tens of seconds per die, which drastically inflates high-volume sorting and qualification costs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Delivery of clean, verified VCD pattern databases represents the critical gating item prior to physical ATE loadboard channel mapping and probe card interface bring-up. Without an automated golden-reference pattern generator validating zero uninitialized 'X' states across all operational cycles, downstream test engineers will be stalled in manual vector debug on costly production ATE shifts.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Metastable 'X'-state propagation in gate-level VCD vectors caused by uninitialized sense-amplifier latch nodes or asynchronous reset deassertion violations during MRS (Mode Register Set) programming.
1. DQS/DQ strobe phase misalignment exceeding the +/- 200 ps window in post-layout SDF back-annotation, causing spurious data latch errors during read/write turnaround verification.
1. Tester vector cycle-aliasing resulting from non-integer ATE clock period quantization during VCD time-event flattening.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-01` | **Post-Layout Gate-Level VCD Simulation for MRS, Precharge, and Burst-Read/Write Cycles** | Synopsys VCS / Cadence Xcelium / Icarus Verilog digital logic simulator integrated with Synopsys PrimeTime SDF back-annotation engine; Python/Perl JEDEC assertion-checking testbench wrapper; VCD vector parser. | 1. Compile the post-layout gate-level netlist with SDF min/typ/max timing annotation. 2. Instantiate the JEDEC DDR functional sequence: Power-Up -> CKE assert -> PRECHARGE ALL -> Auto-Refresh (2x) -> Mode Register Set (CAS Latency = 2.5, Burst Length = 4) -> Extended MRS. 3. Execute sequential Burst Write cycles across all 4 internal memory banks followed immediately by tWR and PRECHARGE. 4. Execute corresponding Burst Read cycles, capturing DQ and bi-directional DQS transitions. 5. Stream simulation events to a compressed VCD/FSDB database. 6. Run automated vector audit to verify zero 'X' or 'Z' states during valid strobe windows and confirm tRCD (min 20 ns), tRP (min 20 ns), and tRAS (min 45 ns) compliance. | `Zero 'X' states captured on DQ/DQS pins during active drive/receive cycles; 100% data integrity match between write input vectors and read output strobe samples; zero setup (tDS >= 0.5 ns) and hold (tDH >= 0.5 ns) timing violations logged across 10,000 continuous test vector cycles.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-02` | **VCD Vector Cycle Slicing and ATE Vector Conversion Verification** | VCD-to-STIL Translation Tool (Synopsys TestMAX / open-source VCD2STIL parser); Virtual ATE Tester Pattern Simulator; STIL syntax and cycle consistency linter. | 1. Ingest golden VCD trace containing 50,000 vector transitions into the STIL translation pipeline. 2. Apply pin-state mapping: Input Drive Low ('0'), Drive High ('1'), High-Z ('Z'), Compare Low ('L'), Compare High ('H'), Compare Float ('X'). 3. Execute cycle-boundary coalescing at 7.500 ns tester cycles with DQS edge strobe placement set at 25% (read) and 50% (write) of period window. 4. Output translated .stil file and execute static timing vector linting for pulse-width violations and tester edge-placement constraints. 5. Run simulated playback of generated STIL vectors against the gate-level simulation model in loopback mode. | `STIL vector file translates with 0 syntax errors and 0 missing edge warnings; exactly 100% of cycle transitions match original VCD logic states; no channel transition violates the ATE minimum pulse-width limit (t_min_pulse >= 1.2 ns).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses for server/EDA hardware access, ESD wrist strap and conductive heel grounders (1 Megohm series resistance), Nitrile gloves (cleanroom Class 1000 compatible, 4 mil thickness) for testbench server maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Wash immediately with soap and copious amounts of water. Eye contact: Flush eyes with emergency eyewash for minimum 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Relocate personnel to well-ventilated open air. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; drink water and seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard clean server room HVAC with positive pressure, minimum 15 air exchanges per hour, and HEPA particulate filtration (ISO Class 7 equivalent environment). Local exhaust ventilation required only if solvent-based chassis or loadboard contact cleaning is performed.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipes and rinse solutions must be sealed in airtight polypropylene hazardous waste containers labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste' and collected via institutional chemical safety protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade (>= 99.9%) | `99.9% w/w` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `1440 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `720 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Digital RTL, gate-level netlists, and physical SPEF/SDF design artifacts stored in Git/LFS version control under strict cryptographic hash verification; no physical wafer queue-time applicable.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully validated, cycle-aligned VCD vector files and translated STIL/WGL test programs staged in secure release directory with corresponding SHA-256 checksums.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Configuration drift between EDA synthesis scripts, library timing models (liberty .lib), and physical tapeout netlist revisions leading to vector invalidation and costly ATE debug delays.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: Pattern synthesis from RTL/gate-level netlist down to Value Change Dump (VCD) vectors requires strict cycle-accurate alignment with JEDEC DDR (JESD79 series) specifications at 180nm core (1.8V) and SSTL_2/1.8V I/O domains. Simulating asynchronous strobes (DQS) against bi-directional data buses (DQ) under event-driven VCD causes severe file bloat (exceeding hundreds of gigabytes) and edge ambiguities unless timing vectors are sliced and cycle-coalesced at explicit test vector boundaries prior to ATE translation.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm CMOS with nominal VDD=1.8V, DDR read/write preamble and postamble sequences exhibit significant RC delays through pad ESD networks (R_series ~ 20-50 Ohms, C_pad ~ 3-5 pF). VCD simulations must utilize post-layout back-annotated Standard Delay Format (SDF) files with full parasitics across PVT corners (Slow-Slow 1.62V 125C, Fast-Fast 1.98V -40C, Typical-Typical 1.80V 25C). Omitting write-recovery (tWR) and activate-to-precharge (tRAS) min/max checks in the VCD monitor creates false test-vector signoffs that fail on physical ATE loadboards.
critics.supply_chain: Translating VCD vectors into tester-specific formats (STIL IEEE 1450 / WGL) directly impacts ATE vector memory depth allocation on platforms like Advantest T5588 or Teradyne UltraFLEX. Uncompressed functional patterns that fail to leverage hardware loop counters and algorithmic pattern generator (APG) structures consume massive tester pattern memory, increasing test execution time from sub-seconds to tens of seconds per die, which drastically inflates high-volume sorting and qualification costs.
critics.laya_pm: Delivery of clean, verified VCD pattern databases represents the critical gating item prior to physical ATE loadboard channel mapping and probe card interface bring-up. Without an automated golden-reference pattern generator validating zero uninitialized 'X' states across all operational cycles, downstream test engineers will be stalled in manual vector debug on costly production ATE shifts.
critical_failure_modes: Metastable 'X'-state propagation in gate-level VCD vectors caused by uninitialized sense-amplifier latch nodes or asynchronous reset deassertion violations during MRS (Mode Register Set) programming.
DQS/DQ strobe phase misalignment exceeding the +/- 200 ps window in post-layout SDF back-annotation, causing spurious data latch errors during read/write turnaround verification.
Tester vector cycle-aliasing resulting from non-integer ATE clock period quantization during VCD time-event flattening.

testcases.title: Post-Layout Gate-Level VCD Simulation for MRS, Precharge, and Burst-Read/Write Cycles
testcases.instrumentation: Synopsys VCS / Cadence Xcelium / Icarus Verilog digital logic simulator integrated with Synopsys PrimeTime SDF back-annotation engine; Python/Perl JEDEC assertion-checking testbench wrapper; VCD vector parser.
testcases.pre_conditions: Synthesized 180nm DDR DRAM logic netlist ready; extracted parasitics (.spef) back-annotated into max/min .sdf files; testbench configured for 1.8V nominal operation at 133 MHz (DDR-266, tCK = 7.5 ns) and 100 MHz (DDR-200, tCK = 10.0 ns) across SS/FF corners.
testcases.procedure:
1. Compile the post-layout gate-level netlist with SDF min/typ/max timing annotation.
2. Instantiate the JEDEC DDR functional sequence: Power-Up -> CKE assert -> PRECHARGE ALL -> Auto-Refresh (2x) -> Mode Register Set (CAS Latency = 2.5, Burst Length = 4) -> Extended MRS.
3. Execute sequential Burst Write cycles across all 4 internal memory banks followed immediately by tWR and PRECHARGE.
4. Execute corresponding Burst Read cycles, capturing DQ and bi-directional DQS transitions.
5. Stream simulation events to a compressed VCD/FSDB database.
6. Run automated vector audit to verify zero 'X' or 'Z' states during valid strobe windows and confirm tRCD (min 20 ns), tRP (min 20 ns), and tRAS (min 45 ns) compliance.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Zero 'X' states captured on DQ/DQS pins during active drive/receive cycles; 100% data integrity match between write input vectors and read output strobe samples; zero setup (tDS >= 0.5 ns) and hold (tDH >= 0.5 ns) timing violations logged across 10,000 continuous test vector cycles.

testcases.title: VCD Vector Cycle Slicing and ATE Vector Conversion Verification
testcases.instrumentation: VCD-to-STIL Translation Tool (Synopsys TestMAX / open-source VCD2STIL parser); Virtual ATE Tester Pattern Simulator; STIL syntax and cycle consistency linter.
testcases.pre_conditions: Golden VCD trace database generated from TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-01; ATE loadboard pin-to-channel configuration mapping file (loadboard_pinmap.cfg) loaded; tester period set to tCK = 7.500 ns.
testcases.procedure:
1. Ingest golden VCD trace containing 50,000 vector transitions into the STIL translation pipeline.
2. Apply pin-state mapping: Input Drive Low ('0'), Drive High ('1'), High-Z ('Z'), Compare Low ('L'), Compare High ('H'), Compare Float ('X').
3. Execute cycle-boundary coalescing at 7.500 ns tester cycles with DQS edge strobe placement set at 25% (read) and 50% (write) of period window.
4. Output translated .stil file and execute static timing vector linting for pulse-width violations and tester edge-placement constraints.
5. Run simulated playback of generated STIL vectors against the gate-level simulation model in loopback mode.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: STIL vector file translates with 0 syntax errors and 0 missing edge warnings; exactly 100% of cycle transitions match original VCD logic states; no channel transition violates the ATE minimum pulse-width limit (t_min_pulse >= 1.2 ns).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): JEDEC DDR Command Sequence & Testbench Pattern Synthesis

**Branch / Path:** `Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > BEOL Multi-Layer Metallization, Wafer Sort & Packaging > Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing > ATE Loadboard Interface Design & JEDEC Timing Vector Pattern Generation > JEDEC DDR Timing Vector Generation, VCD-to-STIL Translation & ATE Channel Calibration > JEDEC DDR Functional Pattern Synthesis & VCD Vector Simulation > JEDEC DDR Command Sequence & Testbench Pattern Synthesis`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Technology Constraints:** Access Transistor Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, Stacked Capacitor $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, $I_{\text{leak}} \le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Command State Sequence

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Power-Up &       │
│  Stabilization 200us  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Precharge All     │
│      tRP=15-20ns      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Extended Mode     │
│   Register Set DLL    │
│        Enable         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Mode Register Set   │
│   DLL Reset CL=2.5    │
│         BL=4          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│       DLL Lock        │
│   Stabilization 200   │
│     Clock Cycles      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Auto-Refresh 1     │
│     tRFC=70-75ns      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Auto-Refresh 2     │
│     tRFC=70-75ns      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Pattern Synthesis:   │
│      March C- /       │
│     Checkerboard      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      VCD Vector       │
│  Simulation & Strobe  │
│   Window Validation   │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **JEDEC DDR Initialization Sequence Synthesis:**
   - **Power-on Stabilization:** Apply nominal $V_{\text{DD}} = 2.5\text{ V}$ and $V_{\text{DDQ}} = 2.5\text{ V}$ with stable differential clock running for $t_{\text{INIT}} \ge 200\text{ }\mu\text{s}$ before driving inputs active.
   - **Precharge All (`PREA`):** Issue `PREA` with address pin $A_{10} = \text{HIGH}$ and maintain minimum precharge time $t_{\text{RP}} \ge 15\text{ ns}$ to discharge all internal folded bitline segments.
   - **Extended Mode Register Set (`EMRS`):** Assert $BA_0 = 0$, $BA_1 = 0$ with `CS_N`, `RAS_N`, `CAS_N`, `WE_N` pulled LOW to enable the on-chip DLL.
   - **Mode Register Set (`MRS`):** Assert $BA_0 = 0$, $BA_1 = 0$, $A_8 = 1$ (DLL Reset), CAS Latency ($CL = 2.5$), Burst Length ($BL = 4$), sequential burst type.
   - **DLL Stabilization Interval:** Hold inputs inactive (NOP/DSEL) for exactly $200\text{ clock cycles}$ to allow internal delay-locked loop phase locking.
   - **Auto-Refresh Commands (`REF`):** Execute two consecutive Auto-Refresh cycles separated by $t_{\text{RFC}} \ge 70\text{ ns}$ to prime the sense amplifier internal latch circuits.

2. **Functional Testbench Pattern Synthesis (BIST & ATE Vectors):**
   - **March C- Diagnostic Engine:**
     - $\{\Updownarrow (w0); \Uparrow (r0, w1); \Uparrow (r1, w0); \Downarrow (r0, w1); \Downarrow (r1, w0); \Updownarrow (r0)\}$ across all wordlines ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ access gates) to detect stuck-at, transition, and address decoder faults.
   - **Checkerboard Physical Coupling Stress:**
     - Alternate logical $1$ and $0$ across contiguous physical bitlines and wordlines ($D = 1, \bar{D} = 0$) to exercise maximum inter-cell dielectric coupling across the $C_{\text{cell}} \ge 28\text{ fF}$ stacked capacitor array.
   - **Retention Pause Profiling:**
     - Insert programmable static NOP delay up to the target refresh boundary to stress junction leakage ($I_{\text{leak}} \le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

3. **VCD Vector Capture & Digital Simulation Signoff:**
   - Execute cycle-accurate simulation with dump directives targeting all JEDEC DDR pins (`CLK`, `CLK_N`, `CKE`, `CS_N`, `RAS_N`, `CAS_N`, `WE_N`, `BA[1:0]`, `ADDR[12:0]`, `DQ[15:0]`, `DQS`, `DM`).
   - Run OpenROAD-compatible digital simulation engine capturing event times at $1\text{ ps}$ resolution.
   - Verify strobe window alignment for dual-data-rate read capture on both rising and falling edges of `DQS`.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DRAM Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked capacitor electrical parameter verification |
| **Cell Leakage Current at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold/junction retention decay test |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L_{\text{gate}}$)** | $180 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical layout signoff / GDS extraction verification |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W_{\text{gate}}$)** | $220 \pm 10$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical layout signoff / GDS extraction verification |
| **DLL Lock Initialization Wait Interval** | $\ge 200$ | $\text{clock cycles}$ | Digital testbench assertion monitor |
| **VCD Timebase Resolution** | $1.0$ | $\text{ps}$ | Waveform generator config signoff |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$."*
  - *"Stacked Capacitor Topology: Crown-shaped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) structure erected above the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug)."*
  - *"Capacitance Budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance."*
  - *"Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to achieve refresh interval."*
- **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow:**
  - Implementation flow verification stages including timing optimization, clock tree buffer synthesis, parasitic extraction, and final DRC/timing vector signoff.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-1-01` | **Thermosonic Ball Wirebond Shear & Wire Pull Mechanical Strength Test** | Dage 4000 / Nordson Microtester Bond Pull & Ball Shear Test System | 1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-1-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with uncured epoxy: Wash with copious soap and warm water (do not use solvents like acetone which increase dermal absorption). Eye contact with silica dicing slurry: Flush at eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dicing saw fully enclosed with continuous high-volume DI water mist shroud. Mold press and post-mold curing ovens vented through dedicated VOC thermal oxidizer exhaust stack.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Silicon dicing slurry centrifuged and segregated into solid cake for non-hazardous landfill. Cured thermoset epoxy scrap disposed of as regulated solid waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Epoxy Novolac Resin (Mold Compound)** | `29690-82-2` | Semiconductor Packaging Grade | `Solid pellet / transfer mold compound` |
| **Amorphous Silica Filler** | `14808-60-7` | Sub-micron spherical particle | `75-88 wt% in epoxy mold compound` |
| **Silver-Filled Conductive Die Attach Adhesive** | `7440-22-4` | Electronic Grade Silver Flake | `70-80 wt% Ag in epoxy base` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Saw-diced wafer mounted on UV dicing tape, clean and dry with zero particulate or water residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Epoxy die-attached, cured, and thermosonically wirebonded to leadframe/substrate pads prior to molding.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation of exposed aluminum/copper bond pads degrades thermosonic ball bond adhesion, inducing high electrical contact resistance or catastrophic non-stick bond pad lifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of JEDEC DDR Command Sequence & Testbench Pattern Synthesis: BEOL metallization, electrical die sort (EDS), wafer backgrinding/dicing, and wirebond plastic encapsulation successfully yield JEDEC-qualified DRAM packaged units.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Electrical_Die_Sort_Wafer_Yield_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Wirebond_Ball_Shear_And_Pull_CPK_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `JEDEC_TSOP54_Final_ATE_SpeedBin_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wirebond ball shear strength** | `>= 18.0 gf` | Minimum failure load >= 15.0 gf across 30 samples | Dage 4000 micro-tester lateral ball shear per MIL-STD-883 |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) wafer array functional yield** | `>= 90.0%` | Minimum yield >= 85.0% on prime wafers | Automated wafer probe array test with March C- diagnostic patterns |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Packaged DRAM package coplanarity & lead pitch** | `<= 0.08 mm coplanarity` | JEDEC TSOP-54 mechanical envelope tolerance (+/- 0.05 mm) | Optical 3D coordinate measuring machine (CMM) metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% passing electrical continuity and JEDEC parametric DC checks; destructive wirebond shear CPK >= 1.67 with zero package voiding or delamination detected under scanning acoustic microscopy (C-SAM).
