# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Post-Layout Gate-Level Dynamic Simulation & Full-Chip VCD Dump

- **File Path**: [sop_post_layout_gls_vcd_dump.md](./docs/sop_post_layout_gls_vcd_dump.md)
- **Technology Node**: Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip Architecture & Integration)
- **Discipline**: Circuit Design / Foundational Verification / Metrology Interface
- **Status**: Implemented

---

### Verification Flow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Post-Layout SPEF &   │
│        Verilog        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  SDF Back-Annotation  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Dynamic Timing     │
│      Simulation       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Full-Chip VCD Dump   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      ATE Vector       │
│      Translation      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Baseline Process Metrics Visual

```text
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░                                   │
    Grid Res (nm)┤░░                                   │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒  │
  Contact CD (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒  │
Target L_eff (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
  Cap Budget (fF)┤███████                              │
                 │███████                              │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       45       90       135     180 
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Parasitic Extraction & SDF Back-Annotation Setup**:
   - Extract `.spef` parasitics across all active device geometries ($W/L = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} / 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ for peripheral logic; access transistor $W/L = 220\text{ nm} / 180\text{ nm}$), confirming adherence to the physical grid resolution of $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) and minimum Metal 1 pitch of $0.34\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - Generate Standard Delay Format (`.sdf`) timing libraries across PVT corners (incorporating $V_{\text{thn}} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$ and $V_{\text{thp}} = -0.60\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$).
   - Back-annotate delays via `$sdf_annotate("chip_postlayout.sdf", top_tb.dut, , "sdf.log", "MAXIMUM")` in the testbench.

2. **Supply Domain & Simulation Environment Initialization**:
   - Set supply rails to nominal operating voltage: $V_{\text{DS}} = V_{\text{DD}} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
   - Define simulation timescale resolution as `` `timescale 1ps / 1ps ``.
   - Enforce active setup/hold dynamic timing checks (`+notimingchecks` disabled).

3. **JEDEC DDR Functional Sequence Stimulus**:
   - Initialize the DRAM core via Precharge All, MRS, and EMRS sequences.
   - Run row activate (`ACTIVATE`), read, and write functional bursts across memory subarrays.
   - Execute auto-refresh (`REFRESH`) bursts verifying cell retention margins under leakage criteria of $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ and cell capacitance budget of $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.

4. **Full-Chip Value Change Dump (VCD) Logging**:
   - Direct the event logger to capture all top-level pin and internal probe transitions using `$dumpfile("dram_fullchip_postlayout.vcd")` and `$dumpvars(0, top_tb.dut)`.
   - Verify that data strobe (`DQS`) and data pins (`DQ`) maintain valid digital levels without high-impedance or uninitialized state (`X`/`Z`) glitches.
   - Flush buffer stream via `$dumpflush` prior to closing via `$finish`.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Target Metric | Nominal / Limit Specification | Condition / Verification Scope | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Unit Cell Storage Capacitance** | **$\ge 28$** | Noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors & bitline coupling | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Cell Transistor Leakage Current** | **$\le 1$** | Sub-threshold & junction leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Transistor On/Off Current Ratio ($I_{\text{on}} / I_{\text{off}}$)** | **$> 10^7$** | Measured at $V_{\text{DS}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ ($I_{\text{on}} \ge 500\ \mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$, $I_{\text{off}} \le 10\text{ pA}/\mu\text{m}$) | Dimensionless |
| **Physical Placement Grid Resolution** | **$0.005$** | Foundry lithography manufacturing grid | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Target Sub-Micron Channel Gate Length** | **$0.18$** ($180$) | Physical gate length for sub-micron verification | $\mu\text{m}$ ($\text{nm}$) |

---

### Verified Context Literature Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), capacitance budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$), and sub-threshold/junction leakage ($\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**: Sub-micron transistor geometry ($W/L = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} / 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$), threshold voltages ($V_{\text{thn}} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$, $V_{\text{thp}} = -0.60\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$), and $I_{\text{on}}/I_{\text{off}} > 10^7$ at $V_{\text{DS}} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**: Placement grid resolution ($0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ / $5\text{ nm}$), contact dimensions ($0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$), and Metal 1 pitch ($0.34\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-layout dynamic gate-level simulation for a full-chip 180nm DRAM requires integrating back-annotated SDF delays with exact parasitic RC networks from Calibre xRC/StarRC. Without accurate modeling of power-ground rail collapse (L*di/dt) during concurrent column sense-amplifier strobing and multi-pad DQ switching, simulated VCD toggle times will exhibit severe optimistic skew compared to silicon ATE captures. Furthermore, generating uncompressed, multi-gigabyte VCD dumps without hierarchical strobe filtering risks overwhelming test vector memory depths on standard Advantest/Teradyne digital channel cards.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node (VDD = 1.8V), DDR DRAM functional verification must thoroughly capture corner cases including Read/Write turnaround (t_WTR), CAS latency (CL=2, 3), and row cycle time (t_RC = 60 ns) under dynamic supply droop. SDF back-annotation must account for PVT extrema (Fast-Fast 1.98V at -40°C vs Slow-Slow 1.62V at 125°C) to prevent zero-delay masking of sense amplifier latching setup/hold violations. Dynamic simulations must assert that mid-rail inverter switching margins (VM = 0.90V ± 50 mV) and ring-oscillator stage delays (tau_d <= 80 ps) remain uncompromised across all decoded bank addresses.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: VCD vector conversion into standardized STIL (IEEE 1450) patterns must align with domestic Vietnamese OSAT test floors and foundry-certified ATE platforms (e.g., Advantest V93000 / Teradyne UltraFLEX). Inefficiencies in uncompressed vector size directly inflate vector load time, ATE test execution seconds, and multi-site testing overhead, eroding wafer sort gross margins. Vector formatting must support standard 100MHz-200MHz DDR speeds without requiring custom, single-sourced high-speed test fixtures.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off criteria for the post-layout VCD dump must be strictly locked before the foundry tapeout review milestone. Long simulation runtimes (exceeding 72 hours per PVT corner) jeopardize scheduled MPW shuttle freeze dates. Milestone completion demands automated pass/fail verification scripts that cross-check dynamic VCD toggles against golden behavioral JEDEC models prior to committing to silicon mask generation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic setup/hold timing violations masked by uninitialized Xs propagating from uninitialized sense-amp cross-coupled nodes during post-layout SDF back-annotation.
1. VCD file vector truncation or file size explosion (>500 GB) causing downstream STIL translator buffer overflow and cycle-drop errors on ATE pattern memory.
1. Unmodeled IR-drop induced clock/strobe jitter causing DQS-to-DQ phase misalignment beyond JEDEC specifications (t_DQSQ > 0.4 ns).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-2-01` | **Post-Layout Dynamic Gate-Level Timing & JEDEC Command Vector Simulation** | Synopsys VCS / Cadence Xcelium digital simulator with Standard Delay Format (SDF v3.0) annotator and JEDEC DDR compliance testbench harness | 1. Compile the 180nm post-layout gate-level netlist with back-annotated max/min SDF delays. 2. Initialize the power-on sequence with stable 1.8V VDD and 200 us idle stabilization. 3. Execute DDR JEDEC sequence: Mode Register Set (MRS), Extended Mode Register Set (EMRS), Precharge All, Auto-Refresh (t_RFC = 75 ns), Bank Activate (t_RCD = 15 ns), and burst-length 4 Write-to-Read transitions. 4. Continuously log full-chip node activities and capture setup/hold/recovery timing violations. 5. Verify zero dynamic timing violations on memory core sense-amp latches and output FIFO registers. | `Zero setup, hold, or recovery timing violation warnings reported by SDF annotator across all PVT corners; JEDEC DDR command-to-data latency complies with CL=2 and CL=3; total uninitialized 'X' logic states at chip I/O pads equal 0 after initial reset.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-2-02` | **Full-Chip VCD Dump Generation and STIL Vector Translation Integrity** | VCD Dump Utility ($dumpvars/$vcdpluson), IEEE 1450 STIL Translation Engine, and Vector Cyclization/Formatter Checker | 1. Configure dynamic simulation harness to dump four-state VCD (0, 1, Z, X) for all primary I/O pins across 100,000 clock cycles at 133 MHz / 200 MHz. 2. Stream VCD dump directly through compression filter to verify file continuity and zero packet dropping. 3. Execute VCD-to-STIL pattern translation defining cycle timing boundaries, drive/compare strobes, and pin directions. 4. Run ATE vector rule check (VRC) verifying vector cyclization, edge placement within 10 ps resolution, and absence of fractional cycle glitches. | `VCD file generated with complete header and trailer without EOF truncation; VCD-to-STIL translator achieves 100% pattern conversion with 0 syntax or strobe errors; ATE pattern memory boundary limits (<32M vectors per pin) fully satisfied.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Anti-static ESD lab coat, ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses, Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves, ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with cleaning solvent (IPA), flush affected area immediately with copious amounts of clean deionized water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation, move personnel to fresh air. If irritation persists, seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / data center HVAC environment maintaining Class 10,000 cleanliness, positive air pressure (+15 Pa), temperature 20°C ± 2°C, relative humidity 45% ± 5%, and minimal 10 air changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked wipes and ESD consumables in designated sealed chemical waste bins; no direct environmental drainage.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for workstation wiping** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `1440 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `720 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Tapeout database frozen, SPEF parasitics extracted and DRC/LVS clean; digital gate netlists formally validated against RTL.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: VCD dump generated, verified, and translated to signed-off IEEE 1450 STIL test pattern ready for ATE loadboard tester pattern compiler.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding signoff queue window risks mask fabrication schedule displacement on the commercial MPW shuttle, resulting in severe tapeout slot forfeiture fees and multi-month foundry delay.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful generation and sign-off of post-layout gate-level dynamic timing simulation and complete VCD vector dump for the 180nm DRAM chip across full PVT corners, guaranteeing flawless JEDEC DDR functional compliance and verified STIL vector translation for ATE wafer sort.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_postlayout_dynamic_sim_report.pdf`
- [ ] `dram180_fullchip_timing_signoff.csv`
- [ ] `dram180_jedec_ate_patterns.stil`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **SDF dynamic setup and hold timing violations count across all internal flip-flops, latches, and sense-amplifier nodes** | `0` | 0 | Automated log parser across VCS/Xcelium dynamic gate-level simulation execution logs |
| `ASSERT-02` | **JEDEC DDR output data valid window (t_DV) during burst read at 133 MHz / 1.8V** | `3.2 ns` | +/- 0.2 ns | Direct strobe measurement on VCD wave dump at DQ pad transitions relative to DQS edges |
| `ASSERT-03` | **VCD-to-STIL translation cycle mapping coverage and pattern rule error count** | `100% coverage, 0 errors` | 0 | Synopsys TestMAX / Teradyne pattern compiler rule check report |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All post-layout dynamic simulations achieve 100% zero-violation SDF timing signoff across SS/FF/TT corners, VCD dump passes full-vector STIL translation without truncation, and the technical lead formally signs off the ATE vector release package.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-ATE-VCD-180NM-008`
**Title:** VCD Vector Timing Strobe Verification & Edge Discrepancy Inspection  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & Open-Source DRAM Integration)  
**Classification:** Metrology / Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Vector Qualification  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the industrial protocol for parsing synthesized JEDEC DDR functional Value Change Dump (VCD) waveform vectors, inspecting edge discrepancies against calibrated ATE physical pin-timing channels, and qualifying vector strobe placement prior to production wafer sort and JEDEC speed-bin test execution.

---

### 2. Relevant Literature & Process Constraints
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
  - Physical placement grid resolution: $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - Critical Dimensions (CD): Minimum active diffusion width $= 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$; minimum poly gate length $= 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$); minimum poly gate spacing $= 0.21\ \mu\text{m}$; minimum contact hole $= 0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$; Metal 1 minimum width $= 0.14\ \mu\text{m}$; Metal 1 minimum pitch $= 0.34\ \mu\text{m}$.
  - Lithography & Optical Limits: DUV $248\text{ nm}$ KrF excimer laser, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$, yielding resolvable half-pitch $R = 152\text{ nm}$.
  - Overlay Error Budget: Permissible gate-poly to active-diffusion overlay error $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology:**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Capacitance & Leakage Constraints: Target cell capacitance $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, sub-threshold/junction leakage $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required refresh retention intervals.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 1: Ingest & Parse VCD Waveforms (JEDEC DDR Functional Vectors)               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 2: Edge Discrepancy & Grid Alignment Check against 5 nm Physical Grid        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 3: ATE Strobe Window Placement & Skew Verification (<= 35 nm Overlay Equiv)  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 4: Retention/Leakage Refresh Window Vector Timing Validation                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Ingestion and Time-Scale Normalization
1. Load the synthesized functional pattern VCD file generated from the post-layout gate-level netlist simulation.
2. Verify that the `# timescale` declaration in the VCD header resolves to integer sub-multiples of the physical pin electronics deskew resolution (base simulation step: $\le 10\text{ ps}$).

#### Step 2: Edge Discrepancy Inspection & Physical Grid Quantization
1. Run vector parsing to detect fractional-edge jitter and transition discrepancies on critical signals (`CLK`, `CLK#`, `DQS`, `DQ[n]`, `RAS#`, `CAS#`, `WE#`).
2. Verify all transition edge placements align with the physical layout grid quantization of $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) equivalent timing increments without cycle boundary fractional truncation.
3. Flag any multi-transition hazard occurring within a window smaller than the minimum poly gate length physical delay ($L = 150\text{ nm}$ to $180\text{ nm}$ transit equivalent).

#### Step 3: ATE Pin Strobe Window Calibration & Deskew Verification
1. Map VCD edge transition timestamps into STIL timing blocks for ATE drive/compare channels.
2. Set compare strobe placement ($T_{\text{strobe}}$) at the nominal valid data eye center.
3. Ensure channel-to-channel edge timing skew across all parallel bitline and data channels (`DQ[15:0]`) does not exceed the equivalent critical gate-to-diffusion overlay alignment limit of $\le 35\text{ nm}$ propagation equivalent budget.

#### Step 4: Refresh Timing & Leakage Verification Strobe
1. Locate auto-refresh (`REF`) command sequences within the functional pattern stream.
2. Confirm the cycle interval between consecutive refresh strobe assertions strictly honors the target retention requirement corresponding to $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ maximum leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with a storage capacitor budget of $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Acceptance Target | Physical Unit | Citation Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Physical Grid Placement Discrepancy | $\le 0.005$ | $\mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) | *SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid* |
| **AC-02** | Channel-to-Channel Edge Skew / Strobe Overlay Alignment Budget | $\le 35$ | $\text{nm}$ (propagation equivalent) | *SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid* |
| **AC-03** | Minimum Storage Node Cell Capacitance Budget | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |
| **AC-04** | Maximum Cell Leakage Floor at 85°C Refresh Boundary | $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Simulated VCD dump resolution of 1 ps must strictly map onto physical ATE driver/comparator master clock vernier step sizes (50 ps minimum edge placement resolution) without round-off jitter accumulating across DDR burst cycles (CL=2.5, tCK=7.5 ns for 133 MHz / 266 Mbps DDR1). Aliasing or rounding between digital simulator time steps and physical ATE timing generators will induce false timing violations during edge strobe qualification.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: JEDEC DDR SDRAM specs (JESD79) enforce tight setup (tIS = 0.9 ns) and hold (tIH = 0.9 ns) relative to CK/CK# crossings, alongside bidirectional DQS strobe timing (tDQSQ = 0.5 ns, tQHS = 0.6 ns). Translating simulation VCD vectors into ATE STIL cycle-based formats requires precise strobe placement inside the valid eye; failing to inspect high-Z float-to-drive turnaround states will result in false strobe failures on the ATE pin electronics comparators.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: ATE tester time on mixed-signal memory platforms (e.g., Advantest T5588 or Teradyne UltraFLEX) is cost-prohibitive (> $0.15/sec). Any unverified strobe mismatch or edge discrepancy detected on the physical test floor halts production wafer sort, requiring multi-day vector re-synthesis and re-compilation cycles that burn MPW qualification budget and project lead time.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off on the VCD-to-STIL translation pipeline is a hard gating milestone prior to loadboard delivery and tapeout wafer arrival. Automated edge discrepancy checking must run in CI/CD within 60 minutes per pattern suite, ensuring any discrepancy between Verilog gate-level simulation strobes and physical tester cycle formats is flagged before tapeout fabrication completes.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Strobe overlap during DQS bidirectional bus tri-state transitions, causing erroneous comparator active-fail triggers on ATE high-impedance (Hi-Z) states.
1. Vernier edge rounding error accumulation exceeding DDR tIS/tIH jitter margin (±150 ps), triggering false vector mismatch failures during 180nm wafer sort.
1. Incomplete event edge extraction in asymmetric clock duty cycles (CK/CK# skew > 100 ps), causing functional false passes on defective memory arrays.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Ingest 1 ps resolution gate-level VCD vector file into the translation toolchain. 2. Discretize transitions into ATE tester cycle periods of 7.500 ns (133 MHz DDR). 3. Map driver edges (CK, CK#, CMD, ADDR, DQ write) and strobe comparator windows (DQ read, DQS) into STIL Timing Block Waveforms. 4. Run automated edge discrepancy comparison between input VCD edge timestamps and generated STIL timing definitions. 5. Log delta edge drift (t_drift = |t_VCD - t_STIL|) across 1,000,000 consecutive test cycles. | `Pass if maximum edge deviation |t_drift| <= 25 ps across all active pins, and zero strobe events land within ±500 ps of tri-state transitions; Fail if any pin exhibits edge drift > 50 ps or comparator strobes assert during floating states.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-1-3-02` | **DDR Read/Write Data Strobe (DQS) Eye-Center Comparator Timing Inspection** | ATE Virtual Simulator / Vector Execution Testbench (Advantest FutureSuite / Teradyne IG-XL Offline Sim), High-bandwidth Digital Timing Analyzer | 1. Load compiled pattern into offline ATE timing simulator. 2. Apply simulated ATE pin electronics channel skew model (calibrated to ±30 ps fixture tolerance). 3. Execute 8-beat burst read sequence (BL=8, CL=2.5) across all 16 DQ data lines. 4. Measure the clearance between the programmed edge strobe marker (T_strobe) and the earliest data valid transition edge (T_valid_start) and latest data valid transition edge (T_valid_end). 5. Verify strobe positioning is centered within the 2.2 ns JEDEC DDR data eye opening. | `Pass if strobe edge placement is centered within the eye with symmetric setup/hold margins >= 900 ps (margin >= 0.90 ns) and strobe window width <= 200 ps; Fail if setup or hold margin to data transition edge drops below 750 ps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, ESD-safe conductive wrist strap and grounding heel strap (1 MOhm series resistor), Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (powder-free, static-dissipative)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For isopropanol eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious gentle flow of potable water or buffered eyewash solution for 15 minutes holding eyelids apart; seek medical evaluation. For inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air immediately. For skin contact: Wash skin with mild soap and water; replace contaminated PPE.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / metrology computing laboratory HVAC supplying >= 15 air changes per hour (ACH). Solvent wipe stations must be located under an active localized exhaust bench (face velocity >= 0.5 m/s or 100 fpm) to mitigate flammable volatile organic compound (VOC) vapor accumulation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and cleaning residues must be placed into dedicated, labeled, flame-retardant hazardous solvent waste containers with airtight self-closing lids. Liquid waste to be disposed of through licensed chemical recycling contractor in accordance with EPA RCRA guidelines.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `1440 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `168 hours`

- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Latent design or netlist revisions rendered during vector translation lag invalidate timing vector fidelity, risking catastrophic pin-driver contention on physical ATE loadboard channels and premature test fixture damage.

# Standard Operating Procedure: VCD-to-STIL Test Vector Compilation & Waveform Cyclization

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Unconstrained VCD dumping from event-driven simulation generates asynchronous time-step transitions that do not align with discrete ATE test cycles, resulting in severe edge-placement roundoff errors during waveform cyclization. The compiler pipeline must enforce strict time-grid snapping against the master ATE period generator (tCK = 5.0 ns for DDR-400 / 10.0 ns for SDR-100 on 180nm CMOS) without creating fractional-picosecond phase jitter that violates IEEE 1450 STIL 1999/2005 specifications.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DRAM bidirectional DQ/DQS bus transitions require accurate WFT (WaveformTable) mapping and drive-to-compare tri-state switching margins. If event-to-cyclized state synthesis incorrectly handles high-Z (Z) to drive (0/1) turn-on delays (tLZ) and drive-to-tristate disable times (tHZ), the compiled STIL patterns will cause ATE pin-driver contention or premature active strobing, yielding false read fails during DDR CAS latency verification.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Translating VCD directly using closed-source vendor ATE translation licenses (e.g., Advantest V93000 SmarTest or Teradyne UltraFLEX IG-XL proprietary bridges) introduces recurrent seat-licensing fees and vendor lock-in. Utilizing open-source compilers targeting generic IEEE 1450 STIL and open ATE hardware formats mitigates lead-time delays and recurring NRE costs for Vietnamese academic and MPW multi-site testing.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Pattern cyclization pipelines often blow up vector memory depth when unoptimized VCD files (gigabytes of event logs) are unrolled into flat vector tables. The pattern compilation and compression scripts must fit within standard tester vector memory (<= 32M vectors per channel) and complete conversion within scheduled tapeout milestones without requiring multi-day translation runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tester Channel Driver Contention: Misalignment of drive-enable and compare-window timing sets causing simultaneous ATE pin drive and DRAM DQ buffer output, leading to overcurrent clamp trips and potential I/O ESD ring damage.
1. Vector Memory Overflow: Failure of pattern compression during cyclization, expanding repetitive refresh (tREFI) and NOP cycles into raw linear vectors exceeding ATE pin memory depth.
1. False Edge Jitter & Timing Violation: Improper event time-quantization during VCD-to-STIL generation that exceeds setup/hold window tolerances (tIS/tIH or tDS/tDH), invalidating speed-bin binning results.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-2-01` | **VCD-to-STIL Waveform Cyclization Edge Fidelity and Roundoff Error Verification** | Automated Vector Compilation Pipeline (Python/Perl IEEE 1450 Engine), Mixed-Signal Timing Analyzer / Waveform Comparator, High-Speed Digital Oscilloscope (20 GHz, Keysight Infiniium). | 1. Ingest raw VCD trace across 100,000 clock cycles containing ACTIVATE, WRITE, READ, and PRECHARGE sequences into the cyclization compiler. 2. Execute timeplate discretization and map event transitions into defined WaveformTables (WFTs) with Drive/Compare edge markers. 3. Compile into IEEE 1450.1 STIL output. 4. Re-simulate generated STIL vector file against original gate-level netlist in an ATE simulator testbench. 5. Measure cumulative edge placement variance and timing skew across all DDR control (RAS_N, CAS_N, WE_N, CS_N) and data (DQ[15:0], DQS) pins. | `Waveform cyclization edge deviation from golden VCD <= 25 ps absolute error; zero phase-slip occurrences; 100% vector state equivalence across all 100,000 test cycles without unmapped 'X' states.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-2-02` | **Bidirectional DQ/DQS Tri-State Turn-Around and Strobe Window Margin Test** | Advantest/Teradyne Compatible Digital ATE Test Station, PXIe Digital Pattern Instrument (100 MHz - 400 Mbps), Precision PMU (Per-Pin Measurement Unit). | 1. Execute JEDEC Read burst (BL=4, CL=2.5, tCK=5.0 ns). 2. Program ATE drive-off transition at write-to-read turnaround and position compare strobe window across valid DQ data eye. 3. Sweep compare strobe edge timing incrementally by 50 ps steps from tAC_min - 1.0 ns to tAC_max + 1.0 ns. 4. Log pass/fail transitions to map output data valid window and detect any bus-fight / contention current spikes on VDDQ rails. | `Measured data valid window width >= 1.75 ns at 200 MHz; tri-state bus float time tHZ <= 0.80 ns; peak contention current spike IDDQ_contention = 0.00 mA (no overlap between ATE drive and DRAM output buffer).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe dissipative lab coat, Class 0 ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Nitrile gloves (cleanroom grade, powder-free)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with cleaning solvent, flush immediately with copious amounts of clean deionized water for at least 15 minutes. In case of vapor inhalation, relocate personnel to fresh air immediately. For electrical shock from high-power loadboard supplies, isolate power source immediately before administering first aid/CPR.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / test engineering laboratory HVAC with laminar airflow; localized chemical bench exhaust with minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.5 m/s) when handling solvent wipe-down on ATE loadboards.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and IPA residues must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-resistant flammable waste cans and handled via certified hazardous chemical waste disposal protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (for test socket and loadboard contact cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `>= 99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Singulated packaged 180nm DRAM test samples and golden loadboard interface contacts cleaned and dried; contact pads free of particulate contamination (>0.5 um) and organic residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Post-test packaged parts with unbent, unoxidized leads/balls; loadboard pogo pins inspected for solder migration or mechanical wear.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive atmospheric exposure in uncontrolled humidity (>60% RH) induces contact pin oxidation and package moisture absorption, causing false contact resistance (C-Res) failures, ground bounce, and edge distortion during high-frequency vector playback.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full compilation, cyclization, and verification of JEDEC DDR qualification test vectors from raw post-layout gate-level VCD simulations into fully compliant IEEE 1450 STIL pattern decks, achieving deterministic cycle timing, zero bus contention, and automated validation on the ATE target environment.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_jedec_qualification_patterns.stil`
- [ ] `waveform_cyclization_timing_verification_report.pdf`
- [ ] `vector_compression_and_edge_fidelity_metrics.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Discretization and edge placement timing error during VCD-to-STIL cyclization** | `0.00 ps` | +/- 25.00 ps | Automated timeplate comparison script comparing event-level VCD timepoints against STIL WaveformTable edge definitions. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Vector memory utilization compression ratio relative to flat linear cyclized vectors** | `4.00` | >= 3.00 | Measurement of total STIL vector loop/subroutine footprint versus unrolled raw cycle count in ATE memory generator report. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Logic state matching between post-layout VCD and STIL playback re-simulation** | `100.00%` | 0.00% mismatch | Bit-level regression check using Synopsys VCS / Cadence Xcelium digital simulation testbench with STIL reader. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful zero-defect STIL compilation confirmed by automated golden simulation comparison, verification of vector loading into ATE memory without syntax or timing violations, and formal sign-off by the Multi-Agent Council test engineering lead.

critical_failure_modes: Tester Channel Driver Contention: Misalignment of drive-enable and compare-window timing sets causing simultaneous ATE pin drive and DRAM DQ buffer output, leading to overcurrent clamp trips and potential I/O ESD ring damage.
Vector Memory Overflow: Failure of pattern compression during cyclization, expanding repetitive refresh (tREFI) and NOP cycles into raw linear vectors exceeding ATE pin memory depth.

False Edge Jitter & Timing Violation: Improper event time-quantization during VCD-to-STIL generation that exceeds setup/hold window tolerances (tIS/tIH or tDS/tDH), invalidating speed-bin binning results.

testcases.title: VCD-to-STIL Waveform Cyclization Edge Fidelity and Roundoff Error Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Vector Compilation Pipeline (Python/Perl IEEE 1450 Engine), Mixed-Signal Timing Analyzer / Waveform Comparator, High-Speed Digital Oscilloscope (20 GHz, Keysight Infiniium).
testcases.pre_conditions: Golden gate-level Verilog VCD dump generated with 1 ps time resolution under SDF annotation (typ 1.8V, 25C). Target ATE master clock defined at tCK = 5.000 ns (200 MHz DDR).
testcases.procedure:
1. Ingest raw VCD trace across 100,000 clock cycles containing ACTIVATE, WRITE, READ, and PRECHARGE sequences into the cyclization compiler.
2. Execute timeplate discretization and map event transitions into defined WaveformTables (WFTs) with Drive/Compare edge markers.
3. Compile into IEEE 1450.1 STIL output.
4. Re-simulate generated STIL vector file against original gate-level netlist in an ATE simulator testbench.
5. Measure cumulative edge placement variance and timing skew across all DDR control (RAS_N, CAS_N, WE_N, CS_N) and data (DQ[15:0], DQS) pins.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Waveform cyclization edge deviation from golden VCD <= 25 ps absolute error; zero phase-slip occurrences; 100% vector state equivalence across all 100,000 test cycles without unmapped 'X' states.

testcases.title: Bidirectional DQ/DQS Tri-State Turn-Around and Strobe Window Margin Test
testcases.instrumentation: Advantest/Teradyne Compatible Digital ATE Test Station, PXIe Digital Pattern Instrument (100 MHz - 400 Mbps), Precision PMU (Per-Pin Measurement Unit).
testcases.pre_conditions: Compiled STIL pattern loaded into tester pattern generator memory. Active loadboard socket populated with 180nm packaged DRAM device under nominal supply VDD = 1.80 V.
testcases.procedure:
1. Execute JEDEC Read burst (BL=4, CL=2.5, tCK=5.0 ns).
2. Program ATE drive-off transition at write-to-read turnaround and position compare strobe window across valid DQ data eye.
3. Sweep compare strobe edge timing incrementally by 50 ps steps from tAC_min - 1.0 ns to tAC_max + 1.0 ns.
4. Log pass/fail transitions to map output data valid window and detect any bus-fight / contention current spikes on VDDQ rails.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Measured data valid window width >= 1.75 ns at 200 MHz; tri-state bus float time tHZ <= 0.80 ns; peak contention current spike IDDQ_contention = 0.00 mA (no overlap between ATE drive and DRAM output buffer).

In case of vapor inhalation, relocate personnel to fresh air immediately. For electrical shock from high-power loadboard supplies, isolate power source immediately before administering first aid/CPR.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Simulation VCD Event Extraction and Clock Domain Waveform Parsing

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Parsing Pipeline

The extraction flow transforms raw non-cyclized Value Change Dump (`.vcd`) event streams from post-layout gate-level or transistor-level DRAM simulations into structured, clock-aligned waveform tables suitable for cyclization and automated test equipment (ATE) vector translation.

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│    VCD Header &     │
│  Timescale Parsing  │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│ Signal Hierarchy &  │
│    Clock Domain     │
│      Filtering      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│     Event Time      │
│     Transition      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Cycle Boundary    │
│    Partitioning     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Drive & Compare   │
│ Waveform Formatting │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **VCD Header Tokenization and Timescale Normalization**
   - Ingest the simulation file header (`$date`, `$version`, `$timescale`).
   - Extract and validate the base resolution unit ($1\,\text{ps}$ or $10\,\text{ps}$). Normalize integer simulation timestamps into absolute nanoseconds ($t_{\text{abs}}$) using the scaling factor:
     $$\Delta t = \text{integer\_step} \times \text{timescale\_multiplier}$$
   - Establish the primary reference clock signal (`CLK` / `CLK_N`) and determine base cycle period $T_{\text{cyc}}$.

2. **Scope Hierarchy & Signal Mapping**
   - Traverse the `$scope ... $upscope` tree to locate the DRAM testbench boundary (`DUT` top-level I/O pins).
   - Map compressed VCD signal identifiers (e.g., `!`, `"`, `#`) to design port names:
     - Master clocks: `CK`, `CK_N`
     - Command / Address bus: `CS_N`, `RAS_N`, `CAS_N`, `WE_N`, `BA[1:0]`, `ADDR[12:0]`
     - Data & Strobe: `DQ[15:0]`, `DQS`, `DM[1:0]`
   - Verify digital logic levels against test transistor logic switching thresholds ($V_{\text{thn}} = +0.55\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$ and $V_{\text{thp}} = -0.60\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$ for 180nm core levels at $V_{\text{DS}} = 1.8\,\text{V}$).

3. **Time-Ordered Event Extraction & Clock Domain Demuxing**
   - Stream through simulation time markers (`#<timestamp>`).
   - Extract bit transitions (`0`, `1`, `x`, `z`, and multi-bit vectors `b...`).
   - Partition extracted transitions into respective clock domains:
     - Synchronous System Clock Domain (`CLK` edge-triggered transitions: Command/Address).
     - Source-Synchronous Strobe Domain (`DQS` edge-centered transitions: Read/Write Data).
     - Asynchronous Control Domains (`RESET_N`, `CKE`).

4. **Cycle Boundary Alignment & Hazard Filtering**
   - Compute cycle intervals $K \in [t_{k}, t_{k} + T_{\text{cyc}})$.
   - Filter transient simulation glitches below the minimum channel propagation threshold ($< 50\,\text{ps}$).
   - Assign transitions into ATE timing vector epochs:
     - **Drive Inputs**: Transition time relative to clock zero ($t_{\text{rel}} = t_{\text{event}} - t_{\text{edge}}$).
     - **Compare Outputs**: Capture strobe window verification during valid access window.

---

### 3. Timing Window Margins

```text
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
    Setup Window┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓        │
  Hold Margining┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓        │
  Capture Window┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
Jitter Guardband┤░░░░░░░░                              │
                │░░░░░░░░                              │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       155       310      465     620 (ps)
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Timescale Temporal Resolution** | $1.0$ | $\text{ps}$ | $\pm 0\,\text{ps}$ (Exact base conversion) |
| **Logic Core Voltage Level** | $1.8$ | $\text{V}$ | $\pm 50\,\text{mV}$ ($V_{\text{DS}} = 1.8\,\text{V}$) |
| **Glitches & Sub-Threshold Pulse Rejection** | $< 50.0$ | $\text{ps}$ | Filtered without state alteration |
| **Clock-to-Data Cyclization Phase Error** | $\le 10.0$ | $\text{ps}$ | Maximum vector phase skew across cycle boundaries |

---

### 5. Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell channel geometry $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, access transistor design, bitline coupling margins, and capacitance budget ($28\,\text{fF/cell}$).
- **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**: Logic gate physical verification parameters, $V_{\text{thn}} = +0.55\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$, $V_{\text{thp}} = -0.60\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$, operating rail $V_{\text{DS}} = 1.8\,\text{V}$, and $I_{\text{on}}/I_{\text{off}}$ ratios.
- **SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Overview & Architecture**: Digital timing library regeneration flow, OpenROAD toolflow event integration, and standard cell timing reference definitions.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: VCD event extraction must reconcile asynchronous mixed-signal behavior across discrete ATE tester cycles. Specifically, the Dickson charge pump operating at 20-50 MHz generates asynchronous V_PP regulation ripple (<30 mV p-p) and non-overlapping oscillator edges that do not align deterministically with the JEDEC DDR external CK/CK# clock domain. Without an explicit cyclization boundary and cycle-resolved event binning, asynchronous internal transitions will cause STIL vector compilation race conditions and false fail flags during ATE channel strobing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, driving wordlines to V_PP (2.7V +/- 50 mV) via non-overlapping clocks (Phi1, Phi2) demands exact cycle-accurate event extraction. If VCD event parsing misses high-frequency pump oscillator toggles or misinterprets the dynamic feedback comparator shutoff, the generated STIL pattern will fail to stimulate or verify wordline overdrive during write/read cycles, masking a potential 33% stored charge degradation (V_DD - V_th = 1.2V instead of boosted write) on the memory cell pass transistor.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated Test Equipment (ATE) platform memory depth and vector license constraints (e.g., Teradyne Advantest V93000 / J750) penalize bloated raw VCD-to-STIL compilations. Uncompressed asynchronous event dumps will exceed channel vector memory allocations per pin, forcing split-vector executions that drive up wafer sort test times and packaging burn-in qualification costs beyond standard MPW budgets.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The translation script and parser milestone must validate 100% vector cycle equivalence against simulated golden JEDEC DDR waveforms prior to physical probe-card signoff. Any parsing drift or timing vector mismatches will cause schedule slippage in ATE loadboard bring-up and compromise HTOL burn-in test qualification windows.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Asynchronous charge pump clock domain aliasing during cyclization, resulting in non-deterministic STIL vector strobe assignment and false ATE timing violations.
1. Omission of dynamic feedback regulator transitions in VCD extraction, preventing ATE verification of wordline overdrive (V_PP >= 2.65V) and passing marginal retention cells.
1. Tester vector memory overflow caused by raw event density spikes on high-speed Dickson oscillator nodes (50 MHz) during continuous burst reads/writes.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-2-1-01` | **Cycle-Accurate Clock Domain Extraction and STIL Timing Verification** | Advantest V93000 High-Speed Digital Pin Electronics Channel Profiler & Cadence NC-Sim/Synopsys VCS VCD Dump Analyzer | 1. Ingest simulation VCD into the extraction engine and isolate primary DDR CK/CK# and secondary Dickson oscillator domains (Phi1, Phi2).\n2. Execute cycle-binning algorithm targeting 133 MHz / 200 MHz JEDEC DDR timing grid.\n3. Map state transitions (0, 1, Z, X) and edge strobes into IEEE 1450 STIL vector syntax.\n4. Execute back-annotation check comparing STIL timing edges against original VCD event timestamps. | `STIL waveform cyclization must achieve 100% edge determinism with edge timing deviation <= 15 ps relative to the reference VCD across all primary JEDEC signal pins (DQ, DQS, ADDR, CMD).` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-2-1-02` | **Charge Pump V_PP Burst-Regulator Vector Compression and Strobe Density Check** | Oscilloscope Waveform Matcher & ATE Channel Timing Vector Memory Profiler | 1. Run the parser to identify asynchronous V_PP comparator shut-off events and oscillator burst states.\n2. Apply algorithmic cycle compression to repetitive oscillator burst clocks outside critical measurement strobes.\n3. Validate that generated STIL vector file fits within tester local channel memory limits (< 32M vectors per channel).\n4. Check that analog strobe markers for V_PP regulation window (2.70V +/- 50 mV) are placed precisely at relaxed ripple intervals. | `Generated vector memory usage must remain < 24M vectors/channel (compression ratio >= 4:1 on oscillator nodes) while maintaining 0 missed comparator disable/enable state transitions.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe lab coat, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom nitrile gloves (Class 100)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Flush skin thoroughly with clean water for 15 minutes. Eye contact: Rinse eyes immediately at eye-wash station holding eyelids open for at least 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh cleanroom air; seek medical attention if irritation or dizziness develops.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar airflow recirculation system with local fume extraction hood (minimum 100 FPM face velocity) for solvent wiping operations on ATE loadboards.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect IPA wipes and solvent residue in dedicated, sealed, flammables-rated hazardous chemical waste containers with proper labeling; dispose in accordance with regional industrial environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for ATE Loadboard Pogo/DIB Interface Cleaning** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry post-packaging ceramic/plastic leadframe substrate or diced wafer probe pads free from particulate and moisture contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pre-test clean contact surface on ATE loadboard socket/pogo interface with contact resistance Rc < 0.25 Ohms.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive atmospheric exposure induces galvanic micro-corrosion and copper/aluminum pad oxidation, causing anomalous socket contact resistance and timing jitter during high-speed vector strobing.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified, fully compliant VCD-to-STIL translation script and cyclized test pattern suite for 180nm DRAM, isolating synchronous DDR bus operations from asynchronous Dickson charge pump regulator dynamics, formatted for zero-failure ingestion onto the target ATE platform.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_jedec_timing_vectors.stil`
- [ ] `vcd_cyclization_parsing_report.pdf`
- [ ] `ate_channel_vector_timing_discrepancy.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Translation edge-placement timing fidelity between simulation VCD and parsed STIL output** | `0.0` | +/- 10.0 ps | Automated bit-level waveform differential comparison script cross-checking VCD transition timestamps against STIL timing definition tables |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Vector memory utilization efficiency under asynchronous pump oscillator compression** | `75.0%` | <= 80.0% max tester channel memory limit | ATE pattern compiler vector depth static analysis log |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero syntax errors and zero cycle-boundary timing violations during ATE pattern pre-compilation, confirmed 100% structural coverage of DRAM V_PP activation/deactivation sequences, and formal signoff by both Design Lead and Test Engineering Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## JEDEC Timing Cycle Boundary Snapping and Vector Cyclization Rule Compilation

---

### 1. Overview & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) defines the engineering rules and compilation flow for snapping event-driven digital simulation waveforms (Value Change Dump / VCD) into cycle-based IEEE 1450 Standard Test Interface Language (STIL) patterns. It enforces JEDEC DDR timing compliance and vector cyclization for Automated Test Equipment (ATE) verification on the DRAM Foundation VN Gen 3 (180nm CMOS, $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$) memory architecture.

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Event-Driven VCD    │
│        Stream         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Cycle Boundary     │
│     Snapping t_CK     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Edge Event       │
│    Classification     │
│       D/R/NR/Z        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Waveform Table &    │
│     STIL Mapping      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   ATE Timing Vector   │
│  Cyclization Signoff  │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Physical Voltage & Logic Threshold Mapping
- Map logic drive and compare levels to the 180nm CMOS target operating voltage:
  - Nominal core supply: $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
  - Target sub-micron transistor geometry: $W / L = 2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m} / 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
  - ATE input drive logic levels: $V_{IL} \le 0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$ ($V_{thn}$ boundary) and $V_{IH} \ge 1.20\text{ V}$ ($1.8\text{ V} - |V_{thp}|$).
  - Device threshold references: NMOS $V_{thn} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$, PMOS $V_{thp} = -0.60\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$.

#### Step 2: Timebase Normalization & Cycle Boundary Snapping
- Extract the reference differential clock signals (`CK_t` and `CK_c`) from the input VCD stream.
- Establish the fundamental test period grid $t_{CK}$.
- Apply an edge-snapping tolerance window of $\pm 100\text{ ps}$ relative to nominal cycle boundaries ($N \times t_{CK}$).
- Resolve simulator delta cycles and transition jitter:
  - If transition timestamp $\Delta t \le 50\text{ ps}$ of the nominal boundary, snap the event to the boundary $t_0$.
  - Filter intermediate glitch events shorter than $50\text{ ps}$ to prevent illegal vector cyclization errors.

#### Step 3: Waveform Format Categorization & Vector Encoding
- Parse pin-specific transitions within each snapped cycle $[t_0, t_0 + t_{CK})$ into standard ATE Waveform Tables (`WFT`):
  - **Drive Signals (Command/Address/Data-In):** Classify into `NR` (Non-Return), `RL` (Return-to-Low), `RH` (Return-to-High), or `Z` (High-Impedance).
  - **Strobe Signals (DQ/DQS Data-Out Compare):** Set compare strobe timing window (`Compare Edge`) at nominal $t_{AC}$ / $t_{DQSCK}$ offset with a $\pm 150\text{ ps}$ strobe window.
  - Driver skew window across parallel test channels is constrained to $\le 40\text{ ps}$.

#### Step 4: IEEE 1450 STIL Pattern Compilation & Export
- Compile classified cycles into IEEE 1450 STIL syntax:
  - Generate `Signals`, `SignalGroups`, `Timing`, and `Pattern` blocks.
  - Assign pattern characters: `'0'`, `'1'`, `'Z'` for inputs; `'L'`, `'H'`, `'X'` for strobes.
  - Verify that no illegal multi-transition edge events occur within any single cyclized test vector cycle.

---

### 3. ATE Timing Margins & Boundary Tolerance

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░                       │
   Driver Skew Window┤░░░░░░░░░░                       │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Compare Strobe Window┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
 Edge Snapping Window┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓           │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓           │
     Jitter Guardband┤████████████                     │
                     │████████████                     │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    37.5    75.0    112.5 150.0 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

1. **Cycle Snapping Boundary Residual Error:**
   $$\Delta t_{snap} \le 100\text{ ps}$$
   Maximum time deviation of classified signal transition edges from the cyclized period boundary across all active pins.

2. **Jitter & Delta Glitch Suppression Filter:**
   $$t_{glitch} \le 50\text{ ps}$$
   All intermediate simulator glitches and phase noise transitions shorter than $50\text{ ps}$ must be filtered without state distortion.

3. **Compare Strobe Placement Accuracy:**
   $$\sigma_{strobe} \le 150\text{ ps}$$
   Timing placement window for read-data strobes (`L`/`H`) relative to reference clock edge across ATE channels.

4. **180nm Device Channel & Operating Level Compliance:**
   - Operational voltage: $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
   - Gate length reference: $L = 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
   - Channel threshold extraction: NMOS $V_{thn} = 0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$, PMOS $V_{thp} = -0.60\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$.
   - Logic drive levels: $I_{on} \ge 500\text{ }\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ at $V_{GS} = 1.8\text{ V}$; $I_{off} \le 10\text{ pA}/\mu\text{m}$ at $V_{GS} = 0\text{ V}$.

---

### 5. Context Citations & References
- **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**:
  - Target sub-micron transistor geometry: $W / L = 2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m} / 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
  - Static device parameters: $V_{thn} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$, $V_{thp} = -0.60\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$ at $V_{DS} = 50\text{ mV}$.
  - Current drive specifications: $V_{DS} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $I_{on} \ge 500\text{ }\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ ($V_{GS} = 1.8\text{ V}$), $I_{off} \le 10\text{ pA}/\mu\text{m}$ ($V_{GS} = 0\text{ V}$), $I_{on}/I_{off} > 10^7$.
- **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow**:
  - Standard cell placement legalization, clock tree synthesis buffering, and setup/hold timing optimization flow.
- **SkyWater Open PDK & Toolflow Guidelines**:
  - Digital flow integration, timing regenerated liberty files, and cell drive signoff.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Unconstrained VCD event streams generated from event-driven Verilog simulations exhibit non-integer picosecond transition timestamps due to variable interconnect RC delays and clock jitter. Ingesting raw event timings directly into an automated test equipment (ATE) cyclization pipeline without deterministic cycle boundary snapping creates timing marker aliasing, where pin drive/compare transitions inadvertently cross JEDEC tCK cycle boundaries. Snapping algorithms must enforce strict integer multiples of tester master period clock (T0) grids (e.g., 10 ps or 20 ps tester time-set resolution) while strictly preserving setup/hold margins (tIS, tIH, tDS, tDH) relative to differential clock (CK/CK#) crossing points without introducing false timing violations on the physical ATE channel drivers.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: JEDEC DDR SDRAM qualification demands exact cyclization rules: clock-edge transitions must be mapped to defined tester period sets (WFTs - Waveform Tables), where drive data (DNRZ, RZ, RO) and strobe compare windows (edge-strobe vs. window-strobe) conform to standard DDR read/write bursts. When snapping VCD transitions to cyclized STIL vectors, rounding artifacts exceeding +/-25 ps will cause false test failures during speed-bin sort (e.g., DDR-200/DDR-333/DDR-400 profiles on 180nm CMOS). Edge-placement algorithms must enforce boundary snapping that maintains differential clock duty-cycle distortion (tERR) within +/-1.5% and prevents vector compression bloat across multi-megabit pattern buffers.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: ATE vector pattern memory depth on mixed-signal legacy testers (such as Advantest T6575 or Teradyne J750/UltraFLEX commonly utilized for 180nm commercial MPW validation) is strictly bounded per pin channel (typically 16M to 64M vectors per board). Failure to enforce proper cyclization rule compilation and repeat-loop vector compression results in uncompressed flat pattern vectors that exceed tester hardware memory limits, necessitating multi-pass pattern reloads, inflating test execution time from 4.2 seconds to >18.5 seconds per packaged DUT, and directly scaling unit production test costs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Delivery of clean STIL/WGL test patterns represents the primary gating milestone between digital RTL tapeout signoff and wafer-level sort / packaged final test qualification. Ambiguities in timing boundary snapping rules cause unresolvable vector compilation errors inside the ATE software toolchain, halting tester bring-up schedules. Milestone sign-off mandates a fully validated, automated VCD-to-STIL compiler script with zero unresolved cycle-boundary edge violations across 100% of standard JEDEC functional patterns (All-Bank-Precharge, ACTIVATE, READ/WRITE burst-4/burst-8, and Auto-Refresh cycles).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Boundary Marker Clipping: High-to-low or low-to-high data transitions occurring near the cycle boundary snap to the subsequent cycle (n+1) instead of the active cycle (n), causing drive-data collisions on bidirectional DQ pins and catastrophic pin-driver contention faults on the ATE loadboard.
1. Tester Time-Set Allocation Exhaustion: Vector cyclizer generates excessive unique timing waveform sets (WFTs) due to micro-jitter snapping variations in asynchronous VCD events, exceeding the maximum hardware time-set capacity (typically 32 to 64 physical timing sets) of the ATE digital pin cards.
1. Differential Clock Skew Violation: Independent snapping of CK and CK# edge events causing instantaneous differential clock crossover skew to exceed 50 ps, violating JEDEC minimum crossing voltage tolerances and invalidating DDR speed-bin qualification.

Ingest raw 100,000-cycle VCD test vector stream into the automated boundary-snapping cyclization engine. 2. Apply snapping quantization rules to align all event timestamps to the 5.000 ns tCK grid. 3. Compile output to standard IEEE 1450 STIL syntax. 4. Execute pattern parser validation check to verify zero out-of-boundary edge transitions. 5. Load STIL vectors into ATE pin memory and measure programmed edge-placement of command/address (CS#, RAS#, CAS#, WE#, ADDR) pins relative to differential CK/CK# rising edge across 1,000 continuous cycles. | `Pass if 100% of command/address transitions snap to exact tester period multiples (T = 5000 ps +/- 20 ps raster step); setup time tIS >= 600 ps and hold time tIH >= 600 ps are strictly maintained across all cycles; zero vector compilation syntax errors or WFT overflow flags reported.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-1-3-2-2-02` | **Bidirectional DQ/DQS Waveform Cyclization and ATE Strobe Window Margin Verification** | Advantest T5503 / Teradyne UltraFLEX ATE system equipped with 800 Mbps digital pin cards, high-speed active dual-transmission-line loadboard, and real-time STIL execution event logger. | 1. Program ATE drive timing sets for WRITE cycles with DQS edge-aligned to DQ data eye center (tDQSS = 0.75 to 1.25 tCK). 2. Program compare strobe timing sets for READ cycles with edge-compare and window-compare markers spanning 20% to 80% of data valid window (tDV). 3. Run continuous looped execution of cyclized burst patterns at 200 MHz (400 Mbps per pin). 4. Perform edge-strobe search sweep across -1.0 ns to +1.0 ns relative to nominal strobe position in 10 ps increments to map physical eye opening. | `Pass if ATE pin electronics execute seamless drive-to-compare tri-state switching without bus contention currents (I_contention < 2 mA during turnaround); measured DQ valid receive window >= 1.85 ns at nominal 1.8V supply; zero vector pattern mismatches over 10^7 pattern cycles.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified impact-resistant UV/laser-rated safety glasses with side shields, Mil-PRF-87893 certified Class-0 ESD-dissipative lab coat with grounded wrist strap, ASTM D3578 cleanroom-grade powder-free nitrile gloves (6 mil thickness), ESD-protective steel-toe leather footwear complying with ASTM F2413 (dissipative range 10^6 to 10^8 ohms)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Immediately flush contaminated skin with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes; remove contaminated clothing. Eye contact: Flush open eyes at certified plumbed eyewash station for 15 minutes while rolling eyeballs. Inhalation of solvent vapors or compressed gas asphyxiant: Move victim immediately to fresh uncontaminated air; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is difficult; initiate CPR if breathing stops and summon professional emergency medical response.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: ATE testing bay and chemical loadboard maintenance hood must operate dedicated local exhaust ventilation (LEV) providing minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with 12 room air volume changes per hour (ACH). Compressed gas enclosures must feature continuous ambient oxygen deficiency monitoring with audible and strobe alarms calibrated to trigger at <19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA solvent wipes and rinse liquid must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-arresting hazardous waste containers labeled according to OSHA HazCom / GHS standards. Disposal through licensed semiconductor hazardous chemical waste management; no unneutralized or solvent drain disposal permitted under any circumstance.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - ATE Loadboard and Pogo Pin Contact Cleaner)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (SEMI-C4) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Loadboard Purge and Contact Drying Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 Grade | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Packaged DRAM ICs in JEDEC matrix trays with leadframes/solder balls free of oxidation, organic residues, and ESD surface charges; loadboard pogo-pins clean, planarized, and scrubbed with IPA.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tested and speed-binned packaged DRAM units sorted into labeled ESD antistatic dry-pack trays, vacuum-sealed with active silica desiccant bags and 10% cobalt-free humidity indicator cards (HIC).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom ambient air queue time causes leadframe moisture absorption exceeding MSL-3 thresholds and contact pin oxidation, leading to parasitic contact resistance spikes (>500 mOhm) during ATE test sockets insertion, producing false setup/hold margin failures and vector synchronization misalignments.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful compilation, verification, and physical ATE qualification of JEDEC-compliant cyclized test vectors derived from 180nm CMOS DRAM VCD functional simulations. All event boundaries are deterministically snapped to the tester's master clock raster without waveform distortion, enabling accurate speed-binning up to DDR-400 specifications with verified zero-error vector execution on tester pin cards.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_jedec_cyclized_timing_vectors.stil`
- [ ] `ate_vector_boundary_snapping_verification_report.pdf`
- [ ] `pin_timing_margin_shmoo_matrix.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum edge-placement discretization error after cycle boundary snapping** | `0.00` | +/-20.0 ps | Automated vector linting script comparing STIL waveform event timestamps against source VCD simulation timestamps on high-precision 20 ps tester grid. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Unique Waveform Table (WFT) count generated during cyclization compilation** | `24` | <= 32 entries maximum | STIL compiler syntax and resource audit parsing header declarations against target ATE hardware physical time-set registers. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Functional pattern execution pass rate on calibrated ATE test head across rated VDD range (1.7V to 1.9V)** | `100.0` | 0.0% failure allowance | Continuous execution of compiled pattern burst sequence across 10,000,000 cycles on Advantest/Teradyne digital pin channels with real-time fail-log recording. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires 100% syntactic validation of the generated STIL pattern file without compiler warnings, zero timing-boundary edge dropouts across all 100,000 simulated cycles, total compiled WFT count <= 32, and flawless real-time pattern burst execution on the physical ATE channel hardware at 200 MHz clock rate with documented Shmoo voltage/timing margins exceeding +/-150 mV and +/-250 ps.
