# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-ATE-MET-038
**Title:** Pin Drive/Compare Strobe Edge Placement Verification and Pattern Timing Validation  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology > Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Verification  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the calibration, edge placement verification, and pattern timing signoff procedures on high-speed Automated Test Equipment (ATE) pin electronics (PE) for the 180nm DRAM tapeout. It ensures sub-cycle timing accuracy across all command, address, clock (`CK`/`CK#`), data strobe (`DQS`), and data (`DQ`) channels prior to executing speed-binning test vectors ($t_{CK}$, $t_{RCD}$, $t_{RP}$).

---

### 2. Relevant Context & Citations
* **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow:** Timing closure, parasitics extraction (`OpenRCX`), setup/hold timing optimization, and clock tree synthesis buffer constraints governing chip I/O pad launch and capture envelopes.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology (Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench):** Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), cell capacitance budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$), and refresh leakage envelope ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) setting the baseline margins for internal array restore ($t_{RP}$) and row-to-column access ($t_{RCD}$).

---

### 3. Equipment & Tool Setup
* **ATE Platform:** High-speed Digital Memory ATE (Pogo pin / DIB interface).
* **Reference Artifact:** Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) calibration substrate / standard gold unit.
* **Metrology Tools:** Oscilloscope/Waveform capture engine integrated into ATE Pin Electronics (TDR resolution $\le 5\text{ ps}$).
* **Environment:** Room temperature ambient ($25^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$), followed by thermal conditioning chuck test at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 4. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                        ATE Pin Timing Alignment Flow                          |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  [Step 1: TDR Deskew]
         |
         v
  [Step 2: Drive Edge (t0, t1) Placement & Slew Validation]
         |
         v
  [Step 3: Compare Strobe (t2) Alignment to Reference Window]
         |
         v
  [Step 4: Vector Execution & Round-Trip Delay Signoff]
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Automated TDR Deskew & Electrical Length Normalization
1. Mount the ATE Device Interface Board (DIB) without the Device Under Test (DUT).
2. Execute automated Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) across all ATE pin channels (Channels 0 to $N$ covering `CLK`, `ADDR`, `CMD`, `DQ`, `DQS`).
3. Calculate physical propagation delay ($\tau_{DIB}$) from driver pin electronics to pogo contact tips.
4. Program programmable delay lines (PDL) to normalize pin-to-pin flight time skew across all channels to $< 15\text{ ps}$.

#### Step 2: Pin Driver Edge Placement Verification (`T0` / `T1` Edges)
1. Load the JEDEC speed-bin timing template into the ATE timing generator:
   * Program master cycle time ($t_{CK}$) baseline.
   * Configure drive rise edge (`T0`) and fall edge (`T1`) markers for differential clock pairs (`CK`/`CK#`).
2. Engage high-bandwidth oscilloscope digitizer at the contact socket.
3. Validate drive edge placement accuracy for all Address/Command pins relative to differential `CK` crossing points.
4. Verify edge placement error does not exceed $\pm 25\text{ ps}$ and edge transition slew rate matches pad library specification.

#### Step 3: Compare Strobe Edge Calibration (`T2` Strobe Window)
1. Set up high-impedance bidirectional compare strobe channels for `DQ` and `DQS` signals.
2. Program compare strobe ($T_2$) search sweep across the valid data window with a step resolution of $10\text{ ps}$.
3. Using the standard calibration fixture, fire drive-to-compare loopback vectors to verify strobe trigger placement against comparator reference thresholds ($V_{OH} / V_{OL}$ and $V_{REF}$).
4. Eliminate transmission-line round-trip delay offsets ($t_{RTD}$) via automated software compensation registers.

#### Step 4: Pattern Vector Timing Execution & Shmoo Boundary Signoff
1. Load digital vector bursts targeting key JEDEC parameters ($t_{RCD}$, $t_{RP}$, $t_{CK}$).
2. Execute continuous checkerboard / March C- pattern sweeps while dynamically perturbing driver edge markers $\pm 100\text{ ps}$ around nominal timing targets.
3. Verify zero strobe miscompares occur inside the nominal valid window, validating edge placement repeatability under multi-pin switching conditions (SSO noise immunity).

---

### 5. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Nominal Target | Tolerance / Threshold | Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Pin-to-Pin ATE Driver Deskew Skew | $\le 10$ | Max $\le 15$ | $\text{ps}$ | Automated TDR metrology sweep |
| **AC-02** | Strobe / Drive Edge Placement Accuracy | $0.0$ | $\le \pm 25$ | $\text{ps}$ | High-bandwidth ATE comparator digitizer |
| **AC-03** | Strobe Edge Timing Repeatability ($3\sigma$) | $\le 8$ | Max $\le 12$ | $\text{ps}$ | 1000-cycle loopback pulse jitter measurement |
| **AC-04** | Round-Trip Delay ($t_{RTD}$) Offset Error | $0.0$ | $\le \pm 30$ | $\text{ps}$ | DIB calibration golden fixture signoff |

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Ensuring pin electronics deskew across all tester channels down to sub-50 ps uncertainty is critical; transmission line mismatches on the ATE load board (DIB) between driver channels (DQ, ADDR/CMD, CLK) and comparator receivers will introduce systematic phase offsets that artificially degrade apparent tCK, tRCD, and tRP timing margins on 180nm DRAM silicon.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Strobe edge placement for DDR compare circuits must account for non-ideal edge transitions, round-trip flight times (TDR calibrated), and capacitive loading effects of the 180nm ESD/pad structures (~3-5 pF), ensuring that read strobe latching captures valid data eyes without false setup/hold violations during speed-bin shmoo plotting.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: ATE tester time on advanced high-speed digital pin-electronics platforms (e.g., Advantest V93000 or Teradyne UltraFLEX) is heavily constrained and costly ($0.10–$0.25/sec); calibration and pin deskew verification overhead must be minimized through automated golden-unit loopback and fixture calibration routines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Pin timing validation schedules must strictly align with the post-HTOL reliability test campaign milestones; delays in pattern timing signoff or uncalibrated edge jitter directly block downstream speed-bin yield classification and automotive AEC-Q100 reliability reporting.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Systematic edge skew between differential clock (CK/CK#) and data strobe (DQS) exceeding ±120 ps, leading to false DDR speed-bin downgrade from 200 MHz (DDR-400) to 133 MHz (DDR-266).
1. Comparator strobe placement drift caused by thermal expansion and tester pin-electronics driver heating, inducing false double-data-rate read capture errors.
1. Impedance discontinuity reflections at the DIB pogo-pin interface corrupting waveform monotonicity during edge-placement verification.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-1-3-01` | **ATE Driver Channel Edge Placement & Skew Calibration across CLK, ADDR/CMD, and DQ Pins** | Automated Test Equipment (ATE) High-Speed Digital Pin Electronics (Advantest V93000 / Teradyne UltraFLEX), 50 GHz Digital Sampling Oscilloscope with Active Differential TDR Probe, NIST-traceable Time-Domain Calibration Fixture | 1. Power up ATE pin electronics and initialize digital timing generator with 5.0 ns period (200 MHz base clock, DDR-400 equivalent).\n2. Program test vector sequence to toggle CLK, DQS, DQ[15:0], and ADDR/CMD pins with alternating 1/0 patterns.\n3. Measure driver edge arrival times across all 64 DUT-facing test channels at the socket contact pads using automated TDR/oscilloscope deskew routine.\n4. Adjust programmable digital delay verniers per channel in steps of 5 ps to align edge placement relative to master differential CLK edge.\n5. Record residual channel-to-channel edge skew and edge transition time (20%-80%). | `Total driver channel-to-channel edge placement skew relative to master CLK must be ≤ ±35 ps across all active pins. Driver rise/fall times (20%-80%) must be 400 ps ± 50 ps into 50-ohm termination.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-1-3-02` | **DDR Compare Strobe Edge Placement and Read Eye Boundary Timing Validation** | ATE High-Density Pin Electronics Dual Comparator Subsystem, Precision Variable Delay Line Metrology Unit, Golden Reference 180nm DRAM Package Unit with pre-characterized tAC/tDQSCK | 1. Execute JEDEC Read Burst sequence (BL=4, CL=3) repeating pseudo-random bit sequence (PRBS7) on DQ pins.\n2. Sweep comparator strobe placement timing dynamically from -2.0 ns to +2.0 ns relative to nominal DQS zero-crossing in fine steps of 10 ps.\n3. Capture bit pass/fail map across all DQ comparator channels to construct dual-edge data-eye Shmoo plot.\n4. Determine leading (setup) and trailing (hold) strobe switching transition thresholds at VOH/VOL compare levels (1.15 V / 0.65 V).\n5. Validate compare strobe edge resolution, jitter (RJ/DJ separation), and repeatability over 10,000 burst cycles. | `Comparator strobe edge placement accuracy must be within ±25 ps of programmed vernier target. Compare strobe timing jitter (RMS) must be ≤ 12 ps, and data eye opening measurement must match golden unit baseline within ±40 ps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe conductive lab coat with continuous grounding snap, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Class 00 (500V rated) electrical insulating gloves for high-power ATE mainframe servicing, Powder-free cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Flush affected skin immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes; remove contaminated garments. Eye contact: Rinse eyes thoroughly at dedicated eye wash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; contact local poison control center or emergency medical services immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: ATE testing area must maintain certified continuous HVAC laminar cleanroom airflow (ISO Class 6 / Class 1000) with local downdraft exhaust over solvent cleaning benches maintaining minimum 100 FPM face velocity.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and liquid IPA residues must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-proof hazardous solvent waste drums clearly labeled 'Flammable Organic Solvents' for licensed hazardous chemical incineration; no drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for socket and DIB pogo-pin cleaning** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C4) | `99.9%` |
| **Electronic Contact Cleaner (trans-1,2-dichloroethylene formulation)** | `156-60-5` | Precision Reagent Grade | `45.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Packaged 180nm DRAM test samples post-burn-in with clean, unoxidized leadframe/BGA solder contacts; ATE socket contacts free of particulate debris and organic film buildup.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated, speed-binned packaged DRAM units sorted into ESD carriers with intact contact pads; socket pins inspected for zero mechanical wear or pitting.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive atmospheric exposure leads to contact lead surface oxidation and copper-tin intermetallic corrosion, introducing contact resistance spikes (>1.5 ohms) that cause false edge placement skew shifts, timing jitter distortion, and incorrect JEDEC speed-bin rejection.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full calibration, verification, and signoff of ATE pin-driver and comparator strobe edge placement across all 64 digital channels on the 180nm DRAM test fixture, demonstrating sub-35 ps deskew error and validated JEDEC pattern timing vectors across 133 MHz (DDR-266), 166 MHz (DDR-333), and 200 MHz (DDR-400) operating frequencies.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_Pin_Timing_Deskew_Calibration_Matrix.csv`
- [ ] `DDR400_Strobe_Edge_Placement_Shmoo_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `DIB_TDR_Channel_Flight_Time_DeEmbedding.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum channel-to-channel driver edge skew relative to differential CLK** | `0.0 ps` | ±35.0 ps | 50 GHz Digital Sampling Oscilloscope and automated ATE TDR deskew algorithm at DUT socket pad interface |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Comparator strobe edge placement accuracy across active DQ channels** | `0.0 ps` | ±25.0 ps | Precision delay-line vernier sweep across NIST-traceable calibrated golden-edge fixture |
| `ASSERT-03` | **ATE pin electronics timing jitter (RMS) during continuous DDR pattern vector burst** | `8.0 ps` | ≤ 12.0 ps | Histogram jitter decomposition (RJ/DJ) using real-time oscilloscope measuring 100,000 clock cycles |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 64 test channels exhibit verified edge placement skew within ±35 ps, comparator strobe error within ±25 ps, and 100% repeatability across three consecutive golden-unit calibration runs with zero JEDEC DDR speed-bin timing classification discrepancies.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Automated Shmoo Plot Margin Execution for tCK, tRCD, and tRP Vector Sweeps

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated Shmoo plotting over multi-dimensional parameter spaces (VDD vs. tCK, tRCD, and tRP) requires sub-picosecond edge placement accuracy and low-jitter tester pin electronics. Parasitic inductances and transmission line mismatches on the ATE load board (DIB) can induce ringing that distorts the effective setup and hold margins at the device under test (DUT) ball-grid or probe contacts, masking actual DRAM core sense-amp latencies.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm CMOS planar node, DRAM sense amplifier activation delay (tRCD) and bitline precharge recovery (tRP) exhibit steep sensitivity to VDD core droop and temperature variation. Automated vector sweeps must account for wordline boost voltage (VPP) pump efficiency and bitline equalization RC constants under pattern-dependent baseline noise such as solid-stripe, checkerboard, and hammer sequences.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: ATE test-head execution time is the primary cost driver for commercialized 180nm MPW packaged units and sorted dies. Running brute-force 2D/3D Shmoo sweeps across thousands of test points per unit severely degrades throughput; an adaptive binary-search boundary-tracking algorithm must be deployed on the tester pattern generator to minimize index dwell time.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test pattern qualification and automated Shmoo vector release milestones depend on strict correlation between pre-layout RTL/gate-level SDF simulations and physical ATE tester measurements across process corners (FF, TT, SS) to freeze DDR speed-binning guardbands prior to volume customer shipment.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal runaway or self-heating during high-frequency back-to-back tCK/tRCD burst execution leading to artificial sense-margin collapse and false-fail bin assignment.
1. Transmission line reflections and impedance discontinuity on the ATE pogo-pin/socket interface inducing false pattern comparison mismatches at the strobe window.
1. VPP charge pump collapse during rapid ACTIVATE-PRECHARGE cycles at maximum tRP sweep corners due to insufficient decoupling capacitance on the DIB.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |

Sweep VDD from 1.50V to 2.10V in 25mV increments. 3. At each voltage step, sweep clock cycle time (tCK) from 15.0ns down to 5.0ns in 100ps steps while maintaining nominal tRCD and tRP constraints. 4. Strobe DQS/DQ pin outputs across the data eye and log pass/fail status into the ATE Shmoo bitmap array. 5. Detect and log the pass/fail boundary contour. | `Device must maintain continuous zero-defect operational envelope at nominal VDD = 1.80V with tCK <= 7.5ns (equivalent to >= 133MHz / DDR-266 spec), exhibiting a minimum timing margin guardband of >= 1.2ns before the boundary cliff, with zero non-monotonic failure voids inside the pass domain.` |

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) safe dissipative lab coat, ESD-safe conductive wrist strap and heel grounders, Thermal protective gloves (handling DUTs from -40°C to +125°C thermal stream), Nitrile gloves (cleanroom Class 100/ISO 5 compatible)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes at an eyewash station; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. Skin exposure: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and water. Cryogenic/thermal burn from thermal stream nozzle: Immediately immerse affected area in lukewarm water (not hot); do not rub; seek medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: ATE testing bay must be equipped with dedicated point-of-use local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at >= 100 FPM face velocity to evacuate solvent vapors during socket cleaning and exhaust high-volume thermal air streams from the ThermoStream unit.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full automated Shmoo plot characterization across VDD, tCK, tRCD, and tRP parameters successfully executed on the ATE for all qualifying 180nm DRAM units, providing verified timing margin boundaries and definitive speed-bin classifications according to JEDEC DDR specifications.

Parasitic inductances and transmission line mismatches on the ATE load board (DIB) can induce ringing that distorts the effective setup and hold margins at the device under test (DUT) ball-grid or probe contacts, masking actual DRAM core sense-amp latencies.

Automated vector sweeps must account for wordline boost voltage (VPP) pump efficiency and bitline equalization RC constants under pattern-dependent baseline noise such as solid-stripe, checkerboard, and hammer sequences.

critics.laya_pm: Test pattern qualification and automated Shmoo vector release milestones depend on strict correlation between pre-layout RTL/gate-level SDF simulations and physical ATE tester measurements across process corners (FF, TT, SS) to freeze DDR speed-binning guardbands prior to volume customer shipment.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## ATE Timing Vector Deskew and Shmoo Test Pattern Calibration

**Document ID:** `SOP-ATE-CAL-180NM-001`  
**Process Node:** 180nm CMOS Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Classification:** Metrology & Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Execution  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Architecture

```text
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ TDR Fixture & Pogo-Pin Transmission Line Normalization │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Hardware Pin-to-Pin Deskew Calibration (CLK, ADDR, DQ) │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Core Supply & Bias Verification (VDD = 1.8 V Nominal)  │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Automated Shmoo Grid Execution (tCK, tRCD, tRP Sweeps) │
       └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Load Test Fixture & Run TDR Calibration:**
   - Mount the 180nm DRAM Device Under Test (DUT) loadboard to the automated test head.
   - Run Time-Domain Reflectometry (TDR) calibration across all active channels (Clock `CLK`, Address/Command `ADDR/CMD`, Data `DQ/DQS`) to measure round-trip trace latency and pogo-pin contact resistance up to the socket/pad interface.

2. **Pin-to-Pin Timing Vector Deskew Normalization:**
   - Execute internal hardware deskew routines using variable delay lines (programmable verniers) at the ATE driver pins.
   - Align the physical arrival time of all parallel input signals (`ADDR`, `CMD`, `DQ`) with reference to differential `CLK/CLK#` edges at the DUT pad plane, neutralizing board-level parasitic flight-time mismatches.

3. **Parametric Supply & Boundary Condition Setting:**
   - Force core and I/O operating voltage $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ with a linear measurement compliance envelope of $V_{DS} = 50\text{ mV}$ for low-bias calibration checks and $V_{DS} = 1.8\text{ V}$ full-rail operational stress.
   - Establish temperature stabilization at $25^\circ\text{C}$ ambient before launching vector execution.

4. **Shmoo Vector Sweep & Pass/Fail Boundary Mapping:**
   - Execute synchronous functional DRAM test pattern sequences across orthogonal two-dimensional grids:
     - **Dimension 1:** Cycle time / clock period ($t_{CK}$) down to nominal speed bins.
     - **Dimension 2:** Row-to-Column delay ($t_{RCD}$) and Row Precharge time ($t_{RP}$).
   - Log pass/fail transitions at each voltage-timing coordinate to construct Shmoo margin envelopes.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                   ATE Timing Calibration Benchmarks    
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Cal Confidence┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
              │▒▒▒▒▒                                   │
Guardband Spec┤▒▒▒▒▒                                   │
VDD Compliance┤▓▓                                      │
              │▓▓                                      │
 Skew Residual┤███████████                             │
              │███████████                             │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      24.9      49.9     74.8     99.7 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Mode |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Channel Deskew Uncertainty** | $\le 25.0$ | Max $\pm 25.0$ | $\text{ps}$ (picoseconds) | ATE Vernier Calibration Engine |
| **Operational Bias Supply ($V_{DD}$)** | $1.80$ | $\pm 0.05$ ($50\text{ mV}$) | $\text{V}$ (volts) | Precision Power Management Unit (PPMU) |
| **Linear Reference Voltage Offset ($V_{DS}$)** | $50.0$ | $\pm 5.0$ | $\text{mV}$ (millivolts) | Linear PPMU Transconductance Bias |
| **Statistical Calibration Confidence Level** | $99.73$ ($3\sigma$) | $\ge 99.70$ | $\%$ (percent) | Shmoo Margin Vector Repeatability |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources

- **Source: Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**
  - Linear region characterization bias: $V_{DS} = 50\text{ mV}$.
  - Target sub-micron transistor geometry: $W / L = 2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m} / 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
  - Full-rail operating conditions: $V_{DS} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $V_{GS} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
- **Source: OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow**
  - Timing closure & parasitic correlation: Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), parasitic extraction using OpenRCX, incremental timing analysis, and final timing/physical signoff.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: High-frequency ATE timing deskew across 64+ parallel DDR channel pin electronics requires active TDR (Time Domain Reflectometry) loopback calibration directly at the DUT socket interface. Fixture pogo pin parasitics (typical L ~1.2 nH, C ~0.4 pF) and trace length mismatches on the high-Tg loadboard induce differential skew that corrupts sub-nanosecond JEDEC timing sweeps (tCK, tRCD, tRP) unless per-pin deskew calibration achieves < 25 ps residual skew across all bidirectional DQ/DQS and command/address strobe channels.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Shmoo margin profiling for 180nm DRAM (VDD = 1.8V/2.5V core, 133-200 MHz operation) must account for thermal drift during active vector bursting. If calibration vector deskew is performed cold, subsequent self-heating during continuous 2D Shmoo pattern sweeps shifts pin driver propagation delays by ~1.5 ps/°C. Dynamic deskew tracking or tight thermal socket stabilization (±0.5°C using thermal stream conditioning) is mandatory to prevent pseudo-failures at the edge of the pass/fail shmoo boundary.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom calibration loadboards, high-bandwidth gold-plated pogo pin sockets, and coaxial golden calibration fixtures for 180nm ATE test heads face 12-to-16-week procurement lead times. A secondary calibration substrate and socket repair kit must be second-sourced domestically to avoid single-point halt of final DDR speed-bin qualification lots.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test cell operational cost exceeds $180/hour on Advantest/Teradyne DRAM platforms. Execution of over-extended Shmoo vector sweeps without coarse-step adaptive boundary tracking will blow test execution budgets. Shmoo search algorithms must implement binary-search boundary edge hunting followed by fine-grid deskewed verification to minimize per-unit test time to under 12 seconds per die.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Channel-to-channel pin electronics skew exceeding ±35 ps at the DUT socket plane, causing false tRCD setup/hold violations and artificial DDR speed-bin downgrades.
1. Transmission line impedance discontinuity (> ±5 Ohm mismatch from 50 Ohm target) inducing ringing and double-clocking on differential DQS strobe inputs during burst read/write vectors.
1. Ground bounce and power sag during concurrent 16-bit DQ switching at VDDmin shmoo corners, collapsing the valid data eye due to inadequate socket decoupling bypass capacitance.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-2-1-01` | **Automated Multi-Channel Pin Electronics TDR Deskew Calibration at DUT Socket Plane** | Automated Test Equipment (Advantest T5503HS2 or Teradyne UltraFLEX-HD), 50-GHz TDR calibration standard substrate with short/open/load/thru (SOLT) artifacts, NIST-traceable calibrated sampling oscilloscope. | 1. Dock the calibration golden fixture into the DRAM test socket applying 1.8 kgf calibrated downward z-axis pressure. 2. Initiate automated TDR reflectometry pulse generation (50 ps rise time, 500 mV amplitude) from each ATE pin channel. 3. Measure round-trip flight time to the socket contact pogo tip for all 64 DQ, DQS, CLK, and Command/Address channels. 4. Calculate relative channel-to-channel delay delta relative to the master differential clock reference channel. 5. Write programmable delay line (PDL) register trim values into the ATE channel timing generators. 6. Execute post-trim verification pulse train at 200 MHz and measure residual channel-to-channel edge arrival skew across all pins simultaneously. | `Maximum channel-to-channel skew across all 64 pin electronics channels at the DUT socket plane must be <= 25.0 ps; TDR transmission line characteristic impedance must remain within 50.0 Ohm ± 2.5 Ohm along the entire signal path.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-2-1-02` | **2D VDD vs. tCK/tRCD Shmoo Margin Execution and Boundary Stability Verification** | DRAM ATE System with pattern generator vector engine, programmable dual-quadrant DUT power supply (DPS), and active thermal conditioning unit (-40°C to +125°C). | 1. Program DPS VDD supply to sweep from 1.50V to 2.10V in 25 mV discrete increments. 2. At each voltage node, sweep cycle time tCK from 5.0 ns (200 MHz) to 10.0 ns (100 MHz) in 50 ps increments and tRCD from 10.0 ns to 25.0 ns in 100 ps increments. 3. At each coordinate point (VDD, tCK, tRCD), burst a 4096-cycle March C- functional pattern with pseudo-random data backgrounds. 4. Log real-time comparator pass/fail flags across all DQ output strobe windows. 5. Run 5 consecutive repeat sweeps at the nominal 1.80V operating corner to evaluate shmoo pass/fail boundary edge jitter. 6. Generate raw 2D Shmoo bitmap matrix and compute guardbanded functional operating box. | `Operating pass window must demonstrate zero bit errors across VDD = 1.80V ± 10% (1.62V to 1.98V) at tCK <= 7.5 ns (DDR-266 / 133 MHz) and tRCD <= 15.0 ns; pass/fail boundary repeatability across 5 consecutive runs must exhibit jitter <= ±30 ps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe conductive nitrile cleanroom gloves (surface resistance 10^6 - 10^8 ohms/sq), Static-dissipative lab coat with grounded wrist strap, Steel-toe ESD protective footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA eye contact: Flush immediately with clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmic medical evaluation. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and water; remove contaminated garments. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move individual immediately to fresh air; provide oxygen if breathing is labored. High-pressure compressed gas injection/injury: Seek urgent surgical medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized laminar flow extraction hood (minimum face velocity 100 FPM / 0.51 m/s) active during solvent swab cleaning of loadboard sockets; test cell ambient HVAC maintained at 21°C ± 2°C, 45% ± 5% RH with minimum 15 air changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of spent IPA wipes and swab applicators in certified, grounded, self-closing hazardous flammables disposal containers. Spent solvent liquid collected in dedicated halogen-free organic waste carboys for commercial licensed high-temperature thermal incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (Electronics Grade IPA for Socket Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 / VLSI | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Dry N2 for fixture drying)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra High Purity (UHP) 99.999% | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pogo pins, socket contacts, and calibration golden substrate freshly solvent-cleaned and blow-dried; contact surfaces free of particulate contamination (>0.3 um zero defect), flux residues, or copper/tin oxide tarnishing.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Calibrated socket interface inspected; gold plating intact with zero mechanical pin bending or gouging; loadboard contact pads free of foreign debris, ready for automated packaged DRAM test lot insertion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure to ambient cleanroom humidity causes atmospheric micro-corrosion and oxidation on bare socket pogo contacts, increasing contact resistance (CRES) from <50 mOhm to >500 mOhm, inducing false signal attenuation, baseline TDR ground bounce, and invalid deskew vector calibration.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full multi-channel ATE pin electronics deskew calibration achieved at the 180nm DRAM DUT socket plane with residual skew below 25 ps, followed by automated 2D Shmoo margin characterization validating JEDEC DDR-266/DDR-333 timing margins across full VDD voltage and temperature ranges.

critics.systems_engineer: High-frequency ATE timing deskew across 64+ parallel DDR channel pin electronics requires active TDR (Time Domain Reflectometry) loopback calibration directly at the DUT socket interface. Fixture pogo pin parasitics (typical L ~1.2 nH, C ~0.4 pF) and trace length mismatches on the high-Tg loadboard induce differential skew that corrupts sub-nanosecond JEDEC timing sweeps (tCK, tRCD, tRP) unless per-pin deskew calibration achieves < 25 ps residual skew across all bidirectional DQ/DQS and command/address strobe channels.
critics.domain_expert: Shmoo margin profiling for 180nm DRAM (VDD = 1.8V/2.5V core, 133-200 MHz operation) must account for thermal drift during active vector bursting. If calibration vector deskew is performed cold, subsequent self-heating during continuous 2D Shmoo pattern sweeps shifts pin driver propagation delays by ~1.5 ps/°C. Dynamic deskew tracking or tight thermal socket stabilization (±0.5°C using thermal stream conditioning) is mandatory to prevent pseudo-failures at the edge of the pass/fail shmoo boundary.
critics.supply_chain: Custom calibration loadboards, high-bandwidth gold-plated pogo pin sockets, and coaxial golden calibration fixtures for 180nm ATE test heads face 12-to-16-week procurement lead times. A secondary calibration substrate and socket repair kit must be second-sourced domestically to avoid single-point halt of final DDR speed-bin qualification lots.
critics.laya_pm: Test cell operational cost exceeds $180/hour on Advantest/Teradyne DRAM platforms. Execution of over-extended Shmoo vector sweeps without coarse-step adaptive boundary tracking will blow test execution budgets. Shmoo search algorithms must implement binary-search boundary edge hunting followed by fine-grid deskewed verification to minimize per-unit test time to under 12 seconds per die.
critical_failure_modes: Channel-to-channel pin electronics skew exceeding ±35 ps at the DUT socket plane, causing false tRCD setup/hold violations and artificial DDR speed-bin downgrades.
Transmission line impedance discontinuity (> ±5 Ohm mismatch from 50 Ohm target) inducing ringing and double-clocking on differential DQS strobe inputs during burst read/write vectors.
Ground bounce and power sag during concurrent 16-bit DQ switching at VDDmin shmoo corners, collapsing the valid data eye due to inadequate socket decoupling bypass capacitance.

testcases.title: Automated Multi-Channel Pin Electronics TDR Deskew Calibration at DUT Socket Plane
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Test Equipment (Advantest T5503HS2 or Teradyne UltraFLEX-HD), 50-GHz TDR calibration standard substrate with short/open/load/thru (SOLT) artifacts, NIST-traceable calibrated sampling oscilloscope.
testcases.pre_conditions: Loadboard installed on ATE test head; ambient temperature stabilized at 25.0°C ± 0.5°C; ATE pin electronic driver/comparator electronics warm-up completed (>60 minutes); golden calibration short-plate seated into pogo pin socket.
testcases.procedure:
1. Dock the calibration golden fixture into the DRAM test socket applying 1.8 kgf calibrated downward z-axis pressure.
2. Initiate automated TDR reflectometry pulse generation (50 ps rise time, 500 mV amplitude) from each ATE pin channel.
3. Measure round-trip flight time to the socket contact pogo tip for all 64 DQ, DQS, CLK, and Command/Address channels.
4. Calculate relative channel-to-channel delay delta relative to the master differential clock reference channel.
5. Write programmable delay line (PDL) register trim values into the ATE channel timing generators.
6. Execute post-trim verification pulse train at 200 MHz and measure residual channel-to-channel edge arrival skew across all pins simultaneously.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Maximum channel-to-channel skew across all 64 pin electronics channels at the DUT socket plane must be <= 25.0 ps; TDR transmission line characteristic impedance must remain within 50.0 Ohm ± 2.5 Ohm along the entire signal path.

testcases.title: 2D VDD vs. tCK/tRCD Shmoo Margin Execution and Boundary Stability Verification
testcases.instrumentation: DRAM ATE System with pattern generator vector engine, programmable dual-quadrant DUT power supply (DPS), and active thermal conditioning unit (-40°C to +125°C).
testcases.pre_conditions: Pin deskew calibration TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-2-1-01 successfully validated; 180nm DRAM test vehicle seated in socket; DUT junction temperature locked at 85.0°C; JEDEC standard DDR initialization vector sequence verified.
testcases.procedure:
1. Program DPS VDD supply to sweep from 1.50V to 2.10V in 25 mV discrete increments.
2. At each voltage node, sweep cycle time tCK from 5.0 ns (200 MHz) to 10.0 ns (100 MHz) in 50 ps increments and tRCD from 10.0 ns to 25.0 ns in 100 ps increments.
3. At each coordinate point (VDD, tCK, tRCD), burst a 4096-cycle March C- functional pattern with pseudo-random data backgrounds.
4. Log real-time comparator pass/fail flags across all DQ output strobe windows.
5. Run 5 consecutive repeat sweeps at the nominal 1.80V operating corner to evaluate shmoo pass/fail boundary edge jitter.
6. Generate raw 2D Shmoo bitmap matrix and compute guardbanded functional operating box.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Operating pass window must demonstrate zero bit errors across VDD = 1.80V ± 10% (1.62V to 1.98V) at tCK <= 7.5 ns (DDR-266 / 133 MHz) and tRCD <= 15.0 ns; pass/fail boundary repeatability across 5 consecutive runs must exhibit jitter <= ±30 ps.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Multi-Corner VDD and tCK-tRCD-tRP Shmoo Sweep Automation
**Project Lineage**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation (GF180) > Metrology & Characterization  
**PDK / Process Platform**: GF180 / 180nm CMOS (Targeting standard core $V_{DD} = 1.80\,\text{V}$)  
**Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Process & Automation Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    ATE Test Setup &    │
│      Vector Load       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    PVT Multi-Corner    │
│  Thermal Chamber Soak  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Voltage VDD Sweeps:   │
│     1.62V to 1.98V     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Timing Parameter    │
│   Steps: tCK, tRCD,    │
│          tRP           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   JEDEC DDR Pattern    │
│      Vector Burst      │
│       Execution        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  2D Pass/Fail Matrix   │
│  Log & Shmoo Boundary  │
│          Gen           │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Test Environment & Pattern Vector Initialization**:
   - Mount packaged packaged DUTs on high-speed 50 $\Omega$ controlled-impedance ATE loadboards.
   - Load pre-verified JEDEC DDR functional speed-bin pattern vectors (ACTIVATE $\rightarrow$ READ/WRITE $\rightarrow$ PRECHARGE burst sweeps) into tester vector memory.

2. **PVT Thermal Conditioning & Corner Setting**:
   - Set environmental thermal chamber to target corner temperatures:
     - **Cold / Slow Corner (SS)**: $-40^\circ\text{C}$
     - **Typical Corner (TT)**: $+25^\circ\text{C}$
     - **Hot / Fast Corner (FF)**: $+125^\circ\text{C}$
   - Soak DUT for a minimum stabilization duration of $180\,\text{s}$ prior to pattern execution.

3. **Multi-Corner $V_{DD}$ Supply Sweep Configuration**:
   - Sweep core supply voltage $V_{DD}$ across the full operating range from $1.62\,\text{V}$ ($-10\%$) to $1.98\,\text{V}$ ($+10\%$) centered at nominal $1.80\,\text{V}$, using $20\,\text{mV}$ programmatic step increments.
   - Program tester per-pin PMU current limits to clamp at $I_{DD,\max} = 150\,\text{mA}$.

4. **Automated Timing Parameter ($t_{CK}$, $t_{RCD}$, $t_{RP}$) 2D Shmoo Sweep Execution**:
   - **Clock Period ($t_{CK}$)**: Sweep $t_{CK}$ from $15.0\,\text{ns}$ ($66.7\,\text{MHz}$) down to $5.0\,\text{ns}$ ($200\,\text{MHz}$) in discrete steps of $100\,\text{ps}$.
   - **Row-to-Column Delay ($t_{RCD}$)**: Sweep parameter offset from $25.0\,\text{ns}$ down to $10.0\,\text{ns}$ in steps of $250\,\text{ps}$.
   - **Row Precharge Time ($t_{RP}$)**: Sweep precharge timing window from $25.0\,\text{ns}$ down to $10.0\,\text{ns}$ in steps of $250\,\text{ps}$.
   - At each grid coordinate $(V_{DD},\, t_{CK},\, t_{RCD},\, t_{RP})$, fire the burst pattern vector and compare output data against golden strobe windows.

5. **Data Logging & Shmoo Margin Extraction**:
   - Stream binary Pass (1) / Fail (0) results into STDF (Standard Test Data Format) logs.
   - Calculate critical operating margins, minimum passing $t_{CK}$, and guard-band speed bins for final wafer sort and post-burn-in speed classification.

---

### 3. Characteristic Timing Shmoo Profile ($t_{CK}$ vs. $V_{DD}$)

```text
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒     │
1.62V (SS/Cold)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                0         3        6         9       12 
```

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Machine-Measurable Targets

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Min Clock Period ($t_{CK,\min}$)** | $\le 7.50$ | $\text{ns}$ ($133.3\,\text{MHz}$) | ATE Pattern Burst Execution at $V_{DD} = 1.80\,\text{V}$, $T = 25^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Worst-Case Row Latency ($t_{RCD,\min}$ / $t_{RP,\min}$)** | $\le 15.00$ | $\text{ns}$ | 2D Shmoo Boundary Pass Point at $V_{DD} = 1.62\,\text{V}$, $T = 125^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Shmoo Grid Sweep Step Resolution** | $\le 20.0$ ($V_{DD}$) / $\le 100.0$ ($t_{CK}$) | $\text{mV}$ / $\text{ps}$ | Automated ATE Test Sequence Configuration File Check |
| **Vector Execution Functional BER** | $0$ (Zero failed cycles over $10^7$ bursts) | $\text{Errors/Burst}$ | ATE Pin Comparator Error Log across valid Shmoo pass envelope |

---

### 5. Context Citations

- **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow**: Validated integration of open-source PDK flows ([`GF180`](file:///d:/coding/dram/docs/context.yaml) 180nm CMOS platform, OpenLane/OpenROAD-flow-scripts toolstack, static timing analysis signoff, and MPW tapeout integration).
- **SkyWater Open PDK & Silicon Test Heritage**: Standard timing constraint structures, cell characterization liberty timing sweeps, and MPW silicon validation flows.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The automation framework for multi-corner VDD versus tCK/tRCD/tRP Shmoo sweeps must tightly synchronize the ATE digital pin electronics, Device Power Supplies (DPS), and device thermal control unit (TCU). In 180nm DRAM architectures running DDR interfaces, transient di/dt during bursts of ACTIVATE and PRECHARGE commands can induce VDD droop across the probe card/loadboard interface. If the DPS transient response settling time is not decoupled from the vector burst launch by at least 5 ms, voltage sag will artificially degrade the measured tCK and tRCD timing margins, causing false test binning failures.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate characterization of tRCD (RAS-to-CAS delay) and tRP (Row Precharge time) across VDD corners (nominal 1.8V +/- 10% for 180nm core/periphery, plus 1.62V-1.98V sweep range) requires strict control over sense amplifier overdrive and bitline equalization timing. In 180nm open-source DRAM cells, margin degradation at low VDD corners (1.62V) is heavily dominated by access transistor sub-threshold leakage and lowered wordline boost voltage (VPP). Shmoo stepping resolutions must be fine enough (<= 100 ps for tCK, <= 250 ps for tRCD/tRP, and <= 25 mV for VDD) to detect non-linear wall boundaries and identify race conditions between bitline sense amplifier latching and column select gate gating.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom high-frequency ATE loadboards with pogo-pin sockets tailored for 180nm ceramic/plastic QFP or BGA packages have an operational lifespan of approximately 50,000 insertions before contact resistance exceeds 50 mOhm. Socket pin wear directly distorts VDD Kelvin sensing and degrades high-speed clock edge slews. Automated Shmoo testing must incorporate socket contact resistance calibration loops to ensure long test run cycles do not yield false bin fallout that artificially impacts packaging yield reports.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Comprehensive 3D Shmoo characterization (VDD vs tCK vs tRCD vs tRP) across 3 standard temperatures (-40°C, 25°C, 85°C) across multiple process corners (SS, TT, FF) generates massive test vector execution times (up to 3.5 hours per packaged DUT). To maintain the prototype characterization schedule and prevent thermal chamber bottlenecks, the automation script must utilize bisection search algorithms to locate pass/fail boundary edges rather than exhaustive brute-force matrix rasterization.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic IR-drop across probe needles/socket pins during simultaneous row activation causing false tRCD wall violation at nominal VDD.
1. Thermal runaway or junction temperature drift during exhaustive Shmoo vector looping due to inadequate thermal head clamping, masking true room-temperature timing limits.
1. ATE clock skew drift between differential CK/CK# pins exceeding 50 ps over long sweep durations, invalidating minimum tCK measurements.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-2-2-01` | **Automated VDD vs tCK Min Frequency Shmoo Sweep with Active Thermal Feedback** | Advantest T5503HS2 or Teradyne UltraFLEX ATE system equipped with high-speed digital pins (<= 20 ps edge placement accuracy), Device Power Supply (DPS) with remote 4-wire Kelvin sensing, and Temptronic ThermoStream thermal forced-air controller (stability +/- 0.2°C). | 1. Initialize DPS VDD to 1.60V and soak DUT for 30 seconds at 25.0°C. 2. Execute automated 2D bisection Shmoo routine: step VDD from 1.60V to 2.00V in 25 mV increments. 3. At each VDD step, sweep tCK from 15.0 ns down to 5.0 ns in 100 ps decrements while holding tRCD and tRP fixed at 15.0 ns. 4. Burst solid/checkerboard algorithmic pattern (March C-) over a 16Mb address space at each coordinate; capture digital comparator fail flags. 5. Log exact pass/fail boundary coordinates and dynamic active current (IDD4R/IDD4W). | `DUT must demonstrate functional pass boundary across 1.80V +/- 10% (1.62V to 1.98V) with minimum operable tCK <= 7.5 ns (equivalent to >= 133 MHz / DDR-266 timing at 180nm) without intermittent edge anomalies. Kelvin VDD variation during burst must remain within +/- 15 mV.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-2-2-02` | **Automated VDD vs tRCD/tRP Margin Shmoo Matrix Characterization** | Teradyne UltraFLEX or Advantest T5503HS2 ATE system with programmable timing generators, differential clock drivers, and multi-channel DPS; calibrated active current monitor with microsecond sampling. | 1. Set thermal chamber to 85.0°C and verify junction stabilization via internal diode monitor. 2. Configure automated nested Shmoo sweep for VDD from 1.62V to 1.98V in 30 mV increments. 3. At each VDD level, sweep tRCD from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 250 ps decrements, executing an Activate-to-Read-to-Precharge sequence. 4. Concurrently sweep tRP from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 250 ps decrements on the row cycle. 5. Detect data bit parity errors across all 16 I/O channels using ATE real-time error log capture. | `At nominal VDD = 1.80V and 85°C, tRCD pass wall must occur at <= 15.0 ns (2 clock cycles at 133 MHz) and tRP pass wall must occur at <= 15.0 ns. At worst-case VDD = 1.62V (-10%), tRCD and tRP must not exceed 20.0 ns. Boundary transition from all-pass to hard-fail must be sharp (< 500 ps transition window).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 2 ESD-safe laboratory coat (surface resistivity < 10^9 ohms/sq), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact resistant safety spectacles with side shields, Class 0 (1000V rated) electrical insulating gloves for high-voltage ATE mainframe maintenance, Cryogenic/thermal protective gloves for handling DUT contactors during -40°C to +125°C thermal stream operation, ESD wrist strap with continuous 1-megohm series resistor ground monitoring
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Wash affected skin immediately with soap and copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes. Eye exposure to IPA or thermal particulate: Flush eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Thermal frostbite/burn from ThermoStream: Do not rub tissue; immerse in lukewarm water (38°C-42°C) and seek immediate medical evaluation. Nitrogen asphyxiation risk: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing has ceased.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: ATE testing bay requires continuous HVAC air exchange (minimum 10 room air volume changes per hour) with dedicated local snorkel exhaust (minimum 150 CFM face velocity) positioned directly above thermal stream shroud to safely discharge cold/hot nitrogen gas and eliminate oxygen depletion risks.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA used for contactor/socket ultrasonic decontamination must be collected in labeled, grounded UN-rated steel flammables containers and disposed of through licensed hazardous organic solvent treatment facilities. No drain disposal allowed.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C12) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Chamber purge / active chilling)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Packaged DRAM ICs clean, dry, post-bake (125°C for 24h per J-STD-033D), package leads/balls free of tin whisker/oxidation and organic contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tested parts inspected for zero socket contact indentation exceeding 25% of lead/ball height; leads clean, dry, and sealed into ESD-shielded dry packs with fresh desiccant and HIC card.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption into package epoxy mold compound (EMC) exceeding 0.1% by weight will cause internal delamination and popcorning during subsequent qualification reflow stress, while lead oxidation increases socket contact resistance, inducing false VDD drops during high-speed Shmoo profiling.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full automated multi-corner Shmoo characterization of the 180nm DRAM prototype demonstrating robust operational timing margins (tCK, tRCD, tRP) across the complete JEDEC supply voltage envelope (1.62V - 1.98V) and temperature range (-40°C to +85°C), verifying zero race conditions between bitline sensing and row decoding.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ATE_Shmoo_VDD_vs_tCK_tRCD_tRP_Matrix_Gen3.csv`
- [ ] `JEDEC_SpeedBin_Timing_Margin_Characterization_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `HighRes_ColorMapped_Shmoo_Plot_Vector_Analysis.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum operating clock frequency across nominal 1.80V VDD at 25°C** | `133.3` | +/- 5.0 MHz (tCK <= 7.5 ns min) | Automated ATE frequency Shmoo sweep utilizing March C- memory vector execution with zero bit errors. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **RAS-to-CAS delay (tRCD) timing wall at minimum voltage corner (1.62V) at 85°C** | `17.5` | <= 20.0 ns maximum | 2D VDD-tRCD Shmoo execution measuring pass/fail transition coordinate via ATE hardware comparator fail counter. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Row Precharge time (tRP) timing wall at minimum voltage corner (1.62V) at 85°C** | `16.8` | <= 20.0 ns maximum | 2D VDD-tRP Shmoo execution measuring bitline recharge and equalization integrity. |

critics.systems_engineer: The automation framework for multi-corner VDD versus tCK/tRCD/tRP Shmoo sweeps must tightly synchronize the ATE digital pin electronics, Device Power Supplies (DPS), and device thermal control unit (TCU). In 180nm DRAM architectures running DDR interfaces, transient di/dt during bursts of ACTIVATE and PRECHARGE commands can induce VDD droop across the probe card/loadboard interface. If the DPS transient response settling time is not decoupled from the vector burst launch by at least 5 ms, voltage sag will artificially degrade the measured tCK and tRCD timing margins, causing false test binning failures.
critics.domain_expert: Accurate characterization of tRCD (RAS-to-CAS delay) and tRP (Row Precharge time) across VDD corners (nominal 1.8V +/- 10% for 180nm core/periphery, plus 1.62V-1.98V sweep range) requires strict control over sense amplifier overdrive and bitline equalization timing. In 180nm open-source DRAM cells, margin degradation at low VDD corners (1.62V) is heavily dominated by access transistor sub-threshold leakage and lowered wordline boost voltage (VPP). Shmoo stepping resolutions must be fine enough (<= 100 ps for tCK, <= 250 ps for tRCD/tRP, and <= 25 mV for VDD) to detect non-linear wall boundaries and identify race conditions between bitline sense amplifier latching and column select gate gating.
critics.supply_chain: Custom high-frequency ATE loadboards with pogo-pin sockets tailored for 180nm ceramic/plastic QFP or BGA packages have an operational lifespan of approximately 50,000 insertions before contact resistance exceeds 50 mOhm. Socket pin wear directly distorts VDD Kelvin sensing and degrades high-speed clock edge slews. Automated Shmoo testing must incorporate socket contact resistance calibration loops to ensure long test run cycles do not yield false bin fallout that artificially impacts packaging yield reports.
critics.laya_pm: Comprehensive 3D Shmoo characterization (VDD vs tCK vs tRCD vs tRP) across 3 standard temperatures (-40°C, 25°C, 85°C) across multiple process corners (SS, TT, FF) generates massive test vector execution times (up to 3.5 hours per packaged DUT). To maintain the prototype characterization schedule and prevent thermal chamber bottlenecks, the automation script must utilize bisection search algorithms to locate pass/fail boundary edges rather than exhaustive brute-force matrix rasterization.
critical_failure_modes: Dynamic IR-drop across probe needles/socket pins during simultaneous row activation causing false tRCD wall violation at nominal VDD.
Thermal runaway or junction temperature drift during exhaustive Shmoo vector looping due to inadequate thermal head clamping, masking true room-temperature timing limits.
ATE clock skew drift between differential CK/CK# pins exceeding 50 ps over long sweep durations, invalidating minimum tCK measurements.

testcases.title: Automated VDD vs tCK Min Frequency Shmoo Sweep with Active Thermal Feedback
testcases.instrumentation: Advantest T5503HS2 or Teradyne UltraFLEX ATE system equipped with high-speed digital pins (<= 20 ps edge placement accuracy), Device Power Supply (DPS) with remote 4-wire Kelvin sensing, and Temptronic ThermoStream thermal forced-air controller (stability +/- 0.2°C).
testcases.pre_conditions: Packaged 180nm DRAM DUT seated in calibrated ATE test socket (contact resistance < 30 mOhm). DUT pre-conditioned at 25.0°C +/- 0.5°C chuck temperature. JEDEC standard MRS registers configured (CL=2.5, Burst Length=8, Sequential mode).
testcases.procedure:
1. Initialize DPS VDD to 1.60V and soak DUT for 30 seconds at 25.0°C.
2. Execute automated 2D bisection Shmoo routine: step VDD from 1.60V to 2.00V in 25 mV increments.
3. At each VDD step, sweep tCK from 15.0 ns down to 5.0 ns in 100 ps decrements while holding tRCD and tRP fixed at 15.0 ns.
4. Burst solid/checkerboard algorithmic pattern (March C-) over a 16Mb address space at each coordinate; capture digital comparator fail flags.
5. Log exact pass/fail boundary coordinates and dynamic active current (IDD4R/IDD4W).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: DUT must demonstrate functional pass boundary across 1.80V +/- 10% (1.62V to 1.98V) with minimum operable tCK <= 7.5 ns (equivalent to >= 133 MHz / DDR-266 timing at 180nm) without intermittent edge anomalies. Kelvin VDD variation during burst must remain within +/- 15 mV.

testcases.title: Automated VDD vs tRCD/tRP Margin Shmoo Matrix Characterization
testcases.instrumentation: Teradyne UltraFLEX or Advantest T5503HS2 ATE system with programmable timing generators, differential clock drivers, and multi-channel DPS; calibrated active current monitor with microsecond sampling.
testcases.pre_conditions: DUT power-up and JEDEC initialization sequence completed. VDD set to nominal 1.80V. Clock frequency locked at tCK = 7.5 ns (133 MHz). Ambient test temperature regulated at 85.0°C +/- 0.5°C to represent worst-case retention and bitline sensing speed.
testcases.procedure:
1. Set thermal chamber to 85.0°C and verify junction stabilization via internal diode monitor.
2. Configure automated nested Shmoo sweep for VDD from 1.62V to 1.98V in 30 mV increments.
3. At each VDD level, sweep tRCD from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 250 ps decrements, executing an Activate-to-Read-to-Precharge sequence.
4. Concurrently sweep tRP from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 250 ps decrements on the row cycle.
5. Detect data bit parity errors across all 16 I/O channels using ATE real-time error log capture.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: At nominal VDD = 1.80V and 85°C, tRCD pass wall must occur at <= 15.0 ns (2 clock cycles at 133 MHz) and tRP pass wall must occur at <= 15.0 ns. At worst-case VDD = 1.62V (-10%), tRCD and tRP must not exceed 20.0 ns. Boundary transition from all-pass to hard-fail must be sharp (< 500 ps transition window).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Shmoo Pass-Fail Boundary Extraction and Timing Margin Metrology

- **Module**: Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing / Metrology
- **Process Technology**: 180nm CMOS Open-Source DRAM (SkyWater SKY130 / 180nm MPW Rules)
- **Target Parameters**: $t_{CK}$, $t_{RCD}$, $t_{RP}$ timing margin characterization across supply voltage ($V_{DD}$)
- **Signoff Engine Alignment**: [OpenROAD Physical Design Flow](https://openroad-flow-scripts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) (STA/parasitics via OpenRCX) & SkyWater PDK Grid Standards

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Load Post-HTOL ATE   │
│      Test Vectors      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Configure 2D Sweep:   │
│  VDD vs Timing Vector  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Execute tCK, tRCD,   │
│   tRP Test Sequences   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Extract Shmoo      │
│   Pass-Fail Boundary   │
│         Matrix         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Compute Guardband &   │
│    JEDEC Speed-Bin     │
│        Signoff         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Test Environment Initialization & DUT Seating**:
   - Dock the post-HTOL burn-in packaged 180nm DRAM test socket to the high-speed digital ATE test head.
   - Configure the thermal forcing unit to target operating temperature ($25^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ room ambient, or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ junction test condition).
   - Verify power-supply decoupling and contact integrity across all $V_{DD}$, $V_{DDQ}$, and $V_{SS}$ pins.

2. **Test Pattern Vector Compilation & Loading**:
   - Load the JEDEC speed-bin test patterns covering standard DRAM command sequences: `ACTIVATE` $\rightarrow$ `READ`/`WRITE` $\rightarrow$ `PRECHARGE`.
   - Map functional strobe timings aligned with gate delay baselines correlated to the foundry minimum drawn poly gate length ($0.15\,\mu\text{m} / 150\,\text{nm}$) and parasitic extraction models from OpenRCX.

3. **Two-Dimensional Shmoo Parameter Grid Setup**:
   - **Voltage Axis ($Y$-axis)**: Sweep core supply voltage $V_{DD}$ from $1.50\,\text{V}$ to $2.00\,\text{V}$ in discrete steps of $25\,\text{mV}$ ($0.025\,\text{V}$).
   - **Timing Vector Axis ($X$-axis)**:
     - **Clock Cycle Time ($t_{CK}$)**: Sweep from $5.00\,\text{ns}$ to $12.00\,\text{ns}$ in steps of $100\,\text{ps}$ ($0.10\,\text{ns}$).
     - **Active-to-Read/Write Delay ($t_{RCD}$)**: Sweep from $10.00\,\text{ns}$ to $25.00\,\text{ns}$ in steps of $250\,\text{ps}$ ($0.25\,\text{ns}$).
     - **Precharge Time ($t_{RP}$)**: Sweep from $10.00\,\text{ns}$ to $25.00\,\text{ns}$ in steps of $250\,\text{ps}$ ($0.25\,\text{ns}$).

4. **Vector Execution & Strobe Evaluation**:
   - At each $(V_{DD}, t_{parameter})$ coordinate point, burst the test pattern across all memory address spaces (marching patterns, checkerboard, and read disturb).
   - Evaluate comparator strobe pass/fail criteria on data pins ($DQ0$--$DQ15$); assign binary flag (`1` = PASS, `0` = FAIL).

5. **Boundary Contour Extraction & Margin Computation**:
   - Apply a gradient edge-detection algorithm across the 2D pass/fail boolean matrix to delineate the operational boundary:
     $$V_{DD,min}(t) = \min \{V_{DD} \mid \text{Pass}(V_{DD}, t) = 1\}$$
   - Identify the point of onset failure and calculate the timing margin relative to JEDEC target bin requirements:
     $$\Delta t_{\text{margin}} = t_{\text{JEDEC\_SPEC}} - t_{\text{boundary\_actual}} \quad (\text{at nominal } V_{DD} = 1.80\,\text{V})$$

6. **Post-Stress Drift Analysis & Bin Allocation**:
   - Compare post-HTOL boundary profiles against pre-stress baseline matrices. Check for shift in threshold due to hot-carrier injection (HCI) or bias temperature instability (BTI).
   - Categorize parts into target speed bins according to boundary margins meeting or exceeding required test guardbands.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Post-Burn-in Shmoo Timing & Voltage Margins
                ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░░                               │
   VDD Shmoo (V)┤░░░░░                               │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
 tRP Margin (ns)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
tRCD Margin (ns)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 tCK Margin (ns)┤████████████████████████████        │
                │████████████████████████████        │
                └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
               0.00     0.60     1.20    1.80    2.40 
```

1. **Clock Period Timing Margin ($\Delta t_{CK}$)**:
   - Target Metric: $\ge 1.85\,\text{ns}$ margin above boundary at nominal $V_{DD} = 1.80\,\text{V}$ for target speed binning.
2. **Row Active-to-Read/Write Delay Margin ($\Delta t_{RCD}$)**:
   - Target Metric: $\ge 2.40\,\text{ns}$ positive setup margin relative to the maximum JEDEC test spec limit.
3. **Row Precharge Timing Margin ($\Delta t_{RP}$)**:
   - Target Metric: $\ge 2.10\,\text{ns}$ recovery margin across nominal supply voltage.
4. **Supply Voltage Shmoo Dynamic Operating Window**:
   - Target Metric: Continuous pass plateau $\Delta V_{DD} \ge 0.28\,\text{V}$ spanning across the nominal operating voltage envelope ($1.80\,\text{V} \pm 10\%$).

---

### 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **[SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid](./docs/context.yaml)**: Provides physical baseline parameters including 130nm-to-180nm geometry, minimum drawn gate length of $150\,\text{nm}$ ($0.15\,\mu\text{m}$), and manufacturing grid step of $5\,\text{nm}$ ($0.005\,\mu\text{m}$) governing device propagation delays and interconnect limits.
- **[OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow](./docs/context.yaml)**: Governs timing extraction standards via OpenRCX parasitic extraction and signoff setup/hold timing optimization utilized for ATE vector correlation and strobe margin validation.
- **[SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Overview & Architecture](./docs/context.yaml)**: Defines digital standard cell characteristics and timing library validation methodologies required for DRAM peripheral logic speed-binning.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated 2D Shmoo margin extraction requires rigorous test program synchronization across ATE pin electronics channels (PECs) to prevent thermal-induced edge drift during dense tCK vs VDD matrix stepping. In 180nm CMOS DRAM operating at 1.8V nominal core / 3.3V I/O, the power dissipation delta between dense March C- execution at minimum cycle time (tCK = 5.0 ns) and loose cycle time (tCK = 10.0 ns) causes dynamic junction temperature (Tj) excursions up to 14.8°C if dwell time per test vector vector-burst is uncalibrated. The extraction algorithm must implement adaptive guardbanding and vector settling delays (>=2.5 ms) between voltage steps, else pseudo-failures will falsely contract the measured JEDEC timing margin envelope.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Extraction of tRCD (RAS-to-CAS delay) and tRP (Row Precharge time) boundaries must resolve the analog nature of sense amplifier latching and bitline equalization under sub-optimal VDD conditions. In 180nm planar DRAM cells, wordline boost voltage (VPP) pump efficiency drops drastically below VDD = 1.62V (-10%), resulting in incomplete access transistor conduction and degraded cell-to-bitline charge transfer (delta V_BL < 120 mV). The edge-detection algorithm must differentiate between true hard timing boundary failures (setup/hold violations on command/address buses) and retention/sensing margin collapse caused by insufficient sense-amp overdrive during compressed tRCD cycles.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: ATE socket life and probe card pogo-pin contact resistance (Cres) degradation directly skew extracted timing margins over extended multi-site qualification lots. Contact resistance variation (>0.8 Ohm increase) across high-insertion burn-in sockets causes localized IR drop during burst precharge and write operations, falsely failing devices on tRP and tCK margins. ATE maintenance schedules must enforce Cres Kelvin contact verification every 2,500 socket cycles, and test loadboards must utilize standardized high-frequency microstrip traces with calibrated controlled impedance (50 Ohm +/- 2%) to avoid artificial reflections clouding speed-bin classification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test execution throughput must be tightly balanced against multi-dimensional shmoo matrix resolution. Running unconstrained high-granularity sweeps (100 steps on VDD x 100 steps on tCK x 64Mbit patterns) creates excessive ATE test time exceeding 145 seconds per unit, rendering production speed-binning commercially unviable. The characterization pipeline must implement coarse-to-fine binary search edge-tracking algorithms (bisection search) reducing step count from 10,000 to <= 36 vector burst points per edge, containing total test time to under 8.5 seconds per packaged DUT while preserving sub-100 ps boundary extraction resolution.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic IR-drop collapse along internal metal-2/metal-3 VDD distribution buses during concurrent bank precharge (tRP sweep), generating transient supply dips below 1.55V and inducing false sense-amp latch failures.
1. Tester pin-to-pin skew and ground bounce (>350 ps) during simultaneous switching outputs (SSO) on DQ buses corrupting tCK boundary determination by masquerading as internal DRAM clock tree skew.
1. Thermal runaway or junction overheating during high-voltage corner (VDD = 2.05V) burst sweeps leading to localized sub-threshold leakage increase in cell access transistors and false retention failure masquerading as tRCD timing limitation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-2-3-01` | **Automated VDD vs tCK Shmoo Boundary Extraction and Timing Margin Characterization** | Advantest T5503HS2 Memory Test System with 50-Ohm matched DUT interface board, high-speed differential pin electronics, and thermal stream control unit (-40°C to +125°C, +/-0.5°C stability) | 1. Initialize DUT at nominal VDD = 1.80V and program JEDEC Mode Register (CAS Latency = 3, Burst Length = 8). 2. Step VDD from 1.50V to 2.10V in 25mV increments. 3. For each voltage step, sweep clock period tCK from 12.0 ns down to 4.0 ns in 100 ps steps using a modified March C- pattern (burst read/write across all 4 banks). 4. Record pass/fail status per matrix point using hardware comparator strobes set to 50% VDD swing. 5. Execute bisection boundary extraction algorithm to locate pass/fail boundary contour line. 6. Calculate timing margin at JEDEC nominal DDR-200 / DDR-333 targets. | `Stable operational pass window must satisfy: minimum tCK <= 6.0 ns at VDD = 1.80V +/- 100mV; timing margin >= 1.25 ns relative to JEDEC DDR-200 specification (tCK = 7.5 ns) across full voltage range; zero non-monotonic 'Swiss-cheese' pass pockets inside the boundary envelope.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-2-3-02` | **Dual-Parameter tRCD vs tRP Latency Shmoo Edge Detection under Low-Voltage Corner** | Teradyne UltraFLEX-M Memory ATE with high-density algorithmic pattern generator (APG), precision dual-channel SMU, and high-frequency active probe head | 1. Configure ATE APG to loop a continuous ACTIVATE-to-READ/WRITE-to-PRECHARGE sequence targeting all rows in Bank 0 and Bank 3. 2. Fix operating clock period tCK at 7.50 ns. 3. Incrementally sweep tRCD from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 200 ps decrements. 4. Concurrently sweep tRP from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 200 ps decrements. 5. Capture cycle-by-cycle error map into ATE fail memory (AFM). 6. Extract contour gradient (dtRCD/dtRP) along the pass-fail boundary and identify critical knee point. | `Boundary extraction must demonstrate robust operation: Pass-to-fail transition edge sharpness < 400 ps; minimum passing tRCD <= 15.0 ns and minimum passing tRP <= 15.0 ns at VDD = 1.62V, Ta = 85°C; extracted timing margin >= 2.50 ns relative to minimum JEDEC spec limit (17.5 ns).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 166 compliant UV and impact safety glasses with side shields, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) compliant conductive nitrile gloves (minimum thickness 0.12 mm), ESD-safe dissipative lab coat (surface resistivity 10e6 to 10e9 ohms/sq), Thermal protective gloves rated to 150°C for DUT socket exchange during elevated temperature testing
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with clean eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Skin Exposure (IPA): Wash affected area with mild soap and water. Thermal/Cryogenic Burns: Submerge or flush affected skin with lukewarm water (approx. 40°C); do not apply direct heat or rub frostbitten skin. Inhalation of inert N2: Immediately remove victim to fresh air; if breathing has stopped, trained personnel must administer artificial respiration and supplemental oxygen; seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: ATE testing bay requires certified HVAC air exchange rate of >= 12 room air turnovers per hour. Point exhaust hoods (flow rate >= 75 CFM) must be positioned over socket cleaning stations and thermal stream exhaust manifolds to discharge thermal discharge and volatile organic vapors outdoors.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free swabs and cleaning pads must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-retardant hazardous waste disposal bins. Volatile waste must not be poured down drains; dispose through certified hazardous solvent reclamation vendors in accordance with EPA RCRA guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for socket contact cleaning** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Liquid Nitrogen (LN2) for thermal conditioning gas stream** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `480 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `168 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Packaged 180nm DRAM DUTs post-HTOL burn-in with leadframes/solder balls degreased, free from organic flux residue, non-corroded, and completely dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tested and speed-binned packages with undamaged lead/ball geometry, zero socket indentation exceeding 15 um depth, and hermetic package integrity verified.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption into plastic mold compound (MSL Level 3 violation) inducing package delamination or popcorning during subsequent socket thermal cycling, coupled with leadframe oxidation causing Cres escalation and erroneous margin extraction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Deterministic and fully automated extraction of 2D/3D Shmoo timing margins (tCK, tRCD, tRP vs VDD and Temperature) for 180nm Open-Source DRAM, establishing precise operational boundaries, identifying parasitic IR-drop sensitivity, and generating binning classification tables compliant with JEDEC DDR specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_SHMOO_MARGIN_EXTRACT_REPORT_REV1.pdf`
- [ ] `DRAM180_TCK_TRCD_TRP_SHMOO_RAW_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM180_PASS_FAIL_BOUNDARY_CONTOUR_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Minimum passing clock cycle period tCK at nominal supply and maximum operating junction temperature** | `5.00 ns` | +/- 0.25 ns | Automated bisection boundary search on Advantest ATE at VDD = 1.80V, Tj = 85°C executing March C- pattern |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Sense-amp RAS-to-CAS delay tRCD timing margin relative to JEDEC DDR-200 minimum limit under worst-case voltage corner** | `2.80 ns` | +/- 0.35 ns | AFM vector failure analysis during 2D VDD (1.62V) vs tRCD sweep with 100 ps edge strobe resolution |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Row precharge time tRP timing margin relative to JEDEC DDR-200 minimum limit under worst-case voltage corner** | `3.10 ns` | +/- 0.30 ns | ATE continuous PRECHARGE-to-ACTIVATE burst vector extraction across all four internal memory banks |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All qualification DUTs successfully characterize across the complete 2D parameter space without non-monotonic anomalies; extracted timing margins on tCK, tRCD, and tRP meet or exceed targets by >= 3-sigma across 3 wafer fabrication lots; complete CSV raw matrices, contour boundary TIFFs, and sign-off report archived in product data management (PDM) system.
