critics.systems_engineer: Automated 2D Shmoo margin extraction requires rigorous test program synchronization across ATE pin electronics channels (PECs) to prevent thermal-induced edge drift during dense tCK vs VDD matrix stepping. In 180nm CMOS DRAM operating at 1.8V nominal core / 3.3V I/O, the power dissipation delta between dense March C- execution at minimum cycle time (tCK = 5.0 ns) and loose cycle time (tCK = 10.0 ns) causes dynamic junction temperature (Tj) excursions up to 14.8°C if dwell time per test vector vector-burst is uncalibrated. The extraction algorithm must implement adaptive guardbanding and vector settling delays (>=2.5 ms) between voltage steps, else pseudo-failures will falsely contract the measured JEDEC timing margin envelope.
critics.domain_expert: Extraction of tRCD (RAS-to-CAS delay) and tRP (Row Precharge time) boundaries must resolve the analog nature of sense amplifier latching and bitline equalization under sub-optimal VDD conditions. In 180nm planar DRAM cells, wordline boost voltage (VPP) pump efficiency drops drastically below VDD = 1.62V (-10%), resulting in incomplete access transistor conduction and degraded cell-to-bitline charge transfer (delta V_BL < 120 mV). The edge-detection algorithm must differentiate between true hard timing boundary failures (setup/hold violations on command/address buses) and retention/sensing margin collapse caused by insufficient sense-amp overdrive during compressed tRCD cycles.
critics.supply_chain: ATE socket life and probe card pogo-pin contact resistance (Cres) degradation directly skew extracted timing margins over extended multi-site qualification lots. Contact resistance variation (>0.8 Ohm increase) across high-insertion burn-in sockets causes localized IR drop during burst precharge and write operations, falsely failing devices on tRP and tCK margins. ATE maintenance schedules must enforce Cres Kelvin contact verification every 2,500 socket cycles, and test loadboards must utilize standardized high-frequency microstrip traces with calibrated controlled impedance (50 Ohm +/- 2%) to avoid artificial reflections clouding speed-bin classification.
critics.laya_pm: Test execution throughput must be tightly balanced against multi-dimensional shmoo matrix resolution. Running unconstrained high-granularity sweeps (100 steps on VDD x 100 steps on tCK x 64Mbit patterns) creates excessive ATE test time exceeding 145 seconds per unit, rendering production speed-binning commercially unviable. The characterization pipeline must implement coarse-to-fine binary search edge-tracking algorithms (bisection search) reducing step count from 10,000 to <= 36 vector burst points per edge, containing total test time to under 8.5 seconds per packaged DUT while preserving sub-100 ps boundary extraction resolution.
critical_failure_modes: Dynamic IR-drop collapse along internal metal-2/metal-3 VDD distribution buses during concurrent bank precharge (tRP sweep), generating transient supply dips below 1.55V and inducing false sense-amp latch failures.
Tester pin-to-pin skew and ground bounce (>350 ps) during simultaneous switching outputs (SSO) on DQ buses corrupting tCK boundary determination by masquerading as internal DRAM clock tree skew.

Thermal runaway or junction overheating during high-voltage corner (VDD = 2.05V) burst sweeps leading to localized sub-threshold leakage increase in cell access transistors and false retention failure masquerading as tRCD timing limitation.

testcases.title: Automated VDD vs tCK Shmoo Boundary Extraction and Timing Margin Characterization
testcases.instrumentation: Advantest T5503HS2 Memory Test System with 50-Ohm matched DUT interface board, high-speed differential pin electronics, and thermal stream control unit (-40°C to +125°C, +/-0.5°C stability)
testcases.pre_conditions: Packaged 180nm DRAM DUT mounted in Kelvin zero-insertion-force (ZIF) socket; device pre-conditioned at Tj = 85.0°C; programmable power supply calibrated for VDD (1.40V to 2.20V in 20mV increments); ATE pin timing calibrated via TDR with skew < 45 ps.
testcases.procedure: 1. Initialize DUT at nominal VDD = 1.80V and program JEDEC Mode Register (CAS Latency = 3, Burst Length = 8). 2. Step VDD from 1.50V to 2.10V in 25mV increments. 3. For each voltage step, sweep clock period tCK from 12.0 ns down to 4.0 ns in 100 ps steps using a modified March C- pattern (burst read/write across all 4 banks). 4. Record pass/fail status per matrix point using hardware comparator strobes set to 50% VDD swing. 5. Execute bisection boundary extraction algorithm to locate pass/fail boundary contour line. 6. Calculate timing margin at JEDEC nominal DDR-200 / DDR-333 targets.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Stable operational pass window must satisfy: minimum tCK <= 6.0 ns at VDD = 1.80V +/- 100mV; timing margin >= 1.25 ns relative to JEDEC DDR-200 specification (tCK = 7.5 ns) across full voltage range; zero non-monotonic 'Swiss-cheese' pass pockets inside the boundary envelope.

testcases.title: Dual-Parameter tRCD vs tRP Latency Shmoo Edge Detection under Low-Voltage Corner
testcases.instrumentation: Teradyne UltraFLEX-M Memory ATE with high-density algorithmic pattern generator (APG), precision dual-channel SMU, and high-frequency active probe head
testcases.pre_conditions: DUT stabilized at worst-case operating corner: VDD = 1.62V (-10% degraded supply), VPP = 2.80V, Ta = 85.0°C; background data scrambled pattern loaded; clock jitter < 30 ps RMS.
testcases.procedure: 1. Configure ATE APG to loop a continuous ACTIVATE-to-READ/WRITE-to-PRECHARGE sequence targeting all rows in Bank 0 and Bank 3. 2. Fix operating clock period tCK at 7.50 ns. 3. Incrementally sweep tRCD from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 200 ps decrements. 4. Concurrently sweep tRP from 25.0 ns down to 10.0 ns in 200 ps decrements. 5. Capture cycle-by-cycle error map into ATE fail memory (AFM). 6. Extract contour gradient (dtRCD/dtRP) along the pass-fail boundary and identify critical knee point.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Boundary extraction must demonstrate robust operation: Pass-to-fail transition edge sharpness < 400 ps; minimum passing tRCD <= 15.0 ns and minimum passing tRP <= 15.0 ns at VDD = 1.62V, Ta = 85°C; extracted timing margin >= 2.50 ns relative to minimum JEDEC spec limit (17.5 ns).

# Standard Operating Procedure: Post-Stress Pass/Fail Yield Analysis and JEDEC Speed-Bin Classification Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-stress JEDEC DDR speed-binning requires deterministic ATE timing calibration (TDR skew < 25 ps across all DQS/DQ pin channels) and calibrated thermal socket insertion loss compensation; uncalibrated contact resistance (R_contact > 0.35 Ohm) after HTOL stress elevates ground bounce and skews true post-stress tCK/tRCD timing margins.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Thermal stress during HTOL accelerates hot carrier injection (HCI), positive/negative bias temperature instability (BTI), and gate dielectric trap generation; speed-bin classification must decouple true transistor threshold degradation (Delta_Vth > 15 mV causing tRCD and tRP stretch) from package-level socket wear or contact oxidation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Qualification sockets with Kelvin contact pins rated for >500k insertions at 125°C are sole-sourced from specialized test socket vendors; contact tip pin-wear during high-volume post-stress re-screening directly impacts test cell uptime and yield binning accuracy.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test execution budgets mandate sub-450 ms test times per packaged device across all speed-bin patterns (DDR-200, DDR-333, DDR-400 equivalent for 180nm CMOS); comprehensive Shmoo margin mapping must be constrained to statistical 5-point boundary search algorithms rather than exhaustive 2D sweeps.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Contact resistance elevation on VDD/VSS pins causing false-fail tCK timing violations due to transient dynamic supply sag exceeding 120 mV
1. BTI-induced sense-amplifier cross-coupled pair Vth mismatch resulting in post-stress tRCD latency expansion beyond JEDEC 15 ns bin threshold
1. Charge pumping and trap generation in 180nm DRAM cell pass-transistors precipitating retention fail confusion during speed-bin margin testing at elevated temperature

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-3-01` | **Post-HTOL High-Temperature JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin Classification** | Advantest T5588 DDR Memory Test System with active Kelvin automated test socket, tri-temp thermal handler (-40°C to 125°C, +/-0.5°C control), and sub-picosecond edge-placement timing generator | 1. Dock handler and engage DUT into Kelvin socket with 35 g/pin contact force. 2. Power up DUT with nominal VDD/VDDQ = 1.80V; verify quiescent current IDD2N < 12 mA. 3. Apply JEDEC initialization sequence (precharge all, 200 us delay, EMRS enable, DLL reset, auto-refresh cycles). 4. Stream pseudo-random binary sequence (PRBS-7) memory burst test vectors at clock periods tCK = 7.5 ns (DDR-266), tCK = 6.0 ns (DDR-333), and tCK = 5.0 ns (DDR-400). 5. Evaluate pass/fail strobe on DQ/DQS pins at programmed tRCD = 15 ns, tRP = 15 ns, and tRAS = 40 ns. 6. Log highest passing operational speed bin and record output vector error log. | `Device passes DDR-333 classification (tCK = 6.0 ns, tRCD = 15.0 ns, tRP = 15.0 ns) with zero single-bit or burst errors across 10^8 cycles at Tj = 85°C; IDD4R read burst current remains <= 65 mA.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-3-02` | **Post-Stress Shmoo Margin Metrology (VDD vs. tCK Clock Period)** | Teradyne UltraFLEX-M DRAM ATE system with multi-channel parametric measurement units (PMU) and active closed-loop thermal head (Tcase = 25°C +/- 1.0°C) | 1. Initialize device at nominal 1.80V VDD at 25°C. 2. Execute March C- pattern while sweeping VDD from 1.50V to 2.10V in 25 mV increments. 3. Simultaneously sweep clock period tCK from 4.0 ns to 8.5 ns in 50 ps increments with fixed tRCD = 3 cycles and tRP = 3 cycles. 4. Record pass/fail boundary matrices and identify voltage-timing cliff coordinates. 5. Calculate timing guardband margin Delta_tCK relative to standard JEDEC DDR specification boundaries. 6. Export 2D Shmoo wafer/package yield contour dataset. | `Operational operating window must exhibit minimum timing margin Delta_tCK >= 450 ps and minimum voltage operating margin Delta_VDD >= 180 mV beyond nominal DDR-333 speed specifications without functional failure.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal-insulating cryo/heat-resistant gloves rated to 150°C, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact safety glasses, Anti-static ESD lab coat with continuous conductive wrist grounding strap (1 MOhm series resistor), Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (thickness >= 4 mil) for contact pin cleaning
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with heated socket components, immediately immerse affected area in cold running water for 15 minutes; seek medical attention for second-degree burns. For IPA inhalation, move worker to fresh air immediately. For eye contact with solvent splatter, flush eyes with emergency eyewash for minimum 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: ATE handler thermal unit equipped with local laminar exhaust duct (minimum face velocity 100 fpm / 0.51 m/s) to capture thermal outgassing from high-temperature IC sockets and solvent cleaning vapors.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipes and contaminated swab consumables collected in dedicated flammable solvent waste receptacles equipped with self-closing foot pedals; disposed via hazardous solvent incineration per EPA/RCRA standards.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.8% w/w` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.0 | `>= 99.999% vol` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-HTOL dry leadframe/ball array with minimal atmospheric oxide accumulation and zero solder bridge flux residues
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Classified speed-binned package pins with intact gold/tin metallization, R_contact < 0.25 Ohm, stored in static-shielding dry-pack carrier
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time causes leadframe/BGA pad micro-oxidation and atmospheric moisture adsorption, elevating package contact resistance and driving false speed-bin down-grading during ATE insertion

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed post-stress ATE speed-binning metrology and JEDEC qualification classification on 180nm DRAM lots, verifying DDR-333/DDR-266 operational yields and timing margin stability against BTI/HCI degradation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_post_htol_speedbin_yield_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `dram_gen3_jedec_shmoo_timing_margins.pdf`
- [ ] `ate_contact_resistance_gage_rr_report.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-HTOL DDR-333 speed-bin package qualification yield** | `>= 94.5%` | -1.5% | Automated ATE test execution on 1,000 post-stress sample parts logging JEDEC DDR-333 vector pass/fail results |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-stress tRCD parameter degradation shift (Delta_tRCD)** | `<= 0.45 ns` | +0.10 ns | High-precision edge-strobe search metrology measuring RAS-to-CAS delay shift pre- vs post-HTOL stress |
| `ASSERT-03` | **ATE Kelvin test socket pin contact resistance repeatability (Gauge R&R)** | `<= 1.0%` | +0.2% | 10-part 3-operator 3-trial Gauge R&R ANOVA metrology on pin contact resistance across active test socket |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All sampled post-HTOL units pass 100% vector validation through JEDEC DDR speed-bin classifiers without unrecoverable timing degradation, Gage R&R CV <= 1.0% confirmed on ATE contact interface, and post-stress Shmoo timing margins signed off by Metrology and Product Engineering leads.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Post-Stress ATE STDF Datalog Parsing and Raw Bit-Failure Extraction

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-MET-180-042`  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (SkyWater SKY130 / 180nm commercial MPW tapeout compatibility)  
**Process Step:** Post-Stress ATE JEDEC DDR Speed-Binning & HTOL Burn-in Metrology  

---

#### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the automated ingestion, parsing, topological coordinate translation, and defect signature classification of binary Standard Test Data Format (STDF v4) datalogs generated during Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR speed-bin qualification and High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) burn-in testing.

---

#### 2. Referenced Local Literature Context
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
  - Physical placement grid resolution: $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\ \text{nm}$).
  - Critical Dimensions (CD): Minimum active diffusion width $= 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$; Minimum poly gate length $= 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\ \text{nm}$); Minimum poly gate spacing $= 0.21\ \mu\text{m}$; Minimum contact hole dimension $= 0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$; Minimum Metal 1 width $= 0.14\ \mu\text{m}$; Minimum Metal 1 pitch $= 0.34\ \mu\text{m}$.
  - Lithography & Overlay: Poly-to-diffusion maximum permissible overlay error budget $\le 35\ \text{nm}$; minimum resolvable half-pitch $= 152\ \text{nm}$ ($\lambda = 248\ \text{nm}$, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$).
- **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow:**
  - Macro placement, standard cell placement, detailed placement snapped to the manufacturing grid, and post-layout parasitics via OpenRCX.
- **SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Architecture:**
  - Standard cell layout structures, analog macro generator interfaces, and digital control integration.

---

#### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

##### Step 1: Binary STDF Record Parsing and Header Validation
1. Ingest post-HTOL stress ATE STDF binary stream (`*.stdf` or gzip-compressed `*.std.gz`).
2. Parse the File Attributes Record (`FAR`) and Master Information Record (`MIR`) to verify test program revision, burn-in chamber lot ID, stress elapsed time ($t_{\text{stress}}$), and test temperature ($T_{\text{junction}}$).
3. Validate Part Information Records (`PIR`) and Part Result Records (`PRR`) to extract hardware site numbers, DUT serial IDs, soft bin, and hard bin assignments.

##### Step 2: Vector Test Failure Extraction (FTR / BPS / EPS Records)
1. Read the Functional Test Records (`FTR`) corresponding to high-speed speed-bin pattern executions ($t_{\text{CK}}$, $t_{\text{RCD}}$, $t_{\text{RP}}$).
2. Decompress Bit Program State (`BPS`) / Error Pin State (`EPS`) structures and identify failing vector cycle numbers, channel numbers, and strobe fail masks.
3. Extract logical fail addresses:
   $$\text{Logical Address} = \{\text{Bank}[2:0],\, \text{Row}[13:0],\, \text{Column}[9:0],\, \text{DQ}[15:0]\}$$
4. Filter parametric test records (`PTR`) for device standby leakage ($I_{\text{DD2N}}$) and precharge currents ($I_{\text{DD3P}}$).

##### Step 3: Physical Topological Coordinate De-scrambling
1. Apply the DRAM array address-scramble decoding matrix $M_{\text{topo}}$ to translate logical bit coordinates into physical silicon array coordinates:
   $$\begin{pmatrix} X_{\text{phys}} \\ Y_{\text{phys}} \end{pmatrix} = M_{\text{topo}} \times \begin{pmatrix} \text{Bank} \\ \text{Row} \\ \text{Column} \\ \text{DQ} \end{pmatrix}$$
2. Snap all derived physical bit centers to the **$0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\ \text{nm}$)** foundry manufacturing placement grid.
3. Verify that bit coordinate boundaries conform to layout physical design rules:
   - Wordline (poly gate) spacing: pitch $\ge 0.36\ \mu\text{m}$ (gate length $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ + gate spacing $0.21\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Bitline (Metal 1) pitch: $\ge 0.34\ \mu\text{m}$ (minimum width $0.14\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Storage node contact: minimum dimension $0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$.

##### Step 4: Spatial Clustering and Failure Classification
1. Cluster adjacent failed cell coordinates $(X_{\text{phys}}, Y_{\text{phys}})$ using nearest-neighbor Euclidean distance thresholding ($D_{\text{cluster}} \le 0.34\ \mu\text{m}$ for bitline neighbors or $0.36\ \mu\text{m}$ for wordline neighbors).
2. Classify raw bit fails into standardized defect morphology bins:
   - **Single-Bit Failure (SBF):** Isolated cell failing retention/speed-bin without neighboring coordinate failures.
   - **Wordline Failure (WLF):** Continuous failed bit string along poly-gate orientation ($Y_{\text{phys}}$ constant, varying $X_{\text{phys}}$).
   - **Bitline Failure (BLF):** Continuous failed bit string along Metal 1 routing ($X_{\text{phys}}$ constant, varying $Y_{\text{phys}}$).
   - **Cross-Point / Area Cluster:** Multi-cell failure spanning $>152\ \text{nm}$ half-pitch across multiple wordlines and bitlines, characteristic of oxide breakdown, gate-to-diff overlay shift exceeding the $35\ \text{nm}$ budget, or particle defects.
3. Output the parsed topological bitmap into standard wafer-map format (`*.xml` / `*.binmap`).

---

#### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
       ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA TARGET THRESHOLDS
       ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
       [Grid Placement Snapping]        0.005 µm (exact 5 nm)
       [M1 Pitch Extraction Gate]      ≥ 0.340 µm
       [Overlay Defect Detection Limit] ≤ 35 nm (0.035 µm)
       [Datalog Parse Accuracy]         100.0% (Zero Record Drops)
       ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

1. **Topological Coordinate Grid Precision:** $100\%$ of extracted cell centroid coordinates $(X_{\text{phys}}, Y_{\text{phys}})$ must snap exactly to an integer multiple of the **$0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\ \text{nm}$)** physical placement grid.
2. **Bitline Dimensional Verification:** Extracted failed bitline column spatial pitches must conform to the minimum Metal 1 pitch specification of **$\ge 0.34\ \mu\text{m}$** (with metal width of **$0.14\ \mu\text{m}$**).
3. **Overlay-Related Cluster Margin Sensitivity:** The clustering engine must detect and classify poly-to-active diffusion overlay degradation clusters matching spatial misalignments exceeding **$35\ \text{nm}$** ($0.035\ \mu\text{m}$).
4. **STDF Parsing Integrity & Record Loss:** Zero dropped records across all ingested test lots; record parsing integrity metric $= 100.0\%$ for all `FAR`, `MIR`, `PIR`, `FTR`, and `PRR` blocks.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Parsing standard STDF v4 datalogs from post-stress ATE runs (such as post-HTOL or post-burn-in) requires strict synchronization between ATE test vector execution cycles and physical memory topological descrambling. In a 180nm folded bitline DRAM architecture (8F^2 cell area = 0.259 um^2), raw bit-failure records (PLR/PMR) must be precisely mapped from logical X/Y addresses to physical wordline, bitline, and sense-amplifier coordinates. The parser pipeline must stream records without loading multi-gigabyte binary files entirely into memory, preventing buffer overflows during high-defect-density post-stress die logging.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-stress burn-in accelerates defect mechanisms such as gate oxide breakdown in the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide access NMOS, cell dielectric leakage (degrading storage capacitance Cs below 25 fF), and inter-metal dielectric (IMD) shorts. The raw bit-failure extraction routine must differentiate between single-bit retention failures, paired-bit adjacent failures (indicative of folded bitline capacitive coupling or subthreshold leakage), and whole-row/whole-column failures (indicative of wordline boost decoder failure or sense amplifier latch breakdown). Parsing must capture parametric test results (PTR) alongside functional fail records (FTR) to correlate speed-bin degradation with tCK, tRCD, and tRP timing margin shifts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: STDF parsing software must remain vendor-agnostic across commercial ATE platforms (e.g., Advantest T5588/T5503 or Teradyne UltraFLEX-DRAM) deployed across domestic and OSAT packaging lines. Proprietary datalog extensions or non-standard record framing by test houses introduce parsing latencies, threatening the 48-hour turn-around-time (TAT) requirement for post-stress yield learning and speed-bin dispositioning.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule alignment requires automated, unattended STDF parsing pipelines that ingest datalogs directly from the ATE SECS/GEM interface upon lot completion. Data extraction bottlenecks delay root-cause analysis for HTOL infant mortality failures and jeopardize milestone sign-off for the 180nm MPW tapeout reliability qualification matrix.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Topological descrambling inversion error resulting in transposed bitline-to-wordline failure coordinate assignment and false physical defect clustering analysis
1. STDF binary stream desynchronization or corrupted record byte-length header truncation causing dropped Functional Test Record (FTR/PMR) packets during multi-megabit catastrophic die failure logging
1. Memory leak and I/O buffer crash during concurrent batch ingestion of multi-gigabyte post-stress ATE STDF v4 files containing millions of retention failure vectors

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-3-1-01` | **STDF v4 Binary Parser Integrity and FTR/PMR Bit-Failure Vector Extraction Validation** | Automated STDF v4 validation harness integrated with Advantest T5588 ATE Offline Analysis Suite, MD5/SHA-256 bit-stream integrity checker, and synthetic known-defect DRAM fault vector generator | 1. Ingest the post-stress STDF v4 binary stream via the high-throughput parsing pipeline. 2. Parse File Header Record (FAR), Master Information Record (MIR), Test Synopsis Record (TSR), Part Information Record (PIR), and Part Result Record (PRR). 3. Extract all Functional Test Records (FTR) and Part Memory Records (PMR) detailing fail cycle counts, pin states, and channel vector offsets. 4. Execute topological address descrambling to convert logical row/column addresses into physical bank, mat, wordline, and bitline coordinates. 5. Compare extracted bit-failure matrix against known injected hardware fault database. | `Zero missing records (100.00% extraction completeness); 10,000 out of 10,000 bit-failure coordinates mapped with 0 coordinate transposition errors (Descramble Accuracy = 100%); Parsing throughput >= 25 MB/s binary data processing rate.` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-3-1-02` | **Post-Stress Shmoo Margin Extraction and JEDEC Speed-Bin Classification Accuracy** | Parametric Test Record (PTR) / Multiple Result Parametric Record (MPR) Parser Engine, High-Density Shmoo Surface Plotter, and JEDEC DDR-200/333/400 Timing Bin Allocator | 1. Parse PTR and MPR records corresponding to parametric timing shmoo tests. 2. Extract voltage-frequency pass/fail boundaries for each tested unit post-HTOL stress. 3. Calculate timing degradation delta compared to pre-stress baseline STDF records. 4. Apply JEDEC speed-bin sorting algorithm to classify units into DDR-400 (3-3-3), DDR-333 (2.5-3-3), DDR-200, or Functional Fail bins. 5. Reconcile software-classified bin designations with hardware ATE Hardware Bin (HBin) and Software Bin (SBin) in PRR records. | `100% agreement between parsed PRR Software Bin results and automated JEDEC classification matrix; timing measurement extraction precision <= ±10 ps; zero parsing truncation on high-density shmoo matrix sweeps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 Cleanroom / Test Floor Antistatic Lab Coat (ESD-safe), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses, ESD-safe dissipative nitrile gloves (surface resistivity 10^6 to 10^9 ohms/sq), Static-dissipative cleanroom safety shoes with heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Isopropyl Alcohol eye or skin contact: Flush immediately with clean eyewash water or physiological saline for at least 15 minutes. For vapor inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air. In case of inert gas (N2) leak causing oxygen displacement: Immediately evacuate area, monitor O2 levels (must be > 19.5%), and administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing has ceased.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / test-bay HVAC system maintaining ISO Class 7 (Class 10,000) air cleanliness, positive pressure differential of >= 15 Pa, 45-55% relative humidity (anti-static control), and ambient temperature controlled to 22°C ± 2°C with certified prober purge exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA lint-free wipes must be disposed of in dedicated flame-retardant, grounded flammables disposal bins and managed as hazardous solvent solid waste in accordance with regional environmental regulations.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Packaged DRAM ICs post-HTOL stress unloaded from burn-in boards (BIB); lead frames/BGA solder balls clean, unoxidized, free of flux residue or mechanical deformation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tested and speed-binned DRAM components placed in ESD-safe matrix trays; leads/balls inspected for probe contact burn marks; dry-packed with desiccant and humidity indicator cards (HIC).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption into plastic packaging exceeds JEDEC MSL-3 thresholds leading to package delamination or 'popcorn' cracking during secondary reflow; galvanic micro-corrosion of exposed package leads degrading contact resistance on ATE socket contactors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable Definition of Done comprises a robust, automated Python/C++ STDF v4 ingestion engine that extracts 100% of all PTR, MPR, FTR, and PMR records from post-stress DRAM ATE test logs. The engine generates physical bit-fail defect maps via verified 180nm folded-bitline topological descrambling, produces pass/fail speed-bin shmoo tables across JEDEC DDR specifications, and exports standardized machine-readable failure databases for yield learning.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## JEDEC Speed-Bin Classification & Parametric Shmoo Margin Sorting **Module**: Final Automated Test Equipment (ATE) JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing **Node**: Gen 3 (180nm CMOS / SKY130 Derivative Architecture) **Process Flow**: Wafer Sort $\rightarrow$ Packaging $\rightarrow$ Post-Stress Metrology $\rightarrow$ **JEDEC Speed-Bin Sorting** --- ### 1. Process Workflow Architecture ```text ┌────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ ATE Vector Loading & │ │ Pin Calibration │ │ │ └────────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ 2D Shmoo Matrix │ │ Execution: VDD vs │ │ tCK │ └────────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────◇───────────┐ │ Timing Parametric │ │ Evaluation: tCK, │ │ tRCD, tRP │ └────────────◇───────────┘ │ ├─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┬─────────────────────╮ │Pass DDR-400 Spec │Pass DDR-333 Spec │Pass DDR-266 Spec │Fail Spec Window ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐┌────────────────────────┐┌────────────────────────┐┌────────────────────────┐ │ Classify Bin 1: ││ Classify Bin 2: ││ Classify Bin 3: ││ Classify Bin 7: │ │ DDR-400 ││ DDR-333 ││ DDR-266 ││ Parametric Reject / │ │ ││ ││ ││ Scrap │ └─────────┬──────────────┘└────────────┬───────────┘└────────────┬───────────┘└────────────┬───────────┘ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Automated Pick-and-Place Handler Sorting │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure 1. **ATE Calibration & Vector Load**: - Dock packaged Gen 3 180nm DRAM units onto high-frequency automated test sockets. - De-skew all pin electronics (DQ, DQS, CK, ADDR/CMD) with an edge-placement resolution $\le 20\text{ ps}$. - Load calibrated timing libraries derived from physical design signoff (Liberty models characterized across corners via OpenROAD / STA engines). 2. **2D Shmoo Margin Execution ($V_{DD}$ vs. $t_{CK}$)**: - Apply functional March C- patterns and random DDR burst read/write vectors across varying core supply voltages ($V_{DD}$ swept from $1.70\text{ V}$ to $2.70\text{ V}$ in $25\text{ mV}$ increments). - Concurrently step cycle time $t_{CK}$ from $10.0\text{ ns}$ down to $4.0\text{ ns}$ in steps of $\Delta t_{CK} = 50\text{ ps}$. - Extract the pass/fail boundary contour (Shmoo envelope) for setup and hold margins. 3. **Parametric Parameter Extraction ($t_{RCD}$ & $t_{RP}$)**: - Execute row-activation to column-read delay sweeps ($t_{RCD}$) and precharge-to-activate time sweeps ($t_{RP}$) at nominal voltage ($V_{nom} = 2.50\text{ V} \pm 0.1\text{ V}$). - Verify that sense-amplifier latching margins and wordline precharge states conform to physical design timing budgets. 4. **Classification & Handler Bin Assignation**: - **Bin 1 (DDR-400)**: Pass $t_{CK} \le 5.0\text{ ns}$ ($200\text{ MHz}$ clock), $t_{RCD} \le 15.0\text{ ns}$, $t_{RP} \le 15.0\text{ ns}$ with voltage guardband $\ge 15\%$. - **Bin 2 (DDR-333)**: Pass $t_{CK} \le 6.0\text{ ns}$ ($166\text{ MHz}$ clock), $t_{RCD} \le 18.0\text{ ns}$, $t_{RP} \le 18.0\text{ ns}$ with voltage guardband $\ge 12\%$. - **Bin 3 (DDR-266)**: Pass $t_{CK} \le 7.5\text{ ns}$ ($133\text{ MHz}$ clock), $t_{RCD} \le 20.0\text{ ns}$, $t_{RP} \le 20.0\text{ ns}$ with voltage guardband $\ge 10\%$. - **Bin 7 (Parametric Reject / Scrap)**: Failure to meet DDR-266 boundaries or Shmoo guardband $< 10\%$. 5. **Physical Sorting & Logging**: - Signal the pick-and-place handler bin ID via GPIB/TCP-IP ATE interface and physically sort devices into partitioned carrier trays/tape reels. - Archive wafer-map and packaged unit STDF (Standard Test Data Format) logs for yield analysis. --- ### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria | Parameter / Metric | Unit | Target Value / Specification | Measurement Tool / Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Minimum Operating Cycle Time ($t_{CK}$)** | $\text{ns}$ | $\le 5.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 1 / DDR-400)
$\le 6.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 2 / DDR-333)
$\le 7.5\text{ ns}$ (Bin 3 / DDR-266) | ATE High-Speed Digital Timing Generator | | **Row-to-Column Delay ($t_{RCD}$)** | $\text{ns}$ | $\le 15.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 1)
$\le 18.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 2)
$\le 20.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 3) | March C- Vector Burst Read Analysis | | **Row Precharge Time ($t_{RP}$)** | $\text{ns}$ | $\le 15.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 1)
$\le 18.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 2)
$\le 20.0\text{ ns}$ (Bin 3) | Precharge-to-Active Command Interval Sweep | | **Parametric Shmoo Voltage Guardband** | $\%$ | $\ge 15.0\%$ operating voltage window around nominal $V_{DD}$ | 2D Shmoo Contour Integration ($V_{DD}$ vs. $t_{CK}$) | --- ### 4. Post-Stress Speed-Bin Distribution Metrology ```text Post-Stress Speed-Bin Distribution (%) ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐ │░░░░ │ Fail / Scrap┤░░░░ │ │▒▒▒▒▒ │ Bin 3 (DDR-266)┤▒▒▒▒▒ │ Bin 2 (DDR-333)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ │ │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ │ Bin 1 (DDR-400)┤███████████████████████████████████████│ │███████████████████████████████████████│ └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘ 0.0 17.1 34.2 51.4 68.5 ``` --- ### 5. Context Citing & Documentation Persistence - **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow**: Governs timing closure, parasitic extraction with OpenRCX, clock tree synthesis buffer sizing, and standard Liberty characterization (`make timing`). - **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**: Sets physical constraints including gate length ($150\text{ nm}$), active diffusion rules, contact dimensions ($0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m}$), and metallization geometries impacting RC wire delays. - **Micro-knowledge capture**: Persisted to [jedec_speed_bin_sorting_sop.md](./docs/knowledge/jedec_speed_bin_sorting_sop.md) under `docs/knowledge/`. --- ### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA) - **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-HTOL ATE speed-binning at 180nm must strictly de-embed tester channel skew, pogo-pin contact resistance variations (R_contact > 0.35 Ohm), and loadboard decoupling parasitic inductance (L_loop > 1.2 nH). Without per-pin automated TDR de-skew and dynamic edge-placement calibration down to sub-50 ps accuracy, false classification between DDR-200 (tCK = 10.0 ns) and DDR-266/333 (tCK = 7.5 ns / 6.0 ns) will degrade yield or cause field timing escapes under thermal-step transient load. - **Domain Physicist Critic**: Parametric shmoo characterization (VDD vs. tCK, tRCD, tRP) across the post-HTOL DRAM core must account for NBTI/PBTI-induced Vth shifts in the PMOS/NMOS cross-coupled sense amplifiers and wordline boost drivers (VPP). At 180nm CMOS operating at 2.5V VDD/VDDQ, sense amplifier offset voltage shifts (Delta-Vos > 15 mV) directly erode the tRCD margin by 1.2 ns to 2.5 ns; shmoo margin tracking must resolve the 4-corner cliff edge (tCK vs VDD from 2.25V to 2.75V) with a raster step no coarser than 25 mV and 100 ps. - **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated speed-bin sorting into physical tape-and-reel buckets relies on handler multi-site index time (< 450 ms) and socket lifecycle maintenance. Pogo-pin gold plating degradation during 8-site parallel testing causes contact chatter and spurious speed-bin downgrades; rigid socket cleaning schedules and yield-drop trigger thresholds (inter-socket variance > 2.5%) are imperative to prevent misallocating viable DDR-266 dies into discarded or DDR-200 bins. - **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test execution time per unit must be capped below 3.8 seconds across the multi-site ATE matrix to respect commercial MPW test cost budgets. The shmoo pattern raster must use binary-search edge tracking rather than full brute-force 2D matrix sweeps for non-boundary points, ensuring delivery of final yield bin distributions and JEDEC qualification reports within the allocated 5-day post-stress turnaround schedule. **Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**: 1. Tester interface pogo-pin wear leading to ground bounce and inductive VDD droop during burst read/write cycles, falsely failing DDR-266 tCK setup times. 1. Sense-amplifier threshold degradation post-HTOL causing bitline latch delay extension, collapsing the tRCD margin cliff at minimum operational core voltage (2.25V). 1. Thermal runaway in package socket during multi-vector shmoo sweeps without active thermal control (ATC), resulting in junction temperature Tj exceeding 110 deg C and unrecoverable refresh/tRP timing failures. ### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench) | Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-3-2-01` | **Post-HTOL JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin Classification Vector Execution** | Advantest T5588 / Teradyne UltraFLEX ATE equipped with 400 MHz digital channel pins, per-pin parametric measurement units (PPMU), active thermal control test socket set at 85 deg C +/- 0.5 deg C, and calibrated high-frequency DUT loadboard. | 1. Execute March C- and PRBS data patterns at nominal DDR-200 timing (tCK=10.0ns, tRCD=20ns, tRP=20ns, CL=2.5) across all 4 banks; record bit error count. 4. Scale tCK frequency to DDR-266 (tCK=7.5ns, tRCD=15ns, tRP=15ns, CL=2.5); re-execute test vectors. 5. If DDR-266 passes with zero bit errors, evaluate DDR-333 timing (tCK=6.0ns, tRCD=18ns, tRP=18ns, CL=2.5). 6. Latch final bin assignment in handler bin register (Bin 1: DDR-333, Bin 2: DDR-266, Bin 3: DDR-200, Bin 4: Timing Reject). | `Pass Bin 2 (DDR-266): Zero bit failures across 100% address space at tCK = 7.50 ns +/- 0.05 ns, tRCD <= 15.0 ns, and tRP <= 15.0 ns under 2.5V +/- 0.1V VDD at 85 deg C. Pass Bin 3 (DDR-200): Zero bit failures at tCK = 10.00 ns +/- 0.05 ns, tRCD <= 20.0 ns, and tRP <= 20.0 ns.` | | `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-2-3-2-02` | **Parametric Shmoo Margin Sorting (VDD vs. tCK / tRCD Timing Window)** | Automated High-Speed Memory Tester with automated pattern generator (APG), high-bandwidth digital timing edge generators (sub-25 ps vernier), and multi-channel programmable precision power supply (PPS). | 1. Set target parameter sweep axes: X-axis = VDD from 2.100V to 2.800V in 25 mV increments; Y-axis = tCK from 5.00 ns to 12.00 ns in 50 ps increments. 2. At each grid node, program PPS voltage, wait 2 ms settling time, and execute a 100 k-cycle read/write burst pattern. 3. Tag grid point as Pass (0 errors) or Fail (> 0 errors). 4. Repeat 2D raster for Secondary Shmoo: VDD (2.10V to 2.80V) vs. tRCD (10.0 ns to 25.0 ns in 100 ps steps). 5. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Stress Degradation Yield Reporting and Speed-Grade Bin Mapping Signoff

**Document ID:** `SOP-ATE-180NM-REL-008`  
**Process Node:** Gen 3 (180nm CMOS DRAM / SkyWater SKY130 compatible)  
**Parent Pipeline:** BEOL Wafer Sort & Packaging $\rightarrow$ JEDEC DDR Speed-Bin & HTOL Burn-in Testing $\rightarrow$ Post-Stress Metrology & Signoff  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    ATE Test Vector    │
│       Execution       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Parametric Shmoo    │
│       Metrology       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Post-Stress Delta   │
│   Drift Extraction    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Bin Mapping & Yield  │
│    Classification     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  QA Final Signoff &   │
│    Lot Disposition    │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental Chamber Conditioning & Socket Docking:**
   - Load post-HTOL stress packaged units into the Automated Test Equipment (ATE) test head socket board.
   - Stabilize the temperature chamber at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate high-temperature retention and worst-case leakage.
2. **JEDEC Speed-Bin Vector Execution ($t_{CK}$, $t_{RCD}$, $t_{RP}$):**
   - Apply supply voltage $V_{DD} = 1.8\,\text{V}$ and cycle functional vectors across target speed grades:
     - **Bin 1 (DDR-200):** $t_{CK} = 10.0\,\text{ns}$ ($100\,\text{MHz}$ clock / $200\,\text{Mbps}$ data rate), $t_{RCD} = 20\,\text{ns}$, $t_{RP} = 20\,\text{ns}$.
     - **Bin 2 (DDR-166):** $t_{CK} = 12.0\,\text{ns}$, $t_{RCD} = 20\,\text{ns}$, $t_{RP} = 20\,\text{ns}$.
     - **Bin 3 (DDR-133):** $t_{CK} = 15.0\,\text{ns}$, $t_{RCD} = 22.5\,\text{ns}$, $t_{RP} = 22.5\,\text{ns}$.
3. **Parametric & Shmoo Margin Extraction:**
   - Run two-dimensional timing-voltage Shmoo plots ($V_{DD} = 1.62\,\text{V}$ to $1.98\,\text{V}$ in $20\,\text{mV}$ increments vs. $t_{CK}$ step resolution of $0.1\,\text{ns}$).
   - Quantify access transistor parametric shifts on monitor structures ($W/L = 2.0\,\mu\text{m} / 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ and cell access transistor $W/L = 220\,\text{nm} / 180\,\text{nm}$):
     - Measure threshold voltage $V_{th}$ at linear region ($V_{DS} = 50\,\text{mV}$) via $g_m$ extrapolation.
     - Extract drive current $I_{on}$ at $V_{GS} = V_{DS} = 1.8\,\text{V}$ and off-state leakage $I_{off}$ at $V_{GS} = 0\,\text{V}$, $V_{DS} = 1.8\,\text{V}$.
4. **Post-Stress Degradation & Delta Analysis:**
   - Compute parameter shift vectors: $\Delta V_{th} = V_{th,\text{post}} - V_{th,\text{pre}}$, $\Delta I_{on} / I_{on,\text{pre}}$, and cell retention margin shift.
   - Screen out units exhibiting cell leakage exceeding $1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ or storage capacitance loss below the minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ budget.
5. **Speed-Grade Bin Mapping & Final Signoff:**
   - Sort passing dies into hard-bin categories (Bin 1, Bin 2, Bin 3) and tag degraded or failing dies into reject categories (Parametric Fail, Functional Fail, Retention Fail).
   - Generate automated Lot Yield and Degradation Summary reports for Quality Assurance (QA) signoff and wafer-sort/assembly disposition.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Baseline / Target Metric | Post-Stress Allowable Degradation / Limit | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **MOSFET Threshold Voltage ($V_{thn}$)** | $+0.55\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$ (nominal) | $|\Delta V_{thn}| \le 50\,\text{mV}$ (Linear @ $V_{DS} = 50\,\text{mV}$) | $\text{mV}$ |
| **On-State Drive Current ($I_{on}$)** | $\ge 500\,\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ (@ $V_{GS} = V_{DS} = 1.8\,\text{V}$) | Post-stress degradation $\le 10\%$ ($I_{on} \ge 450\,\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$) | $\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ |
| **On/Off Current Ratio ($I_{on}/I_{off}$)** | $> 10^7$ ($I_{off} \le 10\,\text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$ @ $1.8\,\text{V}$) | $I_{on}/I_{off} \ge 10^6$ ($I_{off} \le 50\,\text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$) | Dimensionless ratio |
| **Cell Retention Leakage Current** | $< 1.0\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Maximum permissible leakage $\le 1.0\,\text{fA/cell}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0\,\text{fF/cell}$ | Retention capacitance floor $\ge 28.0\,\text{fF/cell}$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Exemplary Post-Stress Speed-Bin Yield Distribution

```text
Post-Stress Speed-Bin Yield Distribution (%)
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░                                    │
Post-Stress Fail┤░░                                    │
                │▒▒                                    │
 Bin 3 (DDR-133)┤▒▒                                    │
 Bin 2 (DDR-166)┤▓▓▓▓                                  │
                │▓▓▓▓                                  │

```

### 5. Context Citations

- **Source: Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**
  - Sub-micron device channel: $W / L = 2.0\,\mu\text{m} / 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ ($180\,\text{nm}$).
  - NMOS nominal threshold voltage: $V_{thn} = +0.55\,\text{V} \pm 50\,\text{mV}$ measured at $V_{DS} = 50\,\text{mV}$ via maximum $g_m$ extrapolation.
  - Device drive targets: $I_{on} \ge 500\,\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ ($V_{GS} = 1.8\,\text{V}$), $I_{off} \le 10\,\text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$ ($V_{GS} = 0\,\text{V}$), $I_{on}/I_{off} > 10^7$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: Minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$.
  - Cell junction and sub-threshold leakage limit: $\le 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**
  - Minimum drawn gate length: $150\,\text{nm}$ (process span $130\,\text{nm}$ to $180\,\text{nm}$); physical placement manufacturing grid: $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-stress degradation yield tracking across High Temperature Operating Life (HTOL / JESD22-A108) and Temperature-Humidity-Bias (THB) must close the correlation loop between pre-stress baseline STDF datalogs and post-stress parametric drifts. A major architecture vulnerability in 180nm DRAM is hot-carrier injection (HCI) in periphery sense amplifier pull-down NMOS and negative-bias temperature instability (NBTI) in PMOS bitline precharge drivers, causing asymmetric signal margin degradation. The speed-binning mapping engine must enforce dynamic re-classification thresholds rather than static boundary checks; otherwise, dies situated near the tCK=5.0ns (DDR-400) border will suffer catastrophic field returns due to undetected post-burn-in jitter and setup/hold timing margin erosion.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In 180nm planar DRAM nodes (operating at VDD=2.5V core / 1.8V periphery), post-stress timing closure shifts dominantly along the tRCD (RAS-to-CAS delay) and tRP (Row Precharge time) axes as wordline boost pumps (VPP generator circuits) and wordline pass-gate transfer transistors experience gate dielectric trap-assisted breakdown. The signoff report must explicitly couple Shmoo margin contours across VDD (1.6V to 2.0V) and ambient temperature (0°C to 85°C) against bit cell retention time (tRET > 64ms) degradation. Any bin mapping signoff that treats functional pass at nominal voltage as qualification signoff without verifying guardbanded tRCD/tRP margins against JEDEC JESD79F limits will incorrectly bin marginal dies into high-frequency DDR-400/DDR-333 categories.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Yield fallout during post-stress qualification directly drives packaging scrap rates and wafer-level commercial viability. If post-HTOL fallout exceeds 3.5% or speed-grade downgrades from DDR-400 (PC3200) to DDR-266 (PC2100) surpass 8.0% of the tested lot, the unit cost model for commercial 180nm MPW tapeout collapses. Furthermore, lack of real-time ATE probe-card interface calibration (pogo-pin contact resistance repeatability CV < 1.0%) creates false-fail binning loops, exhausting test socket allocation and causing delivery schedule bottlenecks with OSAT partners.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: From a project execution and governance standpoint, this work package is the final gate prior to tapeout signoff and commercial product catalog publishing. We cannot permit ambiguous signoff states where re-tested dies are cherry-picked into higher speed bins without complete lineage traceability. The signoff workflow must require tamper-proof digital cryptographic signatures linking raw STDF/ATDF datalogs directly to the generated speed-bin distribution report and failure Pareto chart before releasing the lot for reel packaging.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Hot-Carrier Injection (HCI) and NBTI-induced drive current degradation in periphery sense amplifiers causing tRCD timing inflation beyond 15ns JEDEC DDR-400 limits.
1. Wordline pass-gate oxide trap accumulation leading to elevated bitline junction leakage and sub-threshold retention loss (<64ms at 85°C) post-HTOL stress.
1. Contact resistance instability (Cres > 1.5 Ohm) on ATE load-board pogo pins inducing artificial VDD droop and false speed-bin de-rating.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

Dock DUT socket to ATE test head and verify pin contact resistance across all 66 pins (Cres < 0.8 Ohm). 2. Force VDD=1.80V ± 0.01V and VREF=0.90V. 3. Apply standard March C- and Moving Inversion (MOVI) test algorithmic patterns with JEDEC DDR-400 timing set (tCK=5.0ns, tRCD=15.0ns, tRP=15.0ns, CL=3). 4. Execute 2D Shmoo scan sweeping VDD from 1.60V to 2.00V in 25mV increments and tCK from 7.5ns down to 4.5ns in 50ps steps. 5. Measure standby current IDD2P (power-down standby with CKE low) at VDD=1.90V. 2. Measure active standby current IDD3N (precharge standby current). 3. Write checkerboard pattern into entire memory array. 4. Pause refresh commands for exactly 64.0ms at 85.0°C (Pause Test). 5. Read back pattern and log any bit failures. 6. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe cleanroom coat (surface resistivity 10^6 - 10^9 ohms/sq), Class 100 nitrile examination gloves (powder-free, static dissipative), EN 166 / ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Thermal protective gloves rated to 150°C for handling heated test sockets and thermal chucks, Continuous heel grounders and static-dissipative ESD wrist strap with 1 Mohm current-limiting resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn exposure from heated test sockets: Immediately flush affected skin with cool, clean potable water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply ice directly; cover with sterile non-adherent dressing and seek cleanroom medical triage. IPA splash to eyes: Flush eyes with isotonic saline or eyewash station stream for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmologic evaluation. Electrical shock from ATE high-voltage power supplies: Isolate main 208V/480V breaker, verify no electrical contact, administer CPR if unresponsive, call emergency response immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: ATE testing zone requires certified Class 10,000 (ISO Class 7) airflow with local dedicated downdraft exhaust over solvent cleaning stations (minimum capture velocity 100 LFM / 0.51 m/s). Ambient thermal chuck cooling exhaust must be vented outside the test bay to prevent heat accumulation and maintain room temperature at 21°C ± 2°C.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes and lint-free cleaning swabs contaminated with socket contact residues must be collected in closed, grounded FM-approved self-closing safety flammables waste cans. Solid waste disposed of via certified hazardous chemical incineration stream per local environmental standards. No organic solvents or liquid waste may be discharged into sanitary or fab acid/base neutralization drains.

| **Gaseous Nitrogen (N2) Dry Purge** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 5.0 (99.999% purity, dewpoint <-70°C) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: DUT packages post-burn-in unload must be free of carbonized socket flash, leadframe oxidation, or flux residue. Lead coplanarity within 0.08mm, package body dry and cleaned with zero ionic contamination (>1.5 ug/cm^2 NaCl equivalent triggers wash reject).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tested and speed-binned components inspected for zero probe/socket mechanical damage. Lead integrity verified via automated optical inspection (AOI), dry-pack baked per J-STD-033 (<0.1% moisture content), and vacuum-sealed in moisture barrier bags (MBB) with active desiccant and humidity indicator card.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure queue time causes uncontrolled moisture absorption into plastic mold compound (EMC), leading to catastrophic popcorning during downstream board reflow, while leadframe copper-tin intermetallic oxidation causes contact resistance escalation and false fail speed binning.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Formal signoff of the post-stress degradation yield report and definitive speed-grade bin mapping matrix for the 180nm DRAM Gen 3 qualification lot. The analysis establishes quantitative parameter shift boundaries across HTOL/THB stress intervals, proves JEDEC DDR-400 speed-grade yield sustainability, validates the absence of systematic hot-carrier or dielectric breakdown degradation, and locks the final commercial bin-out map.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_GEN3_POST_STRESS_YIELD_REPORT_REV1.pdf`
- [ ] `DRAM180_QUAL_LOT_STDF_BIN_MAPPING_MATRIX.csv`

| `ASSERT-01` | **Primary speed-grade DDR-400 (tCK=5.0ns, CL=3, tRCD=15ns, tRP=15ns) post-stress yield retention must exceed the minimum qualification threshold.** | `92.5%` | +7.5% / -1.5% | Automated parsing and statistical bin-out tally from ATE STDF datalogs across 1,000 tested qualification units. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum allowable post-HTOL degradation in RAS-to-CAS delay (tRCD) margin across all passing units at VDD=1.80V, Tj=85°C.** | `0.35ns` | ±0.15ns (Upper Spec Limit <= 0.50ns shift) | Direct parametric delta calculation comparing t=0h pre-stress tRCD Shmoo pass boundary against t=1000h post-stress Shmoo pass boundary per DUT. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (GRR) coefficient of variation for ATE speed-binning vector execution across repeated socket insertions.** | `0.65%` | <= 1.00% maximum allowable CV | 10-unit, 3-run repeated contact resistance and Shmoo boundary measurement study per MSA 4th Edition guidelines. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Unambiguous exit signoff requires 100% of the qualification lot units to be classified into valid JEDEC speed bins (DDR-400, DDR-333, DDR-266, or Reject), cumulative post-stress lot fallout <= 4.0%, zero retention failures at 64ms/85°C, complete artifact generation with cryptographic SHA-256 checksums, and unanimous digital signoff approval from Systems Engineering, Reliability Metrology, and Quality Assurance Directors.

# Standard Operating Procedure: 2D VDD-Frequency Shmoo Plotting & Operating Margin Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 2D VDD-Frequency Shmoo test suite must decouple on-chip Power Delivery Network (PDN) dynamic IR-drop and L*di/dt ground bounce from intrinsic 180nm DRAM cell core bitline sensing timing limits. For the 180nm core operating between 1.6V and 2.0V (nominal 1.8V) across clock rates from 100 MHz to 250 MHz, transient switching currents during simultaneous READ/WRITE burst bursts (BL=8) can induce local supply collapse up to 140 mV if package decoupling capacitance (MLCCs on probe-card/loadboard) is insufficient, which artificially distorts the lower-left VDD-FMAX margin wall into a false functional failure.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm planar node, retention time degradation under elevated VDD and temperature intersects with sense amplifier offset voltages. Post-HTOL burn-in stress introduces hot-carrier injection (HCI) and bias temperature instability (NBTI/PBTI) shifts in the cross-coupled pMOS/nMOS sense amp latch transistors, resulting in asymmetric sensing threshold deltas (>35 mV). The shmoo pattern generator must execute marching solid, checkerboard, and hammer stress patterns (Row Hammer/Disturb toggles) across fine VDD steps (<=25 mV) to detect localized charge leakage windows rather than merely verifying coarse digital memory interface PHY timing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: ATE tester socketing interfaces (high-frequency Kelvin contactors) on Advantest V93000 or Teradyne UltraFLEX platforms degrade after repeated insertions during post-HTOL high-volume lots. Mechanical tip wear and pogo pin oxidation directly increase contact resistance (R_contact > 500 mOhm), shifting calibrated VDD at the DUT pin and invalidating JEDEC speed-bin allocations. Direct loadboard socket maintenance protocols, automated contact-check subroutines before shmoo sweeps, and pin-spares availability must be strictly budgeted.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Characterizing multi-dimensional 2D shmoo margins across 4 temperature corners (-40°C, 25°C, 85°C, 105°C) and 3 process splits (SS, TT, FF) threatens total ATE index time per device. Sweeping 1.4V to 2.2V at 25 mV increments across 50 MHz to 300 MHz at 5 MHz steps yields over 1,600 execution nodes per die. We must mandate an adaptive boundary-search binary shmoo algorithm that isolates pass/fail transition boundaries in <85 ms per die rather than running dense raster grids, keeping production cost within target burn-in envelope.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal runaway and junction overheating inside high-density DUT socket during sustained maximum-frequency burst operations at elevated VDD (2.2V), causing localized gate oxide punch-through or latchup.
1. False pass/fail boundary shifts caused by ATE driver channel skew (>120 ps) and loadboard trace impedance mismatches (>5 Ohm delta across DQ/DQS pairs), corrupting JEDEC setup/hold timing margin validation.
1. Post-HTOL threshold voltage drift in DRAM peripheral level shifters and sense amplifiers causing sudden-death cliff margins at minimum operating voltage (VDD_min > 1.72V) under extended refresh cycles (tREFI = 64 ms).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-3-01` | **2D VDD Core vs. Operating Frequency (tCK) Boundary Shmoo & Margin Extraction** | Advantest V93000 High-Speed Memory Test System with Pin Scale 1600 cards, High-bandwidth Kelvin DUT Socket (<=0.1 nH/contact, <=80 mOhm), Keysight N6705C DC Power Analyzer with remote sense lines at DUT bypass caps, ThermoStream Temptronic thermal chamber controller (-50°C to +125°C). | 1. Initialize DUT via standard JEDEC DDR initialization sequence (tINIT = 200 us, PRECHARGE ALL, MRS write for CAS latency = 3, burst length = 8). 2. Configure ATE programmable power supply (VDD) from 1.400 V to 2.200 V in 25 mV increments. 3. At each voltage node, sweep master clock frequency from 100 MHz to 250 MHz in 5 MHz increments. 4. Record functional pass (zero bit errors) or fail (>=1 bit error) per node. 6. critics.systems_engineer: The 2D VDD-Frequency Shmoo test suite must decouple on-chip Power Delivery Network (PDN) dynamic IR-drop and L*di/dt ground bounce from intrinsic 180nm DRAM cell core bitline sensing timing limits. For the 180nm core operating between 1.6V and 2.0V (nominal 1.8V) across clock rates from 100 MHz to 250 MHz, transient switching currents during simultaneous READ/WRITE burst bursts (BL=8) can induce local supply collapse up to 140 mV if package decoupling capacitance (MLCCs on probe-card/loadboard) is insufficient, which artificially distorts the lower-left VDD-FMAX margin wall into a false functional failure.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm planar node, retention time degradation under elevated VDD and temperature intersects with sense amplifier offset voltages. Post-HTOL burn-in stress introduces hot-carrier injection (HCI) and bias temperature instability (NBTI/PBTI) shifts in the cross-coupled pMOS/nMOS sense amp latch transistors, resulting in asymmetric sensing threshold deltas (>35 mV). The shmoo pattern generator must execute marching solid, checkerboard, and hammer stress patterns (Row Hammer/Disturb toggles) across fine VDD steps (<=25 mV) to detect localized charge leakage windows rather than merely verifying coarse digital memory interface PHY timing.
critics.supply_chain: ATE tester socketing interfaces (high-frequency Kelvin contactors) on Advantest V93000 or Teradyne UltraFLEX platforms degrade after repeated insertions during post-HTOL high-volume lots. Mechanical tip wear and pogo pin oxidation directly increase contact resistance (R_contact > 500 mOhm), shifting calibrated VDD at the DUT pin and invalidating JEDEC speed-bin allocations. Direct loadboard socket maintenance protocols, automated contact-check subroutines before shmoo sweeps, and pin-spares availability must be strictly budgeted.
critics.laya_pm: Characterizing multi-dimensional 2D shmoo margins across 4 temperature corners (-40°C, 25°C, 85°C, 105°C) and 3 process splits (SS, TT, FF) threatens total ATE index time per device. Sweeping 1.4V to 2.2V at 25 mV increments across 50 MHz to 300 MHz at 5 MHz steps yields over 1,600 execution nodes per die. We must mandate an adaptive boundary-search binary shmoo algorithm that isolates pass/fail transition boundaries in <85 ms per die rather than running dense raster grids, keeping production cost within target burn-in envelope.
critical_failure_modes: Thermal runaway and junction overheating inside high-density DUT socket during sustained maximum-frequency burst operations at elevated VDD (2.2V), causing localized gate oxide punch-through or latchup.

False pass/fail boundary shifts caused by ATE driver channel skew (>120 ps) and loadboard trace impedance mismatches (>5 Ohm delta across DQ/DQS pairs), corrupting JEDEC setup/hold timing margin validation.

Post-HTOL threshold voltage drift in DRAM peripheral level shifters and sense amplifiers causing sudden-death cliff margins at minimum operating voltage (VDD_min > 1.72V) under extended refresh cycles (tREFI = 64 ms).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: ATE Shmoo Test Pattern Vector Generation & Pin Timing Deskew Calibration

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-3-1-01` | **Thermosonic Ball Wirebond Shear & Wire Pull Mechanical Strength Test** | Dage 4000 / Nordson Microtester Bond Pull & Ball Shear Test System | 1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-ATE-JEDEC-QUALIFICATION-3-3-1-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with uncured epoxy: Wash with copious soap and warm water (do not use solvents like acetone which increase dermal absorption). Eye contact with silica dicing slurry: Flush at eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dicing saw fully enclosed with continuous high-volume DI water mist shroud. Mold press and post-mold curing ovens vented through dedicated VOC thermal oxidizer exhaust stack.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Silicon dicing slurry centrifuged and segregated into solid cake for non-hazardous landfill. Cured thermoset epoxy scrap disposed of as regulated solid waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Epoxy Novolac Resin (Mold Compound)** | `29690-82-2` | Semiconductor Packaging Grade | `Solid pellet / transfer mold compound` |
| **Amorphous Silica Filler** | `14808-60-7` | Sub-micron spherical particle | `75-88 wt% in epoxy mold compound` |
| **Silver-Filled Conductive Die Attach Adhesive** | `7440-22-4` | Electronic Grade Silver Flake | `70-80 wt% Ag in epoxy base` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Saw-diced wafer mounted on UV dicing tape, clean and dry with zero particulate or water residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Epoxy die-attached, cured, and thermosonically wirebonded to leadframe/substrate pads prior to molding.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation of exposed aluminum/copper bond pads degrades thermosonic ball bond adhesion, inducing high electrical contact resistance or catastrophic non-stick bond pad lifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of ATE Shmoo Test Pattern Vector Generation & Pin Timing Deskew Calibration: BEOL metallization, electrical die sort (EDS), wafer backgrinding/dicing, and wirebond plastic encapsulation successfully yield JEDEC-qualified DRAM packaged units.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Electrical_Die_Sort_Wafer_Yield_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Wirebond_Ball_Shear_And_Pull_CPK_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `JEDEC_TSOP54_Final_ATE_SpeedBin_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wirebond ball shear strength** | `>= 18.0 gf` | Minimum failure load >= 15.0 gf across 30 samples | Dage 4000 micro-tester lateral ball shear per MIL-STD-883 |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) wafer array functional yield** | `>= 90.0%` | Minimum yield >= 85.0% on prime wafers | Automated wafer probe array test with March C- diagnostic patterns |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Packaged DRAM package coplanarity & lead pitch** | `<= 0.08 mm coplanarity` | JEDEC TSOP-54 mechanical envelope tolerance (+/- 0.05 mm) | Optical 3D coordinate measuring machine (CMM) metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% passing electrical continuity and JEDEC parametric DC checks; destructive wirebond shear CPK >= 1.67 with zero package voiding or delamination detected under scanning acoustic microscopy (C-SAM).
