```text
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░     │
Die Attach T (°C)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░     │
                 │▒▒                                   │
Void Area Max (%)┤▒▒                                   │
 Pull Margin (gf)┤▓▓                                   │
                 │▓▓                                   │
   Cure Temp (°C)┤█████████████████████████████████████│
                 │█████████████████████████████████████│
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0     43.8     87.5     131.2  175.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **In-Mold Polymerization Temperature** | $175.0 \pm 2.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point embedded Type R/S thermocouple & PID log |
| **Post-Encapsulation Wire Pull Retention** | $\ge 4.0$ (span failure, zero interface bond separation) | grams-force ($\text{gf}$) | Destructive wire pull tester (Mil-Std-883 Method 2011) |
| **Internal Void Area under Die / Encapsulant** | $< 5.0$ | $\%$ | Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (C-SAM) |
| **Die Attach Thermal Resistance ($R_{th}$)** | $\le 5.0$ | $^\circ\text{C/W}$ | Transient Dual Interface Thermal Tester |

---

### Citations & Context Traceability

- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**:
  - Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 pull strength specification: $\ge 4.0\text{ gf}$ for $25\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ wire; bond failure prohibited at the $100\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ pad interface.
  - Die attach integrity criteria: Silver-filled conductive epoxy cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 min with void area under die $< 5\%$ via acoustic microscopy and thermal resistance $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$.
- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  - Mechanical transfer and de-molding ramp control principles ($< 50\text{ mm/minute}$) to prevent mechanical shock and physical deformation.
  - Closed-loop PID temperature stabilization with high-precision thermocouples (Type R/S).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The transfer ram hydraulic pressure profile must be dynamically decoupled into velocity-controlled fill and pressure-controlled pack phases. An uncalibrated transition between ram displacement velocity (1.5-3.0 mm/s) and final packing pressure (6.0-10.0 MPa) introduces hydraulic pressure spikes that transmit shear forces through the molten epoxy molding compound (EMC), exceeding the 4.0 gf yield limit of 25 um gold thermosonic wire bonds and triggering fatal wire sweep or paddle tilt on the TSOP-54 lead frame.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: EMC rheology operates within a narrow chemorheological processing window where mold temperature (175°C ± 2°C) rapidly accelerates cross-linking polymerization. If the transfer time exceeds the gelation threshold (typically 12-18 seconds at 175°C), the viscosity climbs exponentially (>50 Pa·s), inducing incomplete runner packing, micro-void entrapment between high-aspect-ratio bond wires, and incomplete conversion (<80% in-mold conversion) leading to internal thermal stress cracking during subsequent thermal cycles.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Epoxy molding compound pellets (cresol novolac / biphenyl resin with fused spherical silica filler >80 wt%) require strict cold-chain logistics at -20°C with dry ice monitoring. Deviations during transit or improper ambient thawing without desiccant condensation control will alter the spiral flow length and accelerate premature B-stage advancement, resulting in variable batch viscosity and lot-wide yield rejection.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tooling cavity wear, parting-line burrs, and vacuum seal integrity across multi-cavity chases directly govern cycle takt time. Any unscheduled mold cleaning, release agent baking, or plunger jamming stops the downstream Post-Mold Cure (PMC) batch oven scheduling, causing an immediate line bottleneck on the 180nm DRAM packaging line.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Wire sweep exceeding 3% lateral displacement, resulting in electrical shorts between adjacent 25 um gold bond wires across 100 um x 100 um aluminum pad fanouts.
1. Internal acoustic voiding (>5% die-paddle or die-surface interface area) causing interfacial moisture entrapment and popcorning delamination during solder reflow.
1. Incomplete in-mold polymerization (<80% glass transition conversion state) inducing warpage, TSOP-54 lead frame distortion, and mechanical package cracking upon ejector pin actuation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-2-2-01` | **In-Mold Rheological Pressure-Time Profile and Wire Sweep Dynamic Verification** | Multi-cavity transfer mold integrated with dynamic piezoelectric pressure sensors, hydraulic ram LVDT transducer, and high-resolution micro-focus 2D/3D X-ray inspection system (GE Phoenix Microme|x). | 1. Load pre-conditioned EMC pellet (biphenyl resin, fused silica 85 wt%) into the transfer pot. 2. Engage hydraulic ram injection with programmed two-stage profile: fill velocity 2.2 mm/s for 11.5 seconds, transitioning to hydraulic pack pressure 8.5 MPa for 90 seconds. 3. Record cavity pressure sensor curves to identify peak fill pressure and transition timing. 4. Complete in-mold cure cycle for 120 seconds total clamp time at 175°C. 5. Actuate ejector pins and transfer lead frame strip to cooling fixture. 6. Inspect encapsulated units under 3D X-ray to quantify wire sweep percentage = (Max Lateral Deflection / Wire Length) * 100. | `Peak cavity pressure must remain within 8.5 ± 0.8 MPa without hydraulic pressure overshoot > 1.2x nominal. Wire sweep must be <= 2.5% for all 54 bonded wire interconnects. Zero wire-to-wire electrical shorts.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-2-2-02` | **Encapsulation Internal Voiding and Acoustic Interface Delamination Analysis** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM, Sonix or PVA TePla) with 100 MHz transducer, deionized water immersion tank, and Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC, TA Instruments Q2000). | 1. Position molded strips in C-SAM tank with 100 MHz transducer focused at the die top active surface and paddle interface. 2. Perform C-mode acoustic pulse-echo scan across 100% of encapsulated DRAM units (30 units/strip). 3. Image analysis software gates reflected echo amplitude to calculate void area percentage over the silicon die surface and die-attach paddle. 4. Extract a 10 mg sample of molded compound runner flash and execute DSC scan at 10°C/min ramp from 25°C to 250°C to quantify residual curing exotherm and in-mold degree of conversion (Alpha = 1 - Delta_H_residual / Delta_H_total). | `Total interfacial voiding area across active die surface must be < 1.0% total area; individual interfacial void diameter < 150 um. In-mold cross-linking degree of conversion prior to PMC must be >= 82.0%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal heat-resistant Kevlar gloves (rated to 250°C) for hot mold chase handling, Full face shield with ANSI Z87.1 safety spectacles underneath, Half-face elastomeric respirator equipped with organic vapor and HEPA particulate cartridges (NIOSH OV/P100), High-dexterity disposable nitrile gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness) for pellet handling and de-gating, Anti-static, flame-retardant lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal Burns: Immediately irrigate thermal burn areas with sterile cold water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply salves or peel adhered polymer from skin; cover with sterile dry dressing and seek urgent medical treatment. Inhalation of Mold Outgas Fumes: Remove victim to fresh air immediately; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; seek medical evaluation for toxic respiratory irritation. Skin/Eye Contact with Raw Pellet Dust: Flush eyes with isotonic saline or copious eyewash water for 15 minutes; wash skin with mild surfactant and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated local exhaust ventilation (LEV) hoods directly positioned above mold platens and transfer pots maintaining minimum capture velocity of 0.75 m/s (150 fpm) at face, ducted to VOC catalytic thermal oxidizer and HEPA filtration unit to capture phenol, cresol, and organic particulate outgassing during press decompression.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Fully cured runner scrap, pot flash, and cull resin are classified as non-hazardous inert solid industrial waste and collected in labeled fireproof containers for thermal recycling or controlled incineration. Uncured or partially cured B-stage pellets/powder must be sealed in drum containers with desiccant and incinerated by licensed hazardous waste handling facilities in accordance with local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Fused Amorphous Silica (Filler)** | `60676-86-0` | Semiconductor Packaging Grade (>99.5% SiO2) | `75.0 - 88.0 wt%` |
| **o-Cresol Novolac Epoxy Resin** | `29690-82-2` | Electronic Grade (Hydrolyzable Cl < 200 ppm) | `5.0 - 15.0 wt%` |
| **Phenol-Formaldehyde Novolac Hardener** | `9003-35-4` | Electronic Grade | `3.0 - 8.0 wt%` |
| **Triphenylphosphine (Catalyst / Accelerator)** | `603-35-0` | Reagent Grade (>99%) | `0.1 - 0.5 wt%` |
| **Carbon Black (Colorant)** | `1333-86-4` | Pigment Industrial Grade | `0.1 - 0.4 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Die-attached and wire-bonded TSOP-54 lead frame strips cleaned via Ar/O2 RF plasma (5 minutes, 150 W) with contact angle < 15° on silicon passivation and Cu/alloy lead frames, stored in vacuum-sealed moisture-barrier bags.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: In-mold polymerized packages with >80% cross-linking density, free of flashing on external lead contact pins, ready for immediate transfer to multi-rack convection Post-Mold Cure (PMC) batch oven.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time prior to encapsulation exposes bare aluminum bond pads and copper lead frame fingers to atmospheric moisture and airborne organic siloxanes, causing interfacial delamination between EMC and die surface. Exceeding queue time between transfer molding and PMC leads to residual thermal stress freezing, chemical shrinkage non-uniformity, and catastrophic package warpage exceeding JEDEC TSOP coplanarity limits (0.10 mm).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful execution of the transfer ram injection and in-mold polymerization cycle produces fully encapsulated, void-free TSOP-54 DRAM packages with compliant wire sweep (<2.5%), no external lead flashing, and >=82% in-mold degree of cross-linking conversion, meeting JEDEC JESD22 and Mil-Std-883 standards.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TRANSFER_RAM_DYNAMIC_PRESSURE_LOG.csv`
- [ ] `TSOP54_WIRE_SWEEP_XRAY_METROLOGY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `CSAM_INTERFACE_VOID_SCAN_MAPS.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-PLASTIC-ENCAP-01` | **Maximum wire sweep deflection ratio across all 25 um gold thermosonic wire bonds** | `1.8%` | <= 2.5% | 3D High-Resolution Microfocus X-ray Computed Metrology (GE Phoenix Microme|x) |
| `ASSERT-PLASTIC-ENCAP-02` | **Interfacial acoustic void area percentage across active silicon DRAM die surface** | `0.3%` | <= 1.0% | Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (C-SAM) 100 MHz Pulse-Echo C-Scan per JEDEC J-STD-020 |
| `ASSERT-PLASTIC-ENCAP-03` | **In-mold polymer degree of conversion (cure state) before Post-Mold Cure transfer** | `85.0%` | >= 82.0% | Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) residual exotherm integral analysis from 25°C to 250°C |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of tested TSOP-54 units within the lot pass 3D X-ray wire sweep <= 2.5%, acoustic interfacial voiding <= 1.0% with zero continuous delamination across die-to-paddle boundaries, DSC confirms >= 82.0% in-mold conversion, and transfer pressure sensor curves show zero hydraulic pack overshoots exceeding 9.3 MPa.

Any unscheduled mold cleaning, release agent baking, or plunger jamming stops the downstream Post-Mold Cure (PMC) batch oven scheduling, causing an immediate line bottleneck on the 180nm DRAM packaging line.
critical_failure_modes: Wire sweep exceeding 3% lateral displacement, resulting in electrical shorts between adjacent 25 um gold bond wires across 100 um x 100 um aluminum pad fanouts.
Internal acoustic voiding (>5% die-paddle or die-surface interface area) causing interfacial moisture entrapment and popcorning delamination during solder reflow.
Incomplete in-mold polymerization (<80% glass transition conversion state) inducing warpage, TSOP-54 lead frame distortion, and mechanical package cracking upon ejector pin actuation.

testcases.title: In-Mold Rheological Pressure-Time Profile and Wire Sweep Dynamic Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Multi-cavity transfer mold integrated with dynamic piezoelectric pressure sensors, hydraulic ram LVDT transducer, and high-resolution micro-focus 2D/3D X-ray inspection system (GE Phoenix Microme|x).
testcases.pre_conditions: TSOP-54 lead frames post thermosonic gold wire bonding (Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 pull strength >= 4.0 gf) pre-baked at 125°C for 30 minutes; mold chase pre-heated and stabilized at 175°C ± 1.5°C; vacuum assist operational at cavity pressure < 10 mbar.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load pre-conditioned EMC pellet (biphenyl resin, fused silica 85 wt%) into the transfer pot.
2. Engage hydraulic ram injection with programmed two-stage profile: fill velocity 2.2 mm/s for 11.5 seconds, transitioning to hydraulic pack pressure 8.5 MPa for 90 seconds.
3. Record cavity pressure sensor curves to identify peak fill pressure and transition timing.
4. Complete in-mold cure cycle for 120 seconds total clamp time at 175°C.
5. Actuate ejector pins and transfer lead frame strip to cooling fixture.
6. Inspect encapsulated units under 3D X-ray to quantify wire sweep percentage = (Max Lateral Deflection / Wire Length) * 100.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Peak cavity pressure must remain within 8.5 ± 0.8 MPa without hydraulic pressure overshoot > 1.2x nominal. Wire sweep must be <= 2.5% for all 54 bonded wire interconnects. Zero wire-to-wire electrical shorts.

testcases.title: Encapsulation Internal Voiding and Acoustic Interface Delamination Analysis
testcases.instrumentation: Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM, Sonix or PVA TePla) with 100 MHz transducer, deionized water immersion tank, and Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC, TA Instruments Q2000).
testcases.pre_conditions: Molded TSOP-54 package strips de-gated and stabilized at room temperature (25°C, 45% RH) following in-mold cure and prior to batch Post-Mold Cure (PMC).
testcases.procedure:
1. Position molded strips in C-SAM tank with 100 MHz transducer focused at the die top active surface and paddle interface.
2. Perform C-mode acoustic pulse-echo scan across 100% of encapsulated DRAM units (30 units/strip).
3. Image analysis software gates reflected echo amplitude to calculate void area percentage over the silicon die surface and die-attach paddle.
4. Extract a 10 mg sample of molded compound runner flash and execute DSC scan at 10°C/min ramp from 25°C to 250°C to quantify residual curing exotherm and in-mold degree of conversion (Alpha = 1 - Delta_H_residual / Delta_H_total).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total interfacial voiding area across active die surface must be < 1.0% total area; individual interfacial void diameter < 150 um. In-mold cross-linking degree of conversion prior to PMC must be >= 82.0%.

ppe_required: Thermal heat-resistant Kevlar gloves (rated to 250°C) for hot mold chase handling
Full face shield with ANSI Z87.1 safety spectacles underneath
Half-face elastomeric respirator equipped with organic vapor and HEPA particulate cartridges (NIOSH OV/P100)
High-dexterity disposable nitrile gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness) for pellet handling and de-gating
Anti-static, flame-retardant lab coat
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Thermal Burns: Immediately irrigate thermal burn areas with sterile cold water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply salves or peel adhered polymer from skin; cover with sterile dry dressing and seek urgent medical treatment. Inhalation of Mold Outgas Fumes: Remove victim to fresh air immediately; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; seek medical evaluation for toxic respiratory irritation. Skin/Eye Contact with Raw Pellet Dust: Flush eyes with isotonic saline or copious eyewash water for 15 minutes; wash skin with mild surfactant and water.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Dedicated local exhaust ventilation (LEV) hoods directly positioned above mold platens and transfer pots maintaining minimum capture velocity of 0.75 m/s (150 fpm) at face, ducted to VOC catalytic thermal oxidizer and HEPA filtration unit to capture phenol, cresol, and organic particulate outgassing during press decompression.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Fully cured runner scrap, pot flash, and cull resin are classified as non-hazardous inert solid industrial waste and collected in labeled fireproof containers for thermal recycling or controlled incineration. Uncured or partially cured B-stage pellets/powder must be sealed in drum containers with desiccant and incinerated by licensed hazardous waste handling facilities in accordance with local environmental regulations.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Die-attached and wire-bonded TSOP-54 lead frame strips cleaned via Ar/O2 RF plasma (5 minutes, 150 W) with contact angle < 15° on silicon passivation and Cu/alloy lead frames, stored in vacuum-sealed moisture-barrier bags.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: In-mold polymerized packages with >80% cross-linking density, free of flashing on external lead contact pins, ready for immediate transfer to multi-rack convection Post-Mold Cure (PMC) batch oven.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding air queue time prior to encapsulation exposes bare aluminum bond pads and copper lead frame fingers to atmospheric moisture and airborne organic siloxanes, causing interfacial delamination between EMC and die surface. Exceeding queue time between transfer molding and PMC leads to residual thermal stress freezing, chemical shrinkage non-uniformity, and catastrophic package warpage exceeding JEDEC TSOP coplanarity limits (0.10 mm).

expected_result.summary: Successful execution of the transfer ram injection and in-mold polymerization cycle produces fully encapsulated, void-free TSOP-54 DRAM packages with compliant wire sweep (<2.5%), no external lead flashing, and >=82% in-mold degree of cross-linking conversion, meeting JEDEC JESD22 and Mil-Std-883 standards.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum wire sweep deflection ratio across all 25 um gold thermosonic wire bonds
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 3D High-Resolution Microfocus X-ray Computed Metrology (GE Phoenix Microme|x)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Interfacial acoustic void area percentage across active silicon DRAM die surface
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (C-SAM) 100 MHz Pulse-Echo C-Scan per JEDEC J-STD-020

quantitative_assertions.assertion: In-mold polymer degree of conversion (cure state) before Post-Mold Cure transfer
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) residual exotherm integral analysis from 25°C to 250°C

expected_result.signoff_criteria: 100% of tested TSOP-54 units within the lot pass 3D X-ray wire sweep <= 2.5%, acoustic interfacial voiding <= 1.0% with zero continuous delamination across die-to-paddle boundaries, DSC confirms >= 82.0% in-mold conversion, and transfer pressure sensor curves show zero hydraulic pack overshoots exceeding 9.3 MPa.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## In-Line Package Flash, Internal Voiding & Wire Sweep Acoustic Inspection

**Document ID:** `SOP-PKG-MET-180-042`  
**Process Step:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > BEOL Multi-Layer Metallization, Wafer Sort & Packaging > Transfer Molding Epoxy Plastic Encapsulation (TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA Package) > High-Pressure Transfer Molding & Post-Mold Cure (PMC) Execution > High-Pressure Transfer Molding Injection & In-Mold Polymerization > In-Line Package Flash, Internal Voiding & Wire Sweep Acoustic Inspection  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology & Quality Verification  

---

### Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Molded Strip Arrival  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Visual Inspection:   │
│     Package Flash      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Scanning Acoustic    │
│    Microscopy: CSAM    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Void & Delamination   │
│        Analysis        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wire Sweep Acoustic   │
│  & X-Ray Verification  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Acceptance / Rework   │
│      / Scrapping       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Incoming Strip Reception & De-panel Prep**:
   - Receive the cured TSOP-54 lead frame strips or 54-ball FBGA substrate strips immediately following the High-Pressure Transfer Molding and Post-Mold Cure (PMC) cycle (Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 min).
   - Ensure strips are handled using ESD-safe tweezers and vacuum wands to prevent pad or lead deformation.

2. **Optical Flash Metrology**:
   - Place lead frame strips under an automated optical inspection (AOI) / high-magnification optical comparator.
   - Inspect the lead fingers and tie bars for resin bleeding and resin flash along parting lines.
   - Verify that package flash protrusion along lead edges does not exceed $50\,\mu\text{m}$ into the lead bend/trim zone, preventing clearance loss during trimming and forming.

3. **Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (C-SAM) Calibration & Setup**:
   - Mount strip carrier in the immersion tank using deionized (DI) water as the acoustic coupling medium ($25^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Set the high-frequency transducer to 100 MHz – 140 MHz (confocal acoustic lens focused on die surface and die-attach interface).
   - Perform time-of-flight gating for two distinct depth intervals:
     - **Gate 1 (Die Surface / Mold Interface):** Gated to the top mold-to-silicon boundary and wire bond loop plane (monitoring 25 $\mu\text{m}$ gold or Al-1% Si bond pads).
     - **Gate 2 (Die Attach Interface):** Gated between the backside of the DRAM die and the lead frame paddle / FBGA substrate.

4. **Internal Void & Delamination Scanning**:
   - Execute raster acoustic scan across all 54 package units on the strip.
   - Measure acoustic impedance shifts reflecting total void area and interfacial delamination.
   - Validate that die-attach void area under the chip remains strictly below 5% of the total die area.

5. **Wire Sweep Acoustic & X-Ray Confirmation**:
   - Inspect the thermosonic 25 $\mu\text{m}$ Au / ultrasonic 25 $\mu\text{m}$ Al-1% Si wire spans connecting the $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum pads to package leads.
   - Measure lateral wire deformation (sweep) caused by molding compound injection flow.
   - Reject any unit exhibiting lateral wire sweep greater than 5% of the total wire span length or wire clearance spacing $< 50\,\mu\text{m}$.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Measurement Method | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Die-Attach Void Area** | $< 5.0\%$ | Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (C-SAM Gate 2) | $\%$ area |
| **Thermal Resistance ($R_{\text{th}}$)** | $\le 5.0$ | Transient Thermal Metrology (Post-cured Ablebond 84-1LMIS) | $^\circ\text{C/W}$ |
| **Wire Sweep Lateral Deviation** | $\le 5.0\%$ (Max span deflection) | C-SAM / In-line Micro-Focus X-Ray Inspection | $\%$ of wire span |
| **Bond Wire Pull Strength** | $\ge 4.0$ (Failure in wire span, not at bond interface) | Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 Micro-Pull Tester | $\text{grams-force (gf)}$ |

---

### 3. Context & Literature Citations

- **Wire Bond Geometry & Mechanical Integrity:**
  - *Context Source:* `Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging`
  - *Parameters Applied:* $25\,\mu\text{m}$ diameter Au / Al-1% Si wire bonded to $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum pads; Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 wire pull test threshold of $\ge 4.0\text{ grams-force}$ requiring wire-span failure; die-attach void limit $< 5\%$ via acoustic microscopy and thermal resistance $R_{\text{th}} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$.
- **Interconnect Metallization Compatibility:**
  - *Context Source:* `Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects`
  - *Parameters Applied:* Metal-1 aluminum interconnects with thickness target $350\,\text{nm} \pm 5\%$ and $R_s < 0.08\,\Omega/\text{sq}$ providing reliable metallurgical ball/wedge landing.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In-line scanning acoustic microscopy (C-SAM) and optical flash inspection must be tightly synchronized with post-transfer-molding conveyor speeds to prevent lot queuing before post-mold cure (PMC). High-frequency ultrasound transducers (100 MHz to 230 MHz) required for detecting sub-20 um internal delamination at the leadframe/die-attach paddle interface impose significant cycle time limits (typically >45 s per strip), necessitating optimized multi-transducer arrays or statistically rigorous sampling protocols to match molding press takt time.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Epoxy molding compound (EMC) resin bleed and parting line flash exceeding 50 um along TSOP-54 lead shoulders will cause severe lead-trimming burrs, lead bend deformations, and plating bridging. Acoustically, wire sweep inspection via X-ray or high-frequency acoustic reflection must strictly distinguish true viscous melt flow-induced lateral wire displacement (>5% of wire span) from die tilt or leadframe pitch offsets to prevent false rejects of JEDEC standard 180nm DRAM packages.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Coupling water used in acoustic immersion inspection systems requires strict deionization (<0.05 uS/cm conductivity) and degassing (<0.5 ppm dissolved O2) consumables to prevent micro-bubble acoustic shadowing and oxidation of exposed copper leadframe surfaces. Single-source immersion transducers (Sonix, PVA TePla, Sonoscan) create potential tooling lead-time bottlenecks during ramp-up of the Gen 3 180nm DRAM packaging lines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Inspection throughput must not violate the critical Q-time window between mold press ejection and PMC oven loading (maximum 120 minutes in ambient air); excessive acoustic scanning durations directly jeopardize cross-link polymer network integrity and moisture absorption rates, creating schedule slippage across downstream trim-and-form operations.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Viscous drag induced gold wire sweep exceeding 5.0% wire span, resulting in adjacent wire electrical bridging (I/O to GND/VDD short circuits) on 180nm DRAM pad pitches
1. Epoxy molding compound parting-line flash bridging external lead clearances (>75 um), causing trim-tool punch wear, die-edge cracking, and solder-lead shorts
1. Internal acoustic voiding or interfacial delamination >15% area at die paddle or active silicon face, causing popcorn cracking during reflow soldering

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-2-3-01` | **C-SAM Acoustic Immersion Internal Voiding and Interfacial Delamination Scan** | Sonix / PVA TePla Scanning Acoustic Microscope with 100 MHz focused transducer, degassed deionized water bath (dissolved O2 < 0.5 ppm), motorized X-Y stage with 0.5 um resolution | 1. Position molded strip in DI water immersion fixture. 2. Align acoustic focus gate at the die surface to EMC interface (reflection polarity gate). 3. Perform raster C-mode scan across all 54 package units at 50 um step pitch. 4. Record acoustic reflection phase inversion amplitudes (indicating air-void/delamination). 5. Compute total void area percentage per package die surface and leadframe paddle using automated image thresholding. | `Total interfacial delamination area at active die surface < 5.0% of die area; single void diameter < 50 um; zero delamination bridging adjacent bonding pads; total die paddle delamination < 15.0%.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-2-3-02` | **Leadframe Resin Bleed / Flash and Wire Sweep Radiographic/Optical Metrology** | Automated High-Resolution Optical Inspection (AOI) System (telecentric lens, 2.5 um/pixel resolution) coupled with In-Line Micro-Focus X-Ray Inspection System (130 kV, 3 um focal spot size) | 1. Feed strip into optical AOI nest under top/bottom darkfield LED illumination. 2. Measure resin flash length extending past package body along the damper/tie bar and lead surfaces. 3. Transfer strip to in-line micro-focus X-ray station. 4. Acquire top-down projection images of bond wires along all four pin quadrants. 5. Measure maximum lateral deflection (d) of 25 um Au wire relative to straight line path across wire span (L). 6. Calculate wire sweep percentage: (d / L) * 100%. | `Package mold flash along leads <= 50.0 um from package body edge; flash thickness <= 25.0 um; maximum wire sweep <= 3.0% of wire span (reject if wire sweep > 4.5% or clearance between adjacent wires < 35 um).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (class 100, 6 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown and ESD safety footwear, Chemical splash apron and face shield during acoustic tank cleaning and biocide handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA or biocide solution: flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. Eye contact: irrigate with isotonic eyewash solution for 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmologist evaluation. Inhalation of organic vapors: remove personnel to fresh laminar airflow area immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Acoustic tank and drying station equipped with local exhaust ventilation (LEV) maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); X-ray inspection unit shielded to lead equivalent achieving < 0.5 uSv/hr external radiation leakage with active interlock ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent acoustic coupling tank water containing microbicide drained to dedicated industrial wastewater neutralization system; IPA cleaning wipes disposed into hermetic UN-rated hazardous solvent waste bins for authorized chemical incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (degassed immersion medium)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom DI Water (<0.05 uS/cm) | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - lens and carrier degreaser)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.8%` |
| **2-Methyl-4-isothiazolin-3-one (Microbicide tank stabilizer)** | `2682-20-4` | Analytical Grade | `0.05%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly demolded TSOP-54 leadframe strips hot-ejected from transfer mold die (175 deg C), partially polymerized green state (curing degree 75-85%), hydrophobic epoxy finish.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Moisture-free (post-N2 air knife dried), ambient temperature (20-25 deg C), acoustic scan verified, ready for Post-Mold Cure (PMC) batch oven loading.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces ambient moisture absorption into partially cured epoxy molding compound matrix, resulting in latent steam-induced internal delamination and explosive package cracking ('popcorning') during Post-Mold Cure at 175 deg C.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete non-destructive acoustic, optical, and radiographic inspection of transfer-molded TSOP-54 DRAM leadframes, quantifying internal voiding, interfacial delamination, parting-line flash dimensions, and Au wire sweep percentages prior to post-mold cure.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TSOP54_GEN3_CSAM_DELAMINATION_MAP.tiff`
- [ ] `TSOP54_MOLD_FLASH_OPTICAL_METROLOGY.csv`
- [ ] `TSOP54_WIRE_SWEEP_XRAY_ANALYSIS_REPORT.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Package leadframe resin flash length along leads** | `35.0` | +15.0 um / -35.0 um (maximum <= 50.0 um) | Automated telecentric optical darkfield AOI image edge extraction |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum Au bond wire sweep displacement percentage** | `1.8` | +1.2% / -1.8% (maximum <= 3.0% of span) | In-line micro-focus X-ray automated vector trace measurement |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Active silicon surface interfacial acoustic delamination area** | `0.0` | +5.0% / -0.0% total area | 100 MHz C-SAM inverted reflection amplitude surface area integration |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% inspection of designated sample strips with zero packages exhibiting >50 um flash or >3.0% wire sweep, total die face delamination <5.0%, and full N2 dry-off completed within the 60-minute air Q-time limit before PMC batch entry.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Post-Mold Cure (PMC) Batch Oven Run & Acoustic Microscopy (CSAM) Void Metrology

**Category**: Packaging | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-Mold Cure (PMC) kinetics directly govern the crosslinking density and residual thermomechanical stress within the TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA epoxy mold compound (EMC). Incomplete or non-uniform polymerization across the batch oven hot-zone introduces differential shrinkage gradients between the fused silica-filled epoxy matrix and the 180nm silicon die, inducing package warpage, die-tilt, and micro-cracking at high-stress corners. Integrating inline C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (CSAM) as the downstream gatekeeper is essential to catch sub-surface acoustic impedance mismatches before singulation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For biphenyl or multi-functional epoxy novolac resins filled with 85-88 wt% fused silica, the PMC profile must be strictly ramped to avoid thermal shock and excessive exotherm. A sustained bake at 175°C ± 5°C for 4 to 6 hours achieves a glass transition temperature (Tg) >= 160°C and minimizes coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE1/CTE2) divergence. For CSAM metrology, high-frequency immersion transducers (100 MHz to 230 MHz, focal length ~0.5 inch) are mandatory to resolve internal delaminations down to 10-20 um at the leadframe/paddle, die-attach, and EMC-to-die active face interfaces without acoustic shadow artifacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Deionized water degasification units and transducer replacement heads for CSAM acoustic systems face extended procurement cycles (14-20 weeks). Furthermore, cleanroom-grade batch convection curing ovens must feature calibrated multi-point N2 purge manifolds and high-temp HEPA filters; sourcing stainless-steel slotted curing magazines compatible with both TSOP-54 leadframe strips and fine-pitch FBGA substrate strips requires dual-tooling qualification to avoid strip deformation during 175°C soak cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: PMC represents a major cycle time bottleneck (6-8 hours total oven cycle including ramp-down). Scheduling must enforce strict batching rules to prevent queue-time violations between transfer molding ejection and PMC initiation. CSAM sampling plans must balance statistical coverage (AQL 0.4% Level II inspection) against production velocity, ensuring that non-destructive testing does not create an unmanageable back-pressure before strip marking and trim-and-form operations.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete resin crosslinking resulting in low Tg (<150°C), unreacted volatile outgassing during reflow, and popcorn cracking delamination under MSL3 moisture preconditioning.
1. Internal acoustic voiding or interfacial delamination exceeding 10% die surface area or along critical wire-bond stitch zones due to trapped micro-voids expanding during uncontrolled PMC thermal ramp.
1. Immersion DI water residue or ionic contamination ingress into micro-fissures during CSAM scanning, initiating leadframe corrosion or dendritic leakage across DRAM I/O pads.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-3-01` | **PMC Glass Transition Temperature (Tg) and Crosslinking Verification via DSC/TMA** | Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC) / Thermomechanical Analyzer (TMA) calibrated per ASTM E1545 and ASTM D3418 | 1. Mount specimen into TMA quartz expansion cell under 0.05 N static load; 2. Equilibrate at 30°C under 50 mL/min N2 purge; 3. Ramp temperature from 30°C to 260°C at a controlled rate of 5°C/min; 4. Record dimensional expansion curve (dL/dT) to determine alpha-1, alpha-2, and Tg inflection; 5. Conduct DSC run from 30°C to 300°C at 10°C/min to check residual curing exotherm (delta-H). | `Glass transition temperature Tg >= 160.0°C; residual curing exotherm delta-H <= 1.5 J/g (indicating >= 98.5% crosslinking conversion); alpha-1 CTE <= 12.0 ppm/°C.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-3-02` | **High-Frequency CSAM Interfacial Delamination and Void Metrology** | C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Microscope (CSAM) with 100 MHz / 230 MHz broadband focused transducer, degassed deionized water acoustic coupling tank, and calibrated phase-inversion gating | 1. Perform A-scan time-of-flight gating targeting the EMC-to-die surface interface and die-attach paddle interface; 2. Calibrate RF signal phase: verify positive reflection (same phase) for intact bonding and negative phase inversion (180° shift) for air/delamination gap; 3. Execute raster C-scan over 100% of packaged units in sample strip with a step resolution of 10 um; 4. Process automated void area extraction algorithm per JEDEC J-STD-020E / IPC/JEDEC J-STD-035. | `Zero delamination/voiding (0.0% area) over the active circuit area and wire-bond pads; die-attach voiding <= 5.0% total area with single contiguous void <= 1.0%; zero edge delamination bridging into wire-bond interconnect perimeter.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal heat-resistant gloves (rated for 250°C continuous contact) for oven loading/unloading, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (8 mil minimum) for handling CSAM bath and chemical residues, ANSI Z87.1 certified safety splash goggles with side shields, Static-dissipative cleanroom lab coat / ESD smock, Half-face elastomeric respirator fitted with organic vapor/particulate P100 cartridges during oven chamber opening and maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal Burns: Immediately immerse affected skin in cool running water for at least 15-20 minutes; do not apply salves or ice; seek emergency medical treatment. Inhalation of Oven Outgas Vapors: Remove exposed personnel to fresh air immediately; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; seek clinical evaluation. Eye Contact with Contaminated Acoustic Bath Fluid: Flush eyes with sterile eyewash solution for 15 minutes holding eyelids open.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Batch curing oven exhaust must be directly ducted into the facility dedicated VOC/solvent scrubbed exhaust system operating at >= 150 CFM continuous negative pressure; CSAM wet scanning station requires localized downdraft canopy ventilation (face velocity >= 100 FPM) to capture IPA drying vapors and aerosolized DI mist.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: CSAM immersion tank wastewater must pass through an automated drain diversion valve: clean degassed DI water is directed to the industrial wastewater neutralization/recycle loop; contaminated rinse or IPA wiping residues must be collected in closed, labeled hazardous waste containers for certified off-site incineration per RCRA regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (CSAM Acoustic Immersion Fluid)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (ASTM D5127 Type E-1, >18 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |
| **Fused Silica / Silicon Dioxide (EMC filler outgassing particulates)** | `60676-86-0` | Technical Grade | `85-88% in solid EMC matrix` |
| **Phenol-Formaldehyde Novolac Resin (Thermal degradation/outgas fraction)** | `9003-35-4` | Polymer Pre-cure Residue | `< 0.5% vapor phase trace` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - Fixture drying and transducer maintenance)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Grade C) | `>= 99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Solidified green-state epoxy mold compound post-ejection from transfer molding chase at 175°C, with mold gate vestige trimmed and leadframe strips free of oil, particulate dust, and organic grease.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully polymerized, vitreous thermoset EMC matrix with crosslinking >= 98.5%, zero surface blistering or discolored oxidation, and thoroughly dried of all acoustic couplant water residues (< 0.05 wt% moisture).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time before PMC leads to room-temperature physical aging and moisture absorption by green-state epoxy, resulting in steam vaporization, internal blistering, incomplete network crosslinking, and severe delamination during post-mold cure.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful execution of the 175°C batch post-mold cure recipe achieving >= 98.5% crosslinking conversion (Tg >= 160°C) across all TSOP-54/54-ball FBGA strips, validated by 100 MHz - 230 MHz CSAM acoustic metrology confirming zero critical interfacial delamination, zero active die area voids, and strip warpage within packaging assembly specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PMC_Batch_Thermal_Profile_RunLog_180nmDRAM.csv`
- [ ] `CSAM_Die_Interfacial_Acoustic_Inspection_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `CSAM_CScan_Raw_Phase_Inversion_Defect_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Glass transition temperature (Tg) of cured epoxy mold compound** | `165.0` | >= 160.0°C | Thermomechanical Analysis (TMA) penetration/expansion mode per ASTM E1545 |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Acoustic void/delamination area over 180nm DRAM active die surface** | `0.0` | <= 0.0% (Zero detectable acoustic phase inversion) | High-frequency (>=100 MHz) CSAM automated C-scan image defect segmentation per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-035 |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-cure strip warpage across 250mm leadframe carrier strip** | `0.40` | <= 0.75 mm total strip coplanarity deviation | Non-contact shadow moire / optical profilometry over full strip length at 25°C |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> TMA/DSC qualification demonstrates Tg >= 160.0°C and delta-H <= 1.5 J/g; 100% CSAM screening of the designated qualification lot confirms zero active die delaminations and leadframe paddle voiding <= 5.0%; strip coplanarity warpage <= 0.75 mm; QA Engineering, Packaging Lead, and EHS Manager signatures registered on batch lot disposition report.

# Standard Operating Procedure: PMC Convection Batch Oven Thermal Profile Setup & Ramp Qualification

**Category**: Packaging | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: PMC batch convection oven control loops must decouple ambient thermal loading variations across high-density TSOP-54 and 54-ball FBGA carrier racks. An excessive ramp rate (>3.0°C/min) induces sharp thermal gradients between outer strip rails and inner encapsulated DRAM dies, causing differential chemical shrinkage and warpage before cross-linking reaches the vitrification threshold. Multi-zone convective circulation must maintain airflow velocity uniformity across all magazine slots to ensure the ±2.0°C isothermal envelope at 175°C soak.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Epoxy Molding Compound (EMC) kinetics require strict adherence to glass transition temperature (Tg) evolution. A ramp-up rate exceeding 2.5°C/min accelerates the cross-linking reaction prior to complete outgassing of low-molecular-weight volatiles and reaction byproducts, locking in micro-voids and elevating residual thermo-mechanical stress (CTE mismatch between silicon die at 2.8 ppm/°C, Cu leadframe/substrate at 16.5 ppm/°C, and EMC at 12 ppm/°C below Tg). Controlled cool-down (<2.0°C/min) is strictly mandatory to prevent brittle fracture and micro-cracking across TSOP-54 package corners.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Pre-calibrated 9-point or 16-point thermocouple profiler test harnesses (K-type high-temp PFA insulated) and NIST-traceable dataloggers have extended replenishment lead times (10-12 weeks) from domestic metrology suppliers. Sourcing semiconductor-grade multi-slot carrier magazines capable of withstanding 200°C continuous soak without thermal distortion or particulate shedding is critical to sustaining Gen 3 180nm packaging run-rates.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal profiling setup and 9-point ramp qualification must be frozen within a 36-hour window prior to releasing production transfer molding lots. Any abort due to thermocouple detach or profile excursion beyond ±3.0°C halts front-of-line mold presses, rapidly violating the 2-hour transfer-mold-to-PMC queue time and generating scrap risk across full MPW DRAM lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interfacial delamination between leadframe/die paddle and cured EMC driven by excessive thermal ramp stress (>3.5°C/min) during cure vitrification.
1. Outgassing volatile entrapment causing package internal micro-voiding and blister defects due to inadequate ramp profiling prior to 175°C plateau.
1. Warpage-induced die-attach shear failure or inner gold wire bond neck fractures from uncontrolled post-soak cooling (>2.5°C/min).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-3-1-01` | **PMC Convection Oven 9-Point Spatial Thermal Uniformity & Ramp Profile Qualification** | 9-channel NIST-calibrated K-type thermocouple harness, Fluke/Datapaq thermal tracker profiler (0.1°C resolution), slotted dummy package strip magazine. | 1. Load dummy thermocouple strip carrier magazine into oven center flat zone. 2. Close door and initiate ramp profile: ambient (25°C) to 175°C at programmed 2.0°C/min. 3. Monitor and record continuous temperature data across all 9 channels through the 4-hour soak plateau at 175°C. 4. Initiate controlled passive/active cooling ramp from 175°C down to 50°C at 1.5°C/min. 5. Extract datalogger CSV and calculate maximum channel-to-channel delta, peak ramp rates, and steady-state soak variance. | `Heating ramp rate must remain between 1.5°C/min and 2.5°C/min across all channels. Steady-state temperature at 175°C soak must satisfy 175°C ± 2.0°C across all 9 measurement points throughout the 240-minute hold. Cool-down ramp rate must not exceed 2.0°C/min.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-3-1-02` | **Post-PMC Package Warpage and Interfacial Delamination Acoustic Metrology** | Sonix/Sonoscan C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM) with 100 MHz high-frequency transducer, Mitutoyo 3D non-contact optical profilometer. | 1. Place 10 sample package strips into optical profilometer fixture to scan package coplanarity and warpage across the diagonal axes. 2. Transfer strips to DI water immersion bath in C-SAM. 3. Align 100 MHz transducer focus to the EMC-to-die paddle and EMC-to-leadframe interfaces. 4. Perform acoustic pulse-echo scan across 100% of packaged units in the lot. 5. Process ultrasonic reflection phase inversion map to quantify delamination area percentage. | `Total package warpage across strip must measure < 35.0 µm. C-SAM inspection must demonstrate zero (0.0%) leadframe-to-EMC or die-paddle interfacial delamination and void area < 0.5% of total package surface area.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal protection heat-resistant Kevlar gloves (rated to 250°C), Safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Anti-static ESD lab coat, Nitrile gloves for cold magazine loading, Half-face elastomeric respirator with organic vapor/acid gas cartridges for emergency chamber access
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn: Immediately immerse affected skin in clean, cool running water for minimum 15-20 minutes; do not apply salves or ointments; cover with sterile dry dressing and seek medical attention. Inhalation of oven off-gases: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored; seek immediate medical assessment.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated high-temperature exhaust duct operating continuously at minimum 25 m^3/h with differential pressure interlock (< -15 Pa) to evacuate epoxy cross-linking volatile organic outgases. Ambient room air changes must exceed 12 ACH with real-time O2 deficiency sensor alarming below 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhaust volatile condensates captured in cold-trap condenser are drained into dedicated hazardous organic solvent containment drums. Thermally degraded packaging strip scrap is tagged as cured solid hazardous industrial waste and disposed of via certified high-temperature hazardous waste incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 (99.999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Cresol Novolac Epoxy Resin (Degradation Effluent/Volatiles)** | `29690-82-2` | Technical Off-Gas Trace | `< 0.1% volatile fraction` |
| **Phenolic Hardener Decomposition Effluent** | `9003-35-4` | Technical Off-Gas Trace | `< 0.05% volatile fraction` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly demolded TSOP-54 / FBGA leadframes/strips with green (partially cross-linked ~70-80%) EMC, free of mold flash, moisture, or particulate contaminants.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully cross-linked (>98% conversion) EMC encapsulation, rigid vitrified polymer matrix, zero surface blisters or volatile deposit residues, stabilized leadframe coplanarity.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption into un-crosslinked epoxy matrix triggering steam popcorning, micro-cracking, and irreversible package delamination during the 175°C cure ramp.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful baseline qualification and thermal verification of the PMC convection batch oven profile executing a 2.0°C/min ramp, 4-hour soak at 175°C ± 2.0°C, and 1.5°C/min controlled cool-down for TSOP-54/FBGA 180nm DRAM lots, verifying complete cross-linking without delamination or outgassing defects.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PMC_Convection_Oven_9Pt_Thermal_Profile_Run01.csv`
- [ ] `PMC_Thermal_Ramp_Qualification_Report_Rev1.pdf`
- [ ] `CSAM_Post_PMC_Interfacial_Delamination_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Isothermal soak temperature uniformity across all 9 magazine thermocouple positions during 175°C plateau** | `175.0°C` | ± 2.0°C | Multi-channel K-type NIST-calibrated datalogger sampling at 1.0 Hz over 240 minutes |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Thermal ramp-up rate from ambient (25°C) to 175°C soak temperature** | `2.0°C/min` | ± 0.5°C/min | Datalogger continuous first-derivative slope calculation between 50°C and 160°C |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum package substrate strip warpage following complete PMC thermal cycle** | `25.0 µm` | <= 35.0 µm | Non-contact 3D optical profilometer diagonal displacement scanning across 10 random strips |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 thermocouple channels maintain 175°C ± 2.0°C throughout the full 240-minute hold with zero thermal excursions, ramp rate confined within 1.5°C/min to 2.5°C/min, strip warpage <= 35.0 µm, and zero C-SAM interfacial delamination detected across 100% of tested units.

critics.domain_expert: Epoxy Molding Compound (EMC) kinetics require strict adherence to glass transition temperature (Tg) evolution. A ramp-up rate exceeding 2.5°C/min accelerates the cross-linking reaction prior to complete outgassing of low-molecular-weight volatiles and reaction byproducts, locking in micro-voids and elevating residual thermo-mechanical stress (CTE mismatch between silicon die at 2.8 ppm/°C, Cu leadframe/substrate at 16.5 ppm/°C, and EMC at 12 ppm/°C below Tg). Controlled cool-down (<2.0°C/min) is strictly mandatory to prevent brittle fracture and micro-cracking across TSOP-54 package corners.
critics.supply_chain: Pre-calibrated 9-point or 16-point thermocouple profiler test harnesses (K-type high-temp PFA insulated) and NIST-traceable dataloggers have extended replenishment lead times (10-12 weeks) from domestic metrology suppliers. Sourcing semiconductor-grade multi-slot carrier magazines capable of withstanding 200°C continuous soak without thermal distortion or particulate shedding is critical to sustaining Gen 3 180nm packaging run-rates.
critics.laya_pm: Thermal profiling setup and 9-point ramp qualification must be frozen within a 36-hour window prior to releasing production transfer molding lots. Any abort due to thermocouple detach or profile excursion beyond ±3.0°C halts front-of-line mold presses, rapidly violating the 2-hour transfer-mold-to-PMC queue time and generating scrap risk across full MPW DRAM lots.
critical_failure_modes: Interfacial delamination between leadframe/die paddle and cured EMC driven by excessive thermal ramp stress (>3.5°C/min) during cure vitrification.
Outgassing volatile entrapment causing package internal micro-voiding and blister defects due to inadequate ramp profiling prior to 175°C plateau.
Warpage-induced die-attach shear failure or inner gold wire bond neck fractures from uncontrolled post-soak cooling (>2.5°C/min).

testcases.title: PMC Convection Oven 9-Point Spatial Thermal Uniformity & Ramp Profile Qualification
testcases.instrumentation: 9-channel NIST-calibrated K-type thermocouple harness, Fluke/Datapaq thermal tracker profiler (0.1°C resolution), slotted dummy package strip magazine.
testcases.pre_conditions: Convection batch oven chamber interior cleaned, laminar exhaust confirmed at 25 m^3/h, 9 thermocouples affixed to dummy TSOP-54/FBGA packages across top, middle, bottom, front, center, and back magazine carrier positions.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load dummy thermocouple strip carrier magazine into oven center flat zone. 2. Close door and initiate ramp profile: ambient (25°C) to 175°C at programmed 2.0°C/min. 3. Monitor and record continuous temperature data across all 9 channels through the 4-hour soak plateau at 175°C. 4. Initiate controlled passive/active cooling ramp from 175°C down to 50°C at 1.5°C/min. 5. Extract datalogger CSV and calculate maximum channel-to-channel delta, peak ramp rates, and steady-state soak variance.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Heating ramp rate must remain between 1.5°C/min and 2.5°C/min across all channels. Steady-state temperature at 175°C soak must satisfy 175°C ± 2.0°C across all 9 measurement points throughout the 240-minute hold. Cool-down ramp rate must not exceed 2.0°C/min.

testcases.title: Post-PMC Package Warpage and Interfacial Delamination Acoustic Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Sonix/Sonoscan C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM) with 100 MHz high-frequency transducer, Mitutoyo 3D non-contact optical profilometer.
testcases.pre_conditions: TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA DRAM strip lots processed through qualified PMC oven thermal profile cycle and cooled to 25°C ambient.
testcases.procedure: 1. Place 10 sample package strips into optical profilometer fixture to scan package coplanarity and warpage across the diagonal axes. 2. Transfer strips to DI water immersion bath in C-SAM. 3. Align 100 MHz transducer focus to the EMC-to-die paddle and EMC-to-leadframe interfaces. 4. Perform acoustic pulse-echo scan across 100% of packaged units in the lot. 5. Process ultrasonic reflection phase inversion map to quantify delamination area percentage.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total package warpage across strip must measure < 35.0 µm. C-SAM inspection must demonstrate zero (0.0%) leadframe-to-EMC or die-paddle interfacial delamination and void area < 0.5% of total package surface area.

ppe_required: Thermal protection heat-resistant Kevlar gloves (rated to 250°C)
Safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1)
Anti-static ESD lab coat
Nitrile gloves for cold magazine loading
Half-face elastomeric respirator with organic vapor/acid gas cartridges for emergency chamber access
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Thermal burn: Immediately immerse affected skin in clean, cool running water for minimum 15-20 minutes; do not apply salves or ointments; cover with sterile dry dressing and seek medical attention. Inhalation of oven off-gases: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored; seek immediate medical assessment.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Dedicated high-temperature exhaust duct operating continuously at minimum 25 m^3/h with differential pressure interlock (< -15 Pa) to evacuate epoxy cross-linking volatile organic outgases. Ambient room air changes must exceed 12 ACH with real-time O2 deficiency sensor alarming below 19.5% O2.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Exhaust volatile condensates captured in cold-trap condenser are drained into dedicated hazardous organic solvent containment drums. Thermally degraded packaging strip scrap is tagged as cured solid hazardous industrial waste and disposed of via certified high-temperature hazardous waste incineration.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly demolded TSOP-54 / FBGA leadframes/strips with green (partially cross-linked ~70-80%) EMC, free of mold flash, moisture, or particulate contaminants.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Fully cross-linked (>98% conversion) EMC encapsulation, rigid vitrified polymer matrix, zero surface blisters or volatile deposit residues, stabilized leadframe coplanarity.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Moisture absorption into un-crosslinked epoxy matrix triggering steam popcorning, micro-cracking, and irreversible package delamination during the 175°C cure ramp.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Isothermal soak temperature uniformity across all 9 magazine thermocouple positions during 175°C plateau
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Multi-channel K-type NIST-calibrated datalogger sampling at 1.0 Hz over 240 minutes

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Thermal ramp-up rate from ambient (25°C) to 175°C soak temperature
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Datalogger continuous first-derivative slope calculation between 50°C and 160°C

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum package substrate strip warpage following complete PMC thermal cycle
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Non-contact 3D optical profilometer diagonal displacement scanning across 10 random strips

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): PMC Convection Oven Multi-Point Thermocouple Profiler Instrument Setup & Calibration

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > BEOL Multi-Layer Metallization, Wafer Sort & Packaging [BEOL & Packaging] > Transfer Molding Epoxy Plastic Encapsulation (TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA Package) [Packaging & Assembly] > High-Pressure Transfer Molding & Post-Mold Cure (PMC) Execution [Packaging] > High-Pressure Transfer Molding & Post-Mold Cure (PMC) Chamber Run [Packaging] > Post-Mold Cure (PMC) Batch Oven Run & Acoustic Microscopy (CSAM) Void Metrology [Packaging] > PMC Convection Batch Oven Thermal Profile Setup & Ramp Qualification [Packaging] > PMC Convection Oven Multi-Point Thermocouple Profiler Instrument Setup & Calibration [Packaging]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Oxide Thickness Tox: 3.5 nm (Gate) / 350 nm (Field).
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / C-V Profiler.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The multi-point profiler instrument must interface directly with the convection oven chamber without perturbing internal forced-convection laminar airflow or degrading the door silicone seal integrity. Feedthrough ports must utilize hermetic compression fittings with high-temperature PEEK or PTFE glands to prevent thermal cold spots and turbulent boundary-layer separation across the TSOP-54 / FBGA-54 carrier racks. Cold-junction compensation (CJC) within the data logger must be thermally decoupled from the ambient thermal draft of the oven exhaust, ensuring acquisition drift is bounded under 0.05°C/h.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-mold cure (PMC) kinetics for biphenyl and ortho-cresol novolac (OCN) epoxy molding compounds (EMC) require rigorous isothermal soaking at 175°C ± 3°C for 4 to 8 hours. Calibrating multi-point thermocouples (Class 1 / Special Limits of Error Type K or Type T) using a traceable dry-block calibrator across 25°C to 200°C is critical; a ±1.5°C thermal deviation during glass transition temperature (Tg) development can cause incomplete crosslinking, severe warpage (>50 µm across 54-ball FBGA strips), or package delamination at the leadframe-EMC boundary during subsequent reflow.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying off-the-shelf, calibrated Kapton-insulated Class 1 36 AWG fine-wire thermocouples paired with a NIST-traceable multi-channel profiler (such as Datapaq or ECD profilers) mitigates single-vendor lock-in. Sourcing calibration blocks and thermocouple lots with accredited ISO/IEC 17025 certificates ensures export compliance and avoids lead-time bottlenecks in local Vietnamese packaging facilities, where imported specialized thermal profiling electronics can face 6-8 week customs delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration and setup of this profiling tool must be completed within a 3-day milestone window prior to commercial DRAM production batch loading. Any delay directly blocks the PMC Convection Batch Oven Thermal Profile Setup & Ramp Qualification work package. Acceptance testing requires signed-off calibration curves and logger battery discharge endurance logs verifying uninterrupted 10-hour profiling at 175°C operational chamber ambient.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Profilometer cold-junction compensation (CJC) drift induced by external oven convective radiant leakage, leading to an undetected -4°C measurement offset and undercured EMC polymer matrix.
1. Lead-wire parasitic thermal conduction along heavy-gauge thermocouple sheaths sinking heat away from the TSOP-54 dummy package leadframe, yielding falsely depressed temperature readings.
1. Degradation or outgassing of thermocouple adhesive tape (Kapton/silicone) inside the 175°C convection chamber, depositing siloxane contaminants onto package leadframe fingers and wire bond pads.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-3-1-1-01` | **Multi-Point Thermocouple Channel Dry-Block Calibration & Cold-Junction Accuracy Verification** | Fluke 9144 Field Metrology Well (or dry-block equivalent with ±0.02°C stability), Fluke 5615 Secondary Reference PRT, 16-Channel Datapaq/Fluke Precision Thermal Profiler Data Logger, calibrated Type K 36 AWG Kapton-insulated thermocouples. | 1. Insert the reference PRT and all 16 profiler thermocouple junctions into the equalizing block of the dry-block calibrator at identical immersion depth (120 mm). 2. Step the calibrator through setpoints: 25°C, 100°C, 150°C, 175°C, and 200°C, allowing a minimum 15-minute dwell at each setpoint for thermal equilibrium (stability rate < 0.01°C/min). 3. Record 60 consecutive seconds of temperature data at 1 Hz across all 16 channels at each plateau. 4. Calculate the mean offset and maximum absolute deviation (delta T) of each channel relative to the reference PRT standard at the 175°C target post-mold cure setpoint. | `For all 16 channels at 175.0°C: Absolute measurement error relative to reference PRT must be <= ±0.5°C; inter-channel deviation span (T_max - T_min) across all channels must be <= 0.4°C.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-2-3-1-1-02` | **Chamber Multi-Rack 9-Point Simulated Load Dynamic Profiling & Thermal Uniformity Verification** | Calibrated 16-channel thermal profiler, 9 instrumented dummy TSOP-54 / FBGA-54 leadframe strips with embedded Type K thermocouples, high-temperature thermal barrier enclosure, convection batch oven. | 1. Load dummy leadframe carrier magazines into the oven chamber to represent 100% full production thermal mass. 2. Route multi-point thermocouple leads through the hermetic port or stow the profiler within its insulated thermal heat pack inside the chamber. 3. Initiate standard PMC recipe: ramp at 2.5°C/min to 175°C soak temperature, dwell for 240 minutes under 5 SLPM inert N2 sweep, and ramp down at 1.5°C/min. 4. Log temperature profile continuously at 1 Hz sampling rate across all 9 spatial locations. 5. Extract peak temperature, steady-state soak uniformity between minutes 30 and 210, and ramp rate differentials across all channels. | `Soak zone spatial uniformity across all 9 locations during the 175°C dwell must remain strictly within 175.0°C ± 2.5°C; heating ramp rate between 50°C and 160°C must be 2.5 ± 0.5°C/min across all channels with zero overshoot exceeding 178.5°C.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal heat-resistant Kevlar/Nomex gloves (rated >= 250°C contact), ANSI Z87.1 approved side-shield safety glasses, Cleanroom-compatible anti-static ESD lab coat, Closed-toe safety shoes with slip-resistant soles
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn contact: Immediately drench affected area with cold potable water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply salves or ointments; cover with sterile dry gauze and seek medical attention. Skin contact with IPA: Wash with mild soap and water. Eye exposure: Flush thoroughly at nearest safety eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Nitrogen displacement/asphyxiation risk: Move casualty immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen or artificial respiration if breathing ceases.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Oven chamber exhaust must be permanently coupled to dedicated facility VOC/acid scrubbed exhaust ducting at >= 150 CFM face extraction velocity to evacuate solvent and organic amine outgassing. Calibration bench must operate under localized laminar flow hood with >= 0.45 m/s face velocity.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes must be sealed in designated airtight, flame-resistant solvent waste cans and disposed of as Class 3 hazardous flammable waste. Detached thermocouple wire clippings must be segregated into metal recycling bins to eliminate puncture hazards.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, for sensor contact degreasing)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Grade C) | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Thermally Conductive Silicone-Free Alumina Adhesive (Cured)** | `1344-28-1` | Technical Grade | `60-80% Al2O3 in epoxy matrix` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purge and blanketing)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.0 (UHP) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly demolded TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA leadframe strips directly post-transfer molding with green-state epoxy cure (crosslink conversion ~75-85%), free of mold release wax residue on bonding land areas.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully post-cured (crosslink conversion >= 98%) robust package bodies with fully stabilized glass transition temperature (Tg >= 165°C), zero surface blistering, and dry unoxidized copper leadframe finishes ready for deflash and solder ball attach.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time prior to PMC causes green-state epoxy moisture absorption from cleanroom air; absorbed moisture vaporizes violently during subsequent 175°C curing, inducing internal delamination, popcorning, microcracking, and irreversible package warpage.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful setup, multi-channel dry-well calibration, and multi-point in-situ convection oven profiling qualification confirming that all 16 measurement channels achieve NIST-traceable accuracy within ±0.5°C and verify oven thermal chamber soak uniformity within ±2.5°C at 175°C under full dummy magazine loading.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PMC_PROFILER_16CH_CALIBRATION_CERT_REV1.pdf`
- [ ] `OVEN_CONVECTION_175C_UNIFORMITY_RUN_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `TSOP54_FBGA54_PMC_THERMAL_PROFILE_QUAL_REPORT.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Absolute dry-well temperature measurement accuracy of each profiler channel relative to reference PRT at 175.0°C setpoint** | `0.0°C offset` | <= ±0.5°C | Multi-point comparison against Fluke 5615 PRT in Fluke 9144 metrology well across 16 logged channels |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum spatial temperature spread across 9 rack monitoring locations during 175°C isothermal soak dwell (t = 60 min to 200 min)** | `175.0°C` | <= ±2.5°C | Statistical min/max calculation across 9 thermocouple channels attached to carrier-mounted dummy packages during loaded batch run |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Data logger cold-junction compensation internal drift over 4-hour continuous oven cycle at ambient feedthrough junction** | `0.0°C` | <= ±0.2°C | Continuous logging of internal CJC sensor reference channel in ambient harness housing |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 16 thermocouple channels pass dry-well calibration with absolute error <= ±0.5°C at 175°C; 9-point loaded convection oven soak uniformity is verified within ±2.5°C across a 4-hour simulated batch run with zero dropouts, signed off by Packaging Domain Lead and Systems Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Zone Thermal Ramp Recipe Tuning & Isothermal Soak Optimization

**Process Step ID:** `PKG-PMC-THRM-003`  
**Level:** Packaging & Assembly — Post-Mold Cure (PMC) Batch Oven Run  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm CMOS Open-Source DRAM Chip — TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Knowledge Document:** [pmc_multizone_thermal_ramp_tuning.md](./docs/knowledge/pmc_multizone_thermal_ramp_tuning.md)

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
│  Start PMC Batch Load  │

│                        │
│    Zone Coupling &     │
│  Baseline Calibration  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼

│                        │
│   Controlled Thermal   │
│       Ramp Phase       │
│                        │

             │

│   Isothermal Soak &    │

│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘

│          Ramp          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Chamber Inspection & Carrier Loading**:
   - Verify multi-zone resistive heating coils (Kanthal-A1 / APM elements) and dual Type-R / Type-S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in protective thermowells.
   - Load the mold-cured DRAM carrier boats (TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA strips) mechanically into the central process zone at a controlled speed `< 50 mm/minute` to eliminate crystallographic/mechanical shock.

2. **Inert Gas Purge Sweep**:
   - Engage mass flow controllers (MFC) to establish a laminar $N_2$ purge sweep at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** (standard liters per minute) to prevent ambient back-diffusion and oxidative degradation of leadframe finishes.

3. **Multi-Zone Decoupled PID Recipe Tuning**:
   - Initialize triple-loop digital PID controllers with feedforward decoupling across **Source (inlet)**, **Center (process)**, and **Load (door)** zones to compensate for convective end-losses.
   - Tune proportional, integral, and derivative gains across zones to maintain a flat-zone thermal span across the central **300 mm to 350 mm** boat region.

4. **Isothermal Soak Execution**:
   - Ramp to the target cure plateau temperature (150°C for polymeric cross-linking).
   - Maintain the steady-state isothermal soak for **60 minutes**, regulating center flat-zone temperature uniformity within **$\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$**.

5. **Controlled Anneal Ramp-Down & Unload**:
   - Execute controlled cool-down at mechanical extraction speed `< 50 mm/minute` until returning to room temperature (25°C).
   - Transfer strips to acoustic microscopy (CSAM) metrology.

---
