# Standard Operating Procedure: High-Frequency C-SAM Transducer Setup & Gating Calibration

**Module / Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Package Types:** TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA Package  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology SOP  
**Target Knowledge File:** [`docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_gating_calibration.md`](./docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_gating_calibration.md)

---

### Metrology Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Immersion Tank DI    │
│      Water Setup       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Transducer Focus    │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Time of Flight     │
│   Gating Calibration   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      C-SAM Phase       │
│     Inversion Scan     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Metrology  │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Acoustic Coupling Immersion Setup:**
   - Fill the C-SAM scanning tank with deionized (DI) water maintained at room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Degas DI water to eliminate micro-bubbles on the package surface, which can cause spurious acoustic scattering and false delamination readings.
   - Secure the TSOP-54 or 54-ball FBGA package firmly into the leveling fixture to maintain planarity parallel to the scanner $X\text{–}Y$ raster plane.

2. **Transducer Installation & Focal Positioning:**
   - Mount the high-frequency acoustic transducer onto the Z-axis scanning stage.
   - Adjust the focal height ($Z$-axis) until the acoustic pulse echo returns maximum reflection amplitude from the top mold compound surface.
   - Step down the focal plane through the epoxy encapsulation toward the active die surface ($100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum pad layer) and die-attach boundary.

3. **Time-of-Flight (ToF) Gating Calibration (A-Scan):**
   - In A-Scan oscilloscope mode, identify the front-surface mold echo, mold-to-die interface echo, and die-to-paddle die attach echo (Ablebond 84-1LMIS layer).
   - Position an electronic data gate tightly over the die attach reflection peak to capture interfacial echoes while rejecting front-surface ringing.
   - Calibrate the phase reference: a solid, well-bonded interface exhibits standard phase polarity; an air gap/void boundary produces an acoustic phase inversion (180° phase inversion resulting in negative peak polarity due to the lower acoustic impedance of air).

4. **Raster C-Scan Image Acquisition:**
   - Execute an $X\text{–}Y$ scan covering the full footprint of the encapsulated DRAM die and leadframe/substrate.
   - Map acoustic peak amplitude and phase inversion across the gated die-attach layer.
   - Extract defect areas using automated thresholding algorithms to quantify void percentages and interfacial delamination.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░                               │
      Wire Pull Force┤░░                               │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Al Bond Pad Dimension┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
     Thermal Res R_th┤▓▓▓                              │
                     │▓▓▓                              │
Die Attach Void Limit┤███                              │
                     │███                              │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      25      50      75     100 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptance Criteria | Machine Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Die Attach Total Void Area** | $< 5\%$ | **Pass / Fail** ($\le 5.0\%$) | C-SAM acoustic reflection area thresholding over Ablebond 84-1LMIS interface |
| **Package Thermal Resistance ($R_{th}$)** | $\le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$ | **Pass / Fail** ($\le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$) | Transient thermal impedance tester post PMC |
| **Bonding Pad Area Integrity** | $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ | **$\pm 5\%$ planar boundary** | Acoustic C-mode focal top-layer scan |
| **Bond Wire Pull Strength** | $\ge 4.0\,\text{gf}$ | **Pass / Fail** ($\ge 4.0\,\text{gf}$) | Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 wire pull test on $25\,\mu\text{m}$ wire span |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Source: Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging:**
  - *Die Attach & Metrology:* Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ minutes}$; thermal resistance $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$; void area under die $< 5\%$ via acoustic microscopy.
  - *Pad & Wire Specs:* $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum bonding pads; $25\,\mu\text{m}$ wire pull test force $\ge 4.0\,\text{grams-force}$ per Mil-Std-883 Method 2011; operating at room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Knowledge Captured:** Details logged to [`docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_gating_calibration.md`](./docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_gating_calibration.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Transducer acoustic focal length (typically 12.7 mm to 25.4 mm in water) and center frequency (100 MHz to 230 MHz) must be synchronized with high-speed digitizer gating windows (< 1 ns jitter) across the TSOP-54 / FBGA package stack. Gating between the mold compound top surface, die face, and leadframe paddle interface requires sub-5 ns time-of-flight selectivity to prevent signal overlap and phantom phase shifts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Acoustic impedance matching at the epoxy molding compound (Z ~ 6-7 MRayls) to silicon die (Z ~ 19.7 MRayls) interface demands precise gating calibration; improper electronic delay setup in C-SAM will miss interfacial acoustic phase inversion (180° phase flip from positive to negative reflection coefficient) indicative of micro-delamination and JEDEC J-STD-020 MSL-3 moisture-induced package cracking.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of specialized high-frequency UHF transducers (100-230 MHz, PVDF-TrFE or LiNbO3 piezoelectric single crystal) involves long lead times (>16 weeks) and vendor single-source risks (e.g., Sonix, PVA TePla, Nordson Sonoscan); ensure universal UHF BNC/SMA cabling and standardized transducer fixture adapters are sourced with pre-calibrated reference blocks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibrating SAM transducer gating is on the critical path prior to JEDEC post-PMC environmental stress screening; delay in baseline gating golden samples threatens the MSL pre-conditioning schedule and BEOL package qualification timeline for the 180nm DRAM tapeout lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Transducer defocusing or focal plane misalignment causing acoustic energy scattering and false-positive delamination classification at the EMC-die paddle boundary.
1. Gating gate width overlap across multiple reflective interfaces (die top passivated surface vs die attach leadframe), leading to signal washout and missed micro-voids.
1. Acoustic coupling fluid micro-bubble entrapment on the package surface simulating non-existent interfacial delamination.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-3-3-1-01` | **High-Frequency C-SAM Transducer Focal Plane & Axial Resolution Verification** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM) equipped with a 150 MHz spherically focused immersion transducer, 500 MHz / 8-bit RF digitizer, and 0.5 um precision XYZ scanning stage. | 1. Position transducer above reference calibration step block. 2. Perform automated Z-axis focus sweep across the known 180nm DRAM dummy package stack. 3. Acquire raw RF A-scan waveform and compute -6 dB acoustic beam spot diameter and axial pulse width. 4. Verify focal zone depth against package mold cap thickness (0.35 mm). | `Transducer center frequency measured at 150 MHz +/- 5 MHz; axial resolution <= 15 um in epoxy mold compound; focal spot size <= 35 um at -6 dB; Gauge R&R measurement CV < 1.0% across 9 distinct calibration points.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-3-3-1-02` | **Electronic Gating Time-of-Flight & Phase Inversion Calibration for Die-Paddle Delamination** | UHF C-SAM System, pulser/receiver with variable bandpass filter (50-200 MHz), and J-STD-035 compliant acoustic imaging analysis software. | 1. Acquire baseline A-scan waveform through mold compound to die face interface. 2. Set electronic hardware gate width to 12.0 ns, centered precisely at the mold-to-die acoustic return. 3. Shift gate to die-paddle interface (+35 ns ToF). 4. Scan calibration sample in C-mode at 50 um pixel pitch. 5. Measure reflection amplitude polarity (phase angle) over bonded vs delaminated zones. | `Gate timing jitter < 0.5 ns peak-to-peak; echo phase polarity inversion (positive to negative peak inversion) detected across 100% of the calibrated artificial delamination area; spatial defect size measured within +/- 5% of actual 50 um dimension.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 10,000 / ISO 7 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, 4 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified splash goggles, Standard anti-static cleanroom lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA during transducer wipe-down, flush immediately with copious clean water for 15 minutes. In case of vapor irritation, relocate to fresh air. No chemical antidote required for DI immersion fluid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow recirculating air handling (minimum 20 air changes per hour); local solvent-rated bench exhaust for IPA lens-wiping operations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent degassed DI water drained to standard acid/neutral wastewater system; IPA cleaning wipes disposed of in sealed flammable solid hazardous waste receptacles.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (degassed immersion medium)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade Type I | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropanol (transducer face cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C12) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-PMC (Post-Mold Cure) fully cured EMC surface, free of release-agent residue, dust particulates, or organic oil contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thoroughly dried under filtered N2 blow-off (oil-free, -40 deg C dew point) to remove all residual DI water couplant before bake and dry-packing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended exposure to moisture immersion during gating setup without immediate bakeout risks unintended moisture absorption exceeding J-STD-020 MSL-3 floor life thresholds, generating false pop-corning failure modes during subsequent solder reflow testing.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> High-frequency (150 MHz) C-SAM transducer setup, acoustic focal depth alignment, and interface gating calibration completed and validated against JEDEC J-STD-035/020 standards on TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA dummy lots, ensuring robust non-destructive detection of package voids and delamination.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CSAM_Transducer_Calibration_Report_Gen3.pdf`
- [ ] `Acoustic_Gate_Ascan_Bscan_Signoff_Data.csv`
- [ ] `Phase_Inversion_Resolution_Map_GoldenSample.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Acoustic center frequency and -6 dB bandwidth conformance** | `150.0 MHz` | +/- 3.0% | FFT spectral analysis of pulse-echo RF response from polished optical glass reference flat. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Hardware gating time jitter and time-of-flight drift** | `0.3 ns` | < 0.5 ns max | Digital storage oscilloscope continuous edge-trigger timing analysis across 10,000 scan pulses. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Delamination detection spatial repeatability across 9-point grid** | `0.75%` | CV < 1.0% | Gauge R&R 9-point repeated C-scan area measurement on standard micro-void reference coupon. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal signoff requires 100% pass on all 3 quantitative assertions, verified phase-inversion mapping on calibrated micro-defect standard without false alarms, and clean dry-pack bakeout verification approved by Packaging Lead and Metrology Quality Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Acoustic Reflection Phase Inversion & Die-Attach Interface Scanning

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (SAM) non-destructive metrology for inspecting the die-attach interface (silver-filled conductive epoxy, Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at 150°C for 60 min) on encapsulated 180nm open-source DRAM chips (TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA). It utilizes ultrasonic A-scan reflection phase inversion to differentiate intact acoustic interfaces from air voids and delamination, followed by high-resolution C-scan acoustic imaging.

---

### 2. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sample Immersion in   │
│        DI Water        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    A-Scan Acoustic     │
│   Focal Calibration    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Die-Attach Interface  │
│      Gate Gating       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Phase Inversion     │
│     Polarity Check     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  C-Scan Raster Image   │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Automated Void Area   │
│    % Quantification    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Acoustic Tank & Sample Preparation**:
   - Immerse post-mold cured DRAM packages into a temperature-controlled acoustic immersion tank filled with degassed, deionized (DI) water maintained at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Secure the sample fixtures to prevent lateral deflection during high-speed raster scanning.

2. **Transducer Setup & Focal Alignment**:
   - Install a high-frequency focused immersion acoustic transducer (typically 100–230 MHz) calibrated for silicon-to-epoxy interfaces.
   - Adjust the Z-axis height using an oscilloscope A-scan display to focus the acoustic beam through the mold compound and silicon die onto the silicon/die-attach interface.

3. **Time-Resolved Gate Positioning (A-Scan Analysis)**:
   - Identify the echo train on the A-scan: package surface $\rightarrow$ silicon die surface $\rightarrow$ silicon-to-die-attach epoxy interface.
   - Set an electronic hardware acquisition gate strictly spanning the time-of-flight corresponding to the backside silicon-to-epoxy boundary layer.

4. **Phase Inversion Polarity Discrimination**:
   - Evaluate the initial half-cycle echo polarity at the gated interface:
     - **Intact Bond (Silicon to Silver-Filled Epoxy)**: Acoustic impedance transition $Z_{\text{silicon}} \rightarrow Z_{\text{epoxy}}$ (higher to lower, but finite) produces standard negative-peak reflection phase.
     - **Delamination / Void (Silicon to Air/Gap)**: Acoustic impedance transition $Z_{\text{silicon}} \rightarrow Z_{\text{air}} \approx 0$ exhibits total acoustic reflection with a 180° phase inversion and maximum echo amplitude.

5. **High-Resolution C-Scan Raster Scanning**:
   - Execute an X-Y raster scan over the full DRAM die active footprint.
   - Map peak amplitude and phase inversion sign to pixel intensity (e.g., bright inverted high-amplitude pixels indicating delamination or void; low-amplitude baseline indicating intact bonding).

6. **Automated Defect & Void Area Fraction Calculation**:
   - Apply automated image segmentation thresholding to the gated die-attach C-scan image.
   - Calculate total void area fraction:
     $$\text{Void Area Fraction (\%)} = \frac{A_{\text{void}}}{A_{\text{die}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Flag any unit exceeding the threshold for packaging disposition.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                         ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                         │█████████████████████████████│
    Wire Pull (>= 4.0 gf)┤█████████████████████████████│
                         │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
Thermal Res. (<= 5.0 C/W)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
                         │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
       Void Area (< 5.0%)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                       │
                         │▒▒▒▒▒▒                       │
                         └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                         0.0    1.6    3.2    4.9   6.5 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Unit | Method / Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Die-Attach Void Area Fraction** | **$< 5.0$** | **%** | Acoustic Microscopy (SAM C-scan phase-inversion gating) |
| **Package Die Thermal Resistance ($R_{th}$)** | **$\le 5.0$** | **$^\circ\text{C/W}$** | Thermal transient measurement post-cure |
| **Die-Attach Epoxy Cure Schedule** | **$150 \pm 5$ for $60$** | **$^\circ\text{C}$ / $\text{minutes}$** | Convection oven / PMC cure tracking |
| **Interconnect Wire Pull Strength** | **$\ge 4.0$** | **$\text{grams-force (gf)}$** | MIL-STD-883 Method 2011 ($25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire) |

---

### 5. Context & Literature Citations

- **Die-Attach Material & Thermal Performance**: Silver-filled conductive epoxy ([Ablebond 84-1LMIS](file:///docs/context.yaml)) cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ minutes}$; thermal resistance $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$; acoustic microscopy void area threshold $< 5\%$ (*Source: Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging*).
- **Interconnect Integrity**: $25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire thermosonic/ultrasonic bonding requiring pull test force $\ge 4.0\text{ gf}$ under MIL-STD-883 Method 2011 (*Source: Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging*).
- **Die Architecture & Metallization**: 180nm DRAM cell layout with $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ aluminum bonding pads connecting bitline/wordline metallization (*Sources: Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging; 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench; PVD Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (C-SAM) gate positioning must decouple the die-attach interface echo (Si to conductive epoxy/DAF) from the adjacent mold compound-to-die top face and copper leadframe/die-paddle bottom interfaces within a 1.0 mm nominal package profile. For TSOP-54 and 54-ball FBGA, acoustic transit time differences across 180nm DRAM dies (nominal thinned thickness 150 um, longitudinal acoustic velocity v_Si = 8430 m/s) yield a round-trip time delta of ~35.6 ns. A high-frequency transducer (minimum 100 MHz to 230 MHz, focal length 0.25 to 0.5 inches) with a minimum 1.0 GHz RF digitizer sampling rate is mandatory to avoid temporal overlap and false delamination phase identification.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Acoustic reflection phase inversion relies strictly on the acoustic impedance mismatch Z = rho * v. At the silicon-to-die-attach boundary, Z_silicon is ~19.7 MRayl while a fully bonded silver-filled epoxy die attach matrix has Z_DA ~3.5 to 5.0 MRayl. The reflection coefficient R = (Z_DA - Z_Si)/(Z_DA + Z_Si) is negative, inducing an intrinsic 180-degree phase inversion (negative leading half-cycle in A-scan). However, at a delamination or void interface where air/vacuum is present (Z_air ~0.0004 MRayl), R approaches -1.0 with an ultra-high amplitude reflection, whereas ingress of liquid coupling agent (DI water, Z_water ~1.5 MRayl) alters the phase and amplitude profile. Researchers must distinguish between bulk resin starvation, micro-voiding (<25 um diameter), and true cohesive epoxy shear delamination per J-STD-020E criteria.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: High-frequency transducers (>=100 MHz PVDF or LiNbO3 piezoelectric elements) and acoustic scanning stages with sub-micron positional encoders (x-y repeatability <= 0.5 um) are subject to single-supplier dependencies and lead times exceeding 16 weeks. Furthermore, wafer dicing and post-mold curing variations across Southeast Asian OSAT packaging lines dictate that calibrated acoustic impedance reference standards for 180nm DRAM Si/epoxy/Cu coupons must be stocked locally at DRAM Foundation VN metrology facilities to prevent audit halts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: SAM inspection of PMC-cured TSOP-54 packages represents a serial metrology bottleneck; 100% scanning of multi-cavity leadframe strips will stall packaging line throughput. Acoustic die-attach verification must be scheduled using an AQL sampling plan (Level II, 0.65 AQL) during steady-state packaging, escalating to 100% strip mapping only upon excursion triggers (MSL Level 3 preconditioning failure or die-attach shear strength dropping below 1.5 kg/die).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Transducer focal-plane defocusing causing A-scan echo overlap between the die paddle back-side and Si die-attach interface, resulting in false-negative delamination calls.
1. Capillary ingress of deionized immersion water into package edge cracks or micro-voids during immersion C-SAM scanning, falsely elevating local acoustic impedance and masking critical air-gap delaminations.
1. Excessive ultrasonic transducer pulse power causing secondary acoustic cavitation damage or lead wire bond fatigue at un-encapsulated wafer/strip interfaces.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-3-3-2-01` | **Acoustic Reflection Phase Inversion Verification at Si Die-Attach Interface** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope (PVA TePla / Sonoscan Gen6 C-SAM) equipped with 150 MHz UHF focused transducer (focal length 8 mm, spot size ~18 um), 1.0 GHz 10-bit RF digitizer, and automated A/B/C-scan phase analysis software. | 1. Mount TSOP-54 package horizontally in immersion scanning fixture with top mold facing transducer. 2. Align transducer z-axis to maximize the A-scan echo amplitude from the top surface of the die, then lower focal point by delta_z = t_mold * (v_water / v_EMC) + t_Si * (v_water / v_Si) to place focus exactly at die-attach plane. 3. Calibrate RF phase polarity reference using a polished bare silicon-water boundary (known positive leading phase). 4. Execute high-resolution C-scan over the full die active area (nominal 5.0 mm x 8.0 mm) with x-y step pitch of 5.0 um. 5. Extract phase polarity map and peak-to-peak amplitude matrix across the entire die-attach interface layer. 6. Identify regions exhibiting positive phase inversion or anomalous reflection amplitudes indicating air-gap delamination or voiding. | `Total accumulated die-attach delamination area must be <= 10.0% of the active die-attach footprint per J-STD-020E / MIL-STD-883 Method 2030; single contiguous delamination along any die perimeter edge must not exceed 5.0% perimeter length or extend into active silicon scribe streets; phase inversion must show consistent negative-polarity leading peak across bonded zones.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-3-3-2-02` | **Die-Attach Void Sizing and Spatial Resolution Boundary Evaluation** | High-Frequency C-SAM (230 MHz transducer, F-number 1.5, focused spot size 12 um), acoustic immersion tank with active bubble-degasser, micro-calibrated acoustic calibration wedge. | 1. Place MSL-3 stressed test vehicles into the scanning matrix. 2. Configure data acquisition for peak negative amplitude detection gated between 110 ns and 130 ns from mold-die echo. 3. Perform raster scan at scan speed 50 mm/s with pixel grid resolution of 2.5 um x 2.5 um. 4. Apply 2D spatial median filtering and auto-threshold segmentation to delineate contiguous acoustic void boundaries. 5. Measure individual void major/minor axis dimensions, calculate void area percentage relative to total die paddle area, and map distance from void edges to die corners. | `No individual void exceeding 0.05 mm^2; total area of micro-voids across die-attach plane must remain <= 5.0%; zero detectable delamination or void bridging between adjacent package leadframe pins or across active DRAM silicon corner stress-concentration zones.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 374-3 compliant nitrile gloves (minimum thickness 0.15 mm), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-splash safety glasses or face shield, ESD-safe anti-static lab coat, Closed-toe cleanroom safety shoes with chemical-resistant soles
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with IPA or surfactant solution: immediately flush exposed eyes or dermis with copious flowing clean water for a minimum of 15 minutes at the nearest eyewash station. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, relocate personnel to clean outdoor air; if breathing is labored, supply medical oxygen. Ingestion requires prompt toxicological intervention; do not induce vomiting unless instructed by medical staff.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Local chemical extraction hood with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) over the IPA cleaning/degreasing station; enclosed C-SAM immersion tank equipped with moisture-venting HEPA filtration exhaust maintaining negative internal pressure.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent acoustic coupling deionized water containing trace surfactants must be collected in labeled fluorinated HDPE chemical waste drums and transferred to the industrial wastewater neutralization plant; organic solvent wipes contaminated with IPA must be segregated in NFPA-approved self-closing red hazardous waste cans for offsite incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Transducer and Substrate Degreasing)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Tier C) | `99.9%` |
| **Surfactant (Triton X-100 wetting agent for bubble elimination)** | `9002-93-1` | Laboratory Reagent Grade | `0.05% aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry post-mold cured TSOP-54 molded package strips with maximum residual moisture content <= 0.05 wt% and zero surface oil or mold release wax residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Complete post-SAM blown-dry package state via filtered dry nitrogen bake (60°C for 30 minutes); surface completely free of residual moisture droplets, water marks, or coupling agent streaks.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure of post-PMC packages to ambient cleanroom humidity prior to SAM or dry-pack induces moisture ingress into mold epoxy, generating acoustic interface distortion and causing catastrophic package popcorn cracking or false delamination during subsequent reflow simulation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full non-destructive C-SAM acoustic reflection phase inversion and die-attach interface scanning protocol implemented and verified for 180nm TSOP-54 DRAM devices, achieving <= 2.5 um lateral imaging resolution, robust segregation of negative-phase acoustic bonded zones versus positive-phase delaminations, and complete compliance with J-STD-020E MSL-3 inspection requirements.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: J-STD-020/035 Delamination Quantification & Void Ratio Defect Review
**Document ID:** `SOP-PKG-SAM-035`  
**Node/Package:** 180nm Commercial MPW DRAM (TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA)  
**Process Step:** BEOL Metrology & Quality Assurance / Post-PMC & Moisture Sensitivity Review  

---

### 1. Equipment & Pre-Inspection Calibration
1. **Scanning Acoustic Microscope (SAM) Setup:**
   - Equip SAM with high-frequency transducer (typically 50 MHz to 100 MHz for plastic TSOP-54 / FBGA packages).
   - Use deionized, degassed water immersion bath maintained at $25^\circ\text{C}$ as the acoustic coupling medium.
2. **Signal Gating & Focus Calibration:**
   - Position the acoustic focal plane precisely at the relevant packaging interfaces:
     - **Gate 1:** Mold compound to silicon die top active surface interface.
     - **Gate 2:** Die attach paddle / lead frame to backside silicon die interface.
     - **Gate 3:** Lead frame pad to mold compound interface.
   - Calibrate the phase inversion detector: A phase inversion of $180^\circ$ (negative echo phase peak relative to initial pulse) identifies an acoustic impedance drop corresponding to mold compound/air or epoxy/air delamination.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Inspection Procedure

```text
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | Place Degassed DI Water Bath at 25 deg C    |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                             |
                             v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | Align Transducer Focal Plane & Gate Echoes  |
       |  (Gate 1: Die Top | Gate 2: Die Attach)     |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                             |
                             v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | Perform C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Inspection |
       |  (Pixel Pitch <= 5 um across 100% active die) |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                             |
                             v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | Phase Inversion Mapping & Ratio Calculation |
       |  - Die Attach Void Area Ratio (%)           |
       |  - Active Die Face Delamination Area (%)    |
       +---------------------------------------------+
                             |
                             v
       +---------------------------------------------+
       | Disposition: J-STD-020 / J-STD-035 Criteria |
       +---------------------------------------------+
```

1. **C-Scan Data Acquisition:**
   - Perform raster C-mode acoustic scan across each encapsulated package with a lateral scan step size $\le 5\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Capture echo amplitude and phase polarization across Gates 1 and 2.
2. **Die Attach Void Quantification:**
   - Isolate the die-attach interface (Gate 2: cured Ablebond 84-1LMIS silver-filled epoxy under the die footprint).
   - Calculate cumulative void area ratio:
     $$\text{Void Area Ratio (\%)} = \frac{\sum A_{\text{void}}}{A_{\text{die}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Ensure the software threshold flags any continuous void bridging contiguous pad regions.
3. **Active Surface Delamination Review (J-STD-020 / J-STD-035):**
   - Check Gate 1 for phase reversal across the top active die surface and wire bonding zone ($100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum pad periphery).
   - Disqualify packages exhibiting delamination enclosing or propagating into the wire bond ball/wedge stitch regions.
4. **Thermal & Electrical Integrity Cross-Check:**
   - Correlate flagged void regions against junction-to-case package thermal dissipation requirements ($R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Standard | Action on Violation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Die Attach Void Area Ratio** | $< 5.0\%$ of total die area | C-SAM acoustic reflection thresholding at die attach layer | Reject package; quarantine assembly lot; review die attach dispenser volume/pattern |
| **Active Die Surface Delamination** | $0.0\%$ delamination over active area and $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ bonding pads | J-STD-035 Acoustic Microscopy Gate 1 phase-inversion mapping | Reject unit; trigger mold compound PMC/adhesion failure root-cause analysis |
| **Package Thermal Resistance ($R_{th}$)** | $\le 5.0\,^\circ\text{C/W}$ | Transient dual-interface thermal analysis / junction temperature tester | Reject lot if out of thermal budget; re-verify die attach thickness and voiding |
| **Single Contiguous Void Area** | $< 1.0\%$ of total die attach area (no continuous void spanning pad edges) | Automated defect sizing on SAM Gate 2 | Reject unit; adjust epoxy dispensing pattern (e.g., cross/star dispense) |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
- **Source: Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**
  - *Context:* Cured die attach specification using Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 minutes requires void area under the die $< 5\%$ via acoustic microscopy.
  - *Context:* Thermal resistance target is $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$.
  - *Context:* Active bond pads defined as $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum squares.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Delamination quantification under IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020E and J-STD-035 must correlate Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (C-SAM) acoustic impedance phase inversions directly with thermo-mechanical stress profiles across the 180nm DRAM BEOL stack. For TSOP-54 and 54-ball FBGA, interface shear stresses during 260°C peak lead-free reflow will concentrate along the epoxy mold compound (EMC) to polyimide passivation boundary and die-attach pad (DAP) margins. The metrology pipeline must differentiate between benign bulk filler voids (<50 µm) and active interfacial delamination that induces wire bond neck shearing or silicon micro-cracking during subsequent thermal cycling.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Acoustic reflection analysis requires precise transducer gating and high-frequency acoustic focusing (typically 100 MHz to 230 MHz transducers) to resolve the thin interfacial boundaries within plastic encapsulated packages. A phase inversion (180° phase flip from positive to negative acoustic impedance contrast, Z_die > Z_EMC transitioning to Z_gap < Z_EMC) directly signals an air gap or delamination at the die surface or lead-frame paddle interface. In compliance with J-STD-020, delamination across active die circuitry exceeding 0% or across the die paddle exceeding 10% total surface area constitutes outright structural failure.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Post-mold cure (PMC) cycle variability and environmental moisture exposure prior to board reflow drive the majority of open-source tapeout packaging yield losses. Qualification lots for the 180nm DRAM must be strictly segregated into Moisture Sensitivity Level (MSL) baking cabinets at <5% RH to avoid premature popcorn cracking during assembly. Sourcing high-purity, halogen-free epoxy molding compound with low coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE1 < 10 ppm/°C) and consistent spherical silica filler distribution is critical to prevent batch-to-batch voiding variations.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Verification milestones require 100% C-SAM acoustic inspection on post-reflow test vehicles across all MSL preconditioning tiers before authorizing commercial tapeout board-level reliability (BLR) testing. Researchers must automate gate window acquisition to eliminate operator variance in acoustic thresholding, ensuring that void ratio extraction and defect maps are logged in the project repository within 4 hours of post-reflow acoustic scanning.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Popcorn package cracking during 260°C reflow induced by moisture vaporization at the leadframe-to-EMC interface, causing catastrophic package fracturing and fractured 25 µm gold/aluminum wire bonds.
1. Interfacial delamination spreading across the active 180nm DRAM circuit and capacitor area, resulting in mechanical shearing of aluminum bond pads and subsequent intermittent functional open circuits.
1. Continuous acoustic phase inversion along the die attach paddle (DAP) exceeding 10% area, leading to severe thermal dissipation bottlenecks that degrade refresh retention times under high-temperature operating life (HTOL).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-3-3-3-01` | **C-SAM Acoustic Reflection Phase Inversion & Interfacial Delamination Quantification** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope (PVA TePla or Sonix C-SAM) equipped with a 150 MHz high-frequency focused transducer (focal length 0.5 inches), 500 MS/s digital pulser/receiver, and degassed deionized water immersion tank. | 1. Submerge package carrier in degassed DI water tank (<2 ppm dissolved O2). 2. Align 150 MHz transducer normal to the package surface and focus on the EMC-to-die top surface interface. 3. Set the electronic gate width to 15 ns centered precisely on the die surface echo. 4. Perform an X-Y raster scan at 10 µm step resolution across the active die footprint (area ~12 mm²). 5. Record both RF A-scan waveforms and peak positive/negative amplitude C-scans. 6. Analyze phase flip: flag pixels where the primary interface reflection exhibits a 180° phase inversion relative to reference bonded EMC/Si regions. 7. Calculate cumulative delaminated area percentage over active circuitry and die paddle. | `Pass criteria per J-STD-020E / J-STD-035: Zero percent (0.0%) delamination over active die surface area and bond wire pad perimeters; maximum delamination across die-attach paddle (DAP) interface <= 10.0% total area; no single delamination path extending continuously from die edge to package exterior.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-2-3-3-3-02` | **Through-Transmission and Bulk EMC Void Ratio Metrology** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope in Through-Transmission / Dual-Transducer Mode (50 MHz paired transducers) combined with X-ray Computed Tomography (Nordson Dage Quadra 5, 160 kV sub-micron focal spot). | 1. Mount TSOP-54 package in through-transmission acoustic fixture. 2. Gate the through-transmitted acoustic burst through the package thickness. 3. Acquire transmission C-scan image measuring signal attenuation (dB loss) across a 15 µm pitch grid. 4. Correlate regions of high acoustic attenuation (>20 dB drop) with 3D X-ray micro-CT scans (voxel size 2.5 µm). 5. Apply Otsu threshold segmentation to isolate micro-voids in the bulk epoxy matrix and die-attach layer. 6. Sum all void pixel volumes and calculate total void ratio against package bulk volume. | `Pass criteria: Bulk epoxy molding compound void ratio <= 0.5% total volume; individual void diameter in bulk EMC <= 100 µm; die-attach void area directly underneath silicon DRAM die <= 5.0% total die area with no single void exceeding 1.0% die area.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (Class 100, 6 mil thickness, double gloved during tank cleaning), ANSI Z87.1 certified splash-resistant safety glasses with side shields, Anti-static ESD cleanroom lab coat / smock, Closed-toe chemical-resistant cleanroom footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA or biocide solution, flush immediately with copious running water for 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. In case of eye contact, flush exposed eyes at the emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. If aerosolized biocide or solvent vapors are inhaled, move person to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within cleanroom bay with dedicated HEPA laminar airflow (ISO Class 6 / Fed Std 209E Class 1000). Solvent wipe station equipped with point-of-use local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at a minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) directed to VOC carbon abatement.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Acoustic tank drainage containing trace biocide must be diverted to industrial aqueous wastewater treatment; do not discharge to sanitary sewer without neutralization. Used IPA wipes and saturated swabs must be disposed of in sealed, grounded, fire-rated hazardous flammable waste containers for authorized incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (degassed immersion medium)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom Grade (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (transducer and sample wipe)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade (MOS) | `99.9%` |
| **Biocide Additive (tank algae preventative - 2-methyl-4-isothiazolin-3-one)** | `2682-20-4` | Technical Grade | `0.05% aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `168 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-reflow TSOP-54 / FBGA-54 package units with dry, degreased external lead surfaces, cooled to <35°C, free of flux residue or ionic contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully dried package bodies (oven baked at 125°C for 2 hours post-immersion acoustic scan to desiccate trapped water), zero residual moisture in lead crevices, verified clean for electrical test and tape-and-reel.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time post-reflow before acoustic inspection introduces latent ambient moisture re-absorption, masking preexisting interfacial micro-voids by capillary liquid condensation and artificially altering acoustic impedance profiles; failure to dry packages post-C-SAM inspection induces internal galvanic lead corrosion and latent popcorn risk during board attachment.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified C-SAM acoustic metrology report confirming zero delamination across the active 180nm DRAM die surface and under-die void ratios below 5% post-J-STD-020 MSL-3 moisture/reflow preconditioning.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

| `ASSERT-03` | **Die attach paddle (DAP) backside delamination area ratio** | `4.0%` | <= 10.0% | Through-transmission and pulse-echo acoustic ratio evaluation per J-STD-020E Section 6 |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full acoustic inspection completed across a minimum 22-unit sample lot with 100% adherence to zero active die delamination, all die attach void ratios verified <= 5.0%, deliverables committed to repository, and formal signoff by Packaging Reliability Engineer and Quality Assurance Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (CSAM) & Wire Sweep Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (CSAM) & Wire Sweep Metrology: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## CSAM Transducer Calibration & Acoustic Impedance Setup

**Document ID:** `SOP-PKG-MET-CSAM-001`  
**Process Level:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM MPW Backend Assembly & Packaging Metrology)  
**Package Scope:** TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Setup & Inspection  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Degas & Temperature   │
│   Stabilization: DI    │
│     Water Bath 25°C    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Transducer Acoustic   │
│   Alignment & Focal    │
│   Length Calibration   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Acoustic Impedance   │
│    Matching & Echo     │
│    Polarity Gating     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    A-Scan & C-Scan     │
│  Acquisition for Die   │
│  Attach Void Analysis  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Criteria   │
│   Verification: Void   │
│       Area < 5%        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Acoustic Immersion Medium Preparation & Thermal Stabilization
1. Fill the acoustic immersion tank with ultrapure Deionized (DI) water.
2. Degas the water reservoir for $\ge 30\text{ minutes}$ using an inline ultrasonic degassing unit to eliminate micro-bubbles.
3. Verify and maintain water bath temperature at **$25^\circ\text{C}$** room ambient to ensure constant acoustic propagation velocity ($v \approx 1497\text{ m/s}$).

#### Step 2: Transducer Installation & Normal-Incident Alignment
1. Mount a high-frequency focused acoustic transducer (e.g., $100\text{--}230\text{ MHz}$, focal length $8\text{--}12\text{ mm}$) to resolve interfacial boundaries on the $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum pad arrays and die attach layer.
2. Position the transducer normal ($90^\circ \pm 0.1^\circ$) to a flat reference silicon wafer mirror.
3. Maximize the primary radio frequency (RF) reflection peak in the A-scan scope trace to ensure zero tilt.

#### Step 3: Acoustic Impedance Boundary Mapping & Electronic Gate Configuration
1. Calibrate the acoustic impedance mismatch at the die interface:
   - Silicon bulk substrate acoustic impedance: $Z_{\text{Si}} \approx 19.7 \times 10^6\text{ Rayl}$.
   - Silver-filled conductive epoxy attach layer (e.g., Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ minutes}$): $Z_{\text{epoxy}} \approx 3.0\text{--}5.5 \times 10^6\text{ Rayl}$.
   - Delamination/Void interface: Solid to air/vacuum boundary ($Z_{\text{air}} \approx 400\text{ Rayl}$).
2. Set the electronic receiver gate on the RF A-scan trace directly over the die attach reflection echo window (between the back surface of the silicon die and the lead frame/substrate).
3. Calibrate phase polarity gating:
   - **Good bond reflection:** In-phase transmission with lower reflected amplitude ($Z_{\text{Si}} \rightarrow Z_{\text{epoxy}}$).
   - **Void / Delamination reflection:** $180^\circ$ phase inversion with maximal reflected RF amplitude ($R \approx -1.0$).

#### Step 4: C-Scan High-Resolution Raster Acquisition
1. Fixture the cured DRAM packages (TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA).
2. Execute an XY raster scan with a scanning step pitch $\le 5\,\mu\text{m}$ across the entire die area.
3. Compute the percentage of phase-inverted, high-amplitude pixels within the active die attach boundary.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                      CSAM & Packaging Target Thresholds
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
    Pad Dimension (um)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                      │▒▒                              │
    Wire Pull Min (gf)┤▒▒                              │
Thermal Res. Max (C/W)┤▓▓▓                             │
                      │▓▓▓                             │
   Void Area Limit (%)┤███                             │
                      │███                             │
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                       0      25      50     75     100 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Die Attach Total Void Area** | **$< 5.0$** | **$\%$** | Confocal C-Scan Acoustic Microscopy integration over die boundary |
| **Die Attach Thermal Resistance ($R_{\text{th}}$)** | **$\le 5.0$** | **$^\circ\text{C/W}$** | Transient thermal impedance tester post-cure ($150^\circ\text{C}$, $60\text{ min}$) |
| **Bonding Pad Geometry** | **$100 \times 100$** | **$\mu\text{m}$** | Optical metrology / C-scan pad sweep alignment |
| **Minimum Wire Pull Strength** | **$\ge 4.0$** | **$\text{gf}$ (grams-force)** | Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 on $25\,\mu\text{m}$ wire |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

1. **Source:** *Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging*
   - Cured silver-filled conductive epoxy (Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ min}$).
   - Thermal resistance limit: $R_{\text{th}} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$.
   - Die attach acoustic microscopy void acceptance criterion: **Void area under die $< 5\%$**.
   - Bonding pad dimensions: **$100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum squares**.
   - Wire pull strength: **$\ge 4.0\text{ grams-force}$** for $25\,\mu\text{m}$ wire per Mil-Std-883 Method 2011; room temperature operation at $25^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - 180nm 1T1C cell architecture, temperature limits ($85^\circ\text{C}$ operational rating), and backend integration context.

---

> [!NOTE]
> Micro-knowledge extracted and persisted to [`docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_calibration.md`](./docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_calibration.md) per local agent rules.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: CSAM high-frequency transducers (typically 100 MHz to 230 MHz for thin-profile TSOP-54 and 54-ball FBGA encapsulation) require sub-micron precision linear stages and rigid vibration isolation. Rolled ball screws or stepping motor vibrations above 30 Hz introduce Abbe errors and phase jitter, distorting the radio-frequency (RF) A-scan echo arrival time. The acoustic impedance matching between the coupling medium (degassed DI water, Z ≈ 1.48 MRayl) and the mold compound (EMC, Z ≈ 5.5 to 7.0 MRayl) must maintain temperature stability within ±0.5°C to avoid acoustic velocity drift exceeding 0.15%, which would invalidate automated time-of-flight (ToF) delamination gating.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate characterization of mold-to-die and mold-to-die-attach acoustic interfaces relies on precise acoustic impedance (Z = rho * v) calibration. TSOP-54 leadframes and FBGA substrate wire-sweep inspections operate near the spatial resolution limit of acoustic lenses. If the focal length (focal zone Rayleigh length) is not calibrated against a standardized acoustic impedance reference block (e.g., quartz, polished silicon, copper leadframe standard), phase inversion detection (180-degree phase shift indicating air delamination at die top/paddle) will yield false negatives or incorrect void sizing. Degassing DI water to dissolved oxygen/nitrogen levels below 3 ppm is mandatory to eliminate micro-bubble acoustic scattering at the transducer lens face.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of specialized high-frequency UHF acoustic transducers (100–230 MHz spherical focus PVDF or lithium niobate) and acoustic impedance calibration standards involves strict single-source supplier lead times (16–24 weeks, primarily Sonix, PVA TePla, or OKOS). Sourcing high-purity, degassed deionized water loop accessories and corrosion-resistant vacuum deaerator cartridges must be coordinated ahead of package reliability testing to prevent idle cleanroom tool capacity during MPW packaging ramp.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The buy decision for the transducer set and acoustic calibration fixture must adhere strictly to the BEOL packaging milestones for the 180nm DRAM MPW tapeout. Failure to qualify acoustic calibration before incoming molded package lots arrive will bottleneck JEDEC J-STD-020 moisture sensitivity level (MSL-3) preconditioning and wire sweep yield validation, delaying physical qualification signoff.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Micro-bubble cavitation and acoustic lens bubble adherence leading to false-positive interfacial delamination reflections and RF waveform attenuation.
1. Acoustic impedance drift and gate positioning error due to unmonitored DI water bath temperature fluctuations altering sonic velocity.
1. Focal plane misalignment and Abbe error induced by stage vibration during high-speed raster scanning, causing blurred wire sweep resolution and missed leadframe paddle lifting.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-1-01` | **Acoustic Transducer Center Frequency and Impedance Reflection Coefficient Verification** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope pulser/receiver (100–250 MHz bandwidth), 100 MHz / 230 MHz focused acoustic transducers, Digital Storage Oscilloscope (10 GSa/s RF digitization), Polished Monocrystalline Silicon and Fused Silica Calibration Reference Block | 1. Mount the polished silicon calibration block (acoustic impedance Z_Si = 19.7 MRayl) perpendicular to the acoustic axis. 2. Position the transducer at the focal point (Z-axis maximize peak-to-peak reflection amplitude of front surface echo). 3. Acquire 50 consecutive digitized RF A-scan waveforms at 5 GSa/s. 4. Perform Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on the front-surface echo to extract center frequency (f_c) and -6 dB bandwidth. 5. Calculate the reflection coefficient R from water to silicon and fused silica targets, comparing against theoretical Rayleigh acoustic reflection values. | `Transducer center frequency f_c must be within ±5.0% of nominal rating (e.g., 95.0 to 105.0 MHz for 100 MHz transducer; 218.5 to 241.5 MHz for 230 MHz transducer); experimental reflection coefficient R must match theoretical values within ±2.5% across 50 consecutive acquisitions.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-1-02` | **C-Scan Spatial Resolution and Wire Sweep Gauge R&R Repeatability Mapping** | CSAM automated raster scanning stage (MGN12H guide rails, linear magnetic encoder with 1.0 um resolution), 180nm TSOP-54 packaged test vehicle standard with 25 um gold bond wires and engineered die-to-paddle air gaps | 1. Secure the TSOP-54 calibration standard in the leveling immersion fixture. 2. Perform a 9-point planar focus planarization check across the package package surface. 3. Execute high-resolution C-scan acoustic imaging across 54 package wire-bond loops with a raster step size of 2.0 um. 4. Measure the acoustic lateral line spread function (LSF) across the 25 um bond wire and measure the reflection phase inversion at the engineered delamination gap. 5. Repeat the C-scan measurement 10 times with complete part unload/reload to evaluate Gauge R&R measurement repeatability. | `Wire sweep detection spatial resolution must clearly resolve the 25 um bond wire geometry with signal-to-noise ratio SNR >= 20 dB; phase inversion detection accuracy across calibrated delamination sites must be 100%; measurement Gauge R&R coefficient of variation (CV) must be < 1.0% across 10 repeat cycles.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (100% powder-free, ESD safe), ANSI Z87.1 approved chemical splash safety glasses, Class 100 cleanroom lint-free lab coat / smock, Closed-toe ESD protective footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with isopropanol: Flush affected eyes with continuous tepid water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station; wash skin thoroughly with water and mild soap. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, remove victim to fresh air. Slip and fall risk from DI water spillage must be mitigated immediately using cleanroom absorbent socks.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Local chemical exhaust hood for solvent wiping and transducer alcohol bath degreasing maintaining face velocity of 100 FPM (0.5 m/s); general packaging cleanroom air circulation at ISO Class 6 with 60 air changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent isopropanol solvent wipes and rinse liquids must be collected in closed, grounded, explosion-proof flammable solvent drums for hazardous waste incineration. DI water bath effluent drains to the facility industrial neutralization system (pH 6.5–8.5 monitored) prior to municipal release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (degassed immersion medium)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom Grade (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (transducer lens and fixture cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-mold cured TSOP-54 and 54-ball FBGA strip packages, laser marked, dry and free of particulate debris, grease, and flux residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Blow-dried under high-purity dry N2 gun, zero water immersion droplet retention, bake-dried at 60°C to eliminate residual moisture uptake.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding immersion/drying queue time promotes moisture absorption into the epoxy mold compound (EMC), exacerbating popcorning and false delamination propagation during subsequent JEDEC thermal reflow cycles.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full calibration and acoustic impedance qualification of the CSAM high-frequency transducer suite, establishing verified baseline focal lengths, RF reflection coefficients, and automated C-scan delamination gating for 180nm DRAM TSOP-54 and FBGA packages.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CSAM_Transducer_Impedance_Cal_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Acoustic_Reflection_FFT_Waveforms.csv`
- [ ] `TSOP54_Wire_Sweep_Resolution_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Transducer center frequency accuracy and acoustic reflection coefficient against silicon standard** | `100.0 MHz (f_c) and R = 0.860` | ±5.0% for f_c; ±2.5% for R | FFT spectral analysis and RF oscilloscope amplitude measurement over 50 acquisitions |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Gauge R&R measurement repeatability for wire sweep and package interfacial void detection** | `0.65%` | CV < 1.0% maximum allowable limit | 10-run repeatability testing across 9 reference points on TSOP-54 test vehicle standard |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher verification and signoff are completed when the CSAM calibration report confirms center frequency deviations <= ±5.0%, acoustic impedance reflection coefficient matches theory within ±2.5%, Gauge R&R CV < 1.0%, and J-STD-020 MSL-3 delamination gate phase detection yields 100% reproducibility without bubble artifacts.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Die-Attach Voiding & Interface Delamination C-Mode Scan

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: C-SAM inspection must gate subsequent MSL-3 moisture preconditioning and thermal reflow stress testing. Transducer focal depth (Z-axis gating) must be calibrated across the leadframe/substrate die paddle, die-attach adhesive interface, and active silicon die face without acoustic shadowing from package top-surface mold markings or leadframe tie-bars.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: High-frequency ultrasound (>100 MHz, preferably 150-230 MHz for thin packages like TSOP-54 and 54-FBGA) is mandatory to resolve sub-micron die-attach acoustic impedance mismatches (Z = rho * v). Phase inversion of the reflected echo signal (negative amplitude peak) must be isolated to distinguish true voiding/delamination (air gap, reflection coefficient R ~ -1) from high-density filler segregation or benign adhesive meniscus variations.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Deionized water coupling fluid immersion introduces contamination and package corrosion risks if dwell time is unmonitored. Automated dry-out protocols and drying oven fixtures must be qualified to prevent corrosion of Cu/Ni-Pd-Au leads or SAC solder balls prior to tape-and-reel packaging.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: C-SAM throughput of 100% inspection is cost-prohibitive for high-volume commercial production; sampling plan (AQL 0.4%, Level II per MIL-STD-105E) must be enforced for standard runs, transitioning to 100% C-scan screening only during NPI tapeout qualification and early failure analysis triage.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interfacial die-attach delamination exceeding IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020E limits causing localized thermal throttling and die cracking during surface mount reflow
1. Transducer focal gate misalignment causing false negatives by confusing leadframe back-side reflection with active die-surface mold compound delamination
1. Capillary moisture entrainment during water immersion scan lingering in unsealed micro-voids, inducing catastrophic package popcorning during post-inspection testing

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-01` | **C-SAM Quantitative Die-Attach Void Area Fraction Scan** | Sonix Echo or PVA TePla C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Microscope equipped with a 175 MHz high-frequency focused immersion transducer (focal length 12.7 mm, spot size ~25 um), automated XY scanning tank with degassed DI water recirculator, and pulse-receiver/digitizer with 1 GHz sampling rate. | 1. Immerse JEDEC tray into degassed DI water acoustic tank. 2. Align transducer focal plane to the die-to-pad adhesive interface using RF A-scan waveform visualization. 3. Set electronic gating window to isolate the adhesive-substrate reflection peak. 4. Execute C-mode raster scan at 0.5 um step resolution over the 100% area of the 180nm DRAM die paddle. 5. Apply thresholding algorithms on reflected echo phase inversion to quantify void areas. 6. Automatically calculate total void percentage and contiguous void length across die corners. | `Total die-attach voiding <= 10.0% of total die active area; single contiguous void area <= 5.0%; zero interfacial delamination (0.0%) spanning across any die corner or active DRAM guard ring structure per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020E.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-02` | **Mold Compound to Silicon Die Top Interface Delamination Verification** | PVA TePla SAM 300 / Sonoscan Gen6 Scanning Acoustic Microscope with 230 MHz UHF transducer and inverted phase-tracking DSP engine. | 1. Position package active side up in acoustic coupling immersion tank. 2. Set electronic gate across the Epoxy Molding Compound (EMC) to top silicon die passivation interface. 3. Monitor RF echo pulse polarity: positive reflection indicates intimate bond, phase-inverted negative reflection denotes air gap / delamination. 4. Perform area scan mapping over active DRAM peripheral circuitry, bond pads, and address decoder arrays. 5. Measure cumulative delaminated perimeter and area adjacent to wire bonds. | `Zero delamination (0.0% area and 0.0 ppm phase inversion) across all active circuit regions, bond pads, and silicon seal ring boundaries; interfacial EMC-to-die delamination outside wire bonds <= 2.0% total surface area.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Splash-resistant nitrile examination gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 certified splash-proof chemical safety goggles, Polypropylene cleanroom coat / ESD-safe smock, Closed-toe ESD-safe antistatic cleanroom shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with treated acoustic bath water, flush immediately with clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes. For skin contact with IPA or bath biocide, wash thoroughly with soap and water. If IPA vapors cause dizziness, evacuate to fresh air. If ingested, rinse mouth and seek immediate medical attention; do not induce vomiting.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Acoustic microscopy station must be housed under local laminar cleanroom flow hood (ISO Class 6) with auxiliary canopy exhaust (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s) over IPA drying and post-cleaning ultrasonic stations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent acoustic coupling bath effluent containing biocide must be collected in dedicated chemical carboys for licensed hazardous liquid waste treatment; uninhibited clean DI overflow routed to facility neutralization sump with pH target 6.5 - 8.5; spent IPA segregated into flammable solvent waste drums.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (degassed acoustic couplant)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom Grade | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA couplant wetting / drying agent)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Biocide / Algaecide (acoustic water tank inhibitor)** | `55965-84-9` | Technical Grade | `< 0.05%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-mold cure (PMC) complete at 175 deg C; leadframe chemically deflashed and mechanically trimmed; free of molding flash residue, organic particulate, and grease.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Acoustic couplant completely removed; packages baked dry in vacuum oven at 125 deg C for 2 hours; zero residual ionic water stains on leadframe pins or ball pads.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient queue time causes uncontrolled atmospheric moisture absorption into mold compound and package interfaces, invalidating baseline acoustic acoustic impedance calibration and triggering catastrophic steam popcorning during subsequent reflow verification.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Non-destructive C-mode Scanning Acoustic Microscopy verification of die-attach adhesive and EMC-silicon interfaces for 180nm DRAM packages, ensuring zero critical delamination and void area <= 10.0% compliant with IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020E.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_CSAM_DieAttach_Void_Analysis_LotSummary.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM180_CSAM_PhaseInversion_CMode_InspectionReport.pdf`
- [ ] `DRAM180_TSOP54_DieAttach_AcousticIntensity_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total Die-Attach Void Area Fraction** | `5.0` | +/- 2.0% | Automated C-SAM pixel thresholding of inverted phase RF acoustic reflection amplitude across die-attach plane |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Active Silicon Face to Mold Compound Interfacial Delamination** | `0.0` | +0.0% | 230 MHz UHF ultrasonic C-scan echo polarity detection across active DRAM core and bond pad perimeter |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Corner Die-Attach Maximum Contiguous Void Extent** | `0.0` | <= 2.0% | High-resolution acoustic spatial segmentation over 4 die corners (200 um x 200 um corner zones) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of tested DRAM units in the qualification lot meet total die-attach voiding <= 10.0%, zero active circuit interfacial delamination, zero unbaked water retention post-scan, and automated QA approval logged in the MES with attached raw C-SAM image archives.
