Position transducer above TSOP-54 package center and acquire A-scan RF waveform. 2. Identify primary front-surface reflection peak (T0). 3. Adjust time delay to locate mold-die interface reflection at ToF delta t1 (~160-200 ns). 4. Configure Gate 1 width to 25 ns centered on interface echo. 5. Enable dynamic peak-tracking threshold at 20% full-screen height (FSH). 6. Execute 100 µm raster step C-scan over 12 mm x 22 mm package area. | `A-scan RF signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) >= 26 dB; Gate 1 tracking jitter < ±1.5 ns across entire active die area (6.2 mm x 10.5 mm); 0% false delamination flags on standard calibrated flat-surface reference.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-2-2-02` | **Simultaneous Multi-Gate Resolution for Die-Attach and Leadframe Paddle Interfaces** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope equipped with multi-gate DSP hardware card capable of 4 independent hardware gates, 50 MHz transducer, calibrated step-wedge leadframe dummy. | 1. Set Gate 2 at ToF offset corresponding to silicon bulk transit (~50-60 ns after Gate 1). 2. Align Gate 2 width (30 ns) to capture die-to-die-attach adhesive interface. 3. Set Gate 3 at 45 ns width to capture die-attach to copper paddle interface. 4. Run automated C-mode scan at 50 µm resolution with simultaneous multi-channel phase and amplitude acquisition. 5. Process amplitude contrast maps and invert phase data to detect void reflections. | `Clear spatial separation between Gate 1, Gate 2, and Gate 3 echoes with zero mutual clipping; die-attach void resolution capability down to >= 50 µm equivalent diameter; detected void area reproducibility within ±3.0% over 5 repeated scans.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 374 compliant nitrile gloves (8 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 certified splash-proof chemical safety goggles, ESD-safe cleanroom lab coat (Class 10,000 / ISO 7 compliant), Closed-toe ESD-dissipative cleanroom footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with copious water at eyewash station for >= 15 minutes. Skin Contact: Wash affected area with mild soap and water. Inhalation (IPA vapors): Move person to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Rinse mouth thoroughly; do NOT induce vomiting; seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Immersion tank station equipped with local exhaust ventilation (LEV) maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) to vent evaporated IPA vapors during sample post-cleaning.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent immersion water containing surfactant must be routed to designated industrial wastewater/effluent collection for organic carbon degradation; waste IPA solvent collected in grounded hazardous solvent carboys for disposal via certified waste contractor.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Immersion Coupling Medium)** | `7732-18-5` | Ultra-Pure / ASTM Type I | `>= 99.999%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, Transducer Tip and Sample De-watering)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C4) | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Surfactant / Wetting Agent (Triton X-100 or Tergitol for Bubble Suppression)** | `9002-93-1` | Laboratory Reagent | `0.05% v/v in DI bath` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-mold cured TSOP-54 leadframe strips, degreased, dry, free of gross mold flash, stored at room ambient (22 ± 2 °C, RH < 40%).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thoroughly de-watered via clean dry air (CDA) blow-off and vacuum bake (60 °C, 30 min) to eliminate all absorbed moisture prior to electrical test or burn-in.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive wet immersion contact or delayed post-scan drying exceeding Q-time triggers moisture ingress into micro-gaps, causing pop-corning delamination during subsequent thermal solder reflow or lead finish plating.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Qualified and parameterized multi-gate time-of-flight C-SAM scan recipe for TSOP-54 DRAM packages, simultaneously mapping mold-die interface, die-attach layer, and paddle-mold interface at 75 MHz with automated phase-inversion void classification.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TSOP54_CSAM_MultiGate_Recipe_Rev1.0.rcp`
- [ ] `TSOP54_Acoustic_Interface_Metrology_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `TSOP54_Void_Delamination_Area_Distribution.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Acoustic ToF Gate 1 tracking stability at mold-to-die surface across full die topography** | `180.0 ns` | ± 2.0 ns | Automated oscilloscope time-domain peak analysis over 100-point raster grid across package surface. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Minimum spatial resolving capability for mold-die interfacial delamination defect size** | `45.0 um` | +5.0 / -0.0 um | Calibrated laser-drilled acoustic void calibration standard package evaluated per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-020 guidelines. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum allowable total interfacial delamination area at mold compound to active die face** | `0.00 %` | +0.50 % total area (critical perimeter exclusion zone = 0.00%) | Automated image segmentation and acoustic impedance pixel thresholding per MIL-STD-883 Method 2030. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful execution of 5 consecutive TSOP-54 DRAM test strips (total 100 units) demonstrating 100% gate alignment repeatability, zero acoustic false positives on known-good control dies, complete de-watering validation (< 0.05% weight increase post-bake), and formal sign-off by Lead Packaging Reliability Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-PKG-CSAM-003`
**Title:** Mold-Die and Die-Paddle Interface Phase-Inversion Delamination & Void Area Analysis  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA Package  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM)  
**Process Type:** Metrology & Quality Assurance  

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  C-SAM High-Frequency  │
│    Pulse Generation    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Acoustic Echo Gating  │
│      at Mold-Die       │
│       Interface        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Phase-Inversion     │
│     Polarity Check     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      C-Mode Echo       │
│  Amplitude Threshold   │
│      Segmentation      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Void & Delamination   │
│    Area Integration    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Disposition vs     │
│  Acceptance Criteria   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Acoustic Transducer Setup & Immersion Coupling**:
   - Submerge encapsulated TSOP-54 / FBGA-54 package in deionized (DI) water immersion tank at room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Select focused high-frequency acoustic transducer (nominal center frequency: $100\text{ MHz} - 230\text{ MHz}$) to achieve sub-surface axial resolution suited for packaging layers over 180nm DRAM dies.

2. **A-Scan Signal Calibration & Interface Gating**:
   - Align acoustic beam perpendicular to top mold compound surface.
   - Position **Gate 1** across the **Mold Compound-to-Die Surface interface** (active die surface with $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ bonding pads).
   - Position **Gate 2** across the **Die-to-Die Paddle / Substrate interface** (silver-filled conductive epoxy die-attach layer, Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ minutes}$).

3. **Phase-Inversion Polarity Analysis (Acoustic Impedance Reflection)**:
   - Calculate reflection coefficient: $R = \frac{Z_2 - Z_1}{Z_2 + Z_1}$.
   - **Bonded Interface ($Z_2 > Z_1$ or acoustic match)**: Epoxy mold compound ($Z \approx 3 - 6\text{ MRayls}$) to silicon die ($Z \approx 19.7\text{ MRayls}$) produces a positive reflection without phase inversion.
   - **Delamination / Void Interface ($Z_2 \ll Z_1$)**: Delamination gap or air/gas-filled void ($Z_{\text{air}} \approx 0.0004\text{ MRayls}$) exhibits acoustic mismatch with phase inversion (negative leading-edge polarity, $180^\circ$ phase shift) and near-100% echo reflection amplitude.

4. **Immersion C-Mode Raster Scanning & Spatial Mapping**:
   - Perform raster scan across total die area (covering 180nm memory array with $8F^2 / 6F^2$ cell architecture and peripheral circuitry).
   - Generate dual-color or grayscale C-mode acoustic maps based on peak echo amplitude and polarity sign (+ / -).

5. **Void & Delamination Area Quantitation**:
   - Segment phase-inverted pixels at both Gate 1 (mold-die) and Gate 2 (die-attach).
   - Compute total delamination/void area as a percentage of total die interface area:
     $$\text{Area}_{\text{void}} (\%) = \frac{\sum A_{\text{inverted\_pixels}}}{A_{\text{die}}} \times 100\%$$

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                  CSAM Metrology Acceptance Limits (%)
                         ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                         │                               │
 Wire Pull Interface Fail┤                               │
                         │                               │
      Mold-Die Delam Area┤                               │
     Max Single Void Area┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
                         │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
Max Total Die-Attach Void┤███████████████████████████████│
                         │███████████████████████████████│
                         └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                         0.0     1.2    2.5     3.8   5.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Acceptance Limit | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Total Die-Attach Void Area** | $< 5.0$ | $\%$ of total die area | C-SAM Gate 2 Acoustic Area Integration |
| **Mold-to-Die Surface Delamination** | $0.0$ (Zero allowable over active circuit & pad area) | $\%$ of active die area | C-SAM Gate 1 Phase-Inversion Detection |
| **Die-Attach Thermal Resistance ($R_{th}$)** | $\le 5.0$ | $^{\circ}\text{C/W}$ | Post-Scan Thermal Impedance Verification |
| **Wire Bond Interface Failure Rate** | $0$ (All breaks must occur in wire span at $\ge 4.0\text{ gf}$) | Interface breaks / lot | Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 Wire Pull Test |

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Context Citations

- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**:
  - *Die-attach voiding limit*: Silver-filled conductive epoxy (Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ min}$) must maintain thermal resistance $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$ with **total void area under die $< 5\%$** measured via acoustic microscopy.
  - *Bonding pad geometry*: Aluminum bond pad squares dimensioned at $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$; wire pull strength $\ge 4.0\text{ grams-force}$ with failure strictly within wire span.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Encapsulated silicon die features $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline stacked capacitor topology ($L=180\text{ nm}, W=220\text{ nm}$) requiring void-free package thermal dissipation to preserve junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Substrate and top-level metallization alignment on manufacturing grid ($0.005\,\mu\text{m}$) with $0.14\,\mu\text{m}$ metal minimum width interfacing pad metallurgy.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Acoustic wave propagation across heterogeneous package layers (EMC, Si die, Ag-filled die attach paste, Cu paddle) suffers from extreme acoustic impedance mismatch (Z_emc ~ 3.5-5.5 MRayl, Z_si ~ 19.7 MRayl, Z_paste ~ 5-8 MRayl, Z_cu ~ 44 MRayl). Phase inversion detection (+180° reflection shift from acoustic impedance drop Z2 < Z1 at an EMC-to-air/die delamination gap) requires precise ultrasonic gating (gate width < 15 ns) using a 100-230 MHz high-frequency transducer. Failure to isolate the front-side EMC-passivation interface from the backside die-paddle interface results in false-positive delamination calls, masking actual interfacial shear failure occurring during post-mold cure (PMC) thermal shrinkage.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Per J-STD-020E and J-STD-035, delamination criteria must distinguish between non-critical edge delamination and fatal interfacial voids propagating into the active DRAM 180nm top-metal pad pitch and scribe seal ring. When evaluating phase inversion at the mold-die interface, the acoustic reflection coefficient R = (Z2 - Z1)/(Z2 + Z1) transitions from positive (~0.60 for mold compound to silicon) to strongly negative (~ -1.0 for mold compound to trapped gas/air void). In TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA DRAM packages, total accumulated voiding exceeding 10% of the die-attach paddle area, or any single contiguous delamination bridging >2 adjacent bond pads along the perimeter, will cause bond wire necking and thermal-dissipation bottlenecking resulting in DRAM refresh degradation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: CSAM scanning throughput is notoriously slow (raster scan times of 8-15 minutes per single strip/tray at sub-5 um step sizes). Sourcing high-frequency acoustic transducers (100-230 MHz with focal length 0.25 to 0.5 inches) faces tight lead times (16-24 weeks) from specialized suppliers like Sonix, PVA TePla, or Nordson Sonoscan. For the DRAM Foundation VN Gen 3 MPW run, relying on full immersion deionized water tanks without automated wafer/tray loading will constrain metrology turnaround to under 20 packages per shift, necessitating statistical sampling (AQL 0.65 Level II) rather than 100% inline screening.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scheduling immersion CSAM immediately following Post-Mold Cure (PMC) creates a critical Q-time dependency before moisture sensitivity preconditioning (MSL Level 3 soak: 30°C / 60% RH for 192 hours) and reflow simulation (3x 260°C peak). If scanning cycle time exceeds 30 minutes in ambient cleanroom air without dry-pack or N2 cabinet staging, moisture ingress into incipient micro-voids alters acoustic boundary impedance, dampens RF return loss, and invalidates baseline delamination quantification prior to environmental stress screening.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Moisture entrapment inside mold-die interfacial micro-voids during DI water immersion scanning, falsely suppressing negative-phase RF echo inversion and creating latent steam-pressure 'popcorn' package cracking during subsequent 260°C solder reflow.
1. Acoustic gate drift and focal plane de-synchronization across warped thin packages (warpage > 75 um in 54-ball FBGA), causing acoustic gate clipping and misclassifying intact bulk mold compound or leadframe back-surfaces as interface delamination.
1. Ultrasonic beam scattering from high-filler-content spherical silica particles (>85 wt% SiO2 in low-CTE epoxy mold compound) degrading signal-to-noise ratio (SNR < 12 dB) at frequencies >150 MHz, obscuring phase reversal on micro-delaminations under 25 um diameter.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-2-3-01` | **Mold-to-Die Top Interface Acoustic Phase-Inversion and Delamination Area Mapping** | High-Frequency Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM) equipped with 150 MHz spherically focused transducer (Focal length = 0.5 inch, spot size ~ 18 um), motorized XYZ scanning stage with 0.5 um linear encoder resolution, ultra-pure degassed DI water coupling bath, and synchronized RF A-Scan waveform digitizer (>= 1.0 GSa/s sampling rate, 8-bit resolution). | 1. Fixture the package tray into the immersion scanning tank, ensuring sample top mold surface is parallel to the transducer scan plane (tilt < 5 um across package array). 2. Position the 150 MHz transducer over package center and adjust Z-height until the acoustic focal spot coincides precisely with the EMC-silicon active die interface. 3. Configure time-domain data gate: set gate start at the trailing edge of the mold bulk transit echo and gate width to 12.0 ns encompassing the die surface reflection. 4. Calibrate RF phase polarity against a polished bare Si calibration block (+ polarity / positive peak first = bonded intact interface). 5. Execute XY raster C-mode scan over the entire package active die area at 10.0 um step size, recording peak amplitude and RF waveform phase (positive vs. inverted negative first peak) per pixel. 6. critics.systems_engineer: Acoustic wave propagation across heterogeneous package layers (EMC, Si die, Ag-filled die attach paste, Cu paddle) suffers from extreme acoustic impedance mismatch (Z_emc ~ 3.5-5.5 MRayl, Z_si ~ 19.7 MRayl, Z_paste ~ 5-8 MRayl, Z_cu ~ 44 MRayl). Phase inversion detection (+180° reflection shift from acoustic impedance drop Z2 < Z1 at an EMC-to-air/die delamination gap) requires precise ultrasonic gating (gate width < 15 ns) using a 100-230 MHz high-frequency transducer. Failure to isolate the front-side EMC-passivation interface from the backside die-paddle interface results in false-positive delamination calls, masking actual interfacial shear failure occurring during post-mold cure (PMC) thermal shrinkage.
critics.domain_expert: Per J-STD-020E and J-STD-035, delamination criteria must distinguish between non-critical edge delamination and fatal interfacial voids propagating into the active DRAM 180nm top-metal pad pitch and scribe seal ring. When evaluating phase inversion at the mold-die interface, the acoustic reflection coefficient R = (Z2 - Z1)/(Z2 + Z1) transitions from positive (~0.60 for mold compound to silicon) to strongly negative (~ -1.0 for mold compound to trapped gas/air void). In TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA DRAM packages, total accumulated voiding exceeding 10% of the die-attach paddle area, or any single contiguous delamination bridging >2 adjacent bond pads along the perimeter, will cause bond wire necking and thermal-dissipation bottlenecking resulting in DRAM refresh degradation.
critics.supply_chain: CSAM scanning throughput is notoriously slow (raster scan times of 8-15 minutes per single strip/tray at sub-5 um step sizes). Sourcing high-frequency acoustic transducers (100-230 MHz with focal length 0.25 to 0.5 inches) faces tight lead times (16-24 weeks) from specialized suppliers like Sonix, PVA TePla, or Nordson Sonoscan. For the DRAM Foundation VN Gen 3 MPW run, relying on full immersion deionized water tanks without automated wafer/tray loading will constrain metrology turnaround to under 20 packages per shift, necessitating statistical sampling (AQL 0.65 Level II) rather than 100% inline screening.
critics.laya_pm: Scheduling immersion CSAM immediately following Post-Mold Cure (PMC) creates a critical Q-time dependency before moisture sensitivity preconditioning (MSL Level 3 soak: 30°C / 60% RH for 192 hours) and reflow simulation (3x 260°C peak). If scanning cycle time exceeds 30 minutes in ambient cleanroom air without dry-pack or N2 cabinet staging, moisture ingress into incipient micro-voids alters acoustic boundary impedance, dampens RF return loss, and invalidates baseline delamination quantification prior to environmental stress screening.
critical_failure_modes: Moisture entrapment inside mold-die interfacial micro-voids during DI water immersion scanning, falsely suppressing negative-phase RF echo inversion and creating latent steam-pressure 'popcorn' package cracking during subsequent 260°C solder reflow.

Acoustic gate drift and focal plane de-synchronization across warped thin packages (warpage > 75 um in 54-ball FBGA), causing acoustic gate clipping and misclassifying intact bulk mold compound or leadframe back-surfaces as interface delamination.

Ultrasonic beam scattering from high-filler-content spherical silica particles (>85 wt% SiO2 in low-CTE epoxy mold compound) degrading signal-to-noise ratio (SNR < 12 dB) at frequencies >150 MHz, obscuring phase reversal on micro-delaminations under 25 um diameter.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Die-Attach Void Fraction Quantification & Mil-Std-883 Interface Delamination Screening

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The acoustic impedance mismatch between the mold compound (Z ~ 3.0-3.5 MRayl), silicon die (Z ~ 19.7 MRayl), silver-filled epoxy die-attach (Z ~ 5.5-8.0 MRayl), and copper leadframe/substrate (Z ~ 44.3 MRayl) requires strict RF gate windowing. High attenuation in filled epoxy requires high-frequency transducers (>=100 MHz for sub-interface resolving) with acoustic focal depths aligned to within ±15 um of the bondline. Acoustic reflection phase inversion (180-degree phase shift) must be preserved in the A-scan acquisition to distinguish low-density cohesive adhesive voids from adhesive-delamination air gaps, preventing thermal dissipation bottlenecks from exceeding the junction temperature Tj max of 125 C.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Under MIL-STD-883 Method 2030 and J-STD-020 guidelines, total die-attach voiding must not exceed 10% of total die active area, single contiguous voids must not exceed 5%, and corner voiding must remain below 2.5% to avoid localized thermomechanical shear fractures during thermal shock cycling (-55 C to 150 C). Standard C-SAM imaging often exhibits boundary ringing artifacts at die paddle edges; edge-gating thresholding algorithms must be calibrated against destructive cross-sectional SEM/metallographic polish samples to prevent false-positive delamination calls on scalloped dicing kerfs.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Coupling deionized water used during acoustic immersion scanning introduces moisture absorption risks into MSL-3 rated TSOP-54 and 54-ball FBGA plastic packages. Transducer probe fixtures and high-frequency acoustic scan tanks require deaerated DI water (<2 ppm dissolved O2/N2) to eliminate micro-bubble scatter artifacts. Immediate post-scan dehydration bake ovens and vacuum dry-pack sealing must be integrated directly into the inline lot dispatch flow to prevent corrosion on exposed copper tie-bars and leadframes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Inline C-SAM throughput represents a severe cycle-time constraint if 100% screening is mandated. A multi-tier sampling protocol (AQL 0.4 Level II per MIL-STD-105E for standard lots, escalated to 100% C-mode screening only upon thermal impedance Theta-JC test excursions >15%) must be baselined. Scan times per unit must not exceed 45 seconds for a 54-ball FBGA footprint (8x14 mm) using multi-transducer array or high-speed linear drive systems.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal runaway and localized hot-spot induced junction breakdown due to die-attach voids concentrating heat flux under active high-current DRAM charge pumps and wordline drivers.
1. Popcorn cracking and die cracking during JEDEC reflow (260 C peak) caused by acoustic couplant water trapped in micro-fissures or unbaked hygroscopic mold compound.
1. Shear fatigue delamination propagation at the leadframe-to-die-attach interface under thermal cycling, severing perimeter ground bond wires.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-3-01` | **C-SAM Acoustic Phase Inversion & Die-Attach Total Void Area Quantification** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope (Sonix ECHO or PVA TePla SAM 400) equipped with 110 MHz / 12 mm focal length transducer, 500 MHz RF digitizer board, and deaerated DI water immersion tank | 1. Fixture encapsulated DRAM units in planarized scanning tray under immersion tank. 2. Align acoustic focus to the silicon die-to-die-attach adhesive interface using A-scan RF waveform tracking. 3. Set RF echo gate window width to 45 ns covering die-attach bond line. 4. Execute C-mode raster scan at 10 um step pitch across the 8x14 mm die area. 5. Process RF phase polarity: identify 180-degree phase reversed echoes indicative of air gaps (delamination/voids). 6. Run automated segmentation to calculate total void area fraction, largest single contiguous void fraction, and corner void fractions. | `Total die-attach void area <= 10.0% of die area; maximum single contiguous void area <= 5.0%; corner void area <= 2.5%; zero cohesive delamination exceeding 1.0 mm along active circuit boundary per MIL-STD-883 Method 2030.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-3-02` | **Post-Acoustic Dehydration Bake & Moisture Gravimetric Validation** | Cleanroom convection vacuum bake oven (Binder or Yamato), calibrated analytical microbalance (0.01 mg resolution, Mettler Toledo XPR26), ESD dry nitrogen desiccator cabinet | 1. Remove units from C-SAM tank and blot surface dry with lint-free cleanroom wipe. 2. Measure initial wet mass M_wet on analytical balance. 3. Transfer units to vacuum bake oven within 30 minutes of tank extraction. 4. Execute dehydration bake at 125 C ± 5 C for 24 hours under N2 purge. 5. Cool to 25 C in N2 desiccator (< 5% RH) and weigh dry mass M_dry. 6. Inspect leads and exposed paddle for oxidation or acoustic couplant residue under 50x optical microscope. | `Absorbed water mass loss (M_wet - M_dry) / M_dry <= 0.05% of total package mass; zero optical corrosion, staining, or dendrite formation on package pins/leads; package meets JEDEC J-STD-033 dry-pack compliance.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ASTM D6319), ANSI Z87.1 certified splash-resistant chemical safety goggles, Static-dissipative cleanroom smock and ESD wrist strap, Polyethylene aprons during tank cleaning and solvent wiping
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with IPA or surfactant solution, flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes at nearest emergency eye-wash station. For inhalation of IPA vapors, move exposed personnel to fresh air. If irritation or dizziness persists, seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Acoustic tank and IPA prep bench must be equipped with localized exhaust ventilation maintaining capture face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); room air exchange rate minimum 15 ACH with certified ISO Class 6 / Class 1000 cleanroom HVAC filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used acoustic tank DI water with surfactant traces must be collected into industrial wastewater neutralizer tanks; pH balanced to 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal drain release. Spent IPA solvent and contaminated wipes must be disposed of in labeled closed-top hazardous flammable waste drums per EPA RCRA regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Acoustic Couplant)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom Grade | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, Transducer & Tray Cleaner)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Non-ionic Surfactant (Wetting Agent / Bubble Eliminator)** | `9002-93-1` | Analytical Reagent | `0.05%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-mold cured TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA strips with deflashed leadframes, surface free from mold flash residue, dry and clean under ISO Class 6 environment.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Rinsed with deionized water, completely vacuum-baked at 125 C to zero residual acoustic couplant, moisture-sealed in barrier bags with desiccant per JEDEC J-STD-033.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Package moisture saturation beyond J-STD-020 MSL-3 thresholds resulting in internal interfacial delamination propagation, package popcorning during surface-mount soldering, or galvanic leadframe corrosion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Non-destructive C-SAM metrology verification confirms that all TSOP-54 and 54-FBGA DRAM packages meet MIL-STD-883 Method 2030 acceptance criteria, exhibiting total die-attach void fraction below 10%, contiguous void area below 5%, and absence of active-area edge delamination.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CSAM_DieAttach_VoidAnalysis_LotReport.pdf`
- [ ] `CSAM_Interface_Delamination_RawMap.tiff`
- [ ] `DieAttach_VoidFraction_Quantification_Matrix.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total die-attach void area fraction across the DRAM die footprint** | `<= 8.0%` | +2.0% upper bound (max 10.0% per MIL-STD-883) | Automated C-SAM A-scan thresholding and binary pixel integration over die area |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum contiguous void area fraction at die-to-leadframe interface** | `<= 3.5%` | +1.5% upper bound (max 5.0%) | Connected-component blob analysis on high-resolution C-mode acoustic image |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Package moisture content post-dehydration vacuum bake** | `<= 0.03 wt%` | +0.02 wt% (max 0.05 wt%) | Precision gravimetric weighing on calibrated microbalance pre- and post-bake |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero units failing MIL-STD-883 Method 2030 criteria across the sampled lot; verified absence of phase-inverted interface delamination on active DRAM pad regions; 100% completion of post-scan 125 C dehydration bake and vacuum dry-pack sealing with Lot Metrology Sign-Off.

Immediate post-scan dehydration bake ovens and vacuum dry-pack sealing must be integrated directly into the inline lot dispatch flow to prevent corrosion on exposed copper tie-bars and leadframes.
critics.laya_pm: Inline C-SAM throughput represents a severe cycle-time constraint if 100% screening is mandated. A multi-tier sampling protocol (AQL 0.4 Level II per MIL-STD-105E for standard lots, escalated to 100% C-mode screening only upon thermal impedance Theta-JC test excursions >15%) must be baselined. Scan times per unit must not exceed 45 seconds for a 54-ball FBGA footprint (8x14 mm) using multi-transducer array or high-speed linear drive systems.
critical_failure_modes: Thermal runaway and localized hot-spot induced junction breakdown due to die-attach voids concentrating heat flux under active high-current DRAM charge pumps and wordline drivers.
Popcorn cracking and die cracking during JEDEC reflow (260 C peak) caused by acoustic couplant water trapped in micro-fissures or unbaked hygroscopic mold compound.
Shear fatigue delamination propagation at the leadframe-to-die-attach interface under thermal cycling, severing perimeter ground bond wires.

testcases.title: C-SAM Acoustic Phase Inversion & Die-Attach Total Void Area Quantification
testcases.instrumentation: Scanning Acoustic Microscope (Sonix ECHO or PVA TePla SAM 400) equipped with 110 MHz / 12 mm focal length transducer, 500 MHz RF digitizer board, and deaerated DI water immersion tank
testcases.pre_conditions: TSOP-54 or 54-FBGA units post-mold cure; transducer acoustic beam calibrated using silicon-copper standard step wedge; DI water degassed to dissolved gas < 2.0 mg/L; A-scan focal gate positioned at die-attach to die interface
testcases.procedure: 1. Fixture encapsulated DRAM units in planarized scanning tray under immersion tank. 2. Align acoustic focus to the silicon die-to-die-attach adhesive interface using A-scan RF waveform tracking. 3. Set RF echo gate window width to 45 ns covering die-attach bond line. 4. Execute C-mode raster scan at 10 um step pitch across the 8x14 mm die area. 5. Process RF phase polarity: identify 180-degree phase reversed echoes indicative of air gaps (delamination/voids). 6. Run automated segmentation to calculate total void area fraction, largest single contiguous void fraction, and corner void fractions.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total die-attach void area <= 10.0% of die area; maximum single contiguous void area <= 5.0%; corner void area <= 2.5%; zero cohesive delamination exceeding 1.0 mm along active circuit boundary per MIL-STD-883 Method 2030.

testcases.title: Post-Acoustic Dehydration Bake & Moisture Gravimetric Validation
testcases.instrumentation: Cleanroom convection vacuum bake oven (Binder or Yamato), calibrated analytical microbalance (0.01 mg resolution, Mettler Toledo XPR26), ESD dry nitrogen desiccator cabinet
testcases.pre_conditions: Units completed C-SAM DI water immersion metrology within 15 minutes; dry nitrogen purge active at 20 SCFH in transfer desiccator
testcases.procedure: 1. Remove units from C-SAM tank and blot surface dry with lint-free cleanroom wipe. 2. Measure initial wet mass M_wet on analytical balance. 3. Transfer units to vacuum bake oven within 30 minutes of tank extraction. 4. Execute dehydration bake at 125 C ± 5 C for 24 hours under N2 purge. 5. Cool to 25 C in N2 desiccator (< 5% RH) and weigh dry mass M_dry. 6. Inspect leads and exposed paddle for oxidation or acoustic couplant residue under 50x optical microscope.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Absorbed water mass loss (M_wet - M_dry) / M_dry <= 0.05% of total package mass; zero optical corrosion, staining, or dendrite formation on package pins/leads; package meets JEDEC J-STD-033 dry-pack compliance.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ASTM D6319)
ANSI Z87.1 certified splash-resistant chemical safety goggles
Static-dissipative cleanroom smock and ESD wrist strap
Polyethylene aprons during tank cleaning and solvent wiping
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin or eye contact with IPA or surfactant solution, flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes at nearest emergency eye-wash station. For inhalation of IPA vapors, move exposed personnel to fresh air. If irritation or dizziness persists, seek immediate medical attention.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Acoustic tank and IPA prep bench must be equipped with localized exhaust ventilation maintaining capture face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); room air exchange rate minimum 15 ACH with certified ISO Class 6 / Class 1000 cleanroom HVAC filtration.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Used acoustic tank DI water with surfactant traces must be collected into industrial wastewater neutralizer tanks; pH balanced to 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal drain release. Spent IPA solvent and contaminated wipes must be disposed of in labeled closed-top hazardous flammable waste drums per EPA RCRA regulations.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Post-mold cured TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA strips with deflashed leadframes, surface free from mold flash residue, dry and clean under ISO Class 6 environment.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Rinsed with deionized water, completely vacuum-baked at 125 C to zero residual acoustic couplant, moisture-sealed in barrier bags with desiccant per JEDEC J-STD-033.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Package moisture saturation beyond J-STD-020 MSL-3 thresholds resulting in internal interfacial delamination propagation, package popcorning during surface-mount soldering, or galvanic leadframe corrosion.

expected_result.summary: Non-destructive C-SAM metrology verification confirms that all TSOP-54 and 54-FBGA DRAM packages meet MIL-STD-883 Method 2030 acceptance criteria, exhibiting total die-attach void fraction below 10%, contiguous void area below 5%, and absence of active-area edge delamination.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Frequency Transducer Calibration & Acoustic Time-of-Flight Gating Setup
**Module:** BEOL Packaging, Assembly & Metrology | **Package:** TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Signal Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Transducer       │
│   Selection: 50-100   │
│        MHz UHF        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Acoustic Immersion   │
│  and Focal Alignment  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Acoustic        │
│  Time-of-Flight ToF   │
│        Gating         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     A-Scan Phase      │
│       Inversion       │
│      Calibration      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  C-Mode Raster Scan   │
│   and Void Fraction   │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Immersion Setup & Fluid Degassing:**
   - Mount the packaged DRAM device (TSOP-54 or 54-ball FBGA containing the 180nm DRAM die cured with silver-filled conductive epoxy Ablebond 84-1LMIS) in the Scanning Acoustic Microscopy (CSAM) immersion fixture.
   - Fill the scanning immersion tank with high-purity deionized (DI) water maintained at room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$). Degas DI water to eliminate dissolved micro-bubbles prior to transducer immersion.

2. **Transducer Mounting & Axial Focal Alignment:**
   - Install a calibrated ultra-high-frequency (UHF) focused acoustic transducer in the range of **$50\text{ MHz}$ to $100\text{ MHz}$**.
   - Align the transducer perpendicular ($Z$-axis normal) to the package top surface.
   - Adjust the motorized $Z$-stage in RF pulse-echo mode until the peak of the reflection signal coincides with the acoustic focal length ($F_0$) at the die-attach interface plane beneath the silicon die.

3. **RF Signal Time-of-Flight (ToF) Gating Setup:**
   - On the primary A-scan oscilloscope display, identify the sequential reflection echoes:
     1. Package front mold compound surface echo.
     2. Mold compound / die surface interface echo (over the $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum pad and active silicon area).
     3. Silicon bulk / die-attach epoxy interface echo.
     4. Die paddle / lead frame rear echo.
   - Position the hardware electronic gate tightly around the **silicon bulk / die-attach epoxy interface echo**. 
   - Set the gate width ($\Delta t$) to track the exact acoustic Time-of-Flight window corresponding to the thickness variation of the cured silver-filled epoxy bondline.

4. **Phase Inversion & Polarity Calibration:**
   - Calibrate the phase inversion detector:
     - **Bonded Interface (Pass):** Acoustic impedance of silicon ($Z_{\text{Si}} \approx 19.7\text{ MRayls}$) transitioning into silver-filled epoxy ($Z_{\text{epoxy}} \approx 6\text{--}8\text{ MRayls}$) produces a standard positive reflected pulse.
     - **Delamination / Void (Fail):** Solid-to-air interface ($Z_{\text{air}} \approx 0.0004\text{ MRayls}$) produces an acoustic impedance mismatch where reflection coefficient $R \approx -1.0$, generating a **$180^\circ$ phase-inverted (negative) RF echo**.
   - Set the amplitude trigger threshold and color palette mapping (red = phase-inverted void/delamination, gray/black = bonded epoxy).

5. **C-Mode Raster Scan Execution & Interface Metrology:**
   - Initiate high-resolution $X$-$Y$ raster scan over the full die footprint area at a step resolution $\le 5\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Process the integrated gated peak amplitude array into the 2D C-mode acoustic image.
   - Execute automated pixel binary thresholding to compute the cumulative die-attach void fraction and check wire sweep compliance.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓      │
     Min Wire Pull (gf)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓      │
  Max Thermal Res (C/W)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Void Fraction Limit (%)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                       │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                       0.0     1.2    2.5     3.8   5.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Machine-Measurable Target | Specification Limit | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Die-Attach Total Void Area** | $< 5.0$ | $\le 5.0$ | $\%$ of total die footprint area |
| **Package Thermal Resistance ($R_{th}$)** | $\le 5.0$ | $\le 5.0$ | $^\circ\text{C/W}$ |
| **Wire Bond Pull Strength (Post-CSAM Validation)** | $\ge 4.0$ (Mil-Std-883 Method 2011) | $\ge 4.0$ (Span failure only) | $\text{grams-force (gf)}$ |
| **Bond Pad Footprint Clearance** | $100 \times 100$ | $100 \times 100$ | $\mu\text{m} \times \mu\text{m}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging:**
   - *Die-Attach Interface Specification:* Silver-filled conductive epoxy (Ablebond 84-1LMIS) cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ minutes}$. Thermal resistance $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$; acoustic microscopy void area under die $< 5\%$.
   - *Wire Bond & Pad Dimensions:* Bonding pads specified at $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum squares; Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 pull test force $\ge 4.0\text{ grams-force}$ for $25\,\mu\text{m}$ wire with failure in wire span.
   - *Operating Ambient:* Aluminum ultrasonic bonding operates at room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$).
2. **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects:**
   - Interconnect and pad metallization verified as aluminum film ($350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ thickness, $R_s < 0.08\,\Omega/\text{sq}$).
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - Core cell dimension validation ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requiring intact package integrity to guarantee retention and protect storage nodes ($C \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---
*Micro-knowledge note captured and saved at [`docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_calibration_tof_gating.md`](./docs/knowledge/csam_transducer_calibration_tof_gating.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Coupling high-frequency transducers (100 MHz to 230 MHz) for TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA C-mode scanning requires a rigid scanning bridge and sub-micron Z-axis positioning to avoid Abbe error during raster translation. The pulser-receiver RF bandwidth must comfortably exceed 300 MHz with digitizer sampling rates >= 1.0 GS/s to resolve nanosecond Time-of-Flight (ToF) separations between mold compound, die face, and die-attach layers without pulse overlap or phase distortion.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 100-230 MHz acoustic frequencies, acoustic attenuation in silica-filled epoxy mold compound (EMC) is exceptionally severe (> 10-15 dB/mm). Setting acoustic ToF electronic gates requires capturing both positive and negative RF phase inversions: an acoustically softer epoxy die-attach beneath silicon exhibits a phase reversal, whereas delamination/voiding presents an acoustic impedance mismatch approaching zero (air interface), causing total reflection with full phase inversion. Incorrect gate delay or window width will miss sub-surface micro-voids or yield false delamination calls.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial lead times for specialized high-frequency spherical focus transducers (such as Olympus/Evident or Sonix 100-230 MHz acoustic lenses with sapphire delay lines) extend up to 16-24 weeks. Second-sourcing options (PVA TePla, Insight) must be pre-qualified with identical focal length (0.25 to 0.50 inch) and F-number to avoid disruption to packaged DRAM screening schedules.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Transducer calibration and ToF gating setup must be locked before lot release. Calibration standards and automated gating recipes must run within a standard shift window (< 45 minutes calibration per lot) to prevent bottlenecking the final test/pack workflow for 180nm commercial MPW packaged DRAM units.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. ToF gating window drift due to coupling fluid (deionized water) bath temperature fluctuations (> 1.5 deg C shift alters acoustic velocity by ~3.7 m/s, shifting the interface echo out of the electronic gate window).
1. Micro-bubble entrapment on the acoustic transducer lens face causing acoustic impedance mismatch, acoustic beam dispersion, and severe signal-to-noise ratio attenuation (> 20 dB drop).
1. RF pulse overlap between the top-of-die reflection and die-attach interface echo when mold compound thickness varies across packages, resulting in undetected die-attach delamination.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-3-1-01` | **Acoustic Transducer Center Frequency and Bandwidth Verification** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM) pulser-receiver unit, 100-230 MHz focused acoustic transducer, 500 MHz / 2.5 GS/s digital storage oscilloscope, optical-grade quartz/silicon flat reference block, degassed DI water tank. | 1. Position the transducer normal to the polished optical flat reference reflector at focal distance. 2. Fire an impulse excitation pulse (pulse width <= 5 ns, energy 1-2 uJ). 3. Acquire the reflected RF time-domain A-scan waveform on the digitizer. 4. Perform an on-board Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on the reflected waveform to compute center frequency (Fc) and -6 dB fractional bandwidth. 5. Repeat across 10 consecutive acquisitions to calculate signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and coefficient of variation (CV). | `Center frequency must measure within +/- 5% of nominal rating (e.g., 95.0 to 105.0 MHz for 100 MHz transducer); -6 dB fractional bandwidth must exceed 50%; reflected echo SNR must be >= 35 dB; peak-to-peak amplitude repeatability CV must be < 1.0%.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-3-1-02` | **Acoustic Time-of-Flight Gate Alignment and Resolution across Die-Attach Stack** | High-frequency Scanning Acoustic Microscope with synchronized RF digitizer, calibrated TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA mechanical golden sample with laser-micromachined artificial void defects (25, 50, and 100 um). | 1. Collect raw RF A-scan through the mold compound and silicon die. 2. Set Gate 1 (die surface) tracking threshold at 20% full-scale deflection (FSD). 3. Set Gate 2 (die-attach interface) with hardware delay matched to die thickness ToF (approx. 200-250 ns depending on die thickness) and window width of 35 ns. 4. Perform C-mode raster scan across 5 mm x 5 mm die area at 5 um step size. 5. Measure contrast resolution, gate stability, and void boundary sharpness. | `Gate 2 must maintain 100% capture of the die-attach reflection across the entire die area with zero gate dropouts; artificial void size of 50 um must be resolved with contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) >= 6.0; spatial dimensional measurement accuracy within +/- 5 um.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Powder-free nitrile cleanroom gloves (Class 100 compatible, 4-mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom ESD-safe lab coat, Closed-toe ESD static-dissipative cleanroom footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For DI water: Non-hazardous; dry exposed skin. For Isopropanol: Eye contact: Immediately flush eyes with gently flowing water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical attention if irritation persists. Skin contact: Wash with soap and water. Inhalation: Move subject to fresh air. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical advice; seek urgent medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow recirculation (ISO Class 6/Class 1000). Local exhaust mini-hood for isopropanol wipe-down stations to maintain VOC vapor concentrations below 100 ppm OSHA PEL.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used DI water tank drainage routed to cleanroom acid/neutral industrial wastewater treatment system. Used isopropanol-saturated wipes collected in dedicated, sealed, fire-rated solvent waste cans for hazardous waste disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Immersion Couplant)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom Grade (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropanol (Wetting & Degreasing Agent)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / CMOS) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry, cured epoxy mold compound encapsulation (TSOP-54 / FBGA-54) post-mold cure (PMC at 175 deg C) with zero residual wax, mold flash, or particulate debris.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thoroughly dried under filtered N2 blow-off (< 0.2 um filter) with zero residual immersion moisture or water stains on package leads/solder balls; package surface moisture content < 0.05 wt%.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture ingress into micro-cracks or interfaces during acoustic water bath immersion will cause popcorning or delamination during subsequent board assembly reflow (J-STD-020 MSL classification violation) if package post-scan bake/dryout queue time is breached.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> High-frequency acoustic transducer calibrated, acoustic beam profile validated, and electronic ToF gating fully optimized to isolate and resolve TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA die-attach interface reflections without interference from package surface or EMC filler acoustic scattering.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `transducer_rf_calibration_spectrum_report.pdf`
- [ ] `tof_gating_alignment_recipe_tsop54.json`
- [ ] `golden_sample_interface_cscan_verification.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Transducer central frequency deviation from nominal design specification** | `100.0 MHz` | +/- 5.0 MHz | FFT spectral analysis of optical flat echo according to ASTM E1065 standard |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Measurement coefficient of variation (CV) for acoustic peak amplitude over 9-point calibration scan** | `0.65%` | <= 1.00% | Automated 9-point grid repetition on certified quartz standard using A-scan peak-to-peak tracking |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Minimum detectable artificial delamination/void diameter at die-attach interface** | `50.0 um` | +/- 5.0 um | C-scan image contrast quantification with contrast-to-noise ratio >= 6.0 per MIL-STD-883 Method 2030 |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Transducer center frequency, bandwidth, and SNR verified per ASTM E1065; electronic ToF gate recipe locked and demonstrated on golden calibration sample with 100% interface echo tracking; measurement repeatability CV < 1.0% across 9-point verification; approved by Metrology Lead and Packaging QA Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure: C-SAM Acoustic Raster Acquisition & Phase-Inversion Interface Echo Mapping

**Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm DRAM Chip Architecture & Integration)  
**Process Step**: Metrology / Packaging Inspection & Screening  
**Target Package**: TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA (180nm DRAM Die Attach)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sample Immersion in   │
│        DI Water        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Transducer Focus and  │
│      Echo Gating       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  X-Y Acoustic Raster   │
│        Scanning        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Phase-Inversion     │
│     Interface Echo     │
│       Separation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Die-Attach Void     │
│        Fraction        │
│     Quantification     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Sample Mounting & Acoustic Coupling Preparation**:
   - Clean the encapsulated DRAM package (TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA with Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured die attach) and clamp flat onto the scanning fixture.
   - Submerge the fixture in deaerated deionized (DI) water couplant at room temperature (25°C), ensuring zero air microbubbles adhere to the package surface or acoustic lens.

2. **Transducer Setup & Focal Alignment**:
   - Align the high-frequency acoustic transducer vertically over the package surface.
   - Adjust the Z-axis focus stage to bring the focal plane directly onto the silicon die-to-die attach epoxy interface.
   - Monitor the A-scan RF oscilloscope waveform to locate the primary surface echo and the secondary die-attach interface reflection.

3. **Time-Flight Gating & Phase Echo Discrimination**:
   - Position an electronic hardware gate tightly around the die-to-epoxy interface echo pulse.
   - Calibrate the phase-inversion echo detector:
     - **Bonded Interface**: High acoustic impedance (Si die) to lower acoustic impedance (Ablebond 84-1LMIS epoxy) yields a standard polarity echo.
     - **Delamination / Void Interface**: Die-to-air/vacuum interface creates a near-total reflection ($R \approx -1.0$) with an inverted $180^\circ$ phase polarity and high peak-to-peak amplitude.

4. **X-Y Acoustic Raster Scanning**:
   - Execute an X-Y scanning raster across the full active DRAM die area (encompassing pad arrays up to peripheral $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ aluminum bonding pads).
   - Record pixel-by-pixel peak amplitude and polarity phase flag into the C-mode acoustic raster map.

5. **Void Fraction Segmentation & Analysis**:
   - Segment pixels showing negative phase inversion and high reflected amplitude as delaminated/voided areas.
   - Compute the total void area percentage relative to the nominal silicon die footprint.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                         Physical Quality Targets       
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 Bond Pad Size (um)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Pull Force Min (gf)┤▒▒                                 │
                   │▒▒                                 │
Void Area Limit (%)┤░░░                                │
                   │░░░                                │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0       25      50       75     100 
```

1. **Total Die-Attach Void Area Fraction**: $< 5\%$ of total die footprint area under acoustic microscopy.
2. **Thermal Resistance Across Die Interface ($R_{\text{th}}$)**: $\le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$ for silver-filled conductive epoxy (Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 minutes).
3. **Post-Assembly Wire Bond Pull Strength**: $\ge 4.0\ \text{grams-force}$ (Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 for $25\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter wire), verifying non-destructive integrity above the $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ bonding pads.
4. **Channel Length Integrity ($L$)**: Access transistor channel dimension $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ preserved without stress-induced degradation.

---

### Verified Context Sources Citing
- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**:
  - Die-attach material: Silver-filled conductive epoxy (Ablebond 84-1LMIS) cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for 60 minutes.
  - Thermal resistance requirement: $R_{\text{th}} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$.
  - Void fraction criteria: Void area under die $< 5\%$ via acoustic microscopy.
  - Wire pull strength & pad geometry: Pull test force $\ge 4.0\ \text{grams-force}$ for $25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire per Mil-Std-883 Method 2011; bond pad size $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Transistor channel length: $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Acoustic impedance matching between the transducer, coupling fluid (ultra-pure deionized water), and the epoxy molding compound (EMC) is critical. At 100 MHz to 230 MHz UHF transducers, acoustic attenuation in silica-filled EMC exceeds 6 dB/mm, dictating precise electronic time-gain compensation (TGC) and rigorous A-scan gate positioning to avoid false-positive interface echo polarity detection across varying TSOP-54 package thicknesses.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Phase inversion at the mold compound-to-silicon or die-attach paddle interface is the definitive acoustic hallmark of delamination or voiding. A transition from positive acoustic impedance gradient (Z_EMC ~ 6.0 MRayls to Z_Si ~ 19.7 MRayls, zero phase flip) to negative gradient (Z_EMC to Z_air ~ 0.0004 MRayls, 180° phase flip) must be verified via RF A-scan waveform inversion analysis rather than relying solely on envelope peak amplitude thresholding.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: High-frequency ultrasonic transducers (especially 100-230 MHz with sapphire delay lines) have limited operational lifetimes due to cavitation erosion and piezoelectric element fatigue, with lead times exceeding 16 weeks. DI water bath immersion trays and vacuum-hold tooling for TSOP-54 and 54-ball FBGA must be modularized to avoid single-supplier vendor lock-in for commercial C-SAM platforms (e.g., Sonoscan/PVA TePla).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Raster acquisition throughput poses a bottleneck for post-mold reliability testing. A 0.5 um raster step size across a full 54-ball FBGA footprint (8 mm x 11 mm) takes over 4 minutes per unit; scanning protocols must balance raster pixel pitch (2-5 um for screening, sub-micron for localized failure analysis) to meet MIL-STD-883 Method 2030.2 lot-sampling cycle time constraints.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Transducer focal plane misalignment causing focal shift off the internal die-attach interface, resulting in phantom phase inversion signals and incorrect delamination classification.
1. Micro-bubble entrainment on package surface or transducer lens in immersion tank acting as total acoustic reflectors, mimicking package-level interfacial delamination.
1. Post-scan moisture ingress through uncured molding micro-fissures during water bath immersion, inducing popcorn cracking during downstream thermal profiling.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-3-2-01` | **A-Scan RF Waveform Phase-Inversion Verification at Die-to-Paddle Interface** | Scanning Acoustic Microscope (C-SAM) equipped with a 100 MHz / F# 2.0 piezoelectric immersion transducer, 500 MS/s RF digitizer, and 0.1 um precision X-Y-Z scanner stage. | 1. Position transducer normal to the package top surface. 2. Calibrate pulse-echo timing to identify the mold-silicon front interface reflection. 3. Gate the data acquisition window across the die-attach interface (width: 15 ns, delay tracked to die back surface). 4. Acquire raw RF A-scan waveforms at 5 designated intact calibration points and 5 known void/delamination areas. 5. Quantify the primary echo peak polarity, normalized reflection coefficient, and phase shift. | `Intact reference sites must exhibit positive polarity (zero phase inversion, reflection coefficient R > 0). Delaminated/void regions must exhibit a distinct 180° +/- 10° phase reversal (R < 0 with negative primary peak amplitude >= 70% of incident amplitude). False phase classification rate must be 0%.` |
| `TC-PLASTIC-ENCAPSULATION-3-2-3-2-02` | **High-Resolution C-Mode Interface Raster Echo Area Mapping & Delamination Quantification** | UHF C-SAM system operating in C-Scan reflection mode at 175 MHz center frequency with automated image processing and threshold segmentation software. | 1. Define scanning area covering full 8.0 mm x 11.0 mm FBGA die boundary with a 2.5 um raster step size. 2. Execute full bidirectional raster acoustic scan with time-gain compensation. 3. Generate color-coded phase-inversion C-SAM map (red = 180° inverted phase / air void, blue/green = non-inverted bonded interface). 4. Run automated pixel segmentation to calculate the contiguous and total void/delamination area percentage across the active die-attach area. | `Total interfacial delamination / void area must not exceed 10.0% of total die-attach area; single contiguous delamination zone must be < 5.0% of die-attach area; zero corner delamination propagating into wire-bonding exclusion zones as per MIL-STD-883 Method 2030.2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ASTM D6319), ANSI Z87.1 certified impact-resistant safety glasses, Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom coat, ESD-protective cleanroom booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For IPA eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes. For IPA skin contact: Wash affected area with soap and water. For vapor inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air. Ultrapure water poses no chemical toxicity hazards.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating HEPA filtration (ISO Class 6 / FED-STD-209E Class 1000). Local exhaust mini-hood for IPA bench-wiping stations providing minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA rags and solvent wipes disposed of in sealed, fire-rated hazardous flammable waste bins. DI water immersion bath drained via standard industrial acid-waste/neutralization drain system.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Immersion Acoustic Couplant)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (Ultrapure) | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (Pre-scan Surface Degreaser)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `>= 99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-mold cured, degated, deflashed, dry, clean, and free of molding residue, grease, and micro-particles.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Acoustically inspected, spin-rinsed, forced-N2 dried, baked at 125 °C for 2 hours to eliminate moisture, and stored in moisture barrier bags (MBB) with desiccant.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive post-C-SAM immersion dwell in ambient air promotes moisture absorption by the epoxy molding compound (MSL3 violation), causing acoustic shadow artifacts and interfacial popcorn cracking during reflow.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full non-destructive C-SAM C-Mode acoustic raster acquisition and RF phase-inversion mapping completed across TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA DRAM packages, identifying die-attach voids and leadframe delamination with sub-micron spatial resolution conforming to MIL-STD-883 Method 2030.2.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CSAM_TSOP54_DieAttach_Acoustic_Map.tiff`
- [ ] `RF_AScan_PhaseInversion_Waveform_Traces.csv`
- [ ] `MilStd883_Interface_Delamination_Screening_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Phase inversion detection accuracy between void (air) and bonded epoxy-silicon interfaces** | `180` | +/- 10 deg | Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and cross-correlation phase analysis of digitized raw 500 MS/s RF A-scan waveforms at acoustic gates |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum allowable total die-attach interfacial void fraction across packaged DRAM footprint** | `10.0` | <= 10.0 % (max) | Automated binary threshold segmentation of C-SAM acoustic raster map normalized to calibrated active die area |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Spatial lateral raster resolution for micro-delamination defect boundary delineation** | `2.5` | +/- 0.2 um | Optical Ronchi ruling acoustic calibration target scanning using 175 MHz UHF transducer |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All sampled TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA packages undergo full acoustic raster acquisition with zero bubble artifacts; phase-inversion RF gates verified against gold reference; quantitative void fractions comply with <= 10.0% total area and 0% corner leadframe delamination; post-inspection bake-out to < 0.05 wt% moisture completed; formalized inspection report signed off by Metrology and Quality Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Void Fraction Image Segmentation & MIL-STD-883 Method 2030 Screening

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  C-SAM Acoustic Scan   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acoustic Echo Gating  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Otsu/Threshold     │
│      Segmentation      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   MIL-STD-883 Method   │
│     2030 Screening     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Acoustic Bath Preparation & Immersion**:
   - Submerge encapsulated TSOP-54 / 54-ball FBGA DRAM packages into a temperature-stabilized deionized (DI) water acoustic immersion tank at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Ensure bubble-free acoustic coupling between the high-frequency ultrasonic transducer and package surface.

2. **C-Mode Acoustic Echo Time-Gating**:
   - Configure C-SAM in reflection mode.
   - Adjust the receiver time-of-flight gate precisely across the boundary between the $180\text{ nm}$ DRAM silicon die bottom and the silver-filled conductive epoxy die-attach interface (Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ min}$).

3. **C-Scan Acoustic Map Acquisition**:
   - Perform raster scanning over the active die footprint area ($A_{\text{die}}$).
   - Capture echo amplitude matrix where acoustic impedance mismatch between epoxy and air voids produces maximum phase inversion and high peak-to-peak reflection amplitudes.

4. **Automated Image Segmentation & Void Quantification**:
   - Ingest raw C-scan amplitude image into automated image processing pipeline.
   - Apply boundary masking to delineate the full silicon die perimeter.
   - Execute threshold segmentation (e.g. Otsu / high-reflectance threshold) to isolate void and delamination regions.
   - Compute total void fraction metric:
     $$\text{Void Fraction} = \left( \frac{\sum A_{\text{void}}}{A_{\text{die}}} \right) \times 100\%$$

5. **MIL-STD-883 Method 2030 Disposition**:
   - Compare segmented void fraction and maximum contiguous single-void area against screening threshold limits.
   - Flag packages failing total void limits or localized stress concentrations for isolation/rejection.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text

                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░       │

     Die R_th (C/W)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
```
